title: Noob Warrior
description: This mod adds different abilities to Minecraft which can be used with mana.
body:
# Noob Warrior

**Noob Warrior** is a lightweight RPG-style ability mod for Minecraft 1.21.5 (26.1.2) that adds a mana system and unlockable combat/support abilities. It requires Fabric Loader >=0.19.3 and Fabric API.

---

## Why Install It?

Vanilla combat is straightforward — left-click to attack, right-click (with a shield) to block. Noob Warrior adds **skill-based mechanics** that give you more options in combat and exploration without overhauling the entire game. Abilities are earned through gameplay, consume a resource (mana), and require timing and awareness to use effectively. It's designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla.

---

## Mana System

Every player starts with a mana pool of **5**. Key mechanics:

- **Passive regen**: 1 mana per minute
- **Food**: Eating any food gives 0.5–1.5 mana (based on nutrition)
- **Sleep**: Waking from bed refills mana to maximum
- **Max mana**: Permanently expandable by consuming Mana Ore (+5) or Purified Mana (+20)

---

## Abilities

Abilities are permanent unlocks. To obtain one, enchant a book at an enchanting table (the ability enchantments appear randomly). Right-click the enchanted book to consume it and learn the ability.

Cycle between your unlocked abilities with **Ctrl + Scroll Wheel** and activate with **R** (customizable in key bindings).

### Jump
- **Cost**: 0.5 mana
- **Effect**: Launches you 8 blocks forward and 3 blocks upward
- **Restriction**: Can only be used while on the ground
- **Use case**: Quick vertical mobility, escaping danger, reaching high places

### Critical Hit
- **Cost**: 3 mana
- **Effect**: Launches you upward, applies Strength VIII for during the ability
- **Requirement**: Must be holding a sword or axe
- **Restriction**: Can only be activated while airborne
- **Visual**: Orange/yellow border glow appears while active
- **Use case**: Powerful aerial attacks

### Mob Inspector
- **Cost**: 0.1 mana per tick (while looking at a mob)
- **Effect**: Displays the target mob's name, health, attack damage, and active potion effects on its name tag
- **Use case**: Assessing threats, finding weakened enemies, checking ally status

---

## Items

### Mana Ore
- **Recipe**: 4 diamonds (cross pattern) + 1 netherite scrap
- **Effect**: Eating it permanently increases max mana by 5
- **Animation**: Standard eating animation

### Purified Mana
- **Recipe**: 8 diamonds (full ring) + 1 enchanted golden apple
- **Effect**: Right-click instantly consumes and permanently increases max mana by 20
- **Animation**: Custom blue soul-flame particles + totem-style item activation animation
- **Note**: Does not use the eating animation — instant use

### Mana Tome
- **Obtain**: Creative tab
- **Effect**: Right-click opens an info screen listing all abilities with their descriptions and mana costs
- **Navigation**: Arrow keys or page buttons to flip through pages

### Ability Book
- **Obtain**: Enchant a book at an enchanting table
- **Effect**: Right-click consumes the book and permanently grants the contained ability
- **Visual**: Automatically gains a custom book model when it contains an ability enchantment

---

## HUD Elements

- **Selected ability**: Displays the currently selected ability name at the bottom-right of the screen (with a semi-transparent background)
- **Critical Hit overlay**: Orange/yellow border with rounded corners while critical hit mode is active

---

## Commands

All commands require operator privileges:

- `/ability give <player> <ability_id>` — grants an ability
- `/ability remove <player> <ability_id>` — removes an ability
- `/ability list <player>` — lists all abilities a player owns
- `/mana get [player]` — shows current mana
- `/mana set <player> <amount>` — sets mana
- `/mana add <player> <amount>` — adds mana
- `/mana-limit get [player]` — shows max mana
- `/mana-limit set <player> <amount>` — sets max mana
- `/mana-limit add <player> <amount>` — increases max mana

---

## Miscellaneous

- **Multiplayer compatible**: All features work on dedicated servers
- **Creative mode bypass**: Creative players can use abilities without consuming mana
- **Abilities screen**: Accessible from the pause menu — shows owned and all available abilities
- **Fabric API dependency**: Required

## Check out my other projects:
[Mythralite](https://modrinth.com/mod/mythralyte) | [Housing Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/housing-plus)

title: WarpPortals
description: Highly customizable warp system with animated portals
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4969527d98d8eafa2fcac37e8be0d74de2b99304.png) ![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03f8b5577e60752c7dce75012532f42ef679c35f.png) > WarpPortals is designed for servers that want warp travel to feel intentional, configurable and polished instead of being just another instant teleport command. You can keep classic `/warp` behavior, turn warps into animated portal travel, or mix both styles depending on the command, warp, rank or server area. | Good for | Why it fits | | --- | --- | | Spawn and hub travel | Create clean shortcuts like `/spawn` and `/hub`. | | VIP destinations | Protect individual warps with custom permissions. | | Economy servers | Charge for direct teleporting, portal creation, or both. | | Survival servers | Add a no-move timer before teleporting. | | RPG and dungeon areas | Use portals when instant teleporting feels too flat. | | Server networks | Configure different behavior per shortcut without writing extra plugins. | Every saved warp stores the destination position and player rotation, so players arrive facing the direction you prepared. Portal visuals, sounds, timing, access rules, messages and costs can all be adjusted from configuration files.
Portal Feature Preview ![Portal preview](https://github.com/GDLev/GDLev/blob/main/assets/plugin_preview.gif?raw=true)
## Commands ![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ee18d67e24dcc01aa4676b61a5e4254bf8a033c.png) Most server owners will use three simple workflows: | Workflow | What you do | | --- | --- | | Player travel | Players use `/warp ` for direct travel or `/portal ` for portal travel. | | Warp management | Admins create and remove saved destinations. | | Access and pricing | Admins set costs, custom permissions and reload the plugin. | > If direct warp teleport is disabled in config, `/warp ` automatically opens a portal instead.
Command behavior notes ### Player Travel Players use `/warp ` for normal warp travel and `/portal ` when they should open an animated portal. ### Warp Management Admins create warps by standing at the destination and running `/warpportals setwarp `. The plugin saves the world, coordinates, yaw and pitch. Warps can be removed later with `/warpportals delwarp `. ### Access And Pricing Admins can set separate prices for direct teleporting and portal creation. They can also attach a custom permission to a warp, which makes it easy to create rank-only destinations without making multiple command aliases or separate config sections. After editing config, storage, messages or custom commands, use `/warpportals reload` to refresh the plugin without restarting the server.
--- ## Permissions ![Permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/876dd97bc53917281a40d1c8c048d291008aa1a5.png)
Permission Copy-Paste | Permission name | Permission description | | --- | --- | | warpportals.admin | All WarpPortals permissions. | | warpportals.command.help | Show the help menu. | | warpportals.command.version | Show the plugin version. | | warpportals.command.portal | Open portals. | | warpportals.command.teleport | Use direct warp teleport. | | warpportals.command.setwarp | Create warps. | | warpportals.command.delwarp | Delete warps. | | warpportals.command.reload | Reload the plugin. | | warpportals.command.cost | Edit warp costs. | | warpportals.command.setperm | Edit custom warp permissions. | | warpportals.cost.bypass | Bypass teleport and portal costs. |
The default permission setup is intentionally simple: | Group type | Suggested permissions | | --- | --- | | Normal players | `warpportals.command.teleport`, `warpportals.command.portal` | | VIP players | Normal player permissions plus custom warp permissions like `warpportals.warp.vip` | | Staff | Admin command permissions for creating, deleting, pricing and reloads | | Trusted users | `warpportals.cost.bypass` if they should ignore costs |
Example rank setup ```text default: warpportals.command.teleport warpportals.command.portal vip: warpportals.command.teleport warpportals.command.portal warpportals.warp.vip admin: warpportals.admin ``` Custom warp permissions are not hardcoded. You can use any permission string you want, then assign it through your permissions plugin.
--- ## Configuration WarpPortals uses three main configuration areas: | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `config.yml` | Global behavior, portals, sounds, timers and custom commands. | | `storage.yml` | Saved warps, warp permissions and per-warp costs. | | `messages/*.yml` | Language files and MiniMessage-formatted messages. |
Essential configuration ### Global Teleport Settings ```yaml teleport: delay-seconds: 3 cancel-on-move: true title: true actionbar: false ``` Set `delay-seconds` to `0` to disable the timer. Any value above `0` enables the warmup before teleporting. ### Direct Warp Or Portal Warp ```yaml commands: direct-warp-teleport: true ``` When this is `true`, `/warp ` teleports directly. When this is `false`, `/warp ` opens a portal instead. ### Optimizations ```yaml optimizations: cache-warps: true shared-particle-scheduler: true portal-spatial-index: true cache-portal-calculations: true cache-settings: true cache-vault-provider: true ``` These advanced settings are enabled with defaults suitable for most servers. Change them only when profiling or a specific server setup shows that a different mode works better. ### Portal Settings ```yaml portal: protection-mode: block material: TINTED_GLASS width: 1.25 height: 2.5 distance-from-player: 1.5 min-distance: 10 animation-enabled: true use-display-transitions: true animation-ticks: 10 hold-ticks: 60 ``` `portal.min-distance` prevents players from opening a portal when they are already too close to the destination. Set it to `0` to disable that check. `portal.use-display-transitions` lets Minecraft clients animate each display entity from a start transform to an end transform. Disable it only when you need the legacy server-side animation updated every tick.
Saved warp example ```yaml warps: vip: world: world x: 120.5 y: 70.0 z: -40.5 yaw: 180.0 pitch: 0.0 permission: warpportals.warp.vip costs: teleport: enabled: true type: xp amount: 100 item: DIAMOND portal: enabled: true type: item amount: 5 item: DIAMOND ``` The `permission` field is optional. Leave it empty if every player with warp access can use that destination.
Cost types | Type | Meaning | | --- | --- | | `xp` | Removes raw experience points. | | `level` | Removes experience levels. | | `vault` | Removes money through Vault economy. | | `item` | Removes items from the player's inventory. | | `none` | Disables the cost. | Teleport and portal costs are separate, so opening a portal can be priced differently from using direct teleport.
Custom command example ```yaml custom-commands: spawn: aliases: - hub warp: spawn mode: direct delay-seconds: 0 cooldown-seconds: 0 message: "" cost: enabled: false type: xp amount: 0 item: DIAMOND ``` Use `mode: direct` for instant or timer-based teleporting. Use `mode: portal` when the command should open a portal.
Languages English and Polish are included by default: ```yaml language: en_us ``` ```yaml language: pl_pl ``` You can add your own language file in the `messages` folder. Missing keys are copied from English when the plugin reloads.
--- ## Q&A
Warp creation and basic travel ### How do I create a new warp? Stand where players should arrive and run: ```text /warpportals setwarp spawn ``` The plugin saves the location, world, yaw and pitch. ### How do I make `/warp` open portals instead of teleporting directly? ```yaml commands: direct-warp-teleport: false ``` After reload, `/warp ` will open a portal. ### How do I keep `/warp` as a normal teleport command? ```yaml commands: direct-warp-teleport: true ```
Teleport timer ### How do I create a warp with a delay? Set the global delay: ```yaml teleport: delay-seconds: 3 cancel-on-move: true ``` Players will need to wait 3 seconds before direct teleporting. If `cancel-on-move` is enabled, moving cancels the teleport. ### How do I disable the delay? ```yaml teleport: delay-seconds: 0 ```
VIP and custom permissions ### How do I make a warp only for VIP players? Create the warp: ```text /warpportals setwarp vip ``` Assign a permission: ```text /warpportals setperm vip warpportals.warp.vip ``` Then give `warpportals.warp.vip` to your VIP group. ### How do I remove the VIP requirement from a warp? ```text /warpportals setperm vip reset ``` ### How do I manually edit a warp permission? Open `storage.yml` and edit: ```yaml warps: vip: permission: warpportals.warp.vip ``` Use an empty string to make it unrestricted: ```yaml permission: "" ```
Costs and economy ### How do I charge XP for teleporting? ```text /warpportals cost spawn teleport xp 100 ``` ### How do I charge XP for opening a portal? ```text /warpportals cost spawn portal xp 100 ``` ### How do I charge levels? ```text /warpportals cost spawn teleport level 10 ``` ### How do I charge Vault money? ```text /warpportals cost spawn teleport vault 20 ``` Vault and an economy plugin must be installed. ### How do I charge items? ```text /warpportals cost spawn portal item 5 DIAMOND ``` This charges 5 diamonds when opening a portal. ### How do I remove a cost? ```text /warpportals cost spawn teleport none 0 ``` For portal costs: ```text /warpportals cost spawn portal none 0 ``` ### How do I let staff bypass all costs? Give them: ```text warpportals.cost.bypass ```
Custom commands ### How do I create `/spawn`? ```yaml custom-commands: spawn: warp: spawn mode: direct delay-seconds: 0 ``` ### How do I make `/hub` also run the spawn warp? ```yaml custom-commands: spawn: aliases: - hub warp: spawn mode: direct ``` ### How do I make a specific shortcut open a portal? ```yaml custom-commands: dungeon: warp: dungeon mode: portal ``` Players can then use `/dungeon` to open a portal to that warp. ### How do I add a cooldown to a custom command? ```yaml custom-commands: spawn: warp: spawn mode: direct cooldown-seconds: 30 ``` ### How do I add a custom success message? ```yaml custom-commands: spawn: warp: spawn mode: direct message: "Teleported to <#e23a6f>spawn." ```
Portal-only setups ### How do I make a warp available only through a portal? Use portal mode for the command players should use: ```yaml custom-commands: dungeon: warp: dungeon mode: portal ``` Then do not give those players `warpportals.command.teleport`, or keep direct `/warp` usage for staff only. ### How do I disable portals completely for a group? Do not give that group: ```text warpportals.command.portal ``` If `/warp` is configured to open portals, also keep `commands.direct-warp-teleport: true` for groups that should only use direct teleport.
Portal distance and protection ### How do I stop players from opening a portal too close to the target? ```yaml portal: min-distance: 10 ``` If the entrance portal would be closer than 10 blocks to the destination portal, it will not open. ### How do I disable that distance check? ```yaml portal: min-distance: 0 ``` ### How do I prevent duplicate active portals? ```yaml portal: protection-mode: block ``` ### How do I replace the old portal when a new one opens? ```yaml portal: protection-mode: replace ```
Portal travel rules ### How do I make portals one-way? ```yaml portal: teleport: one-way: true ``` ### How do I allow everyone to walk through a portal? ```yaml portal: teleport: only-owner: false ``` ### How do I make portals work only for the creator? ```yaml portal: teleport: only-owner: true ``` ### How do I close portals after the creator uses them? ```yaml portal: teleport: close-after-owner-use: true ```
Portal visuals and timing ### How do I change portal size? ```yaml portal: width: 1.25 height: 2.5 depth: 0.1875 ``` ### How do I change how far the entrance portal appears from the player? ```yaml portal: distance-from-player: 1.5 ``` ### How do I change the portal animation speed? ```yaml portal: animation-enabled: true use-display-transitions: true animation-ticks: 10 ``` Set `animation-enabled` to `false` to make portals appear and disappear immediately. Lower `animation-ticks` values are faster, while higher values are slower. ### How do I change how long portals stay open? ```yaml portal: hold-ticks: 60 ``` 20 ticks equals 1 second.
Sounds ### How do I disable a sound? Use `none`: ```yaml portal: sounds: open: sound: none ``` ### How do I change teleport sounds? ```yaml teleport: sounds: complete: sound: ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP volume: 1.0 pitch: 2.0 cancel: sound: BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS volume: 1.0 pitch: 0.6 ``` ### How do I change portal sounds? ```yaml portal: sounds: open: sound: BLOCK_PORTAL_TRIGGER volume: 0.7 pitch: 1.6 close: sound: BLOCK_PORTAL_TRAVEL volume: 0.4 pitch: 1.8 ```
Reloading and language files ### How do I reload the plugin? ```text /warpportals reload ``` Reload refreshes config, storage, messages and custom commands. ### What happens if config or message files are missing? The plugin recreates missing config and message files on startup or reload. ### Can I add another language? Yes. Create a file such as: ```text messages/de_de.yml ``` Then set: ```yaml language: de_de ``` Missing keys will be copied from English.
## EXPECT BUGS I tried to anticipate every possible scenario that could cause errors or bugs, but testing it alone might have missed something. If you find a bug, PLEASE report it immediately to the issue tracker on the project's GitHub pin or on my Discord. Thank you ❤️ > If you find this plugin helpful, unique, or simply cool, please consider supporting me by following the project on Modrinth. If you’d like to offer even more support, you can also check out my Ko-fi. Every bit of support motivates me to keep working on this plugin. [![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/gdlev)

title: Super Item Zene
description: The mod adds (for now) four sets of armor and tools. It also includes an ore that can be used to obtain ingots of a new material called Zenium.
body:
# Super Items Zene 🌌🔥🧪

Welcome to Super Items Zene, an endgame expansion that overhauls your survival progression! This mod introduces a high-tier ecosystem of unique resources, ultimate sets of enchanted gear, and innovative survival mechanics. Embark on a journey from a rookie miner to a powerful warrior, mastering cosmic space and hellish heat.

## 💎 Features

### 🌌 Tier 1 & 2: The Aymond Progression
Discover Aymond, a rare and powerful cosmic crystal found in the world.
* **Base Set:** Craft highly durable weapons, armor, and tools that surpass traditional diamond gear.
* **Enhanced Set:** Take your gear to the next level. Crafting Enhanced Aymond tools automatically bestows them with permanent, high-tier enchantments (Efficiency V and Unbreaking III) straight from survival crafting!

### 🌋 Tier 3: Nether Aymond & End Aymond
Take your Aymond tools into other dimensions. Upgrade your gear using hellish alloys and ender blocks to create the ultra-fast and incredibly durable Nether Aymond and End Aymond weapon tiers.

### 🖤 The Zenium Element & True Damage
Delve into the deepest, hottest layers of the Nether to discover Zenium Ore.
* **Zenium Sword:** Forged from high-grade hell steel, this weapon possesses the terrifying ability to deal True Magic Damage, completely bypassing conventional armor defenses.
* **Zenium Armor Set:** Heavy armor plates that grant the wearer absolute immunity to fire and lava damage, allowing you to safely explore the Nether's lava lakes.

title: MonumentWaypoints
description: An easy way to create teleportation waypoints!
body:
# 🗺️ Monument Waypoints

**Player-owned teleport waypoints with taxes, permissions and a clean GUI.**

Let your players build, manage and even earn money from their own teleport points! Monument Waypoints brings a complete waypoint system to your server – including a tax system, trust/access management, search, promotion, and full Bedrock support.

---

## ✨ Features

- 📍 **Player-Owned Waypoints** – Players receive a Waypoint Item (Recovery Compass) they can place to create their own teleport point.
- 🔓 **Public or Private** – Waypoints can be made public or kept private.
- 🤝 **Trust System** – Grant individual players access to your private waypoints.
- 💰 **Custom Tax per Waypoint** – Owners can set a usage fee (tax) that's automatically paid to them whenever someone teleports there.
- 🏦 **Server Fees** – Configurable server fee, either as a fixed price or distance-based (with a max cap).
- 📈 **Promotion System** – Waypoints can be "promoted" for a fee to appear in a dedicated promoted list.
- 🏛️ **Server Waypoints** – Admins can create their own permanent server waypoints.
- 🔍 **Search** – Players can search public waypoints by name.
- ⏱️ **Teleport Warmup** – Configurable warmup time, cancels if the player moves.
- 🖥️ **Clean GUI** – Dedicated menus for your own waypoints, public waypoints, server waypoints, and promoted waypoints.
- 📱 **Bedrock Support** – Full Floodgate/Geyser support, including dedicated forms for Bedrock players.
- 🌐 **Multi-Language** – German and English included out of the box, easy to extend.
- 🔧 **Fully Configurable** – All messages, prices, GUI titles, and limits can be adjusted in `config.yml`.

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

| Plugin | Required |
|---|---|
| **Vault** | ✅ Yes (for economy features) |
| **Floodgate** | ⬜ Optional (for Bedrock support) |
| **Geyser-Spigot** | ⬜ Optional (for Bedrock support) |

> 🟢 Supports API version **1.20**

---

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/mw` | Opens the Monument Waypoints main menu |

*(Alias: `/monumentwaypoints`)*

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `monumentwaypoints.use` | `true` | Allows using the waypoint features |
| `monumentwaypoints.admin` | `op` | Admin access (e.g. server waypoints, reload) |

---

## 📋 Example Configuration

```yaml
waypoint:
  default-public: true
  default-tax: 13.0
  max-tax: 1000.0
  max-public-waypoints-per-player: 10
  marker-material: "LODESTONE"

server-fee:
  mode: "FIXED"
  fixed-price: 5.0
  distance-price-per-block: 0.05
  distance-max-price: 250.0
```

---

## 💡 How It Works

1. A player gets the **Waypoint Creator** item via `/mw` (or your shop).
2. They place it on a block – a **Lodestone marker** appears above it and the waypoint is created.
3. The owner can make the waypoint public, set a tax, or grant trusted access to specific players.
4. Other players find the waypoint through the GUI or search and teleport there – paying the server fee and, if applicable, the owner's tax.

---

## 📜 License & Support

For questions, bugs, or feature requests, feel free to open an issue on Modrinth! 🐛

**Enjoy Monument Waypoints!** 🚀

title: Create: Pipes
description: Create addon that adds item pipes with side modes, filters, and network control.
body:
# Create: Pipes

Create: Pipes is a Create addon for item transport.

The idea is simple: pipes move items around like Mekanism logistical transporters, but built to feel like they belong next to Create machines.

This is still an MVP. It works, but it is not trying to be a full logistics mod yet.

## What It Adds

- Steam Item Pipes for moving items between inventories
- per-side pipe modes: Normal, Pull, Push, and None
- Create wrench support for cycling pipe side modes
- Create filter support on pull and push sides
- a Network Control Tool that can turn a whole connected pipe network on or off
- server-side routing that retries instead of voiding items when a route fills or breaks

## Current State

Steam is planned, but it is not required by default right now.

The default config is:

```toml
require_steam = false
```

That means pipes work without steam intakes for now. The steam side is planned as the balance hook later, once it has had more testing and polish.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.233 or newer for 1.21.1
- Create 6.0.10

## Notes

This mod does not copy or redistribute Create's reserved assets. Create is required as a dependency.

## Planned

- proper steam-powered mode
- better visuals
- more testing on large networks
- more routing options after the core pipe behavior is solid

title: Ence size
description: Aspect-ratio mod by ence.studio
body:
# ence-size

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/ence-size?style=for-the-badge&color=248046)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ence-size)
[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ence-size)
[![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://fabricmc.net/)

**ence-size** is a premium, client-side Minecraft mod designed to let you adjust your in-game aspect ratio on the fly. Whether you want to preview how your build looks in ultra-widescreen, simulate cinematic camera setups, or play with custom stretched resolutions, **ence-size** handles it all with a gorgeous UI and fluid animations.

---

## ✨ Features

*   **Real-time Aspect Ratio Adjustments:** Control your aspect ratio dynamically using a precise slider.
*   **Aesthetic UI Panel:** A sleek, glassmorphic dark-themed control panel that glides in from the right edge of the screen.
*   **One-Click Presets:** Instantly switch between common aspect ratios:
    *   `21:9` (Ultrawide cinematic view)
    *   `16:9` (Standard widescreen)
    *   `4:3` (Retro/stretched view)
    *   `1.00` (Perfect square)
*   **Smooth Motion & Transitions:** Features dynamic cubic-out animations for a premium, responsive feel when changing ratios or opening/closing the UI.
*   **Highly Optimized & Server-Safe:** Works entirely client-side. Safe to use on any multiplayer server!

---

## 🎮 How to Use

1.  Press **`Right Shift`** (default keybinding) while in-game to open the **ence-size** adjustment panel.
2.  Drag the vertical slider up or down to set a custom aspect ratio.
3.  Click on any of the preset buttons (`21:9`, `16:9`, etc.) to snap instantly to that ratio.
4.  Click anywhere outside the panel or press **`ESC`** / **`Right Shift`** to close it.
5.  *(Optional)* Customize the keybinding in Minecraft's standard controls menu under **Key Binds > ence-size**.

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1.  Make sure you have [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) installed for Minecraft **1.21.11**.
2.  Download the latest **ence-size** JAR file.
3.  Place the downloaded JAR in your Minecraft `mods/` directory.
4.  *(Recommended)* Install [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) to access the configuration screen directly from the main menu.

---

## 📄 License

This mod is released under the **MIT License**. Feel free to include it in your modpacks!

title: Custom Treasure Maps
description: Turn any empty map into a custom treasure map pointing to your chests!
body: # Custom Treasure Maps *[Русская версия ниже](#русская-версия)* **Custom Treasure Maps** is a Fabric mod that allows players to easily create their own treasure maps pointing to hidden loot! Perfect for map makers, multiplayer servers, and roleplay. ## 🌟 Features - **Create Custom Maps**: Turn any ordinary Empty Map into a Treasure Map that points directly to a container. - **Red 'X' Marker**: The generated map features the classic red 'X' marker, just like vanilla buried treasure maps. - **Custom Names**: If the target container has a custom name (e.g., renamed in an anvil), the resulting map will inherit that name. - **Supported Containers**: Works with Chests, Trapped Chests, and Barrels. ## 📖 How to Use Creating a custom treasure map is simple and integrated right into gameplay: 1. Place down a **Chest**, **Trapped Chest**, or **Barrel** (this will be your treasure). 2. Equip an **Empty Map** in your **Main Hand**. 3. Equip a **Compass** in your **Off-Hand**. 4. **Sneak (Shift) + Right-Click** on the container. The Empty Map will be consumed, and you will immediately receive a Custom Treasure Map pointing to that exact location! ## ⚙️ Requirements - **Minecraft**: 26.1.2 or 26.2 (Works on supported snapshot/release versions). - **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader (0.19.3+ recommended). - **Dependencies**: Fabric API. ## 📥 Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for your Minecraft version. 2. Download the latest version of the [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and place it in your `mods` folder. 3. Download the `CustomTreasureMaps` `.jar` file and place it in your `mods` folder. 4. Launch the game and enjoy hiding your treasures! ## 📄 License This project is open-source and available for use in any modpack. Please refer to the `LICENSE` file for more details. --- # Пользовательские Карты Сокровищ (Custom Treasure Maps) **Custom Treasure Maps** — это Fabric мод, который позволяет игрокам легко создавать собственные карты сокровищ, указывающие на спрятанный лут! Идеально подходит для создателей карт, мультиплеерных серверов и ролевых игр. ## 🌟 Особенности - **Создание своих карт**: Превратите любую обычную Пустую карту в Карту Сокровищ, которая указывает прямо на контейнер. - **Красный крестик 'X'**: На созданной карте появляется классический красный крестик 'X', прямо как на ванильных картах сокровищ. - **Свои названия**: Если у целевого контейнера есть свое имя (например, переименован в наковальне), полученная карта унаследует это название. - **Поддерживаемые контейнеры**: Работает с Сундуками, Сундуками-ловушками и Бочками. ## 📖 Как использовать Создать свою карту сокровищ очень просто, процесс интегрирован прямо в игровой процесс: 1. Поставьте **Сундук**, **Сундук-ловушку** или **Бочку** (это будет ваше сокровище). 2. Возьмите **Пустую карту** в **Главную руку**. 3. Возьмите **Компас** во **Вторую (левую) руку**. 4. Нажмите **Shift (приседание) + Правая кнопка мыши** по контейнеру. Пустая карта пропадет, и вы сразу же получите Пользовательскую Карту Сокровищ, указывающую точно на это место! ## ⚙️ Требования - **Загрузчик модов**: Fabric Loader (рекомендуется 0.19.3+). - **Зависимости**: Fabric API. ## 📥 Установка 1. Установите [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) для вашей версии Minecraft. 2. Скачайте последнюю версию [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) и поместите ее в папку `mods`. 3. Скачайте файл `CustomTreasureMaps` `.jar` и поместите его в папку `mods`. 4. Запустите игру и наслаждайтесь прятаньем своих сокровищ! ## 📄 Лицензия

title: AlaHorde
description: Hostile mobs grow stronger the more you kill them. A global per-species kill counter raises HP, damage, speed and XP for every new spawn, with an RPG-style level label above each mob.
body:
# AlaHorde

Hostile mobs grow stronger as you kill them — a global per-species kill counter raises HP, damage, speed and XP for every new spawn.

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.10 (26.1.2)
- **Loader:** NeoForge 26.1.2.28-beta
- **Side:** both client and server (vanilla clients can join a server with this mod)
- **License:** MIT
- **Languages:** English, Русский, Українська, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português (BR), 日本語, 简体中文, Polski

## How it works

Every hostile mob (`MobCategory.MONSTER` — zombie, skeleton, creeper, witch, enderman, blaze, ghast, wither, ender dragon, warden, …) has its own world-wide kill counter. Every 25 player kills of a species bumps that species to the next level — every NEW spawn of that species after that point comes in stronger.

| Stat | Per-level scaling | Attribute |
|---|---|---|
| Max health | +10% over base | `MAX_HEALTH` |
| Attack damage | +8% over base | `ATTACK_DAMAGE` |
| Movement speed | +5% over base | `MOVEMENT_SPEED` |
| XP drop | +10% over base | via `LivingExperienceDropEvent` |

Cap at level 20 by default. All thresholds and multipliers are configurable in `serverconfig/alahorde-server.toml` or via the in-game **Mods → AlaHorde → Settings** UI.

Each spawned mob gets a styled `[Lv.N]` label above its head, color-tiered by level (gray Lv.1 → white 2-5 → yellow 6-10 → gold 11-15 → red 16-20). The label is **occluded by solid blocks** — no X-Ray cheating; the level only shows when the mob is in line of sight.

When a species levels up, all players within the configured radius get a chat broadcast and flame/smoke particles burst at the kill site.

Bosses (Wither, Ender Dragon, Warden) are included by default — only attribute base values are touched, so boss AI phases stay intact.

## Commands

| Command | Permission | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/alahorde info` | everyone | Shows the tracked species with current level, kill count and threshold to the next level |
| `/alahorde reset all` | op (level 2) | Resets every species' kill counter to zero |
| `/alahorde reset <mob_id>` | op (level 2) | Resets a single species (e.g. `/alahorde reset minecraft:zombie`) |

## Configuration

The config file lives at `<world>/serverconfig/alahorde-server.toml`. The same options are editable from the in-game **Mods → AlaHorde → Settings** screen.

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `general.enabled` | `true` | Master switch — when off, the mod is fully inert (no scaling, no labels, no kill counting) |
| `general.killsPerLevel` | `25` | Kills required per level-up |
| `general.maxLevel` | `20` | Level cap; kills are still counted past it |
| `general.excludedMobs` | `[]` | Entity ids opted out of the system (e.g. `["minecraft:bat"]`) |
| `scaling.hpMultiplierPerLevel` | `0.10` | HP gain per level (0.10 = +10%) |
| `scaling.dmgMultiplierPerLevel` | `0.08` | Attack damage gain per level |
| `scaling.speedMultiplierPerLevel` | `0.05` | Movement speed gain per level |
| `scaling.xpMultiplierPerLevel` | `0.10` | XP drop gain per level |
| `visuals.showLevelLabel` | `true` | Show `[Lv.N]` above mobs |
| `visuals.showLevelUpMessage` | `true` | Broadcast a chat message on level-up |
| `visuals.levelUpMessageRadius` | `-1` | Notify radius (blocks); `-1` = entire server |

## Installation

1. Install [NeoForge 26.1.2.28-beta](https://neoforged.net) for Minecraft 1.21.10.
2. Download the latest `alahorde-26.1.2-<version>.jar` from the **Files** tab on this page.
3. Drop the jar into `.minecraft/mods/` (client) or `<server>/mods/` (server).
4. Launch.

## Compatibility

- **Multiplayer:** progress is stored in the world's `SavedData`, shared across all players on the server.
- **Other mods:** mob tags / categories from other mods are respected. Use `excludedMobs` to opt out specific species.
- **Modpacks:** zero hard dependencies. Drop in and go.

## License

[MIT](https://github.com/Ma3auka/AlaHorde/blob/main/LICENSE) © Artem Pavelko (Ma3auka).

title: No Ominous Banners
description: Pillager Captains no longer drop their banners upon death. This ensures unclogged farms and boots performance
body:
# 🧭 Introduction

**This is a lightweight server-side optimization mod designed for Minecraft servers that frequently run raids or pillager-related farms. It focuses on improving farm efficiency and reducing unnecessary item clutter without changing core gameplay mechanics.
**
# ⚙️ What This Mod Does

** The mod prevents Pillager Captains from dropping Ominous Banners when they are defeated. By removing this drop, it stops banner items from accumulating during large-scale raid farms or patrol grinding setups.**

# 🚀 Performance Benefits

** By eliminating constant banner item drops, the mod reduces entity load and item lag in high-activity areas. This helps improve overall server stability, especially on survival SMPs or automated farming servers where raids are repeatedly triggered for Ominous Bottles and loot farming.**

# 🔧 Compatibility

** Fully server-side and does not require clients to install anything. Works seamlessly with vanilla mechanics and most fabric-based server environments.
**

A simple but effective optimization for smoother raid farming and cleaner servers ✨

title: World of Dwarven Caverns
description: Overhauls the underworld to be much more interesting and viable to explore/inhabit as a skilled Dwarf
body:
Let's be honest, even after the Caves & Cliffs update Minecraft caves are still pretty dull and for a game that's half about mining, that side of it has been very neglected.

Which is where this pack comes in; Minecraft is the perfect game to roleplay as a Dwarf. And to me "It is Dwarven to seek perfection".
So I've added a whole bunch of mods starting with Quality-of-life to make the basic stuff simpler and satisfying. Then of course as I said, the underworld had to be made fun and challenging to explore.
-that includes having a wide range of new areas and mechanics
-new mobs of varying uses and difficulties
-tools and weapons to deal with/optimize the other two

And lastly, there's no point in conquering the underworld if there's nothing to do and no one to share it with once it's all done. In my opinion the homely things like the cooking, decoration, pets and trinkets and instruments are just as important as the guns, backpacks and cogwheels.

There's much more that I've chosen to leave out of the description and a fair bit that you can only experience first-hand, so get out there and start digging, comrade!

title: Fools Rise Tweaks
description: Small mod for Fools Rise modpack! Added progression for modpack and some more!
body:
# Fools Rise Tweaks

**Fools Rise Tweaks** is the core progression and balancing mod designed specifically for the **Fools Rise** modpack. It completely reshapes the traditional Minecraft journey, forcing players to master alternative dimensions before conquering the vanilla world, while also adding custom exploration content and balancing boss fights.

---

## Reimagined Dimension Progression

Forget everything you know about Minecraft progression. You no longer start your main journey in the Overworld. This mod enforces a strict, custom dimensional path that players must follow to unlock the game's full potential:

Aether -> Eternal Starlight -> The End -> The Nether -> The Overworld

You must conquer the skies of the **Aether** and survive the dim lands of **Eternal Starlight** long before you can even think about stepping into the Nether or fully mastering the Overworld.

---

## Custom Dungeons & Exploration

* **The Starter Dungeon:** To support this unique progression, the mod alters world generation. A custom dungeon automatically spawns in the **Aether** upon world creation. 
* **High-Stakes Loot:** This dungeon serves as a crucial starting point for players, packed with challenges and essential rewards needed to kickstart your progression.

---

## Boss Fixes & Balancing

To ensure a smooth yet challenging modpack experience, this mod includes built-in tweaks and fixes for various bosses across multiple dimensions. These fixes resolve AI glitches, optimize multiplayer compatibility, and balance boss health/damage scaling to prevent cheesing.

---

## FAQ

**Q: Can I use this mod outside of the Fools Rise modpack?**  
**A:** This mod is highly customized for the specific progression line of the **Fools Rise** modpack. While you can technically install it, it is hardcoded to restrict progression based on mods like *The Aether* and *Eternal Starlight*, so it is highly recommended to use it only within the official pack.

title: FTechResource
description: Bring the surface mineral veins and mining machines from the Factorio game to the Minecraft
body:
# FTech Resource

## ✨ Highlights

- **Surface Ore Veins** — Ore patches generate naturally on the terrain surface. No more branch-mining: find, place, collect.
- **Terrain‑adaptive surface vein generation** — Generates ore veins only on the surface, adaptively adjusting their placement and quantity based on terrain features.
- **Two Tiers of Mining Drills**
  - **Burner Mining Drill** — runs on coal/charcoal/any fuel. Simple early-game automation.
  - **Electric Mining Drill** — powered by FE (Forge Energy). Mines all veins in range simultaneously. Auto-ejects output to adjacent container.
- **Multiple Mineral Types** — Coal, iron, copper, gold, redstone, lapis, emerald, diamond (Overworld) + nether quartz (Nether). Each with custom weight, size, and surface tint.
- **Rich Configuration**
  - Disable vanilla ore generation per-block-ID (replace unwanted ores with stone/deepslate/netherrack on chunk load).
  - Tune vein generation chance, drill speed, fuel efficiency, and energy consumption.
  - Define custom vein types via JSON — add ores from any mod.
- **Vanilla+ Feel** — Pickaxes work on veins (drops scaled by config). Left-click a vein to collect a few items; automate the rest with drills.
- **JEI & Jade Integration** — View vein type info (dimension, biome) in JEI. Hover with Jade to see remaining blocks and drill energy.
- **Clean Placement UX** — Live overlay shows drill range and vein locations before you place.

## ⚙️ Configuration

### `ftresource_vein_types.json` — (generated at `config/ftresource/` on first run)

Define which ores appear as surface veins:
**Key fields:**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `outputItem` | What the drill (or pickaxe) drops |
| `weight` | Generation probability relative to other types |
| `maxBlocks` | Total ore reserves in one patch |
| `maxPerBlock` | Max blocks per world block (0 = default 64) |
| `color` | ARGB tint on the vein overlay |
| `noiseFreq` / `noiseGamma` / `shapeThreshold` | Controls vein shape & density |
| `biomes` / `dimensions` | Where the vein can generate (empty = all) |
| `surfaces` | Valid surface blocks to generate on (`#` prefix for tags) |
| `surfaceMode` | `"auto"` (default), `"nether"` |

Weapons Expanded: Editions is a Fabric addon for Better Combat and Weapons Expanded. The goal of this mod is to add unique weapons, variants, and special editions that fit naturally alongside existing combat content.

The first addition currently added is the Bl1xickle, a custom sickle designed with dual-wield combat in mind. Future updates may introduce additional weapons, reimagined variants, and other experimental combat equipment.

title: ABBA Rules
description: A datapack that transforms a world into the ABBA Rules caving minigame from VintageBeef in Mindcrack.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f2903b90b54b085f03d882a1969f9287d5cbacf.png)

## Happy Anniversary
Near the day I post this, it has been 14 years from the first ABBA Rules Match, in the Mindcrack Server, between VintageBeef and AnderZEL.

## WARNING
This datapack is **NOT** meant for survival or SMP server worlds, installing this will overwrite loot, clear inventories, etc. It is meant to be played in a brand new world only for this, installing like it says in the instructions below.

## ABBA Rules Caving
The objective is to collect ores, and some other interesting items in loot as in Mineshafts. Each one has a different point value. Combine common and rare to be the winner of the match!

## Datapack Content
- Configurable Ore Points (in Lobby)
- Configurable Equipment, Effects and Difficulty
- Configurable Match Time
- Match Leaderboard and Statistics
- Winner Bundle (if wanted)

## Installation
1. Create a new world with Cheats/Commands enabled.
2. Add the datapack in the datapacks directory.
3. Exit and enter the world, or restart the server.
4. Run the command /function abba_rules:setup
5. If there is any light glitch, leave and rejoin.
6. Then, you can change the options in the lobby, lock them with the menu, and invite other players to start the match! Have fun!

## Templates
In the host menu, there is a button to go to the Templates menu. In this menu, you can copy to the clipboard a command, that when ran, will set all settings to the ones saved when copied.

There are two types of template commands, the simple one, that only has ore and item values, or the full, that has equipment, time, etc.

This was made to make world changes a bit easier and prevent the need of a lot of arrow clicking.

title: Biome Rings
description: Mod for biome controls by distance of the world center
body:
# Biome Rings

This mod aims to provide a json file to force the generation of a biome or a list of biomes in a specified range of the overworld center.

#### This mod **DO NOT** changes the terrain, it only forces the biome settings, what affects mob spawnings, structure generations and natural enviroment (trees, grass, flowers, etc).
#### It only works on new generations, this mod do not overwrites already existing chunks.

---

Note that this mod **was only tested in vanilla 1.21.1, and probably has little to no compatiblity with any other custom biomes/terrain generation mods**.

I (the author) have no plans of updating this mod any further than bugfixes, optimization and/or config file QoL.
If you want to add features or compatibilities **you are strongly incentivated to fork/copy the repository and do your version**.

## How to use / What it can do

> The config file is located in `~/config/biomerings.json`
> 
Note that the config file will be auto-generated with an example code in the config.

the parameters in the config are:
| Key | Description | Default |
| - | - | - |
| roundness | The deformation of the rings, where 1.0 is perfectly circular | 0.7 |
| noise | The repetition of the "stripes" of biome when there are many in the same range, a bigger number means more visible "stripes" | 0.4 |
| global_blacklist | The list of biomes that are not meant to be overrided | [...] |
| rules | The list of rules for the generation | [...] |

---

You can force a list of biomes to appear at certain range of the overworld center, settings minimum and maximum distances and pool weigth.

For example, you can set generation to be plains from 0 to 300, pool desert, badlands and wooded_badlands between 300 and 600, and pool forest and dark_forest between 600 and 900 blocks of distance of the world center.
<details>
<summary>Example of config file</summary>
  
```JSON
{
  "roundness": 0.4,
  "noise": 0.5,
  "global_blacklist": [
    "minecraft:ocean",
    "minecraft:deep_ocean",
    "minecraft:warm_ocean",
    "minecraft:lukewarm_ocean",
    "minecraft:cold_ocean",
    "minecraft:deep_cold_ocean",
    "minecraft:beach",
    "minecraft:river",
    "minecraft:mushroom_fields"
  ],
  "rules": [
    {
      "biome_id": "minecraft:plains",
      "min_distance": 0.0,
      "max_distance": 300.0,
      "probability": 1.0
    },
    {
      "biome_id": "minecraft:desert",
      "min_distance": 300.0,
      "max_distance": 600.0,
      "probability": 0.4
    },
    {
      "biome_id": "minecraft:badlands",
      "min_distance": 300.0,
      "max_distance": 600.0,
      "probability": 0.3
    },
    {
      "biome_id": "minecraft:wooded_badlands",
      "min_distance": 300.0,
      "max_distance": 600.0,
      "probability": 0.3
    },
    {
      "biome_id": "minecraft:forest",
      "min_distance": 600.0,
      "max_distance": 900.0,
      "probability": 0.7
    },
    {
      "biome_id": "minecraft:dark_forest",
      "min_distance": 600.0,
      "max_distance": 900.0,
      "probability": 0.3
    }
  ]
}
```
</details>

You can also overwrite unwanted biomes at range of the worldspawn by setting then as whitelist of whatever you feel like, for example here i overwrite snow biomes with plains and meadow. (also frozen rivers as rivers and etc)

title: Silent's Gems & The Gem Project Compat
description: Removes the duplicate ruby/sapphire/topaz between Silent's Gems and The Gems Project
body:
# Silent's Gems + The Gems Project Compatibility Patch

A small compatibility patch for two great gem mods that happen to add the
exact same three gemstones: **Silent's Gems** and **The Gems Project**.
Both add a ruby, sapphire, and topaz — which means with both installed
you end up with two separate, non-interchangeable versions of each gem,
two separate ores, and a confusing mess in the creative menu / JEI.

This patch removes the duplication so Silent's Gems and The Gems Project
feel like one coherent gem system instead of two competing ones — while
keeping everything else from both mods completely untouched (Silent's
Gems' other 13 gems, The Gems Project's onyx, glowroses, tools, jewelry,
all of it).

## What it actually does

- **Stops Silent's Gems' ruby, sapphire, and topaz ore from generating**
  in the Overworld, Nether, and End. The Gems Project's versions of these
  three ores are the ones that spawn going forward.
- **Keeps Silent's Gems' gem-storage block recipes working.** Silent's
  Gems lets you craft 9 gems into a storage block and back. That recipe
  normally only accepted Silent's Gems' own gem item, so this patch
  redirects it to accept gems from either mod, the same way the rest of
  Silent's Gems' recipes (tools, armor, lamps, glass, bricks, tiles)
  already do out of the box via a shared Forge tag.
- **Adds a building-focused recipe for the gem blocks.** Place 2 of The
  Gems Project's raw gem (top and bottom) and 2 Stone (left and right)
  in a crafting grid to get 4 of Silent's Gems' gem blocks at once — a
  faster, more building-friendly alternative to the 9-gem recipe above.
  Works for ruby, sapphire, and topaz. The original 9-gem recipe still
  works too; this is an addition, not a replacement.
- Everything else in both mods is left exactly as the original authors
  made it.

## Requirements

This is a **datapack**, not a mod — but it needs two mods to actually do
anything:

- **Silent's Gems** and **The Gems Project**, obviously.
- **[Moonlight Lib]** — used purely for its global datapack folder
  feature, so this patch applies automatically to every world instead of
  needing to be copied into each world's save folder individually.
- **[Item Obliterator]** — this patch only
  handles worldgen and one recipe. To fully hide Silent's Gems' ruby,
  sapphire, and topaz items (and their 12 ore block variants) so they
  can't be picked up, traded, or crafted with even if a player already
  has one, you also need Item Obliterator installed with the config
  below.

## Installation

Both steps below refer to your "instance folder" — the folder for this
specific modpack/profile, the same one that contains your `mods`,
`config`, and `saves` folders. If you're using the Modrinth App, you can
find it by right-clicking the instance and choosing "Open Folder".

1. Install Silent's Gems, The Gems Project, Moonlight Lib, and
   Item Obliterator.
2. In your instance folder, find (or create) the `moonlight-global-datapacks`
   folder — it sits next to `mods` and `saves`, not inside either of
   them, and Moonlight Lib creates it automatically the first time you
   launch with it installed. Drop this zip directly into that folder.
   Do not unzip it.
3. In your instance folder, open the `config` folder, then open
   `item_obliterator.json5` inside it (so the full path looks like
   `config/item_obliterator.json5`) with any plain text editor. Add the
   following entries to the `blacklisted_items` list:

   ```json5
   "silentgems:ruby",
   "silentgems:sapphire",
   "silentgems:topaz",
   "silentgems:ruby_ore",
   "silentgems:deepslate_ruby_ore",
   "silentgems:ruby_nether_ore",
   "silentgems:ruby_end_ore",
   "silentgems:sapphire_ore",
   "silentgems:deepslate_sapphire_ore",
   "silentgems:sapphire_nether_ore",
   "silentgems:sapphire_end_ore",
   "silentgems:topaz_ore",
   "silentgems:deepslate_topaz_ore",
   "silentgems:topaz_nether_ore",
   "silentgems:topaz_end_ore"
   ```

   **This is a one-time step.** You only need to paste this once, when
   you first install the patch. Updating to a newer version of this
   datapack later won't require touching the Item Obliterator config
   again, unless a future update specifically adds support for more
   gems (which will be called out clearly in that version's changelog
   if it ever happens).

4. Launch the game and load into a world (new or existing). Run
   `/datapack list` to confirm the patch picked up.

This only affects **newly generated chunks** — ore that's already
generated in explored terrain won't retroactively disappear, though
Item Obliterator will still stop it from being usable if mined.

## Notes

- Only ruby, sapphire, and topaz are touched, since those are the only
  three gems both mods have in common. The Gems Project's onyx and all
  of Silent's Gems' other 13 gems are fully untouched.

title: Management Panel
description: Minecraft Plugin That Manages Admin Features
body:
ManagementPanel provides server administrators with powerful tools to manage players, perform complete profile wipes (inventory, enderchest, economy) with built-in backup and restore systems, and issue advanced punishments seamlessly integrated with EssentialsX and Vanilla Minecraft.

## Features

* **Complete Player Wipes**: Wipe a player's entire server profile with a single command. Supports wiping:
  * Vanilla Inventory
  * Vanilla Enderchest
  * EssentialsX Economy
  * YueMi Libs Economy
* **Safe Backup & Restore (Unwipe)**: Worried about false wipes? ManagementPanel automatically generates a secure backup of a player's data *before* wiping them. If you make a mistake, simply use `/unwipe` to restore their inventory, enderchest, and economy!
* **Integrated Punishments**: Deep integration with EssentialsX and Vanilla Minecraft to handle Warnings, Mutes, Kicks, and Bans securely and safely.
* **Developer API**: Built from the ground up to be extensible. Other developers can easily hook into the `core-api` to register custom `WipeHandler`s or `PunishmentHandler`s for third-party plugins.

## Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/managementpanel reload` | Reloads the configuration files. | `managementpanel.admin` |
| `/wipe <player> [reason]` | Safely backs up and wipes a player's profile. | `managementpanel.command.wipe` |
| `/unwipe <player> [backupId]` | Restores a wiped player's profile from a backup. | `managementpanel.command.unwipe` |
| `/warn <player> <reason>` | Issues a warning to a player. | `managementpanel.command.warn` |
| `/mute <player> <duration> <reason>` | Mutes a player for a specified duration. | `managementpanel.command.mute` |
| `/ban <player> <duration> <reason>` | Bans a player for a specified duration. | `managementpanel.command.ban` |
| `/status <player>` | Checks the punishment/wipe status of a player. | `managementpanel.command.status` |

*Note: All management commands require the user to have the base permission `managementpanel.use`.*

## Configuration

ManagementPanel offers a highly customizable `config.yml` that lets you toggle specific wipe integrations, enable/disable the backup system, and define fallback mechanisms.

```yaml
# Enable or disable specific integrations
integrations:
  essentials-economy: true
  yuemi-economy: true

# Configure how player wipes are handled
wipe:
  # Whether to create a backup before wiping (highly recommended)
  enable-backups: true
```

title: Chanyoris MMO
description:
Play Chanyoris and earn a little mcMMO skill XP based on your score.
茶ニョリスを遊ぶと mcMMO のスキルが少し上がる連携プラグイン。
body:
# Chanyoris MMO

Play one match of Chanyoris, and a random mcMMO skill gains a little XP based on your score.

Chanyorisを1試合プレイすると、スコアに応じて mcMMO のスキルが少し上がる連携プラグイン。

---

## ✨ What is this?

After finishing one match of Chanyoris, a **single random mcMMO skill** gains a little XP based on your **score**.
A chat message tells you which skill gained how much.

## ✨ これは何？

Chanyorisを1試合プレイし終えると、その**スコア**に応じて **mcMMO のスキルがランダムに1つ**、少しだけ上がります。
試合終了後に「どのスキルが・いくつ上がったか」をチャットで通知します。

---

## ⚖️ Balance design

- Only **one skill** per match (not all at once)
- **Capped XP** (no runaway gains on high scores)
- Respects mcMMO's **rate multipliers** (`addModifiedXP`)
- No XP for quitting mid-match or dying

## ⚖️ バランス設計

- 付与は**1スキルのみ**（全スキル同時には上がらない）
- **上限あり**（高スコアでも上振れしない）
- mcMMO の**倍率設定に追従**（`addModifiedXP` 使用）
- 途中退出・死亡中断では**XP なし**

---

## 📊 Rough XP amounts / XP の目安

- Score ~900 → min 3 XP / 最低 3 XP
- Score 3,000 → ~10 XP / 約 10 XP
- Score 9,000 → ~30 XP / 約 30 XP
- Score 18,000+ → max 60 XP / 上限 60 XP

> Fully adjustable via `score-divisor`, `xp-min`, `xp-max`.
>
> `score-divisor` / `xp-min` / `xp-max` で自由に調整できます。

---

## 🎯 Candidate skills / 対象スキル（default / 既定）

`MINING` `WOODCUTTING` `EXCAVATION` `HERBALISM` `FISHING` `ACROBATICS`
`SWORDS` `AXES` `ARCHERY` `UNARMED` `REPAIR` `ALCHEMY` `TAMING`

> Editable in config.yml. Invalid skill names are silently removed on startup.
>
> config.yml で追加・削除できます。無効なスキル名は起動時に自動除外されます。

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- **Server**: Paper 1.21.x
- **Java**: Java 25+ (required)
- **Depends**: Chanyoris + mcMMO (both required)

## ⚙️ 動作環境

- **サーバー**: Paper 1.21.x
- **Java**: Java 25 以上（必須）
- **依存**: Chanyoris 本体 + mcMMO（両方必須）

---

## 🔧 Config example / 設定例

```yaml
score-divisor: 300.0   # base XP = score ÷ this / スコア ÷ この値 = XP基礎値
xp-min: 3              # min XP per match / 最低XP
xp-max: 60             # max XP per match / 最大XP
win-multiplier: 1.25   # win bonus / 勝利時の倍率
lose-multiplier: 1.0   # lose rate / 敗北時の倍率
```

---

body:
# Guide Lib

A lightweight, data-driven guide library for **NeoForge 26.x** (Minecraft 26.1.2).

## For Players

*   Craft a **Codex** (book + paper ×2) to browse in-game guides from every mod that supports Guide Lib
*   Upgrade to a **Codex Tablet** for a scrollable cyber UI
*   Craft mod-specific **Manuals** when available — opens one mod's guide directly

## For Mod Authors

No Java API required. Drop JSON under `data/<modid>/guide/<book_id>.json`:

*   **text** pages — translation keys or `literal:...`
*   **crafting** pages — show recipes by ID
*   **spotlight** pages — item + description

Optional per-mod Manual via recipe `components` on `minecraft:written_book`.

Ships with a built-in **Example** book. See [Deconstructor](https://github.com/ogata-mizuki-99/neoforge-mods/tree/main/mods/deconstructor) for a full integration.

## Features

*   Book & tablet themes (JSON-customizable)
*   Optional JEI integration on recipe slots
*   `/reload`\-friendly datapack loading
*   Safe MOD removal — items degrade to vanilla written books

## Requirements

*   NeoForge 26.1.2+
*   Java 25
*   JEI optional

## Credits

This mod was developed with partial assistance from AI (Claude, Gemini, etc.) to improve development efficiency and optimize code. All game balance decisions and playtesting were performed manually by the developer. If you encounter any unexpected issues, please report them via GitHub Issues.

# Guide Lib

title: Barrel Shop Vanilla
description: The plugin allows players to create barrel shops and sell items for other items!
body:
The plugin allows players to create barrel shops and set prices for items inside them. It protects against griefing and theft of these items, as well as against explosions and hopper damage. Players can also choose any items they want to trade for selling items. 

The plugin is highly vanilla-friendly and does not add any custom menus. It is suitable for vanilla and SMP servers.



Guide
Creating a shop

    Look at a barrel.
    Use the command:
    /createshop <price> <payment item (diamonds by default)>

Example:

/createshop 5 diamond


This creates a barrel shop where players must pay 5 diamonds for each item they take.


Selling items

After creating the shop, simply put the items you want to sell into the barrel.


Players must have the required payment items in their inventory to purchase anything from the shop.


Buying items

To buy an item:


    Open the barrel shop
    Click on any item you want to purchase

If you have enough payment items in your inventory, the trade will be completed automatically.


Protection

    Only the barrel owner or a player with OP can break the barrel shop.
    Players with OP see barrel shops as normal barrels and can freely take, place, or move items inside them.
    Barrel shops are fully protected from griefing.

body:
# MG20 Bounties
An advanced, economy-driven bounty and debt management system designed for SMPs, Factions, and PvP servers. Fully powered by **Vault** and built with a lightweight **SQLite** database for maximum performance and zero lag.

## 🌟 Key Features

* **Dynamic Bounties:** Place a price on your rivals' heads using `/bounty place <player> <amount>`. The stakes have never been higher!
* **Smart Tracking Compass:** Hunt down high-value targets! If a player's bounty exceeds $10,000, bounty hunters can purchase a real-time tracking compass via `/bounty track <player>`.
* **Automated Debt Collector:** If a player places a bounty but goes broke, they fall into debt. A smart background system automatically deducts money as soon as they earn it until the debt is completely cleared.
* **Anti-Exploit System:** Fully secured. Players cannot place bounties on themselves or exploit the system to claim their own bounties.
* **Plug & Play:** No complicated database setups required. The built-in SQLite system handles everything seamlessly.

## ⚙️ Commands & Permissions
* `/bounty place <player> <amount>` - Set a bounty on a target.
* `/bounty track <player>` - Receive a tracking compass for high-value targets.
* `hight-value = >10000 

## 📋 Requirements
* **Java 21** (Supports Minecraft versions `1.21` to `1.26.2`)
* **[Vault](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/vault)** (Required for all economy transactions)
* An Economy Provider (e.g., EssentialsX)

title: Avenoxrtp
description: Modern RTP plugin for Paper/Spigot featuring safe random teleportation, optimized chunk loading, and smooth performance.
body:
# **AvenoxRTP**

## **Overview**

AvenoxRTP is a professional-grade Random Teleport plugin built from the ground up for performance, safety, and total configurability. Designed to compete with the best RTP plugins on the market, it focuses entirely on doing one thing exceptionally well — getting players to safe, random locations fast, with **zero reward systems, zero economy gimmicks, and zero bloat.**



## 🌐 Links

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Server-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/DH3xfGHDFt)

[![YouTube](https://img.shields.io/badge/YouTube-@FinalStrikerrr-FF0000?style=for-the-badge&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/@FinalStrikerrr)




## **Features**

### **🌍 Multi-World Support**

* Unlimited configured worlds — Overworld, Nether, End, or any custom world
* Per-world settings: cooldown, price, radius, permissions, enable/disable
* **Two border modes**: `FOLLOW_WORLD_BORDER` (auto-detects the vanilla world border) or `CUSTOM_RADIUS` (your own bounds)

### **🛡️ Safe Location System**

* Full hazard detection: lava, fire, cactus, magma, powder snow, void, cave pockets, and more
* Configurable safety rules with extra unsafe-block overrides
* Min/max Y-level bounds per search
* **Main-thread-safe chunk loading** — every chunk check happens correctly on Paper’s main thread, so destinations always render properly with no invisible terrain or lag spikes

### **⚡ Performance**

* **Location pre-caching** — safe spots are pre-calculated in the background so teleports feel instant
* Batched, tick-friendly search loop that avoids main-thread stalls
* Built to support **500+ concurrent players** with minimal TPS impact
* Persistent chunk tickets keep destination chunks loaded through teleport

### **🎨 GUI Customization**

* Every slot, material, name, lore line, sound, enchant glow, and custom model data is editable via `gui.yml`
* Built-in placeholders for cooldown, distance, and player stats inside item lore
* Border/filler decoration support for a polished, professional look out of the box

### **⏱️ Countdown System**

* Configurable countdown timer with live **BossBar**, **Title**, and **ActionBar** updates
* Per-tick sound effects (fully configurable)
* **Smart cancellation** — countdown cancels on move, damage, command use, or disconnect (each independently toggleable)
* Particle effects on success/failure

### **🔌 Automatic Hooks**

AvenoxRTP works completely standalone on a fresh Paper server. If you install any of the plugins below, it automatically detects and hooks them with no configuration needed — and silently skips them if they’re absent.

| Category             | Supported Plugins                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Economy**          | Vault                                                                                                 |
| **Placeholders**     | PlaceholderAPI (13 built-in placeholders)                                                             |
| **Permissions**      | LuckPerms                                                                                             |
| **Claim Protection** | WorldGuard, GriefPrevention, GriefDefender, Towny, Lands, Residence, KingdomsX, HuskTowns, RedProtect |

All integrations use pure reflection internally, meaning **no external plugin jar is required to compile or run the plugin.**

### **📊 Statistics**

* Tracks total, successful, and failed teleports
* Per-world usage breakdown
* Average search time tracking
* Per-player lifetime teleport counts

### **🎛️ Permissions**

* Tiered cooldown permissions (`avenoxrtp.cooldown.<seconds>`)
* Bypass permissions for cooldown and economy
* Per-world access permissions
* Admin-only commands locked behind dedicated nodes

### **🧩 Commands**

```text
/rtp                  → Opens the RTP GUI
/rtp gui              → Opens the RTP GUI
/rtp reload           → Reloads all configuration files
/rtp stats            → View server-wide RTP statistics
/rtp debug            → View live debug information
/rtp version          → Plugin & integration info
/rtp force <player>   → Force-teleport a player (admin)
/rtp biome <biome>    → Teleport into a specific biome
```

### **⚙️ Configuration**

Four fully documented config files:

* **`config.yml`** — worlds, cooldowns, economy, search behavior, feedback, sounds, particles
* **`gui.yml`** — every visual element of the GUI
* **`messages.yml`** — every player-facing message, fully customizable
* **`worlds.yml`** *(generated)* — per-world rules

---

## **Compatibility**

| Requirement               | Version                       |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| **Server Software**       | Paper 1.21+, Purpur, or Folia |
| **Java**                  | Java 21                       |
| **Required Dependencies** | **None**                      |

---

## **Why AvenoxRTP**

Unlike plugins padded with crates, tokens, and streak rewards, AvenoxRTP stays focused on what an RTP plugin should actually do: **find safe locations quickly, teleport reliably, and stay out of the way.** Every feature exists to improve performance, safety, or customization — nothing else.

title: TextAPI
description: TextAPI is a Kotlin-native Spigot text engine with a MiniMessage-like syntax, built-in placeholders, gradients, rainbow, 16 pride presets, click/hover/insert events, and a custom TPS ticker. All fully extensible at runtime via a clean handler-based API.
body:
> Actively searching a graphist for the logo  
> DM me on discord if interested: nolly__

TextAPI is a Kotlin-first Spigot API/library for advanced text parsing, formatting, and rendering. It combines MiniMessage-style tags, PlaceholderAPI-like placeholders, gradients, rainbow effects, hover/click/insertion events, and runtime extensibility into a single high-performance system.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b00b9f408f91719d75fa9d3445b967be1b674678.png)

## Overview

TextAPI is designed for plugin developers who want rich in-game text without heavy complexity. It can be used as a dependency in other plugins, or standalone if you want to test and explore its features through the built-in debug command. The focus is on clean DX, strong UX, and predictable rendering behavior.

It supports built-in colors, hex colors, decorations, gradients, pride presets, placeholders, legacy string output, and component output. On top of that, developers can register and unregister custom placeholders, custom tags, and custom gradients at runtime without touching the renderer internals.

## What it does

TextAPI parses a compact markup syntax and turns it into either legacy-formatted text or Bungee chat components. It supports:
- Named colors and hex colors
- Decorations like bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, and obfuscated
- Gradients with multiple color stops
- Rainbow text with phase control
- Hover and click actions
- Insertions
- Placeholder expansion
- Runtime custom tags with handler callbacks
- Runtime custom gradients with named presets

The result is a flexible formatting engine that feels like a cleaner, lighter, and more extensible alternative to mixing multiple text systems together.

## Performance

Performance is a core design goal. TextAPI uses a single-pass tokenizer, a stack-based renderer, and lightweight context resolution to keep parsing fast and predictable. Gradients and rainbow effects are expanded only when needed, and placeholder lookups are resolved through a normalized registry instead of reflection or heavy dynamic inspection.

The rendering pipeline is built to minimize unnecessary allocations while still preserving nested formatting, event support, and style inheritance. A custom TPS tracker powers live server timing placeholders without relying on external dependencies. The end result is a fast API that stays practical for real-time in-game use.

## Developer experience

The API is built to be easy to learn and easy to extend. Developers can:
- Parse strings directly
- Get components for chat output
- Send messages to players
- Inspect tokens for debugging
- Register and unregister placeholders at runtime
- Register and unregister tags at runtime
- Register and unregister gradients at runtime

The command system is intentionally powerful too, so the project can be tested standalone in-game without writing extra integration code. That makes it useful both as a dependency and as a developer tool during experimentation.

## Built-in content

TextAPI ships with a broad default feature set:
- Player placeholders
- Server placeholders
- Time placeholders
- TPS placeholders
- 14 pride gradient presets
- Common text decorations
- Hover and click interactions
- Reset and escape handling
- Component and legacy outputs

This gives developers a lot out of the box while still leaving room for custom behavior when needed.

## Extensibility model

Custom tags are handler-based, which means a tag can modify style dynamically and can react to arguments. Custom gradients are registered by name with color stop lists, making them easy to define and reuse. Placeholders can also be registered with player-aware resolvers, making the API suitable for dynamic content such as ranks, prefixes, placeholders from other systems, or per-player metadata.

## Testing and debugging

For direct testing, TextAPI includes a comprehensive in-game debug command that can:
- Render messages
- Dump components
- Dump tokens
- List placeholders, tags, and gradients
- Register and unregister runtime content
- Preview gradients
- Run a full feature test set in-game

That makes it easy to validate syntax, inspect output, and verify new runtime registrations without leaving the server.

## Summary

TextAPI is what you get when you combine MiniMessage-style formatting and PlaceholderAPI-style dynamic content into a Kotlin-based Spigot library, then optimize it for fast parsing, clean extensibility, and developer-friendly runtime control.

title: Fractured Mending
description: This data pack overhauls the Mending enchantment into a 5-tier system to balance late-game progression.
body:
Vanilla Mending is far too cheap and makes tool maintenance trivial. This pack turns gear immortality into something players actually have to earn.
Earlier tiers can barely extend the life expectancy of tools, while end-game tiers are the regular near-unbreakable tools you find in vanilla.

## Tiered Progression
Mending now ranges from Level 1 to Level 5. The repair effectiveness scales aggressively with the enchantment level:

> Level 1: 0.25 durability per XP (A brutal grind—four experience points heal a single point of durability).
> 
> Level 2: 0.5 durability per XP.
> 
> Level 3: 1.0 durability per XP.
> 
> Level 4: 1.5 durability per XP.
> 
> Level 5: 2.0 durability per XP (Restores standard vanilla behaviour).

Librarian villagers and loot chests will randomly generate these tiers just like any other standard enchantment. Players will have to spend serious time cycling trades or exploring to secure that elusive Level 5 book.

## Anvil Economy
The base anvil_cost multiplier has been adjusted to 4. This ensures early-tier books remain cheap to apply, but slapping a Level 5 Mending book onto endgame gear carries a hefty experience premium.

## Installation
Drop the folder or .zip directly into your server's world datapacks folder and run /reload. No client-side downloads are required.

### Critical Server Requirement:
Because Level 5 Mending pushes the application cost high, this datapack is designed to be paired with a separate Fabric/Forge mod that removes the vanilla "Too Expensive!" (level 39) anvil cap. This pack strictly handles the enchantment maths; it does not bypass the hardcoded anvil UI limits.

title: Chunky Dungeons
description: A basic dungeon generating plugin for your dungeon needs.
body:
# Chunky Dungeons!!!
Chunky Dungeons is a plugin designed to easily create infinitely generating dungeons. It works by filling in Minecraft's subchunks in an orderly way using user-saved rooms.

 ***FYI, this plugin is untested on other versions, but might still work.***
### Features:
- Room saving
- Container saving
- Randomized loot tables
- Infinte Dungeon generation
- Finite* Dungeon generation
- Room rotation
- Connector logic

*Finite is broken
## Usage
### Room saving:
After building a room as desired in a subchunk (the area between the blue and pink lines when using F3+G) ![Visual indicator of subchunks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8dd9becf05b15eb0a4cb1646fa1f2837f7ef627_0.webp)
You can use the command /chunkydungeons saveroom <folder> <roomid> <rarityweight> <connectingdirections>
- Folder: The place for the file to save. Also determines where dungeons generate from.
- Room ID: The file name for the room.
- Rarity Weight: A number that determines how likely it is to generate in respect to other rooms.
- Connecting Directions: A line of binary 0/1 that defines if a side is a connector or not (connectors must connect to connectors when generating). Corresponds to NESW compass directions. For example, if the room you are saving opens to the North and East, you would put 1100.
Exaple of command usage: /chunkydungeons saveroom TestDungeon Test 1 1010
### Dungeon Generating:
After saving rooms, to generate a dungeon, you can run /chunkydungeons createdungeon <infinite|#numberofrooms> <sourcefolder> [dungeonID]
- Infinite / Number of Rooms: either put infinite, where it will continue expanding as loaded in, or designate a number of rooms. Finite dungeons will not behave as expected. If you set it to 1, it will generate 1 room. If you set it to more, it will fill your entire render distance before checking to see if it hit the number of rooms and then stop when it does.
- Source Folder: Where to pull rooms from for generating.
- Dungeon ID: only for infite, gives the dungeon file a specific name.
### Loot Tables
To use a loot table, you first must define one using /chunkydungeons loottable create <id> <filledSlotChancePercent>
- ID: Name of the loot table
- Filled Slot Chance Percent: A number 0-100 that determines how many slots will be filled
Then you can save rooms with containers in them that are named the loot table ID, and they will generate with the loot table.
To add an item to a loot table you must hold it in your hand (single item, as it detects stack size) and use /chunkydungeons loottable addto <ID> <rarityWeight> <maxStack?>
- ID: the loot table to add to.
- Rarity Weight: A number that determines how likely it is to generate in respect to other items.
- Max Stack: It chooses randomly (1 - this number) each time it is chosen, for the stack size.
To check a loot table you can run /chunkydungeons lootcheck <ID> which places a chest with the loot for ID at your location.
**Note:** Loot tables only generate in empty chest slots, allowing you to have specific items in chests along with the randomized loot.
## Files
Each room, dungeon, and loot table is saved to a file that should all be easy to modify and delete. To stop an infinite dungeon you can either use /chunkydungeon stopsession <dungeonID> or simply delete the file yourself.

Have fun!

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
I created this for my own Minecraft Server to my specifications and needs. It is unlikely I will have much further development.
Also, it was very much coded with AI, but I did rigorous testing and iterated it. The AI was just to speed things up and make everything okay syntax-wise.~~~~
</details>
