title: Yet Another Home
description: Homes, TPA, /back, and combat-safe teleports for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1+
body:
# Yet Another Home

Server-only Forge mod that adds homes, teleport requests, and a safe `/back` — with built-in combat protection to prevent teleporting out of PvP fights.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/sethome [name]` | Save current location as a named home (defaults to `home`) |
| `/home [name]` | Teleport to a saved home |
| `/delhome [name]` | Delete a saved home |
| `/listhomes` | List all your saved homes |
| `/tpa <player>` | Request to teleport to another player |
| `/tpahere <player>` | Request another player to teleport to you |
| `/tpaccept` / `/tpdeny` | Accept or deny an incoming TPA request |
| `/tpcancel` | Cancel a TPA request you sent |
| `/back` | Return to your last teleport origin, or back to your death location |
| `/tphere <player>` | *[OP only]* Force-teleport a player to your location |

## Combat Safety

Teleports are protected by two layers of configuration:

* **Hurt lockout** (`hurtLockoutSeconds`, default **15s**): If you take damage, you cannot start or complete any mod teleport until the lockout expires. Death clears the lockout so you can immediately `/home` or `/back` to your corpse.
* **Teleport warmup** (`teleportWarmupSeconds`, default **5s**): Player-initiated teleports (`/home`, `/back`, accepted TPA) wait before executing. If you take damage during the warmup, the teleport is cancelled.

These prevent using teleport commands to escape from a fight.

## `/back` Behavior

* Returns to your **death location** first (if you died recently). Cleared once used or after `deathBackExpirySeconds` (default 10m).
* Falls back to your **last teleport origin** (a toggle: `/back` swaps you between where you were and where you are now). Expires after `backExpirySeconds` (default 5m) so teleporting out of a friend's base doesn't leave a permanent waypoint back in.

## Configuration

All settings in `config/yet-another-home.toml`:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `maxHomes` | `1` | Homes per player |
| `opUnlimitedHomes` | `true` | Operators bypass `maxHomes` |
| `tpaExpirySeconds` | `60` | How long a TPA request stays pending |
| `deathBackExpirySeconds` | `600` | How long after death preceding the death location |
| `backExpirySeconds` | `300` | How long a teleport origin is valid for `/back` |
| `hurtLockoutSeconds` | `15` | Seconds after taking damage when players can't teleport (0 to disable |
| `teleportWarmupSeconds` | `5` | Delay before a teleport executes (0 for instant) |
| `opUnlimitedHomes` | `true` | Operators bypass `maxHomes` |

## Compatibility

* Server-only mod — vanilla clients can join without installing anything.
* Fires `EntityTeleportEvent.TeleportCommand` so protection mods (WorldGuard, GriefPrevention, etc.) can veto teleports.
* Saves persist across restarts via world `SavedData`.

## AI disclosure

Coding agent was used in developing this mod.

Paper

| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |

| `/doubledice`              | Roll two dice.                      |
| `/trueorfalse <statement>` | Randomly answers **Yes** or **No**. |
| `/funchatrng reload`       | Reload the plugin configuration.    |


## 🔑 Permissions
| Permission               | Default | Description                                |
| ------------------------ | :-----: | ------------------------------------------ |
| `funchatrng.dice`        |    ✅    | Allows using `/dice`.                      |
| `funchatrng.doubledice`  |    ✅    | Allows using `/doubledice`.                |
| `funchatrng.trueorfalse` |    ✅    | Allows using `/trueorfalse`.               |
| `funchatrng.funchatrng`  |    ✅    | Allows access to the main plugin command.  |
| `funchatrng.reload`      |    OP   | Allows reloading the plugin configuration. |

## ⚙️ Configuration

FunChatRNG includes a simple configuration file.

Currently you can customize how dice results are displayed:

```
# ==========================================
#            FunChatRNG v1.3
# ==========================================
# Developed by Zontik
#
# This file contains all plugin settings.
# You can safely edit it while the server is offline.
# ==========================================

#En: Will symbols be used instead of numbers when using the /dice command?

#Ru: Будут ли использоватся символы вместо чисел при использовании команды /doubledice?
doubledice_symbol: true

When enabled, the plugin displays UTF-8 dice symbols instead of plain numbers, making chat look more immersive and fun.

title: Individual Keep Inventory Refabricated
description: This is the updated version of Individual Keep Inventory which is a Server-side Fabric mod that makes keepInventory work on an individual basis.
body:
> NOTE:
> **Individual Keep Inventory Refabricated** is a community-maintained fork of the original **Individual Keep Inventory** mod. Its goal is to keep the mod working on newer versions of Minecraft, as the original project is no longer actively maintained.

# Individual Keep Inventory Refabricated

Ever have that one friend who dies every five minutes and begs for `keepInventory` to be enabled? You'd turn it on... except everyone else on the server wants the normal survival experience.

**Individual Keep Inventory Refabricated** lets you enable `keepInventory` on a **per-player basis**, so each player can have their own inventory retention setting.

## Features

- Enable or disable keep inventory for individual players.
- Configure the default setting for new players.
- Fully server-side. Vanilla clients can join without installing the mod.
- Supports modern Minecraft versions.

## Commands

### Set a player's keep inventory status

```text
/ikeepinv set <player> <true|false>
```

Enables or disables keep inventory for a specific player.

### View a player's setting

```text
/ikeepinv get <player>
```

Displays whether keep inventory is currently enabled for the specified player.

### Change the default for new players

```text
/ikeepinv default <true|false>
```

Sets the default keep inventory state for players who join the server for the first time.

## Vanilla Gamerule

The vanilla gamerule:

```text
/gamerule keepInventory
```

is ignored by this mod. Whether it is set to `true` or `false`, it has no effect while Individual Keep Inventory Refabricated is installed. All inventory behavior is controlled through the `/ikeepinv` commands instead.

## Client Compatibility

This mod is **server-side only**. Players can join using a completely vanilla client without installing the mod.

title: COAL — YACL adapter
description: Renders every COAL-using mod's settings screen in YetAnotherConfigLib.
body:
Renders every [COAL](https://modrinth.com/mod/config-object-abstraction-lib)-using mod's settings screen
in [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl), plus JSON
persistence, load-time validation, and versioned migrations.

## For players

Install **all three** side-by-side in your `mods/` folder:

1. **[COAL](https://modrinth.com/mod/config-object-abstraction-lib)** — the abstraction layer that
   COAL-consuming mods depend on.
2. **coal-yacl-adapter** — this mod.
3. **[YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)** — the GUI library that actually
   renders the screens.

Any mod that consumes COAL will use YACL for its settings screen once these
three are installed together. Your config files land in `config/<mod>.json`
and every mod's screen looks and feels the same.

### Don't install alongside `coal-cloth-adapter`

Only **one** COAL adapter should be installed at a time. If you'd rather use
Cloth Config, install [`coal-cloth-adapter`](https://modrinth.com/mod/coal-cloth-adapter)
instead of this one.

## For mod authors

You don't compile against this mod. Depend on `coal-api` +
`coal-api-gui-<loader>` at compile time; your users install whichever adapter
they prefer at runtime. See the [docs](https://mc.oliveryasuna.com/coal/) for
the walkthrough.

## Feature coverage

Advertises `MIGRATION`, `VALIDATION`, and `GUI_DELEGATION`. Does not advertise
`SYNC`, `FILE_WATCH`, `JSON5`, or `CUSTOM_FORMATS` — see the module README on
GitHub for the full annotation-to-widget mapping and known limitations.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://mc.oliveryasuna.com/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/oliveryasuna/minecraft-mods)
- [Sibling: `coal-cloth-adapter`](https://modrinth.com/mod/coal-cloth-adapter)

title: no-teleport
description: Not allowed to enter nether portal at client side.
body:
# No Teleport

Github: https://github.com/Rutubet/no-teleport

No Teleport is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft `26.1.2` that prevents players from teleporting through Nether portals.

It makes Nether portal blocks behave like full solid blocks on the client, so walking into a portal feels like hitting an invisible wall while the portal still renders normally. It also performs a conservative Ender Pearl trajectory check before item use is sent to the server. If the predicted danger area may touch a Nether portal, the client cancels that Ender Pearl use before the server can spawn the pearl.

## Features

- Client-side only; no server mod is required.
- Nether portals still render and animate normally.
- Players cannot normally walk into Nether portal blocks.
- Ender Pearl use is checked before the use packet is sent.
- Suspicious near-portal Ender Pearl throws are conservatively blocked.
- Normal Ender Pearl use away from Nether portals remains available.

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft | `26.1.2` |
| Fabric Loader | `>=0.19.2` |
| Java | `>=25` |
| Fabric API | Not required |

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft `26.1.2`.
2. Download or build `no-teleport-0.1.0.jar`.
3. Put the jar into the client's `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game.

The built mod jar is located at:

```text
build/libs/no-teleport-0.1.0.jar
```

## Building From Source

Windows:

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat clean build
```

Linux/macOS:

```bash
./gradlew clean build
```

The mod jar will be generated at:

```text
build/libs/no-teleport-0.1.0.jar
```

## Behavior

Portal blocking is implemented through client-side collision. The mod changes the collision shape for `Blocks.NETHER_PORTAL` to a full block, without changing the portal's rendered shape.

Ender Pearl blocking happens before the client sends the item-use packet. The mod simulates a conservative pearl path and expands it into a wide danger area. If that area may touch any loaded Nether portal block, the item use is cancelled.

## Limitations

- This is a client-side mod and cannot change server-authoritative logic.
- It does not rescue players who are already inside portal blocks.
- It does not roll back a player after the server has already decided to teleport them.
- Ender Pearl checking is conservative, so some near-portal throws that look safe may still be blocked.
- Servers with custom teleport logic, custom Ender Pearl physics, or unsynchronized portal blocks may bypass the assumptions this client-side guard relies on.

## Development

Run the test suite:

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat test
```

Build the release jar:

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat clean build
```

## License

MIT

# No Teleport

No Teleport 是一个纯客户端 Fabric Mod，用于在 Minecraft `26.1.2` 中阻止玩家通过地狱门传送。

它会在客户端把地狱门方块当作完整实体方块处理，让玩家像撞到空气墙一样无法正常走进地狱门。同时，它会在投掷末影珍珠前进行保守轨迹预测：如果预测出的危险轨迹范围可能接触到地狱门，客户端会取消这次末影珍珠使用，避免服务端生成末影珍珠实体。

## 功能

- 纯客户端 Mod，不需要服务端安装。
- 地狱门仍正常渲染和动画显示。
- 玩家无法通过普通移动走进地狱门。
- 末影珍珠投掷前会进行地狱门风险检测。
- 靠近地狱门的可疑末影珍珠投掷会被保守拦截。
- 远离地狱门的正常末影珍珠使用不受影响。

## 兼容性

| 要求 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft | `26.1.2` |
| Fabric Loader | `>=0.19.2` |
| Java | `>=25` |
| Fabric API | 不需要 |

## 安装

1. 安装支持 Minecraft `26.1.2` 的 Fabric Loader。
2. 下载或构建 `no-teleport-0.1.0.jar`。
3. 将 jar 放入客户端的 `mods` 文件夹。
4. 启动游戏。

构建产物位于：

```text
build/libs/no-teleport-0.1.0.jar
```

## 从源码构建

Windows:

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat clean build
```

Linux/macOS:

```bash
./gradlew clean build
```

构建完成后，Mod jar 会生成到：

```text
build/libs/no-teleport-0.1.0.jar
```

## 行为说明

地狱门阻挡通过客户端碰撞实现。客户端会把 `Blocks.NETHER_PORTAL` 的碰撞形状改为整格方块，但不会改变地狱门的渲染形状。

末影珍珠阻挡发生在客户端发送使用物品包之前。Mod 会模拟一段保守的末影珍珠轨迹，并把轨迹扩展成较粗的危险范围。只要这个范围可能接触到已加载的地狱门方块，本次使用就会被取消。

## 限制

- 这是纯客户端 Mod，不能改变服务端权威逻辑。
- 不会救援已经进入地狱门方块内的玩家。
- 不会在服务端已经决定传送后强制回退玩家。
- 末影珍珠风险检测是保守的，靠近地狱门时可能误拦一些看似安全的投掷。
- 如果服务器使用自定义传送逻辑、自定义末影珍珠物理，或客户端未加载相关地狱门方块，Mod 不能保证完全覆盖这些情况。

## 开发

运行测试：

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat test
```

构建发布 jar：

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat clean build
```

## 许可证

MIT

body:
# Tidy Drops

**Leaf Litter and Wildflowers flooding your inventory? Fix it with one slider.**

Since they were added, Leaf Litter and Wildflowers generate *everywhere* in forests and
meadows — and every single one you brush past ends up as an item. Tidy Drops makes them
drop with a configurable chance instead (default **50%**).

## Features

- 🎚️ **One simple setting:** drop chance from 0% to 100%
- 🖱️ **In-game config:** slider via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) — no file editing needed
- 📄 **File config too:** `config/tidydrops.json` → `"dropChancePercent": 50`
- ✨ **Silk Touch always drops** — set 0% and these blocks become Silk Touch exclusives
- 🌊 **Every breaking method covered:** by hand, water flow, pistons, explosions — they all
  go through the same loot hook
- 🎲 Each flower/leaf in a multi-segment block is rolled separately (a 4-flower block at 50%
  drops 0–4, ~2 on average)

## Compatibility

- ✅ Sodium, Iris, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast & friends — no rendering or tick hooks, one tiny loot mixin
- ✅ No Fabric API required, no other dependencies
- ✅ Multiplayer: install **server-side only** and it works for everyone; Mod Menu screen is client-side
- ✅ Datapack-friendly: modifies drops *after* the loot table runs, so custom loot tables still work

## FAQ

**Does it change world generation?** No — the blocks still generate; only their item drops change.

**Fortune?** Fortune doesn't affect these blocks in vanilla, and Tidy Drops keeps it that way.

**Where's the config screen?** Mods → Tidy Drops → Configure (requires Mod Menu).

body:
# ☁️ HorizonPotion

**HorizonPotion** adds the **Heaven Potion** — a custom "Rapture" brew that launches players into the sky, drifts them safely back down on angel wings, blasts nearby enemies with a burst of divine light, and rewards a safe landing with a healing blessing.

Perfect as an escape button, a scouting tool, or a way to reach your sky base.

## ✨ What it does

Drink it, and in order:

1. **Ascend** — you're launched up toward build height.
2. **Drift** — Slow Falling carries you down safely (no fall damage).
3. **Divine light** — nearby hostile mobs are knocked back and blinded.
4. **Blessed landing** — you gain Regeneration and Absorption on touchdown.

## ⚙️ Deeply configurable

Almost *every* value is tunable from a clean `config.yml` — no code required:

- Launch mode (build height / relative / fixed), height, teleport vs. velocity
- Slow-fall duration, fall-damage immunity, optional forward "steering" drift
- Divine light radius, knockback, blindness — toggle mobs and/or players
- Landing rewards (Regeneration & Absorption), amplifiers and durations
- Per-use cooldown, blocked worlds/environments (Nether & End off by default)
- Particles & sounds, potion color, name, lore, glint, custom model data
- Crafting recipe (shapeless **or** shaped) — fully customizable
- All text supports **MiniMessage** (gradients, hex colors, formatting)

Changes apply live with `/heavenpotion reload` (recipe changes need a restart).

## 🧪 How to get it

Craft it — a shapeless recipe:

> **Water Bottle + Feather + Glowstone Dust + Ghast Tear → Heaven Potion**

Or grant it with `/heavenpotion` (aliases: `/rapture`, `/heavenpot`).

## 🔑 Commands & permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/heavenpotion` | Get a Heaven Potion | `horizonpotion.give` |
| `/heavenpotion <player>` | Give one to a player | `horizonpotion.give` |
| `/heavenpotion reload` | Reload the config | `horizonpotion.reload` |

Players drink with `horizonpotion.use` and craft with `horizonpotion.craft` (both on by default).

## 🧩 Compatibility

- **Server:** Paper / Purpur (or any Paper fork)
- **Minecraft:** 1.21.x (single jar works across all 1.21.x)
- **Java:** 21+

title: Change of Control
description: A mod for quickly switching keybind profiles. Create, save, load, rename and delete custom keybinding presets. Perfect for players who need different control schemes for different game situations (PvP, building, minigames, etc.
body:
## ENGLISH VERSION (EN)

### Change of Control

**Description:**
Change of Control is a lightweight yet powerful mod designed for instant switching between complete keybind configurations. With this tool, you can create, save, load, rename, and delete custom keyboard presets effortlessly. It is the perfect companion for players who need radically different control schemes depending on the situation — whether you're fighting in PvP, constructing complex buildings, competing in fast-paced minigames, exploring, or piloting vehicles.

**Key Features:**

- **One-Click Profile Switching** – Change your entire keybind layout instantly without restarting your game or navigating through deep settings menus.
- **Full Preset Management** – Create new profiles from scratch, save your current bindings, load any saved preset, or remove outdated ones with a clean and intuitive interface.
- **Rename & Organize** – Give your profiles clear, descriptive names (e.g., "PvP Tryhard," "Creative Build," "Parkour Pro," "Vehicle Pilot") so you always know which scheme is which.
- **Safe & Reliable** – Your original settings are preserved; switching profiles is non-destructive and fully reversible.
- **Game-Changing Flexibility** – Adapt to any gameplay scenario in seconds. No more manual rebinding of 20+ keys every time you change your activity.

**Who is this mod for?**
- **PvP players** – optimize your keys for quick weapon swaps, crits, and strafing.
- **Builders** – have building blocks, tools, and rotation keys at your fingertips.
- **Minigame enthusiasts** – switch to arcade-style controls instantly.
- **Content creators & streamers** – demonstrate different playstyles without boring menu pauses.
- **Modpack users** – handle complex key conflicts across multiple mods with ease.

**Why Change-of-Control?**
Because your controls should adapt to you, not the other way around. Stop wasting time in menus and start playing the way you want, exactly when you want.

**Compatibility:**
Client-side only – works on any server. Compatible with most popular Minecraft mods and launchers.

---

## RUSSIAN VERSION (RU)

### Change of Control

**Описание:**
Change of Control — это легкий, но мощный мод для мгновенного переключения между полными наборами назначений клавиш. С его помощью вы можете создавать, сохранять, загружать, переименовывать и удалять собственные пресеты управления без лишних усилий. Это идеальный инструмент для игроков, которым требуются кардинально разные схемы управления в зависимости от ситуации: PvP-сражения, сложное строительство, динамичные мини-игры, исследование мира или управление транспортом.

**Ключевые возможности:**

- **Переключение в один клик** – Меняйте всю раскладку клавиш мгновенно, без перезапуска игры и бесконечных переходов по меню настроек.
- **Полное управление пресетами** – Создавайте новые профили с нуля, сохраняйте текущие назначения, загружайте любые сохраненные варианты или удаляйте устаревшие — всё через понятный и удобный интерфейс.
- **Переименование и организация** – Давайте профилям понятные названия (например, «PvP-Режим», «Креатив-Стройка», «Паркур-Профи», «Пилот») — вы всегда будете знать, какая схема за что отвечает.
- **Безопасность и надежность** – Ваши оригинальные настройки всегда сохраняются; переключение профилей безопасно и полностью обратимо.
- **Максимальная гибкость** – Адаптируйтесь к любому игровому сценарию за секунды. Забудьте о ручном переназначении 20+ клавиш при смене занятия.

**Для кого этот мод?**
- **Для PvP-игроков** – настройте клавиши под быструю смену оружия, критические удары и уклонение.
- **Для строителей** – держите блоки, инструменты и клавиши поворота всегда под рукой.
- **Для любителей мини-игр** – переключайтесь на аркадное управление в одно касание.
- **Для контент-мейкеров и стримеров** – показывайте разные стили игры без скучных пауз в меню.
- **Для пользователей сборок модов** – легко разрешайте конфликты клавиш между десятками модов.

**Почему именно Change-of-Control?**
Потому что управление должно подстраиваться под вас, а не наоборот. Хватит тратить время в меню — начните играть так, как вам удобно, именно тогда, когда вам это нужно.

**Совместимость:**
Только клиентская часть — работает на любых серверах. Совместим с большинством популярных модов и лаунчеров для Minecraft.

title: AutoCrafterPattern
description: Locks specific recipe patterns into the vanilla Crafter to make automation easier. (AI-Assisted)
body:
# AutoCrafterPattern (AI-Assisted)

A performance-optimized Paper plugin designed for **Minecraft 26.1.x** to simplify and secure automated crafting with the vanilla Crafter block.

By locking specific recipe layouts into the Crafter, the block will only activate and allow items to enter if they match your pre-configured pattern perfectly. This ensures your industrial setups run smoothly without getting jammed or broken by irregular item hopper flows.

> ⚠️ **Important Auto-Crafting Tip:** Since the Crafter fills its 3x3 grid slot-by slot from left to right and top to bottom, your automation (hoppers/droppers) must inject the ingredients **in the exact correct order** required to build the pattern. If the items end up in the wrong slots, the layout won't match your template and the auto-craft won't activate!

---

### ✨ Features

* **Pattern Locking GUI:** Shift + Right-click any Crafter block to open a dedicated 3x3 layout interface.
* **Smart Hopper Filtering:** Automatically blocks hoppers from inserting items that do not belong in your configured pattern.
* **No Redstone Required:** Features an optional global auto-craft scheduler that ticks every 4 ticks without requiring complex redstone clocks.
* **Anti-Grief Integration:** Fully compatible with land protection plugins like GriefPrevention.
* **Full i18n System:** Built-in multilingual support (EN/FR) with customizable language files in `plugins/AutoCrafterPattern/Message/`.
* **Highly Optimized:** Utilizes asynchronous YAML saving with a 5-second debounce, EnumSet material caching, and skips unloaded chunks to ensure zero server lag.

---

### 📘 Commands & Permissions

**Main Command:** `/autocrafter`

| Command | Description | Permission | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/autocrafter help` | Displays the in-game mini-tutorial | None | Public |
| `/autocrafter reload` | Reloads configuration and translation files | `autocrafter.reload` | OP |

* **`autocrafter.use`** *(Default: true)* — Allows players to interact with the Crafter pattern GUI.

---

### 📝 Project Origin & Credits

I don't really know how to code, but since I couldn't find any simple alternative that suited my server's needs, I decided to use an AI to help me create this plugin. It was made to provide a simple, lightweight solution for pattern-based auto-crafting.

* **License:** [MIT License](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

---

### 📥 Installation

1. Download the `.jar` file.
2. Place it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. *(Optional)* Customize settings in `config.yml` or patterns in `Pattern.yml`.

================================================================================

# 🇫🇷 Version Française

**Un plugin Paper performant conçu pour Minecraft 26.1.x afin de verrouiller des schémas de recette sur l'Auto-Crafter vanilla.**

En verrouillant un patron spécifique dans le Crafter, le bloc n'autorisera l'insertion d'objets et ne s'activera que si la grille correspond parfaitement à votre configuration. Cela empêche les entonnoirs de dérégler vos usines et d'enrayer vos systèmes automatisés.

> ⚠️ **Note importante pour l'automatisation :** Comme le Crafter se remplit case par case (de gauche à droite et de haut en bas), vous devez impérativement configurer vos entonnoirs/droppers pour **envoyer les items dans le bon ordre**. Si un objet arrive au mauvais endroit, le schéma ne correspondra plus à votre patron et le craft automatique ne se déclenchera pas !

---

### ✨ Fonctionnalités

* **GUI de Configuration :** Faites Maj + Clic-droit sur n'importe quel Crafter pour ouvrir une interface 3x3 dédiée au patron de recette.
* **Filtrage Intelligent des Hoppers :** Bloque automatiquement l'insertion via entonnoir si l'objet ne fait pas partie du patron.
* **Auto-Craft sans Redstone :** Planificateur global optionnel (toutes les 4 ticks) qui déclenche le craft sans nécessiter de circuits redstone complexes.
* **Protection Anti-Grief :** Entièrement compatible avec les plugins de revendication de terres comme GriefPrevention.
* **Système i18n complet :** Support multilingue natif (FR/EN) avec fichiers modifiables dans `plugins/AutoCrafterPattern/Message/`.
* **Optimisation de Pointe :** Sauvegardes YAML asynchrones avec debounce de 5 secondes, mise en cache EnumSet, et exclusion automatique des chunks non chargés pour préserver votre processeur.

---

### 📘 Commandes & Permissions

**Commande principale :** `/autocrafter`

| Commande | Description | Permission | Par défaut |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/autocrafter help` | Affiche le mini-tutoriel en jeu | Aucune | Public |
| `/autocrafter reload` | Recharge la configuration et les fichiers de langue | `autocrafter.reload` | OP |

* **`autocrafter.use`** *(Par défaut : true)* — Permet aux joueurs d'utiliser l'interface de patron du Crafter.

---

### 📝 Origine du Projet & Crédits

Je ne sais pas vraiment coder et comme je ne trouvais aucune alternative simple qui me correspondait pour mon serveur, j'ai utilisé une IA pour m'aider à concevoir ce plugin de A à Z afin d'obtenir le résultat parfait.

title: EclipseAFKPlugin
description: A simple AFK plugin with prefix and color.
body:
# AFKPlugin

A lightweight, configurable AFK plugin for Paper 1.21.x. Automatically detects inactive players and marks them as AFK.

## Features

- **Automatic Detection** – Players are marked AFK after a configurable inactivity timeout
- **Low Sensitivity** – Small movements (stuttering, mouse clicks, short walks) won't cancel AFK. Only moving a significant distance or actively interacting counts as activity
- **Manual Toggle** – `/afk` to toggle AFK manually
- **Tablist Display** – AFK players get an `[AFK]` prefix in the player list
- **Auto-Kick** – Optional automatic kick after prolonged AFK time
- **Broadcast** – Optional chat notification when players go AFK / return
- **Fully Configurable** – Timeout, messages, kick, and detection are all adjustable
- **Permissions** – Bypass, ignore, and reload controlled via permissions
- **Customizable Messages** – All messages editable in `messages.yml`

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/afk` | Toggle AFK mode | `afk.use` |
| `/afk reload` | Reload configuration | `afk.reload` |
| `/afk <player>` | Check a player's AFK status | `afk.others` |

## Perms

| Permission | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `afk.use` | `true` | Allows using `/afk` |
| `afk.others` | `op` | Allows checking others' AFK status |
| `afk.bypass` | `false` | Never automatically marked AFK |
| `afk.kick.bypass` | `op` | Never kicked for being AFK |
| `afk.reload` | `op` | Allows reloading the config |

## Install

1. Make sure you're running [Paper 1.21.x](https://papermc.io)
2. Place `AFKPlugin-1.0.0.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server or run `/reload`
4. Optionally adjust `config.yml` and `messages.yml`

## Config

### config.yml

```yaml
timeout: 600
kick:
  enabled: false
  after: 1200
detection:
  min-movement-distance: 5.0

title: Item Limiter snup

body:
# snuplimit

**SnupLimit** is a powerful Paper plugin for Minecraft servers that allows administrators to restrict items and enchantments through a simple and intuitive GUI.

The plugin is designed for survival, SMP, economy, and PvP servers where certain items need to be blocked or globally limited.

## Features

- 🛡️ Block specific items from being crafted or obtained.
- 📦 Set a global limit for any item across the entire server.
- ✨ Limit enchantments and their maximum levels.
- 🖥️ Easy-to-use graphical interface (GUI).
- ⚡ Instant configuration saving.
- 🔄 Reload configuration without restarting the server.
- 🌍 Automatic multilingual support based on the player's Minecraft language.
- 📁 YAML configuration files for easy editing.
- 🔐 Permission-based administration.
- 🚀 Lightweight and optimized for Paper servers.

## Supported Languages

- 🇺🇸 English
- 🇷🇺 Russian
- 🇩🇪 German
- 🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese

If a player's language is not supported, English is used automatically.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/snuplimit` | Open the main GUI |
| `/snuplimit reload` | Reload the plugin configuration |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `snuplimit.admin` | Full access to the plugin |
| `snuplimit.reload` | Reload configuration |
| `snuplimit.bypass` | Ignore all item and enchantment restrictions |

## Requirements

- **Paper 1.21.11**
- **Java 21**

## Configuration

The plugin automatically generates its configuration files on first startup:

- `config.yml`
- `blocked-items.yml`
- `item-limits.yml`
- `enchantment-limits.yml`

All changes made through the GUI are saved immediately—no manual save button is required.

---

SnupLimit is actively maintained and will receive new features, improvements, and bug fixes in future updates.

# Verticality+

Are you **Tired** of sorting your hotbar by opening and closing your inventory each time? Well Verticality+ fixes this problem. You can use a key (Default: Left Alt) to scroll through your hotbar slot. For example, Line 1 of your inventory contains 4 items, you can easily scroll through it by pressing your set key by scrolling up and down.

* **Vertical Scrolling**: Navigate your inventory with a scrolling mechanic, making sorting your hotbar way easier.
* **Smart Fallback**: Makes it so that if there is nothing in your inventory slot above, it instantly goes to the slot with an item, making your experience easier and funner.
* **Customizable**: Easily toggle features and bind your preferred keys via **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config API**.

**Because**, it makes minecraft easier, and just funner to play with. Personally, I even use Verticality in my minecraft game.

title: AE2InfinityCell
description: Adds an AE2 infinity storage cell for GTNH-era Minecraft 1.7.10 packs
body:
# AE2 Infinity Cell

AE2 Infinity Cell adds a single Applied Energistics 2 storage cell for
Minecraft 1.7.10 / GTNH-era modpacks. The cell mounts item, fluid, and essentia
storage channels in AE2 drives while keeping the actual contents in
save-scoped external storage instead of writing a large inventory directly into
the item stack.

## Features

- One `Infinity Storage Cell` item for AE2 storage systems.
- Item, fluid, and Thaumic Energistics essentia channel support.
- Effectively unlimited storage capacity and type count from AE2's point of view.
- Lightweight item NBT: the cell stores only a UUID reference.
- Contents are persisted in the current world save and written through the
  mod's saved-data storage.
- Copied cells keep the same UUID and intentionally share the same backing
  inventory inside that save.

## Requirements

Runtime dependencies:

- Minecraft 1.7.10
- Minecraft Forge 10.13.4.1614
- Applied Energistics 2 Unofficial
- Thaumic Energistics
- Thaumcraft
- Avaritia

The development workspace also uses the GTNH Gradle convention plugin and GTNH
dependency catalog entries.

## Usage Notes

Place the Infinity Storage Cell in an AE2 drive or compatible AE storage host.
AE2 will ask the custom cell handler for the requested channel and the cell will
serve item, fluid, or essentia storage from the same backing record.

The backing storage is scoped to the Minecraft save. Copying the item stack
within the same save copies the UUID and shares the same contents. Moving a cell
NBT into another save only carries the UUID string; it does not carry the saved
record unless the external saved data is moved too.

title: Recipe Shuffler
description: A Minecraft mod that randomizes all crafting and smelting recipes
body: # Recipe Shuffler **Shuffle every crafting recipe in your world — vanilla and modded.** Recipe Shuffler takes every crafting recipe in your modpack and randomly reassigns their outputs, turning progression into a fun guessing game. Works with any mod that adds recipes, not just vanilla Minecraft. *** ## ✨ Features * 🔀 **Shuffles ALL recipes** — vanilla and every modded recipe in your pack * 🧩 **Full modpack compatibility** — recipes are generated per-mod namespace, so shuffled outputs correctly override the originals (even in heavily modded packs) * 🌱 **Seed-based shuffling** — the same seed always produces the same shuffle, and the mod remembers your world's seed automatically * ♻️ **Auto rebuild & reload** — the shuffle regenerates automatically if your config or mod list changes, no manual steps needed * 🚫 **Blacklists** — exclude specific items, recipes, or entire mods from being shuffled * 🎲 **Chaos Mode** — an even more unpredictable shuffle option for the brave * 🛠️ **In-game commands** — reshuffle, look up, and debug recipes without leaving your world *** ## 📥 Installation 1. Requires **Forge** for **Minecraft 1.20.1** 2. Drop the `recipe_shuffler-1.0.4.jar` into your `mods` folder 3. Launch the game — the shuffle generates automatically on first world start *** ## 💬 Commands | Command |Description | | -------------------- |--------------------------------------------------------------- | | /rshhelp |Shows the list of available commands | | /rshreshuffle |Reshuffles all recipes using a new random seed | | /rshreshuffle <seed> |Reshuffles using a specific seed (repeatable results) | | /rshfind <item> |Finds what recipe now produces a given item | | /rshrecipe <recipe> |Looks up what a specific recipe now crafts | | /rshdebug |Prints debug info about the current shuffle state | | /rshcheck |Verifies the generated datapack is active and healthy | | /rshdump |Dumps the full shuffled recipe list for inspection | | /dkrsreload |Legacy alias for reshuffling (kept for backwards compatibility) | *** ## ⚙️ Configuration Config file: `config/recipe_shuffler-common.toml` | Option |What it does | | -------------------- |-------------------------------------------------- | | randomize_recipes |Master toggle — turns recipe shuffling on/off | | chaos_mode |Enables a more extreme, less predictable shuffle | | item_blacklist |Items that should never appear in shuffled outputs | | recipe_blacklist |Specific recipes to leave untouched | | mod_blacklist |Entire mods to exclude from shuffling | | show_welcome_message |Shows a chat message when the shuffle loads | *** ## ❓ FAQ **Does this work with modded recipes?** Yes — this was the main fix in the latest update. Shuffled recipes are now written into each mod's own namespace, so they properly override the originals instead of only affecting vanilla recipes. **Will I get the same shuffle every time?** Yes, if you use the same seed. The mod remembers your world's seed automatically, or you can set one manually with `/rshreshuffle `. **Can I stop certain items from being shuffled?** Yes — use `item_blacklist`, `recipe_blacklist`, or `mod_blacklist` in the config to protect specific items, recipes, or whole mods. *** ## 🧾 Version **Current version:** `1.0.4` **Mod ID:** `recipe_shuffler` **Loader:** Forge **Minecraft:** 1.20.1

title: Supply Drop
description: This mod adds a customizable supply drop event that can be started by operators using commands. Admins can choose the loot, reveal coordinates after a timer, show a bossbar countdown, and spawn a protected supply drop.
body:
# Supply Drop

Supply Drop is a simple server-side Fabric mod that adds customizable supply drop events to Minecraft.

Operators can start a supply drop at chosen coordinates, fill a custom GUI with any loot they want, and let players fight for the reward once the timer ends. The drop uses a protected barrel, a bossbar countdown.

## Features

- Custom loot GUI for operators
- Supply drops at custom coordinates
- Bossbar countdown with coordinates
- Title announcements for players
- Protected barrel that cannot be broken
- Locked drop before the timer ends
- Automatic removal after opening
- Polish and English command versions
- Timer skip and reset commands for operators

## Commands

### Polish version
- `/zrzut <x> <y> <z>` - starts a supply drop
- `/zrzut skip` - skips the full timer
- `/zrzut skip5` - skips 5 minutes
- `/zrzut reset` - resets the active supply drop

### English version
- `/supplydrop <x> <y> <z>` - starts a supply drop
- `/supplydrop skip` - skips the full timer
- `/supplydrop skip5` - skips 5 minutes
- `/supplydrop reset` - resets the active supply drop

## How it works

After starting a supply drop, players receive an announcement. The coordinates are revealed later, and a bossbar shows the countdown. When the timer ends, the drop becomes available and players can open it to collect the loot.

Perfect for SMP servers, PvP events, Lifesteal servers, factions, and survival events.

title: OraxenOre
description: This plugin manages ore generation using Oraxen.
body:
# OraxenOre

**OraxenOre** is a lightweight addon for [Oraxen](https://modrinth.com/plugin/oraxen) that allows you to naturally generate your custom Oraxen blocks (ores, decorations, etc.) in the world, just like vanilla ores — all fully configurable through a simple `config.yml`.

## ✨ Features

- 🎯 **100% configurable generation**: choose any Oraxen block, the number of placement attempts per chunk, and the minimum and maximum generation height.
- 🪨 **Automatic deepslate support**: assign a deepslate variant to your ore, and the plugin will automatically choose the correct version based on the Y level (configurable threshold).
- ⚡ **On-the-fly generation**: ores are placed as soon as a new chunk is generated, with no need to regenerate the world.
- 🔒 **Safe and performant**: placement is designed to avoid freezes or lag during chunk generation (no interaction with neighboring chunks).
- 🔄 **Hot reload**: modify your configuration and apply changes without restarting the server using `/oraxenore reload`.
- ✅ **Automatic validation**: on startup, the plugin checks that every configured block exists in Oraxen and safely ignores invalid entries (with a clear message in the console).

## 📋 Requirements

- [Paper](https://papermc.io/) 1.21+ (or a compatible fork)
- [Oraxen](https://modrinth.com/plugin/oraxen) (an Oraxen license is required)

## ⚙️ Configuration

Example `config.yml`:

```yaml
# Y threshold below which the deepslate variant is used
deepslate-threshold-y: 0

ores:
  amethyst:
    block: "amethyst_ore"
    deepslate-block: "amethyst_deepslate_ore"
    amount-per-chunk: 6
    min-y: -64
    max-y: 32

  ruby:
    block: "ruby_ore"
    amount-per-chunk: 4
    min-y: -64
    max-y: 16
```

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the latest version of OraxenOre.
2. Place the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins/` folder (Oraxen must already be installed).
3. Start the server to generate the default `config.yml`.
4. Configure your ores in `plugins/OraxenOre/config.yml`.
5. Reload the plugin with `/oraxenore reload` or restart the server.

## 🐛 Report a Bug / Suggestion

Feel free to open an issue on the project's repository if you encounter a bug or have an idea for an improvement.

title: Personal Chronicles
description: Personal journey logs and player profiles saved as readable TXT files.
body:
# Personal Chronicles

Personal Chronicles is a server-side Fabric mod that creates a personal history for every player on your Minecraft server.

While many history mods focus on global server events, Personal Chronicles focuses on individual player stories. Every player receives their own journey log and player profile, saved as readable text files. These files are designed to preserve personal memories, milestones, deaths, discoveries, progress, and important moments after the server world is finished.

The mod is made for survival servers, SMPs, and friend groups that want to remember not only what happened on the server, but also what happened to each specific player.

Personal Chronicles creates separate files for each player. A journey log records events from the player’s adventure, while a profile file stores a readable summary of the player’s progress.

## Files are saved in:

`config/personal-chronicles/`

## Journey logs are saved in:

`config/personal-chronicles/journals/`

## Player profiles are saved in:

`config/personal-chronicles/profiles/`

## For example, a player may receive files like:

`config/personal-chronicles/journals/PlayerName.txt`
`config/personal-chronicles/profiles/PlayerName.txt`

Journey logs are written as readable records of a player’s adventure. They can include the first time a player joined the server, join and leave events, Nether and End visits, important item milestones, deaths with coordinates, combat milestones, and other progression moments.

Player profiles provide a summary of a player’s story and progress. They can include the player name, UUID, first join, last seen time, last known position, visited dimensions, death count, important milestones, and other personal statistics.

The purpose of Personal Chronicles is to create files that are worth reading after the server is over. Instead of only storing raw data, the mod creates readable records that help preserve the memories of the world and each player’s journey.

The mod supports both Russian and English. The server language can be changed with commands.

Personal Chronicles is fully server-side. Players do not need to install the mod on their clients.

## Features:

- Personal journey logs for every player
- Individual player profile files
- Readable text file output
- Automatic file creation on first join
- Join and leave logging
- Death logging with cause and coordinates
- Nether and End visit tracking
- Important item milestone tracking
- Selected combat milestone tracking
- Profile auto-updating
- Russian and English language support
- Server-side only
- No client installation required

## Commands:

`/pchronicles book`

`/pchronicles book <player>`

`/pchronicles journal <player>`

`/pchronicles profile <player>`

`/pchronicles save`

`/pchronicles reload`

`/pchronicles language ru`

`/pchronicles language en`

## The full command alias is also available:

`/personalchronicles`

## Configuration file:

`config/personal-chronicles/personal-chronicles.properties`

## Example configuration:

`language=ru`

`create_files_on_first_join=true`

`write_coordinates=true`

`write_join_leave=true`

`write_mob_kills=true`

`profile_update_interval_seconds=300`

Personal Chronicles works especially well together with server history mods such as World Chronicles. World Chronicles records the shared story of the server, while Personal Chronicles preserves the personal journey of each player.

title: MimiVouchers
description: The best Free Vouchers Plugin!
body:
# About MimiKoth
Supported Minecraft Versions: 1.21-26.1.2

Required Java Version: 21 or higher

[DISCORD](https://discord.gg/dMqbVMFa5v)

# Why MimiVouchers?
Most voucher plugins rely on insecure item renaming (lore/name checks) or are bogged down by outdated legacy code. MimiVouchers changes the game.

This plugin guarantees 100% anti-duplication and anti-spoofing security. Players cannot forge vouchers using anvils, and server lag/crashes will never duplicate rewards.

Whether you need simple Economy Vouchers, complex Mystery Lootboxes with percentage chances, or exclusive Premium Keys with Custom Model Data, MimiVouchers handles it all flawlessly.

## Core Features
- Bulletproof Security
- PDC Tagging: Vouchers are identified by invisible, unforgeable NBT data.
- Anti-Dupe Architecture: Items are removed from the inventory *before* any commands are executed. Say goodbye to lag-based double-redemptions.
- Anti-Placement: Prevents players from accidentally placing `PLAYER_HEAD` vouchers on the ground.
- Stack Control: You can explicitly choose which vouchers can be stacked and which cannot, with - dynamic UUID injection to force unstackability.

## Advanced Reward System
Percentage-Based Chances: Set exact probabilities (e.g., 5% chance for a Jackpot, 100% chance for base money).
Reward Types:
  - `multiples`: Every action rolls its chance independently (players can win multiple things).
  - `normal`: The system evaluates weights and picks exactly *one* reward from the list.
Player & Console Execution: Run commands as the server or force the player to run them.

## Fully Customizable Aesthetics
- Modern Text Formatting: Full support for MiniMessage hex colors (`&#RRGGBB`), gradients, and legacy color codes.
- Custom Model Data Support: Easily hook your vouchers into your server's Resource Pack! Just add `custom-model-data: 10001` to your config.
- Base64 Heads: Built-in support for custom `PLAYER_HEAD` textures.
- Glow Effects: Add that premium enchant-glint without ugly "Binding Curse" text ruining your lore.
- Particles & Sounds: Trigger epic visual and audio feedback upon redemption.

## Quality of Life Mechanics
- Shift + Click Mass Redeem: Allow players to redeem entire stacks (e.g., 64x Money Vouchers) instantly with configurable limits.
- Double-Click Confirmation: Prevent accidental redemptions on high-value items (like Premium Keys or Ranks).
- Inventory Space Checks: Require players to have *X* amount of free slots before opening a - - - Lootbox voucher so items don't drop on the floor.
- Cooldowns: Set per-voucher cooldowns (seconds, hours, or days) saved persistently to disk.
- Modular Configuration: Keep things clean. Drop as many `.yml` files as you want inside the `vouchers/` folder (e.g., `economy.yml`, `crates.yml`) and the plugin will auto-load them all!

## Commands & Permissions

Main Command: `/mimivoucher` (Aliases: `/mv`, `/voucher`, `/vouchers`)

- `/mv give <player> <id> [amount]` - *Give a voucher to a player.*
- `/mv list` - *See all loaded vouchers across all files.*
- `/mv info <id>` - *Inspect a voucher's configuration in-game.*
- `/mv reload` - *Hot-reload configs, messages, and vouchers without restarting.*

Permissions:
- `mimivouchers.admin` - *Grants access to all admin commands.*
- `mimivouchers.use` - *Allows players to right-click and use vouchers (Enabled by default).*
- Custom per-voucher permissions (e.g., `mimivouchers.vouchervip`).

## Requirements & Hooks
Server Version: Paper / Purpur / Folia 1.21+ (Requires Java 21).
PlaceholderAPI (Optional but recommended): Full PAPI support in items, lores, and broadcast messages.

## Developer API (Coming Soon)
Built with modularity in mind. The robust manager architecture will soon feature a full API for custom reward hooks and external database synchronization.

description: Transform ordinary End Crystals into intelligent, auto-targeting laser turrets with advanced combat mechanics, custom health, and fully configurable behavior.
body:
# End Crystal Turret

This plugin transforms the standard End Crystal which normally only heals the Ender Dragon into a formidable defensive turret. It deals "true damage" capable of piercing any defense, scaling from negligible initial damage to devastating levels.

```
  #==========================================

    #END CRYSTAL TURRET CONFIGURATION

  #==========================================

  attack:
    radius: 15.0
    base-damage: 0.05
    max-damage: 10.0
    damage-increase-per-tick: 0.2
    damage-interval-ticks: 6
    target-lost-timeout-ticks: 40

  health:
    max-hp: 60.0
    auto-heal-delay-seconds: 5
    auto-heal-amount: 2.0
    auto-heal-interval-seconds: 2

  defense:
    knockback-radius: 5.0
    knockback-strength: 1.5
    slowness-duration-ticks: 60

  booting:
    boot-time: 5 

  meltdown:
    duration-seconds: 3
    explosion-power: 6.0
```

- radius: Area reachable by an end crystal.
- base-damage: the initial damage inflicted.
- max-damage: The highest damage that can be dealt.
- damage-increase-per-tick: damage that increases with each tick.
- damage-interval-ticks: The interval between damage ticks.
- target-lost-timeout-ticks: The maximum duration an End Crystal can currently sustain damage per tick.
- max-hp: Maximum End Crystal health.
- auto-heal-delay-seconds: The delay before an end crystal can restore health.
- auto-heal-amount: amount of health restored.
- auto-heal-interval-seconds: The interval between each health recovery.
- knockback-radius: Range at which knockback can be inflicted.
- knockback-strength: Knockback force that can be dealt.
- slowness-duration-ticks: Duration of the slowness effect.
- boot-time: booting duration in seconds.
- duration-seconds: Duration of the end crystal during the meltdown phase.
- explosion-power: The explosive force exerted upon destruction.


### The plugin features:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

1. The End Crystal booting phase duration.
2. End Crystals cannot be attacked with projectiles unless they are currently attacking.
3. The End Crystal will trigger a knockback effect when it takes damage.
4. A highly dangerous End Crystal attack capable of penetrating armor, the damage starts off low but intensifies over time.
5. The "End Crystal destroyed" phase which lasts for a few seconds before exploding and dealing massive damage.
6. End crystals will not attack mobs tamed by their owners.

8. Configure your end crystal via chat by right-clicking on it.

</details>

Normally, changing your scale with the `/attribute` command ONLY changes your scale, Resizable changes that. Resizable adjusts many of your attributes, including but not limited to speed, step height and jump height. When changing your scale via `/function ncs:resize {t:"<target>",s:<scale>}` you will be able to play the game at your desired scale. The formula to find the correct scale (`s`) is `<blocks>/2`. Using that formula, the way to find the command to change your scale to half of a block is as follows:
```
/function ncs:resize {t:"<target>",s:<scale>}

<target> = @s (self)
<scale>  = 0.5/2
<scale>  = 0.25

/function ncs:resize {t:"@s",s:0.25}
```
###### Tested on 26.2

title: Origins x FTB Ranks
description: FTB Ranks x Origins (NeoForge) Compact. Adds compatability between FTB Ranks and Origins (NeoForge) allowing ranks to be defined by origin.
body:
# Origins Ranks

Origins Ranks is a server-side addon for FTB Ranks that adds a custom rank condition for the Origins mod, allowing ranks to be automatically applied based on a player's selected Origin.

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Architectuary API
* FTB Ranks
* FTB Library
* Origins (IAFEnvoy NeoForge)

## Condition

**Type:** `originranks:has_origin`

### Properties

| Property | Required | Description                                              |
| -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `origin` | Yes      | The Origin ID to check (for example `origins:avian`).    |
| `layer`  | No       | The Origin layer to check. Defaults to `origins:origin`. |

## Example

```snbt
avian: {
    name: "Avian"
    power: 50

    condition: {
        type: "originranks:has_origin"
        origin: "origins:avian"
    }
}
```

Specifying a layer:

```snbt
condition: {
    type: "originranks:has_origin"
    origin: "origins:archer"
    layer: "origins:class"
}
```

## How It Works

Whenever FTB Ranks evaluates a player's ranks, the `has_origin` condition checks the player's current Origin from the Origins mod. If the configured Origin matches, the rank is considered active.

No commands, scoreboards, datapacks, or KubeJS scripts are required.

## Notes

* This addon is server-side only.
* The default Origin layer is `origins:origin`, so `layer` can usually be omitted.
* The `origin` value must match the Origin's full resource ID.

title: Double Jumps
description: Adds double jump ability and its own enchantment
body:
![enchant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea836ed1714c4f065aca5466c99c9e7d8f5baeff.png)


# DoubleJump 

A lightweight double jump ability and enchantment for Minecraft boots, compatible with Spigot/Paper 1.19–1.21+.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/o7_S7hCMNZM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![paper](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.jsdelivr.net%2Fnpm%2F%40intergrav%2Fdevins-badges%403%2Fassets%2Fcozy%2Fsupported%2Fpaper_vector.svg&n=-1) ![spigot](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.jsdelivr.net%2Fnpm%2F%40intergrav%2Fdevins-badges%403%2Fassets%2Fcozy%2Fsupported%2Fspigot_vector.svg&n=-1) ![purpur](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.jsdelivr.net%2Fnpm%2F%40intergrav%2Fdevins-badges%403%2Fassets%2Fcozy%2Fsupported%2Fpurpur_vector.svg&n=-1)


## Features
* **DoubleJump** ability (does not need enchantment)
* **Double Jump I–III** enchantment stored via Persistent Data Containers (version-safe).
* Obtainable through enchanting tables with configurable chances.
* Optional **Shift Boost** system for stronger jumps.
* Global enable/disable toggle.
* Configurable cooldown, hunger cost, particles, and sounds.
* `doublejump.use` permission for non-enchanted players.

## Commands

| Command                             | Description        |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| `/doublejump`                       | Show help          |
| `/doublejump reload`                | Reload config      |
| `/doublejump setcooldown <seconds>` | Set cooldown       |
| `/doublejump enable`                | Enable globally    |
| `/doublejump disable`               | Disable globally   |
| `/doublejump enchant <1-3>`         | Enchant held boots |

Alias: `/dj`

## Permissions

| Permission         | Description           |
| ------------------ | --------------------- |
| `doublejump.use`   | Allows double jumping |
| `doublejump.admin` | Access admin commands |

## Configuration

Key options include:

* Global enable/disable
* Jump cooldown
* Hunger cost
* Per-level jump power
* Enchanting table chances
* Anvil costs
* Shift Boost settings

The plugin automatically generates a `config.yml` on first startup.

## How It Works

Players wearing Double Jump boots (or with `doublejump.use`) can jump again while airborne to launch themselves forward. Jump strength, cooldowns, effects, and boost mechanics are fully configurable.

The enchantment is stored using Persistent Data Containers, ensuring compatibility across Minecraft versions without relying on the vanilla enchantment registry.

## Compatibility

* Spigot 1.19+
* Paper 1.19+
* Java 17+
* No dependencies

title: NightVisuals AutoSprint
description: Automatically keeps you sprinting whenever you move forward.
body:
**REQUIREMENTS**
[NightVisuals GUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/nightvisuals-gui)

**EN:**

NightVisuals AutoSprint is a utility modification that automatically triggers and maintains sprinting during player movement, eliminating the need to hold or double-tap the sprint key.

**Core Features**

* **Smart Auto-Sprint:** Automatically engages sprinting whenever you move forward.
* **Toggle On/Off:** Easily enable or disable the feature through the NightVisuals in-game GUI menu.
* **Seamless Integration:** Fully compatible with vanilla movement mechanics without causing rubberbanding or desync.
* **Zero Performance Impact:** Lightweight logic that executes within the player tick event without additional rendering overhead.

**Configuration**

AutoSprint toggles via the NightVisuals GUI (default key: **RShift**). No separate config files required.

**Installation**

1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API.
2. Install **NightVisuals GUI** (required dependency).
3. Place the downloaded AutoSprint mod `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game.

---

**RU:**

NightVisuals AutoSprint — это утилитарная модификация, которая автоматически активирует и удерживает режим бега при движении игрока вперёд, избавляя от необходимости зажимать или дважды нажимать клавишу спринта.

**Основной функционал**

* **Умный авто-спринт:** Автоматически включает бег при любом движении вперёд.
* **Включение/Выключение:** Удобное управление функцией через внутриигровое меню NightVisuals GUI.
* **Полная синхронизация:** Корректно работает с ванильной механикой движений, не вызывая дёрганий (rubberbanding) или десинхронизации с сервером.
* **Нулевое влияние на FPS:** Максимально лёгкий код, выполняющийся в событии тика игрока без дополнительной нагрузки на систему.

**Настройка**

AutoSprint переключается через NightVisuals GUI (клавиша по умолчанию: **RShift**). Дополнительных конфигов нет.

**Установка**

1. Установите Fabric Loader и Fabric API.
2. Установите **NightVisuals GUI** (обязательная зависимость).
3. Поместите скачанный файл мода AutoSprint в папку `mods`.
4. Запустите игру.

title: Pillager Assault Brigade-Priestess
description: Summon the Illager legion and survive brutal curses and massive onslaughts—will you face the “Disaster”?
body:
# Assault Brigade- Priestess

[English](#english) | [中文](#中文)

---

## English

### What the mod does
- Adds the `/assault brigade <player> [radius] [counts]` command, which spawns a configurable raiding party around a target player. The party consists of vanilla illagers (pillagers, vindicators, ravagers, illusioners, evokers) and three custom mobs. All spawned creatures ignore distance and line-of-sight, pursuing the target indefinitely.
- Introduces three new mobs:
  - **Vengeful Slayer** – A zombie-based melee attacker that dual-wields golden axes. It can break wooden doors, step up two-block-high obstacles, and inflicts strong knockback while being immune to knockback itself. It drops gold ingots upon death.
  - **Valkyrie** – Rides a phantom (which has no independent AI) and fires arrows at a rate of approximately three per second. Arrows deal a fixed amount of damage and apply the Bad Omen effect.
  - **High Priestess** – A ranged curse-caster that attacks from up to 50 blocks away without needing line-of-sight. It applies Weakness, Darkness, Nausea, and Mining Fatigue to the target and displays a red action‑bar message to the victim. Killing the High Priestess grants the player a new status effect, **Disaster**, which lasts for 40 minutes.
- Implements the **Disaster** effect, during which:
  - The sky and fog turn reddish, and a heartbeat sound plays periodically.
  - Every minute, a random threat message (language automatically matched to the target) is broadcast to all players.
  - At 5, 10, 15, and 20 minutes, a Vengeful Slayer spawns within 25 blocks of the player.
  - At 25, 30, and 35 minutes, three escalating waves of assault brigades are automatically summoned.
  - The effect cannot be removed by drinking milk.
- Adds two advancements: **Disaster** (awarded the first time the effect is obtained) and **Enemy of Ten Thousand** (awarded when the effect expires naturally after 40 minutes). The latter also gives the player an enchanted book containing the exclusive **Disaster Warding** enchantment.
- Provides the **Disaster Warding** enchantment, which can be applied to weapons. Hitting a target with an enchanted weapon causes a knockback of approximately 9 blocks.
- Includes the `/assault deter [player]` command, which manually sends a pillager threat message visible to all players, with automatic language detection.

### Why use this mod
The mod creates a demanding survival scenario where the player must endure a prolonged, multi‑stage assault that cannot be escaped by conventional means. It introduces new hostile mobs with distinct behaviors and a unique curse mechanic that tests preparation and combat ability. The custom enchantment and advancements offer additional long‑term objectives.

### Important notes before downloading
- All commands require operator‑level permissions.
- The Disaster effect is intentionally difficult to remove. Only death or waiting out the full 40‑minute duration will clear it. Milk is specifically blocked from removing this effect, although cleansing items from other mods may still work if they use a different removal method.
- The mob spawning process uses command‑level initialization to ensure that equipment and AI are set up correctly.

---

## 中文

### 模组功能
- 添加指令 `/assault brigade <玩家> [半径] [数量]`，可在目标玩家周围生成一支可配置的灾厄突袭队。队伍成员包括原版灾厄村民（掠夺者、卫道士、劫掠兽、幻术师、唤魔者）和三种自定义生物。所有生成的生物均无视距离和视线阻挡，会持续追击目标。
- 引入三种新生物：
  - **复仇杀手** – 基于僵尸的进程攻击者，双手持金斧。能破坏木门、直接走上两格高的障碍，攻击造成强力击退且自身免疫击退。死亡时掉落金锭。
  - **女武神** – 骑乘幻翼（幻翼无独立AI），以每秒约三发的频率射出箭矢。箭矢造成固定伤害并附加不祥之兆效果。
  - **大祭司** – 远程诅咒施法者，可从最多50格外无视障碍物攻击。对目标施加虚弱、黑暗、反胃和挖掘疲劳效果，并向受害者显示红色动作栏消息。击杀大祭司会使玩家获得持续40分钟的新状态效果——**灾至**。
- **灾至**效果包含以下机制：
  - 天空和雾气变为红色，周期性播放心跳声。
  - 每分钟向全服广播一条随机威胁消息（根据目标语言自动切换）。
  - 在第5、10、15、20分钟时，于玩家周围25格内生成一只复仇杀手。
  - 在第25、30、35分钟时，依次自动召唤三波规模递增的突袭大队。
  - 该效果无法通过饮用牛奶移除。
- 添加两个进度：首次获得灾至时授予**“灾至”**，灾至效果自然消失时授予**“万人敌”**。后者还会奖励一本附有专属附魔**“灾厄退散”**的附魔书。
- 提供**灾厄退散**附魔，可附在武器上。击中目标时造成约9格的击退。
- 包含 `/assault deter [玩家]` 指令，可手动向全服发送掠夺者威胁消息，语言根据目标自动选择。

### 使用理由
本模组提供了一个富有挑战性的生存场景：玩家必须在无法用常规方式规避的长时间多波次袭击中存活下来。新的敌对生物拥有不同的行为模式，独特的诅咒机制考验玩家的准备和战斗能力，而专属附魔和进度则提供了长期目标。

### 下载前需知
- 所有指令需要管理员权限。
- 灾至效果被刻意设计为难以移除。只有死亡或等待40分钟自然结束才能消除。牛奶被特意阻止移除该效果，但其他模组的净化物品如果使用不同的移除方式，可能仍然有效。
- 生物生成过程使用了命令级别的初始化，以确保正确的装备和AI配置。
```

title: OptimizerX
description: Optimize your server with AI Boost...
body:
# ⚡ OptimizerX — The Ultimate Overdrive Performance Solution

**OptimizerX** is a next-generation, aggressive performance optimizer built from the ground up to eliminate server lag, micro-stutters, and high RAM usage. By utilizing ultra-lightweight, primitive-backed custom data structures like **BlockKey** and **ChunkKey**, it tracks redstone and hopper activity with absolute precision and a near-zero memory footprint.

Whether you run a heavy Towny, Factions, or massive Survival server, OptimizerX dynamically monitors your hardware resources and steps in with aggressive limits when your server needs it most—without breaking the core vanilla gameplay experience.

---

## 🚀 Key Features & Aggressive Modes

*   🔥 **Emergency Overdrive Mode (`/ox force`):** Instantly pushes the plugin into strict, hard performance limits. It slashes mob spawn caps down to absolute essentials per chunk to save your TPS during critical lag spikes or player rushes.
*   🧩 **Custom Key Architecture (`BlockKey` & `ChunkKey`):** Replaces heavy, memory-hogging Bukkit location objects with lightning-fast primitive caches. This completely immunizes your server against memory leaks and ensures maximum thread-safety.
*   🛑 **Smart Hopper & Redstone Limiter:** Blocks lag machines before they can choke the main thread. Empty hoppers are safely put into a 5-second deep sleep, and redstone ticks are capped dynamically per chunk.
*   ⚙️ **Asynchronous Map Pre-Loading (`WarmupManager`):** Safely pre-loads your world spawn radius asynchronously on startup. It saves progress to disk across restarts so players won't experience chunk-generation lag while exploring.
*   💤 **Dynamic View Distance (AFK Optimizer):** Automatically detects idle players and drops their individual render distance down to 2 chunks, instantly recovering vast amounts of network and CPU bandwidth.
*   🧠 **Intelligent Entity AI Throttling:** If no players are within a tight 10-block radius, Villager and Mob AIs are completely frozen. No wasted CPU cycles on background entities!
*   📦 **Next-Gen Item Stacking:** Merges dropped ground items up to 256 per stack and attaches smooth, custom neon-green quantity holograms above them, massively lowering client and server entity rendering overhead.
*   💻 **Hardware Auto-Tune:** Automatically analyzes your server hardware (available CPU cores and allocated RAM) and dynamically configures `server.properties` on the fly for low-end environments.

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

All commands require the **`optimizerx.admin`** permission node.

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/ox clean` | Triggers a deep, lag-free smart purge on loaded chunks and safely invokes GC if required. |
| `/ox usage` | Displays real-time free RAM ratios and the exact number of active chunks loaded. |
| `/ox force` | Activates extreme Overdrive Mode to aggressively handle heavy server stress. |
| `/ox gc` | Forces the JVM garbage collector to run immediately with a before/after RAM comparison. |
| `/ox purge` | Aggressively clears ground items older than 60s, freezes distant mob AIs, and forces GC. |
| `/ox chunks <radius>` | Asynchronously pre-loads chunks within a block radius centered at world spawn. |
| `/ox chunks status` | Displays the live progress, percentage complete, and processed counts of the preloader. |
| `/ox chunks cancel` | Aborts the active chunk preloader task and clears the saved disk progress file. |
| `/ox chunks resume` | Resumes a previously stopped chunk preloader seamlessly from its last saved disk state. |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

OptimizerX comes pre-configured out of the box for immediate, peak performance results.

```yaml
warmup:
  # Radius in blocks to pre-load
  preload-radius: 500
  # Loading speed (chunks per second)
  chunks-per-second: 5
  # Message shown to players while server is warming up
  kick-message: "&7Server is warming up, please wait..."

performance:
  # Seconds of inactivity before a player is considered AFK
  afk-threshold-seconds: 60
  # View distance to apply to AFK players
  reduced-view-distance: 2

performance-monitor:
  # Aims to keep at least 50% of RAM free at all times
  min-free-ram-percent: 0.50
  # How often to check resource usage (seconds)
  check-interval-seconds: 30
  # CPU usage threshold before alerting ops (0.85 = 85%)
  cpu-threshold: 0.85

security:
  # Redstone pulse limit per second per coordinate
  redstone-limit: 20

item-optimization:
  # Enable/disable item despawn optimization
  enabled: true
  # Time in seconds after which dropped items will be removed
  despawn-time-seconds: 60
  # Worlds where item despawn optimization should be active (empty for all worlds)
  worlds: []

title: RisersSecurity
description: RisersSecurity is a premium Minecraft authentication plugin that protects player accounts with a fast, secure, and reliable login system.
body:
# 🛡️ **RisersSecurity**

> **Protect your server with a fast, lightweight, and dependency-free authentication system.**

**RisersSecurity** is a premium authentication plugin for Paper and Spigot servers that provides a secure register/login system without requiring MySQL, SQLite, or any external libraries. Built with performance and simplicity in mind, it stores player data in clean YAML files while protecting passwords using industry-standard **BCrypt** hashing.

Simple to set up, lightweight to run, and powerful enough to secure your server.

---

# ✨ **Features**

## 🔐 Secure Authentication

Keep player accounts safe with a reliable authentication system.

* **BCrypt password hashing**
* Passwords are **never stored in plain text**
* Secure register and login system
* Change passwords anytime using in-game commands

---

## ⚡ Lightweight & Dependency-Free

No databases.

No external plugins.

No complicated setup.

RisersSecurity is built entirely using the **Bukkit API** and the **Java Standard Library**, making installation quick and maintenance effortless.

---

## 🌍 Spawn Protection

Prevent unauthorized players from exploring your server before logging in.

When an unauthenticated player joins:

* They are teleported to the configured spawn
* Movement is restricted
* Blindness prevents them from seeing their surroundings
* Their original location is securely remembered

After successfully logging in, players are automatically returned to the exact location where they left.

---

## 📍 Location Memory

Players never lose their position.

RisersSecurity remembers where players disconnected and restores them immediately after authentication.

---

## ⏱️ Smart Security Controls

Protect your server from brute-force attempts with configurable security settings.

Features include:

* Login timeout
* Register timeout
* Maximum failed login attempts
* Minimum password length
* Maximum password length
* Session timeout

Everything can be customized through the configuration file.

---

## 🎨 Fully Customizable

Every aspect of the plugin can be personalized.

Customize:

* Prefix
* Colors
* Login messages
* Register messages
* Error messages
* Success messages

Supports traditional Minecraft color codes.

---

## 👮 Admin Tools

Manage your server without restarting it.

Available admin features include:

* Reset player passwords
* Reload the plugin configuration instantly

---

# 📁 Simple Storage

Player information is stored inside a clean and human-readable **playerdata.yml** file.

No SQL databases.

No external services.

Just simple and reliable YAML storage.

---

# ⚙️ Requirements

* **Paper / Spigot 1.21+**
* **Java 21**

---

# ❤️ Why RisersSecurity?

Many authentication plugins rely on external databases or complicated setups.

**RisersSecurity focuses on simplicity without sacrificing security.**

With secure password hashing, zero dependencies, configurable protection, and lightweight performance, it's the perfect authentication solution for both small and large Minecraft servers.

---

# 🚀 Secure Your Server

**Register.**

**Login.**

**Play with confidence.**

title: dotMod
description: Client-side Fabric PvP/survival utility mod with quick craft, draggable HUD editor, local player name colors, and toggle sneak.
body:
# dotMOD

**dotMOD** is a lightweight client-side Fabric utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.11, focused on PvP and survival quality-of-life features.

The mod adds a small set of configurable client tools: quick crafting from selected inventory slots, a draggable HUD editor, local player name coloring, and toggle sneak.

## Features

### Quick Craft

Adds a `Craft` button to the player inventory and crafting table screen.

When pressed, dotMOD moves items from configured inventory slots into the crafting grid using normal client click actions.

Default source slots:

**2x2 player inventory:**
- 9
- 10
- 18
- 19

**3x3 crafting table:**
- 9
- 10
- 11
- 18
- 19
- 20
- 27
- 28
- 29

Source slots are configured as logical player inventory slots, not raw GUI slot ids.

### HUD Editor

Adds a `HUD` button to the inventory and creative inventory.

The HUD Editor lets you move selected vanilla HUD elements by dragging them with the mouse.

Supported elements include:

- Hearts
- Armor
- Hunger
- Hotbar
- Experience bar / level positions in config
- Status effects
- Bossbar
- Scoreboard

The editor includes:
- draggable element frames
- element labels
- reset button
- optional grid snapping
- saved `dx/dy` offsets

### Name Colors

dotMOD lets you locally recolor the name of the player you are looking at.

Default keybinds:

- `G` - color targeted player green
- `R` - color targeted player red
- `V` - reset targeted player's name color

Colors are stored by player UUID and only affect your own client.

Supported displays:

- Nameplate above the player
- Tab list name, when possible

Optional chat notifications can be enabled in the config.

### Toggle Shift

Adds a toggle sneak keybind.

Default keybind:

- `Right Shift`

When enabled, your sneak key is held client-side until you toggle it off again. Normal physical sneak still works as usual.

## Configuration

dotMOD has a Mod Menu + Cloth Config settings screen.

Config sections:

- General
- Quick Craft
- HUD Editor
- Name Colors
- Toggle Shift
- Keybinds info

The config is client-only and saved between game launches.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu
- Cloth Config API

## Notes

dotMOD is fully client-side.  
It does not add server-side content and does not require installation on the server.

HUD movement is designed for vanilla HUD behavior. Compatibility with large HUD overhaul mods may vary.

title: Quick Stack Charm
description: Right-click any container (chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dropper, etc.) while holding the charm and items from your inventory that match types already in that container get pushed in automatically.
body:
Quick Stack is one item, doing one job, well.

Craft a **Quick Stack Charm** from a chest and an ender pearl (shapeless). Hold it and right-click any container — chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dropper. Items in your inventory that match types the container **already holds** get pushed in.

## Why "already holds"?
The charm never introduces new item categories to a container. If your iron chest is full of iron ingots, blocks and nuggets, quick-stacking against it will only top up those three. Everything else stays in your inventory. Sorted storage rooms stay sorted; you don't have to clean up afterwards.

## Features

Super simple and easy to use.
**Hotbar protected.** By default the mod skips your hotbar so your tools and food don't get taken. Toggle in the config.
**Soft feedback.** Optional pickup sound and a private chat message telling you how many items moved.


## Compatibility

Works with vanilla containers and any modded storage block that implements the standard Container interface.

title: ManageChest
description: Simple and safe chest locking plugin using a stick. Zero database, zero lag, full dupe protection.
body:
# ManageChest

ManageChest is a secure, lightweight, and modern chest locking plugin for Minecraft 1.20+ (Paper/Purpur) servers. It doesn't use any external databases or messy YAML config files for player data. Instead, it stores all lock information directly inside the chest blocks using `PersistentDataContainer` (PDC), ensuring zero data loss during server crashes.

---

## Features

* **Direct PDC Storage:** No databases, no lag. Data is embedded directly into the chest blocks.
* **Anti-Dupe Protection:** Prevents item duplication by closing open inventories automatically if a chest is broken or unlocked.
* **Hopper Protection:** Locked chests completely block hoppers and hopper minecarts from pulling or pushing items.
* **Piston & Explosion Proof:** Locked chests cannot be moved by pistons and are completely immune to TNT, Creeper, or Wither explosions.
* **Double Chest Control:** Untrusted players cannot expand your locked chest into a double chest.

---

## How to Use

1. Take a regular **Stick** in your hand.
2. **Right-click** on a chest to lock it under your name.
3. **Right-click** the locked chest again with a stick to see the management menu in chat.

---

## Commands & Permissions

The plugin completely separates language commands based on the active language setting.

### English Mode Commands:

* `/player add <name>` - Grants a player permission to open the chest.
* `/player remove <name>` - Revokes permission from a player.
* `/lock remove` - Completely unlocks the chest.

### Türkçe Modu Komutları:

* `/oyuncu ekle <isim>` - Belirtilen oyuncuya sandığı açma yetkisi verir.
* `/oyuncu kaldır <isim>` - Oyuncunun yetkisini geri alır.
* `/kilidi kaldır` - Sandığın kilidini tamamen kaldırır.

### Admin Commands & Permissions:

* `/managechest language <english/turkish>` - Changes the plugin's active language and command set.
* *Permission:* `managechest.admin`


* **Admin Bypass:** Players with the `managechest.bypass` permission can open or break any locked chest.
