- cannot use FTP
- use restricted hosting
- are beginners
- need a simpler plugin installation workflow

title: AIServerHost
description: An AI-powered server host plugin for Minecraft
body:
# AIServerHost

An AI-powered server host plugin for Minecraft

## Overview

AIServerHost integrates DeepSeek AI into your Minecraft server to act as an intelligent server host. It monitors player chat, detects conflicts, mediates disputes, enforces rules, and even initiates conversations when players are idle.

## Features

- **AI Chat Monitoring** — Every player message is analyzed by the AI in real time.
- **Conflict Detection & Mediation** — When players argue, the AI steps in to mediate.
- **Evidence Gathering** — The AI can @ players for testimony and query CoreProtect logs (3-day limit) before taking action.
- **Automated Punishment** — The AI can issue temporary bans (up to 10 minutes) via AdvancedBan. Punishments exceeding 10 minutes are logged for admin review instead of auto-executed.
- **Idle Chat** — When the server is quiet and players seem bored, the AI can start friendly conversations.
- **Token Saving** — The AI can pause chat monitoring when conversations are casual and don't require supervision.
- **Full Action Logging** — Every AI analysis step is recorded in `whataido.yml` with configurable retention.
- **Severe Punishment Logging** — Punishments over 10 minutes are recorded in `log.yml` with time, player, and details for admin review.
- **Async Processing** — API calls and heavy operations run on separate threads to prevent server lag.

## Safety Restrictions

The AI is **hardcoded** to never perform these actions:

- Setting admin/op status
- Banning players for more than 10 minutes directly
- Shutting down the server
- Deleting chunks
- Filling blocks
- Giving items to players
- Executing arbitrary server commands

## Requirements

- **Server**: Purpur or Paper 1.21.x
- **Java**: 21+
- **DeepSeek API Key** — Required for AI functionality
- **[Optional] CoreProtect** — For block log queries
- **[Optional] AdvancedBan** — For punishment execution (falls back to kick if unavailable)

## Installation

1. Download `AIServerHost-1.0.0.jar`
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` directory
3. Start the server — default config will be generated
4. Edit `plugins/AIServerHost/config.yml` and set your DeepSeek API key
5. Run `/aiserverhost reload` or restart the server

## Configuration

### config.yml

```yaml
# DeepSeek API Configuration
api:
  key: "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"           # Your DeepSeek API key (required)
  base-url: "https://api.deepseek.com"  # API base URL
  model: "deepseek-chat"             # Model name (deepseek-chat for V3)
  timeout: 30                        # Request timeout in seconds

# AI Behavior Settings
ai:
  max-context: 100                   # Maximum chat history messages to keep
  max-pause-duration: 30             # Maximum pause duration (minutes)
  idle-chat:
    enabled: true                    # Enable idle chat feature
    min-players: 2                   # Minimum online players to trigger
    check-interval: 120              # Check interval in seconds
    max-idle-time: 300               # Max idle time before AI chats (seconds)

# Punishment Settings
punishment:
  max-direct-duration: 10            # Max direct punishment (minutes)
  log-threshold: 10                  # Log threshold for severe punishment (minutes)

# Logging Settings
logging:
  whataido-retention-days: 30        # Days to keep whataido.yml records
```

### Generated Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `config.yml` | Plugin configuration |
| `whataido.yml` | AI action log (auto-cleaned based on retention days) |
| `log.yml` | Severe punishment log (for admin review) |

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `/aiserverhost reload` | `aiserverhost.admin` | Reload configuration |
| `/aiserverhost` | `aiserverhost.admin` | Show plugin info |

Aliases: `/ash`, `/aishost`

## AI Actions

The AI responds in JSON format and can perform these actions:

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `chat` | Send a public chat message |
| `ask_player` | Ask a specific player a question publicly |
| `ask_witness` | Ask an online player for evidence/testimony |
| `query_coreprotect` | Query CoreProtect block logs (3-day limit) |
| `punish` | Issue a temporary ban (max 10 minutes) |
| `request_ban` | Request a ban over 10 minutes (logged, not auto-executed) |
| `mediate` | Mediate a conflict between players |
| `pause` | Pause chat monitoring to save tokens |
| `idle_chat` | Initiate a casual conversation |
| `no_action` | No action needed |

## How It Works

1. When a player sends a chat message, it's added to the AI's context
2. The AI analyzes the message along with recent chat history
3. Based on its analysis, the AI decides on an action (or no action)
4. Actions are executed on the main server thread (game operations) or async threads (API calls)
5. Every step is logged in `whataido.yml`

title: SyAI
description: Let the ai be integrated into your server, ai chat and take over games
body:
# SyAI - AI Integration Plugin for Minecraft


SyAI connects Minecraft players to AI models, enabling AI-powered chat conversations and autonomous task execution directly in-game.

---

## Supported AI Models

| Model | Provider | API Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | DeepSeek | OpenAI |
| `deepseek-v4-flash` | DeepSeek | OpenAI |
| `kimi-k2-6` | Kimi (Moonshot) | OpenAI |
| `qwen3.7-plus` | Qwen (Alibaba) | OpenAI |
| `qwen3.7-max` | Qwen (Alibaba) | OpenAI |
| `glm-5.1` | GLM (ZhipuAI) | OpenAI |
| `minimax-m3` | MiniMax | Anthropic |

---

## Installation

1. Download `SyAI.jar` and place it in your server's `plugins/` folder.
2. Start/restart the server.
3. Edit `plugins/SyAI/config.yml` to configure API keys (see below).
4. Use `/syai reload` to reload configuration without restarting.

---

## Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
# Whether to use admin-provided API keys
# If true, players will use the keys configured below
# If false, players must provide their own API keys via /syai api
use-admin-api: true

# Admin API keys (only used if use-admin-api is true)
admin-api-keys:
  deepseek-v4-pro: "sk-your-key-here"
  deepseek-v4-flash: "sk-your-key-here"
  kimi-k2-6: "sk-your-key-here"
  qwen3.7-plus: "sk-your-key-here"
  qwen3.7-max: "sk-your-key-here"
  glm-5.1: "your-key-here"
  minimax-m3: "your-key-here"

# Default model for chat and tasks
default-model: "deepseek-v4-flash"

# Maximum context messages for chat
max-context: 100

# AI task settings
task:
  max-rounds: 50
  action-delay: 10
```

### Two API Key Modes

**Admin Mode** (`use-admin-api: true`):  
All players share the API keys configured by the admin. Players do not need to configure anything.

**Player Mode** (`use-admin-api: false`):  
Each player must provide their own API key using `/syai api <model> <key>`. Keys are stored in a local JSON file (`api_keys.json`).

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/syai chat true` | Enable AI chat mode — all messages are sent to AI |
| `/syai chat false` | Disable AI chat mode |
| `/syai task <requirement>` | Let AI take over your client to complete a task |
| `/syai task cancel` | Cancel the current AI task |
| `/syai api <model> <key>` | Set your personal API key for a model |
| `/syai model [name]` | View or change your active model |
| `/syai status` | View your current status |
| `/syai reload` | Reload configuration (admin only) |

---

## AI Chat Mode

When chat mode is enabled, every message the player sends in chat is forwarded to the AI. The AI responds with the conversation context.

- **100 messages of context** are maintained per player.
- The AI is aware of the player's Minecraft username.
- The AI responds in the same language the player uses.
- Context is cleared when chat mode is disabled or the player logs out.

---

## AI Task Mode

AI tasks allow the AI to take control of a player's client and perform actions in the world. The AI uses **function calling (tool use)** to interact with the game.

### Available Tools (18 tools)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `execute_command` | Execute a player command (admin commands are **blocked**) |
| `send_message` | Send a chat message |
| `move_to` | Teleport to specific coordinates |
| `move_forward` | Move forward in the facing direction |
| `look_at` | Change view direction (yaw/pitch) |
| `get_position` | Get current position and direction |
| `get_inventory` | View inventory contents |
| `place_block` | Place a block from inventory |
| `break_block` | Break a block |
| `attack_entity` | Attack the nearest entity |
| `interact_chest` | View/deposit/withdraw chest items |
| `drop_item` | Drop items from inventory |
| `switch_hotbar` | Switch held hotbar slot (0-8) |
| `switch_hand_item` | Swap items between two inventory slots |
| `use_item` | Consume/use held item |
| `get_nearby_blocks` | Scan nearby blocks |
| `get_nearby_entities` | List nearby entities |
| `finish_task` | Signal task completion |

### Command Security

For security, **AI cannot execute administrative commands**. The following command types are blocked:

- **Bans/punishment:** `/ban`, `/ban-ip`, `/kick`, `/mute`, `/warn`, `/jail`, `/tempban`, `/ipban`, `/pardon`, `/unban`, `/unmute`
- **Operator:** `/op`, `/deop`, `/stop`, `/restart`, `/reload`, `/plugins`, `/pl`, `/whitelist`
- **Game manipulation:** `/kill`, `/gamemode`, `/give`, `/xp`, `/enchant`, `/effect`, `/summon`, `/clear`, `/difficulty`, `/gamerule`, `/time`, `/weather`
- **World editing:** `/setblock`, `/fill`, `/clone`, `/setworldspawn`, `/worldborder`, `//` (WorldEdit)
- **Economy manipulation:** `/eco`, `/economy`, `/money give`, `/money take`, `/money set`
- **Permissions:** `/lp`, `/luckperms`, `/perm`, `/pex`, `/groupmanager`
- **Server control:** `/save-all`, `/save-off`, `/save-on`, `/timings`, `/spark`, `/paper`, `/purpur`
- **Invasion:** `/invsee`, `/openinv`, `/vanish`, `/sudo`, `/force`, `/socialspy`, `/spectate`

**Allowed commands** include: `/tpa`, `/tpahere`, `/tpaccept`, `/res tp`, `/money`, `/pay`, `/home`, `/spawn`, `/warp`, `/msg`, `/kit`, `/trade`, `/shop`, `/ah`, `/fly`, `/nick`, and other common player commands.

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `syai.use` | `true` (everyone) | Access to all SyAI commands |
| `syai.admin` | `op` | Access to `/syai reload` |

---

## API Key Privacy

- Player API keys are stored locally in `plugins/SyAI/api_keys.json` (JSON file).
- Keys are never transmitted to third parties — they are only used to call the respective AI provider's API.
- When `use-admin-api` is enabled, individual player keys are not required.

---

title: ChromAuth

body:
**ChromAuth** is an enterprise-grade, lightweight authentication framework tailored explicitly for Paper 1.21.11 infrastructure. Designed from the ground up to replace bloated, legacy login managers, ChromAuth protects  servers from identity theft, unauthorized account access, and malicious bot vectors while maintaining an incredibly light system footprint. 💻✨

## 🌟 Key Features:

**Cryptographically Secure Data Footprint:** Say goodbye to raw text vulnerabilities. ChromAuth protects your community's data natively using **BCrypt** with salted keys, matching modern web standard security patterns. 🛡️🔑

**Total Player Isolation:** Unauthenticated sessions are instantly locked. Impact processes automatically restrict movement vectors, chat streams, physical item interactions, command injections, and incoming entity damage. 🥶🙅‍♂️

**Intelligent IP-Session Caching:** Minimize player login fatigue. If a player drops connection due to a client crash or a quick server reboot, they can rejoin fluidly without typing a password, provided they reconnect from the exact same network footprint within the admin-defined time frame. 🔄🔌

**Complete Formatting Autonomy:** Tailor every user interaction via a dedicated ```messages.yml``` engine with built-in color-code processing. 🎨💬

**TabPac** is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable solution for your server's Tablist and Sidebar Scoreboard. Designed for Paper/Spigot 1.21.x, it offers a "branded" experience with smooth animations and smart features.

title: Void One Block
description: A world type that turns Minecraft into a true void survival experience — while keeping progression, structures, biomes, and mod compatibility intact.
body: # Void One Block **A minimalist, mod-compatible one-block-void world type for Forge 1.16.5./1.20.1** Start with nothing but a single block beneath your feet — and everything else is up to you. *** ## What is this? Void One Block adds a brand-new **world type** to Minecraft. Instead of generating normal terrain, it strips everything away and leaves you standing on exactly one block, floating in the void. From there, it's your job to survive and expand — while biome identity still works exactly as it should, so modded biomes and biome-aware systems behave normally even though there's no terrain to look at. No mountains. No oceans. No forests. No structures to stumble into. Just you, one block, and whatever you build from there. *** ## Key Features ### 🧱 True One-Block Start The Overworld spawns you on a single platform block above an endless void. The block regenerates itself if it's ever removed by outside means (but never overwrites anything you've placed — it only fills in plain air). ### 🌌 Void Nether & Void End Take the challenge further — the Nether and the End can be voided too: * **Nether:** stripped of terrain entirely — pure void. * **The End:** islands are gone, but the exit fountain, obsidian spikes, and the full dragon fight and podium sequence are preserved and placed directly, so the End fight still works correctly. Both are optional and configurable independently. ### 🧩 Biome-Compatible, Structure-Free This void generator preserves original biome sources, so modded biomes (BYG, BOP, and similar) still assign their correct biome IDs to your world — useful for anything that keys off biome identity. Structures, however, are intentionally disabled across every void dimension: no strongholds, villages, fortresses, bastions, End Cities, or modded structures will generate. The one-block challenge is meant to be self-contained rather than a structure hunt. ### ⚙️ Configurable Spawn Block Choose exactly what you start on. By default, Void One Block pairs with **Random Item Generator Resurrected**, spawning you on its mystery item block for an extra layer of unpredictability. Don't have that mod installed? No problem — it automatically falls back to plain `minecraft:bedrock` so the world always generates safely. ``` spawnBlock = "random_item_generator_resurrected:item_block" ``` ### 🎁 Bonus Chest Support Enabled the bonus chest at world creation? It'll spawn right beside your starting block, using the standard vanilla loot table — one time only, and it won't reappear once it's been placed. ### 🌀 Safe End Gateways End gateways get a small safety platform automatically, so stepping through one in a void End won't strand you in empty space. ### 🧭 No Experimental Warnings World generation settings are marked stable, so you won't get the "This world uses experimental settings" pop-up when creating a Void One Block world. *** ## Configuration Options | Option |Default |Description | | ------------------ |-------------------------------------------- |---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | spawnBlock |random_item_generator_resurrected:item_block |The block placed beneath the player at Overworld spawn. Falls back to minecraft:bedrock if the configured block/mod isn't present. | | voidNether |true |Voids Nether terrain entirely. | | voidEnd |true |Voids End terrain while preserving the fountain, obsidian spikes, and dragon fight. | > Structure generation is always disabled in every void dimension — this is no longer a configurable option. *** ## Recommended Pairing Void One Block is designed to work great on its own, but it shines alongside **Random Item Generator Resurrected** — your starting block becomes a mystery item source, turning the classic "one block" survival challenge into a proper progression loop. _(Random Item Generator Resurrected is an optional dependency — Void One Block works fine without it.)_ *** ## Getting Started 1. Install the mod (and optionally Random Item Generator Resurrected). 2. Create a new world. 3. Select the **Void One Block** world type. 4. Fall into the void, land on your block, and start surviving. *** _Built for Forge 1.16.5./1.20.1_

**Mods Simplified Chinese Translation Pack**

This resource pack provides complete Simplified Chinese translations for the following mods:

- **Xaero's World Map** — 295 entries fully translated
- **Zoomify** — Replaces incomplete official translation
- **Do a Barrel Roll** — Includes advanced expression documentation
- **Faster Elytras** — Full translation of all settings and commands

---

## Features

- Complete translation of all text, no untranslated English remaining
- Unified terminology, consistent with Minecraft player conventions
- Covers settings UI, right-click menus, HUD, keybindings, server configuration, and advanced expression documentation
- Loaded as a resource pack, does not modify original mod files
- Compatible with vanilla and other resource packs

---

## Installation

1. Download this resource pack (`.zip` file)
2. Place it into the `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` folder
3. Launch the game, go to Options → Resource Packs
4. Move this resource pack to the right "Selected" list, ensuring it has priority over other translation packs
5. Click "Done" and it will take effect

---

## Notes

- This is a community-made translation, **not an official version**
- Does not include Xaero's Minimap (that mod already has official built-in Chinese)
- If you encounter untranslated text or have suggestions, leave feedback in the comments

---

## Supported Versions
See the "Game Versions" list on the right side of this page. Each version of this resource pack is packaged separately for different Minecraft version ranges. Download the one that matches your game version.


### ⚠️ Version Notes
Language file structures may differ between major Minecraft versions. This resource pack is primarily optimized for current mainstream versions (1.21.x, 1.20.x, 1.19.x). If you encounter any untranslated text on older versions (1.19.2 and below), it may be due to key name differences. Please report it, and I will address it in future updates.
---

- [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)
- [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)
- [Do a Barrel Roll](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll)

---

## Update Plans

- More mod translations may be added in the future
- Maintained alongside mod version updates

title: QOL-TOOLKIT
description: An Improvement mod from minecraft with simple features
body:
# QoL Toolkit

**A lightweight, client-side quality-of-life mod for Minecraft 26.2 — no server required.**

QoL Toolkit bundles the small-but-essential features that vanilla Minecraft is missing into a single, zero-dependency mod. Everything is toggleable, nothing is forced on you, and it works on any server you join.

---

## Features

### 🗺️ Info HUD
A clean heads-up display showing your coordinates, FPS, light level, compass bearing, current biome, XP level, armor durability, and your last death location — all in one place. Toggle with **F6**.

### 📋 Smarter Tooltips
Hover over any item to see extra detail: durability as a percentage, food hunger and saturation values, stack size, and a compact enchantment summary (e.g. `Sharp V · Unbr III · Loot II`) so you can read your gear at a glance.

### ❤️ Target Health Display
See the health of whatever mob your crosshair is resting on, shown directly on your HUD. Toggle with **F8**.

### 📦 Pickup Log
A small on-screen feed that shows the last few items you've picked up — useful when farming or looting chests quickly.

### ⚠️ Chat Warnings
Automatic alerts so nothing sneaks up on you:
- **Low durability** — warns before your tools break
- **Low hunger** — reminds you to eat
- **Wrong tool** — nudges you when you're mining with the wrong item
- **Inventory full** — lets you know before you start losing drops

### 📐 Block Selection Tool
Mark two corners with `/qol pos1` and `/qol pos2`, then use `/qol count` to get a full block-type breakdown of the selected volume. Great for building planning and survival inventory prep.

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/qol` | Open the main menu |
| `/qol settings` | Open the settings screen |
| `/qol toggle <feature>` | Toggle any feature without opening the menu |
| `/qol pos1` / `/qol pos2` | Set selection corners to the block you're looking at |
| `/qol count` | Count block types in your selection |
| `/qol selection` | Show current selection corners |
| `/qol clearselection` | Clear the selection |

---

## Keybindings

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| **F6** | Toggle Info HUD |
| **F8** | Toggle Target Health Display |
| **F9** | Open QoL Toolkit menu |

---

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- Fabric API **0.152.2+26.2**

---

## Notes
- **Client-side only** — works on any multiplayer server, no mod needed server-side
- All settings persist between sessions
- Made by **James Berry** · Licensed under **CC0-1.0**

# Beyond SMP – Enhanced

Welcome to the official Beyond SMP – Enhanced modpack!

Beyond SMP is a Minecraft Java server inspired by Attack on Titan and Avatar: The Last Airbender, featuring Titan powers, elemental bending, factions, exploration and community events.

The Enhanced edition provides the complete Beyond SMP experience by combining every required server mod with additional visual enhancements and quality-of-life features for players who have a more powerful PC.

## Features ##

* ⚔️ Attack on Titan gameplay through Danny’s AOT Mod.
* 🌊 Avatar-inspired elemental bending.
* 🌄 Multiple shader packs.
* 🏞️ Distant Horizons support.
* ✨ Additional visual enhancements.
* 🧭 Extra client-side quality-of-life mods.
* 🎮 Fabric 1.21.1 support.
* 🛡️ Officially maintained by the Beyond SMP developers.
* 🔄 Updated alongside every server update.

## Why download? ##

This modpack allows you to experience Beyond SMP exactly as intended without manually installing every required mod yourself. It also includes carefully selected client-side enhancements that improve immersion while remaining fully compatible with the server.

## Essential Edition ##

If you have a lower-end PC or simply prefer maximum frame rates, check out Beyond SMP – Essential, which contains all required server mods while remaining lightweight and performance-friendly.

### Credits ###

A huge thank you to danny7_7 for creating Danny’s AOT Mod, which makes the Attack on Titan gameplay in the Beyond SMP possible.

Thanks to all of the amazing mod developers whose work is included in this modpack.

title: Graphica Workaround
description: Graphica modpack with mods/optimizations for CPU/GPU that doesn't support modern OpenGL.
body:
![Dark Indigo Black Hole Banner Graphica](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7a7f94f7e6fce91ba48a9fee48173477e3a9e47_0.webp)

This modpack is version of Graphica, specifically for users that have to use workarounds like MESA to run modern Minecraft.

This modpack collected all mods from Graphica that doesn't care about OpenGL3.3 support. So users with CPUs/GPUs that doesn't support OpenGL3.3 can run Minecraft 26.2, through, expect slight rise of FPS rather than x2 FPS that Sodium can bring.

Mods like Sodium, Entity Culling, ImmediatelyFast, ModernFix - all of them are using OpenGL3.3, do not add them to the pack if you don't want to lose FPS.

# Zet's Grace: Repair Equipment
Discarding item data variant: [Zet's Grace: Recraft Equipment](https://modrinth.com/datapack/zg-recraft-eq).


## Description
Recipes for repairing equipment, added item data is not lost. _(Added item data means components such as Enchantments, Dyed Color, and Item Name.)_


## Features
Adds repair recipe for each equimpment with durability.


## Usage
any **Equipment** with durability
**+** its main **Ingredient**
**=** repaired **Equipmemt**

<details><summary>Ambiguous Ingredients</summary>

### Tools
- **Shears** are repaired with **Iron Ingot**
- **Flint and Steel** is repaired with **Flint**
- **Fishing Rod** is repaired with **String**
- **Carrot on a Stick** is repaired with **Carrot**
- **Warped Fungus on a Stick** is repaired with **Warped Fungus**
- **Brush** is repaired with **Feather**

### Weapons
- **Bow** is repaired with **String**
- **Crossbow** is repaired with **String**
- **Trident** is repaired with **Prismarine Crystals** or **Prismarine Shard**
- **Mace** is repaired with **Breeze Rod**

### Wearables
- Iron **Chainmail Armor** is repaired with **Iron Chain**
- **Elytra** is repaired with **Phantom Membrane** or **Shulker Shell**

</details>


## Details
Damaged equipment is replaced with undamaged copy.


## Limitations
Transmute crafting doesn't support:
1. Usage of experience points.
2. Choosing how much durability can be repaired with single ingredient.
3. Changing durability. _(Before 1.21.5)_


## Other
Part of [Zet's Grace Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/4Hmh13Uh).

title: Be Everything
description: The plugin allows players to transform into blocks, items, or mobs.
body:
# **Vietnamese:**

**1. Plugin biến hình thành mọi thứ**
- be-everything là plugin nhẹ cho Minecraft server, cho phép người chơi biến thành block, item hoặc mob.
- Plugin được tách riêng từ hệ thống transform, dùng độc lập và không cần cài NightmareRules.
- Hỗ trợ Paper, Spigot và Bukkit 1.21.x.
- Không cần plugin phụ thuộc.

member:
/be block [material] [duration]
- Biến bản thân thành block.

/be item [material] [duration]
- Biến bản thân thành item.

/be mob [entityType] [duration]
- Biến bản thân thành mob.

/be clear
- Xóa biến hình và trở lại bình thường.

admin:
/be block [material] <player> [duration]
- Biến người chơi khác thành block.

/be item [material] <player> [duration]
- Biến người chơi khác thành item.

/be mob [entityType] <player> [duration]
- Biến người chơi khác thành mob.

/be clear <player>
- Xóa biến hình của người chơi khác.

/be reload
- Tải lại config.

**2. Biến thành block**
- Người chơi có thể biến thành tất cả block hợp lệ trong Minecraft.
- Block sẽ giữ ngang, không bị nghiêng khi người chơi nhìn lên hoặc nhìn xuống.
- Block chỉ xoay trái/phải theo hướng nhìn để trông tự nhiên hơn.

ví dụ:
```text
/be block oak_planks
/be block diamond_block
/be block crafting_table
```

**3. Biến thành item**
- Người chơi có thể biến thành tất cả item hợp lệ trong Minecraft.
- Item nằm ở dưới chân người chơi để nhìn thật hơn.
- Item xoay theo đầy đủ hướng nhìn của người chơi.

ví dụ:
```text
/be item paper
/be item diamond_sword
/be item apple
```

**4. Biến thành mob**
- Người chơi có thể biến thành các entity sống và spawn được.
- Mob transform sẽ đi theo vị trí người chơi.
- Mob được đặt silent, invulnerable, no-AI và không va chạm để dùng như lớp biến hình.

ví dụ:
```text
/be mob zombie
/be mob cow
/be mob creeper
```

**5. Hỗ trợ duration và cooldown**
- Có thể đặt thời gian biến hình bằng tham số duration.
- Nếu duration là 0 thì biến hình không tự hết.
- Có cooldown để tránh spam biến hình.
- Có thể chỉnh duration mặc định và cooldown trong `config.yml`.

ví dụ:
```text
/be block stone 60
/be item diamond 30
/be mob skeleton 120
```

**6. Config đơn giản**
- Có thể bật/tắt transform.
- Có thể chỉnh block mặc định.
- Có thể chỉnh item mặc định.
- Có thể chỉnh mob mặc định.
- Có thể chỉnh cooldown.
- Có thể chỉnh clear-on-quit.
- Có thể chỉnh message.

config:
```yaml
transform:
  enabled: true
  default-block: OAK_PLANKS
  default-item: PAPER
  default-mob: ZOMBIE
  default-duration: 0
  cooldown: 5
  clear-on-quit: true
```

**7. Alias lệnh**
- Lệnh chính là `/be`.
- Có thêm alias để tiện dùng.

alias:
```text
/bee
/beeverything
```

**8. Permission**
be.use
- Cho phép người chơi dùng transform cho bản thân.
- Mặc định: true.

be.admin
- Cho phép admin biến hình người chơi khác và reload config.
- Mặc định: op.

# **English:**
**1. Morphing Plugin**
- "be-everything" is a lightweight plugin for Minecraft servers that allows players to transform into blocks, items, or mobs.
- This plugin is a standalone version of the transformation system; it functions independently and does not require NightmareRules.
- Supports Paper, Spigot, and Bukkit 1.21.x.
- No dependencies required.

Member commands:
/be block [material] [duration]
- Transform yourself into a block.

/be item [material] [duration]
- Transform yourself into an item.

/be mob [entityType] [duration]
- Transform yourself into a mob.

/be clear
- Remove the transformation and return to normal.

Admin commands:
/be block [material] <player> [duration]
- Transform another player into a block.

/be item [material] <player> [duration]
- Transform another player into an item.

/be mob [entityType] <player> [duration]
- Transform another player into a mob.

/be clear <player>
- Remove another player's transformation.

/be reload
- Reload the configuration.
**2. Transform into a block**
- Players can transform into any valid Minecraft block.
- The block remains upright and does not tilt when the player looks up or down.
- The block only rotates left or right based on the player's facing direction for a more natural look.

Examples:
```text
/be block oak_planks
/be block diamond_block
/be block crafting_table
```

**3. Transform into an item**
- Players can transform into any valid Minecraft item.
- The item is positioned at the player's feet for a realistic appearance.
- The item rotates fully according to the player's view direction.

Examples:
```text
/be item paper
/be item diamond_sword
/be item apple
```

**4. Transform into a mob**
- Players can transform into any spawnable living entity.
- The transformed mob follows the player's position.
- The mob is set to silent, invulnerable, no-AI, and non-colliding to serve as a disguise.

Examples:
```text
/be mob zombie
/be mob cow
/be mob creeper
```

**5. Duration and cooldown support**
- Transformation duration can be set using the duration parameter.
- A duration of 0 means the transformation does not expire automatically.
- Cooldowns prevent transformation spamming.
- Default duration and cooldown values ​​can be configured in `config.yml`.

Examples:
```text
/be block stone 60
/be item diamond 30
/be mob skeleton 120
```

**6. Simple configuration**
- Toggle transformation on/off.
- Configure default block.
- Configure default item.
- Configure default mob.
- Configure cooldown.
- Configure clear-on-quit behavior.
- Configure messages. config:
```yaml
transform:
  enabled: true
  default-block: OAK_PLANKS
  default-item: PAPER
  default-mob: ZOMBIE
  default-duration: 0
  cooldown: 5
  clear-on-quit: true
```

**7. Command Alias**
- The main command is `/be`.
- Added alias for convenience.

alias:
```text
/bee
/beeverything
```
**8. Permissions**
be.use
- Allows players to use the transformation ability on themselves.
- Default: true.

be.admin
- Allows admins to transform other players and reload the configuration.
- Default: op.

title: Combustion Blade
description: A funny mod based on Rei Ninja Sect meme. Adds Blazing Blade that plays iconic misheard lines on hit, craftable in survival mode to tease your friends.
body:
# Explanation
 
The lex Ninja Sect is a series of internet memes derived from reversed audio misheard clips of videos featuring [[LexBurner]](https://space.bilibili.com/777536?), a well-known Bilibili streamer and online commentator, combined with settings from works such as Naruto and Ninja Slayer.
 
This meme originated from reversed footage of LexBurner’s livestream on December 19, 2022, during which he broke down crying after being accused of emotional infidelity by his ex-wife.
 
The original line "I didn’t do anything wrong except not love you" became the misheard reversed line "You startled me, I’m unleashing my ninja jutsu", which spread wildly across the internet. Netizens spontaneously reinterpreted numerous bizarre, distorted reversed "eldritch speech" audio snippets from the livestream through misheard phonetic translations, and created fan art centered on ninja emojis .

![shaking hands 🤝.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce0067d79e38168ae8a37c9e7e3bd6b30a98c85e_0.webp)
 
# Introduction
 
This mod adds a weapon called the Blazing Blade. Every strike with it plays the powerful line "Slice after slice, Blazing Blade". It also includes survival-mode crafting recipes, perfect for tormenting your friends for shared amusement.

title: Sulfur Oxidizes Copper
description: Advance copper oxidation stages with the Sulfur Spike instead of waiting for time to pass.
body:
# Sulfur Oxidizes Copper

Adds sulfur oxidation recipes for copper blocks using the Sulfur Spike, allowing you to advance copper oxidation stages without relying on in-game time.

## How it works

Combine any copper block with a Sulfur Spike in the crafting table to advance it one oxidation stage. Waxed variants are also accepted, the block will keep its wax while progressing through oxidation stages.

中文

title: Mind Your Bruises
description: A client-side Minecraft mod that colors the entity hurt overlay based on damage type.
body:
# Mind Your Bruises

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Mind Your Bruises is a client-side Minecraft Fabric mod for 1.21.11 that recolors the vanilla entity hurt overlay based on the damage type that caused it.

The mod keeps vanilla red as the fallback color, then uses different overlay rows for broad damage categories such as fire and explosion, frost and drowning, plant, arcane/wither/void-like damage, shock, starvation, and ender pearl damage.

## Features

- Recolors the vanilla entity hurt overlay on the client.
- Uses different colors for broad damage categories such as fire and explosion, frost and drowning, plant, arcane/wither/void-like damage, shock, starvation, and ender pearl damage.
- Keeps vanilla red as the fallback color for unmatched damage types.
- Supports JSON configuration for colors and damage type overrides.
- Supports custom damage types from mods and datapacks through `damageTypeOverrides`.

## Configuration

Mind Your Bruises creates this config file after the game starts:

```text
.minecraft/config/mind-your-bruises.json
```

In a development environment, the file is created under:

```text
run/config/mind-your-bruises.json
```

The config uses one JSON file directly under `config/`.

If Mod Menu and YetAnotherConfigLib are installed, you can also open the in-game configuration screen from the Mod Menu entry. The in-game screen supports the main toggle, fixed color group color pickers, and advanced damage type overrides.

Example config:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "fireColor": "#ff7014",
  "frostColor": "#4bd2ff",
  "plantColor": "#50dc3c",
  "fallbackColor": "#ff0000",
  "arcaneColor": "#b950ff",
  "shockColor": "#d8f6ff",
  "starvationColor": "#9a7a32",
  "enderColor": "#2bd6b3",
  "damageTypeOverrides": {}
}
```

Manual edits require a game restart.

Configuration fields:

- `enabled`: Turns the mod's recolored hurt overlay on or off. When set to `false`, the overlay falls back to vanilla red.
- `fireColor`, `frostColor`, `plantColor`, `fallbackColor`, `arcaneColor`, `shockColor`, `starvationColor`, and `enderColor`: Hex RGB colors in `#rrggbb` format. Missing `#` is accepted and normalized on save.
- `damageTypeOverrides`: Adds custom overrides on top of the built-in mappings. The left side is a damage type id and the right side is a color group. Valid color groups are `fire`, `frost`, `plant`, `fallback`, `arcane`, `shock`, `starvation`, and `ender`. Built-in mappings are not written to the config file; to override one, add it here explicitly.

Default color groups:

| Color group | Default color | Built-in damage types |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fire` | `#ff7014` | Fire, lava, hot floor, fireballs, explosions, fireworks |
| `frost` | `#4bd2ff` | Freezing and drowning damage |
| `plant` | `#50dc3c` | Cactus and sweet berry bush damage |
| `arcane` | `#b950ff` | Magic, indirect magic, dragon breath, sonic boom, thorns, wither, wither skull, out of world, outside border, generic kill |
| `shock` | `#d8f6ff` | Lightning damage |
| `starvation` | `#9a7a32` | Starvation damage |
| `ender` | `#2bd6b3` | Ender pearl damage |
| `fallback` | `#ff0000` | Unmatched damage types, vanilla physical damage, bee stings, suffocation, cramming |

For example, this makes a custom thorny plant damage type use the plant overlay color, and forces vanilla drowning damage back to the fallback red overlay:

```json
"damageTypeOverrides": {
  "examplemod:thorny_vine": "plant",
  "minecraft:drown": "fallback"
}
```

If a damage type is not listed in `damageTypeOverrides`, Mind Your Bruises falls back to its built-in broad matching rules, then finally to `fallbackColor`.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Java 21 or newer

Mod Menu and YetAnotherConfigLib are optional, but recommended if you want to edit the config in game. Without them, the mod still works and can be configured by editing `mind-your-bruises.json` manually and restarting the game.

## Compatibility

Mind Your Bruises is client-side only. It changes how hurt entities are rendered on your client and does not change damage rules, health, invulnerability frames, or server behavior.

## Building

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat build
```

The built jar will be generated under `build/libs/`.

title: Mushoku Craft
description: A hardcore RPG mod inspired by the Mushoku Tensei universe. Master intense sword styles, level up magical schools from scratch, and forge powerful modular artifact weapons using custom mini-games.
body:
![Mushoku Tensei](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/492a848abd04bebaa3142183662dba4d50d93fba_0.webp)

# ⚔️ Mushoku Craft — Hardcore RPG Overhaul inspired by Mushoku Tensei

> *"Mastery over numbers. Skill over grind."*

**Mushoku Craft** is an ambitious, hardcore RPG total-conversion mod for Minecraft inspired by the universe of **Mushoku Tensei (Jobless Reincarnation)**. It completely reimagines combat, magic, crafting, and world exploration — replacing vanilla grind with systems that reward **player skill, knowledge, and mastery**.

You start as nobody — no magic, no sword techniques, nothing. Every ability must be **earned**.

---

## 🔮 Magic System

- **4 Schools of Magic** — Water, Fire, Earth, Wind — each with independent mastery progression
- **Spell Learning from Books** — hold the book, read the incantation, and attempt to learn. Base success rate: **25%**. On failure you only lose mana — the book stays
- **Fizzle Mechanic** — low mastery = chance of spell failure (interrupted cast, wasted mana). Mastery eliminates fizzle
- **Silent Casting** — at 100% spell mastery, incantation disappears, cast becomes **instant**, and you unlock **Hold-to-Charge** (hold to pour more mana into the spell for extra power)
- **Mentorship (Multiplayer)** — learn spells by standing near a casting master. Students inherit up to 20% of the teacher's mastery as a headstart
- **Mentorship (Singleplayer)** — learn from NPC masters in Magic Academies (rare world structures)
- **Spell Ranks** — Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced, and beyond

## ⚔️ Sword Combat & Touki (Battle Aura)

Three distinct **Sword God Styles**, switchable via stance menu:

| Style | Focus | Signature |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 **Sword God** | Offense | Extended reach, fast attacks, Longsword Light Flash dash |
| 🔵 **Water God** | Defense | Perfect parry (RMB), counter-attacks, projectile deflection |
| 🟣 **North God** | Trickster | Debuffs (bleed, slow), blade throwing, unpredictable strikes |

- **Touki (Battle Aura)** — unlocked at high style mastery, activated via radial menu. Continuously drains mana while providing style-specific combat bonuses that **scale with mastery**
- **Sword mastery** improves through combat and training on custom dummies

## 📖 Currently Implemented (v0.3.0 — Alpha 3)

*   ✅ Full **mana system** with passive regen, sleep-based full restore, and configurable HUD (Classic Bar / Dynamic Arc / Hybrid / Minimal)
*   ✅ **Magic Books** (Water, Fire, Earth) with 3D GeckoLib models and spell learning UI, now obtainable as rare loot in standard dungeons!
*   ✅ **Waterball spell** — full cast cycle with incantation text, fizzle mechanic, mastery-based cast time reduction, and silent casting at 100%
*   ✅ **Fireball spell** — explosive fire magic that sets the target area ablaze on impact!
*   ✅ **Rock Bullet spell** — piercing earth magic that scales in speed and damage the longer you charge it!
*   ✅ **Hold-to-Charge** mechanic for mastered spells — projectiles now smoothly sync with your camera direction in 1st-person view!
*   ✅ Spell Mastery system fully synchronizes with the R-menu during combat.
*   ✅ All **3 Sword Styles** with functional stance switching, unique attack modifiers, and custom player animations
*   ✅ **Water God Parry** — perfect parry window, counter-attacks, projectile deflection
*   ✅ **North God** — blade throwing, bleed/slow debuffs, fall damage reduction with Touki
*   ✅ **Sword God** — increased reach & attack speed
*   ✅ **Touki (Battle Aura)** — per-style bonuses (damage, defense, speed/jump), mana drain, toggle via radial menu

## 🗺️ Roadmap

### 🔜 Coming Soon
- 🔥 Fire, Earth, Wind spell schools with new spells
- 📕 Bestiary — scan defeated monsters to study their weaknesses and unlock damage bonuses
- 🌿 Herbalist Journal — discover and catalog magical plants for alchemy
- ⚗️ **Intelligent Alchemy** — no levels, pure player skill. Mortar & Pestle + Alchemy Cauldron with timing-based mini-games
- 🔨 **Modular Weapon Forging** — assemble unique weapons from Blade + Hilt + Monster Core on a Magic Anvil. Forging mini-game determines quality. Name your creation
- 🏛️ Magic Academies & Sword Dojos — rare generated structures with NPC masters and merchants

### 🔮 Future Vision
- 🐉 Custom boss mobs (Red Dragon, Orsted) with terrain-destructive AI, area attacks, and spawn zones
- 💍 Magic accessories (mana regen rings, amulets)
- 🌍 Full world generation overhaul with biome-specific magic creatures
- 🎓 Advanced mentorship system for multiplayer communities

---

## 📋 Technical Info

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft** | 1.21.1 |
| **Mod Loader** | NeoForge 21.1+ |
| **Java** | 21 |
| **Required Deps** | GeckoLib 4.6.6, PlayerAnimator 2.0.4, Better Combat 2.3.2, Cloth Config, MmmMmmMmmMmm  |

---

## 🤝 We're Looking For Contributors!

**Mushoku Craft is an open community project and we need YOUR help to bring the Six-Faced World to Minecraft!**

We are actively looking for:

### 🎨 3D Modelers (Blockbench / GeckoLib)
- Custom mob models (Coati, Giant Frog, Stone Golem, Red Dragon, Orsted)
- Weapon and item models (modular swords, staves, alchemy equipment)
- Structure interiors (Magic Academies, Sword Dojos)
- Animated models with GeckoLib integration

### ☕ Java Developers (NeoForge)
- Combat systems & AI programming
- World generation (structures, biomes)
- Networking & multiplayer systems

### 🎵 Other Roles
- **Texture Artists** — mob textures, item sprites, UI elements
- **Sound Designers** — spell SFX, combat sounds, ambient audio
- **Translators** — help localize the mod to more languages

title: Geasd
description: Harvest wheat seeds from grass and ferns in Minecraft 26.1.2. Use your hand or shears to gather seeds, with shears leaving regrowing stubble for sustainable farming.
body:
Geasd — Full Description & Usage Terms
Overview
Geasd is a Minecraft mod (mod ID: geasd) for Minecraft 26.1.2 on Fabric Loader 0.19.2. It adds a simple early-game loop: harvest wheat seeds from vanilla grass and fern plants using your empty hand or shears.

The mod does not add new seed types. All drops are vanilla Wheat Seeds.

Current version: 1.0.0
License: All Rights Reserved

Supported Plants
Geasd only affects these four vanilla blocks:

Plant	Minecraft block
Short Grass
minecraft:short_grass
Tall Grass
minecraft:tall_grass
Fern
minecraft:fern
Tall Fern
minecraft:large_fern
Tall plants (Tall Grass, Tall Fern) are handled as a pair of blocks. Interacting with either the top or bottom half applies to the whole plant.

No other blocks (flowers, crops, vines, etc.) are affected.

How Harvesting Works
1. Empty hand — right-click
Requirement: Main or off-hand must be empty (no item held).
Effect: The plant is fully removed and does not regrow.
Seed drop: Rolled once per harvest
85% chance → 1 wheat seed
15% chance → 2 wheat seeds
Stubble: None. The block becomes air (or whatever was underneath).
Durability: Nothing is consumed.
2. Shears — right-click (sustainable harvest)
Requirement: Shears in the hand used to click.
Effect: The plant is replaced with a tiny Plant Stubble block that regrows into the original plant later.
Seed drop: Rolled once per harvest
10% chance → 1 wheat seed
90% chance → 2 wheat seeds
Shears durability: 1 point of damage per harvest.
Regrowth time: 6,000 ticks (~5 minutes at 20 TPS).
Sounds & feedback: Block break particles/sound from the original plant, plus the shears snip sound and arm swing animation.
3. Shears — left-click (permanent break)
Requirement: Break the plant normally while holding shears (mining/left-click).
Effect: Vanilla block break — plant is permanently removed, no stubble, no regrowth.
Seed drop: Same odds as shears right-click
10% → 1 seed
90% → 2 seeds
Shears durability: Normal vanilla break durability rules apply to the break action itself (in addition to any other interactions).
4. Breaking stubble
If a Plant Stubble block already exists (from a prior shears harvest):

Right-click (empty hand or shears) removes the stubble permanently.
No seeds are dropped from breaking stubble alone.
Stubble does not regrow further once broken.
Plant Stubble (Regrowing Block)
When shears right-click converts a plant to stubble, Geasd places a custom block: Plant Stubble (geasd:plant_stubble).

Appearance
Each stubble matches the plant it came from:

Source plant	Stubble look
Short Grass
Tiny short-grass-style model
Tall Grass
Tiny tall-grass-style model
Fern
Tiny fern-style model (fern texture, biome-tinted green)
Tall Fern
Slightly taller fern-style stubble (more visible than other stubbles)
All stubbles use biome grass color tinting, so they stay green and match the local biome like normal grass.

Regrowth
After 6,000 ticks, the stubble automatically restores:

Short Grass → Short Grass
Fern → Fern
Tall Grass → full Tall Grass (both halves)
Tall Fern → full Tall Fern (both halves)
Seed Drops
Seeds are spawned as world items on the ground via Block.popResource.
They are not placed directly into your inventory.
Drop location is the root block of the plant (bottom half for tall plants).
Each harvest rolls seed count once — you get either 1 or 2 seeds, never 0 and never more than 2 from a single action.
What Geasd Does Not Do
Does not change wheat farming, loot tables, or mob drops.
Does not add new tools, items (beyond the internal stubble block), or crafting recipes for players.
Does not affect grass/fern when broken by anything other than the interactions above (e.g. breaking with a sword still uses vanilla behavior unless shears left-click rules apply).
Does not work on blocks other than the four listed plants (and their stubble).
Requires Fabric API in addition to Fabric Loader.
Requirements
Component	Version
Minecraft
26.1.2
Fabric Loader
0.19.2+
Fabric API
Required (e.g. 0.152.1+ or 0.154.0+ for 26.1.2)
Java
25+ (for development/build)
Configuration (Defaults)
Values are defined in code (Config.java) and are not yet exposed as an in-game config file:

Setting	Value	Meaning
HAND_ONE_SEED_CHANCE
0.85
85% chance of 1 seed when hand-harvesting
SHEARS_ONE_SEED_CHANCE
0.10
10% chance of 1 seed when shears-harvesting
REGROWTH_TICKS
6000
Ticks until stubble regrows (~5 min)
Shears always have the complementary chance for 2 seeds (15% hand, 90% shears).

Usage, Copyright & Name Protection
Ownership
Geasd, including the name “Geasd”, the mod identifier geasd, associated logos, descriptions, source code, models, textures, and compiled JAR files, is All Rights Reserved unless the author explicitly grants permission in writing.

“Geasd” is the official name of this mod. It is not a generic term and must not be used to refer to unrelated projects without permission.

What You MAY Do (Personal Use)

title: Over Enchantment Anvil

## 📖 Mod Introduction

**Over Enchantment Anvil** is a lightweight Fabric mod that removes the level cap for anvil enchanting in Minecraft, allowing you to apply enchantment books to tools, weapons, and armor infinitely, crafting artifacts that surpass all limits!


## ✨ Core Features

- **Removes Enchantment Level Cap:** All enchantments are no longer restricted by maximum levels and can be stacked infinitely
- **Unrestricted Anvil Operations:** Apply enchantment books of any level to equipment via the anvil
- **Vanilla Mechanics Compatibility:** Fully preserves the original anvil consumption mechanics (experience levels, material costs)
- **Lightweight Implementation:** Only redirects core logic via Mixin, without affecting other game mechanics


## 📥 Installation Requirements

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.x
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- **API Dependency:** Fabric API


## 🚀 Usage Instructions

1. Download the `.jar` file for the corresponding version
2. Place it into the `.minecraft/mods/` directory
3. Launch the game – the mod will take effect automatically
4. Use enchantment books normally in the anvil; the level cap has been removed


## ⚠️ Notes

- Extremely high-level enchantments may produce unpredictable effects (e.g., attack damage overflow, abnormal durability consumption, etc.)
- Some enchantments (such as Sharpness, Protection) may not yield additional effects beyond their original maximum values – please refer to actual in-game experience
- It is recommended to use this mod in conjunction with other mods to fully leverage its functionality


## 🛠️ Developer Information

- **Open Source License:** MIT License


## 🙏 Acknowledgments

Thanks to the Fabric community and the Mixin project for their technical support.

---

**Enjoy crafting god-tier equipment!** ⚔️✨

---

**无限附魔铁砧**是一个轻量级的 Fabric 模组，它移除了 Minecraft 中铁砧附魔的等级上限限制，让你可以无限次地将附魔书应用到工具、武器和盔甲上，打造出超越极限的神器！

title: Info Copy
description: Copy any item's full data (NBT/components) to your clipboard with one keypress — hover, press C, done.
body:
InfoCopy
Copy any item's full data to your clipboard with one keypress.

Hover over an item in any inventory, chest, or container screen, press the keybind (default: C), and the item's complete data — item ID, count, and every data component / NBT tag — lands on your clipboard as SNBT.

Why?
Ever wanted to know exactly what's on an item? Enchantments, attribute modifiers, custom names, lore, weird datapack components — instead of digging through F3+H tooltips or external tools, just point and press a key. Paste the result into a /give command, a datapack, a kubejs script, or wherever you need it.

How to use
Open any screen with item slots (inventory, chest, furnace, villager trades...)
Hover your mouse over the item
Press C (rebindable in Controls)
Done — the full item data is on your clipboard, and a chat message confirms it
Example output for an enchanted sword:

{components: {"minecraft:enchantments": {"minecraft:sharpness": 5}}, count: 1, id: "minecraft:diamond_sword"}

Notes
Client-side only — works on servers, realms, and singleplayer. Nothing to install server-side.
Works in every container screen, including modded ones.
Requires Fabric API.
The keybind can be changed in Options → Controls → Key Binds.

title: PotionManagmentUltimate
description: With this Plugin you are able to enable or disable some specific potion effects!
body:
# 🧪 PotionFilter
Take absolute control over how status effects are distributed on your Minecraft server. PotionFilter is a lightweight, highly flexible, and granular solution designed for server administrators who need more than just a simple "enable/disable" switch for potions.

Whether you want to balance your PvP meta by disabling drinkable Strength II potions while keeping splash potions enabled, or completely block specific newer 1.21 effects like Trial Omen or Oozing, PotionFilter allows you to customize every single scenario.

## ✨ Features
Granular Delivery Control: Decide how an effect is blocked. Toggle individual rules for:

🥤 Drinking (Normal Potions)

💥 Splash (Splash Potions)

☁️ Lingering (Area Effect Clouds)

🏹 Tipped Arrows (Bow/Crossbow projectiles)

**Per-Effect Customization:** Every single Minecraft status effect up to version 1.21.1+ is supported, including the latest Tricky Trials and Ominous Event effects.

**Lightweight & High-Performance:** Built on the modern EntityPotionEffectEvent API. The plugin checks the source of the effect directly, ensuring zero server lag or performance overhead.

**Smart Filtering:** Bypasses non-potion sources. Natural game mechanics like Beacons, Apple consumption, or Admin Commands (/effect) will continue to work perfectly unless they originate from a potion tool.

## ⚙️ Configuration (config.yml)
The configuration is incredibly intuitive. Simply list the effect in uppercase and set the delivery method to true to block it, or false to allow it:

**YAML**
- PotionFilter Configuration
- true  = Blocked (Effect will NOT be applied via this method)
- false = Allowed (Effect works normally)

- effects:
  - STRENGTH:
    - drink: true                     
    - splash: false                   
    - lingering: false               
    - tipped_arrow: false             
  - SPEED:
    - drink: false
    - splash: true       
    - lingering: false
    - tipped_arrow: false

    
## 🚀 Installation
Download the PotionFilter.jar file.

Drop the file into your server's plugins folder.

Restart or start your server to generate the default config.yml.

Open plugins/PotionFilter/config.yml, adjust the toggles to your liking, and restart the server to apply the changes!

## 💻 Compatibility
Supported Versions: Minecraft 1.21 and higher.

Software: Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and any other Paper forks.

title: PePr - Permission Preflight
description: Preview whether block, container, entity, and item interactions are likely allowed before trying them.
body:
# Permission Preflight

**Permission Preflight** previews whether block, container, entity, and item interactions are likely allowed before you attempt them.

It is a Forge quality-of-life utility built for multiplayer servers, protected areas, spawn regions, adventure-mode zones, and modded setups where it is not always clear whether something is broken, restricted, claimed, or simply unavailable.

---

## What it helps with

Permission Preflight can help answer:

- Can I break this block?
- Can I place here?
- Can I open this chest?
- Can I interact with this block or entity?
- Is this a permission issue, claim issue, protection issue, or setup issue?

The mod displays a compact HUD overlay when it has useful information. It is informational only and does not bypass or grant permissions.

---

## Supported actions

Permission Preflight can check:

- Break block
- Place block
- Use/interact with block
- Open container
- Interact with entity
- Attack entity
- Use item on block

---

## Result types

Permission Preflight reports results as:

- **Allowed** — available checks found no restriction
- **Denied** — the action is likely blocked
- **Partial** — some part of the action may be possible, but the result is incomplete or mixed
- **Unknown** — no provider could verify the action

Unknown is a normal result. It means the mod did not have enough information to safely say Allowed or Denied.

---

## HUD overlay

The overlay is designed to stay compact and out of the way.

By default:

- Denied results are shown
- Partial results are shown
- Allowed results are hidden unless enabled in config
- Unknown results are hidden in normal mode unless enabled or detailed mode is active

Detailed mode can show:

- Action being checked
- Provider name
- Confidence level
- Cache freshness
- Provider trace details

The overlay can be configured to appear above the hotbar or near the crosshair.

---

## Chat warnings

When a player attempts an action that was predicted as denied, Permission Preflight can show a short chat warning.

Warnings are rate-limited to avoid spam.

Example:

`Preflight: likely denied — cannot open containers here.`

---

## Providers

Permission Preflight 1.0.0 includes:

### Vanilla provider

Checks common vanilla restrictions such as:

- Spectator mode
- Adventure/build restrictions
- World border
- Spawn protection
- Missing or unloaded target blocks
- Missing or dead target entities

### Recent observation provider

Watches cancelled Forge interaction events and briefly remembers recent denied actions.

This can help identify restrictions from protection systems after a failed attempt, even without a direct claim-mod integration.

---

## Claim mod support

Permission Preflight does not currently include direct API adapters for FTB Chunks, Open Parties and Claims, Flan, or other claim mods.

There are no hard dependencies on claim mods. Missing claim mods will not crash the game.

Claim-related denials may still appear after a cancelled interaction through the recent observation provider.

---

## Commands

- `/preflight here`  
  Checks your currently targeted block or entity.

- `/preflight debug`  
  Toggles detailed provider output and detailed overlay mode.

- `/preflight reload`  
  Reports config reload/live config behavior. Requires permission level 2.

---

## Config

Config options include:

- `enableOverlay`
- `overlayPosition`
- `showAllowed`
- `showUnknownInNormalMode`
- `showProviderInDetailedMode`
- `showConfidenceInDetailedMode`
- `useColorEmphasis`
- `compactOverlay`
- `maxReasonLength`
- `enableChatWarnings`
- `warningCooldownTicks`
- `requestRateLimitPerSecond`
- `cacheTtlTicks`
- `maxInteractionReachBlocks`
- `enableVanillaProvider`
- `enableObservationProvider`
- `enableClaimAdapters`
- `debugLogging`

Default networking behavior:

- `requestRateLimitPerSecond`: `4`
- `cacheTtlTicks`: `20`

---

## Multiplayer behavior

Permission Preflight is designed for multiplayer and dedicated servers.

- Server-side checks are authoritative
- Client overlay only displays server responses
- Clients send requests only when needed
- Server validates target reach
- Clients cannot query arbitrary distant chunks or claims
- Results are briefly cached
- Missing server support degrades gracefully

Recommended setup:

- **Singleplayer:** install on the client
- **Dedicated server:** install on the server
- **Best multiplayer setup:** install on both server and clients
- **Server-only:** commands and server checks work, but clients without the mod will not see the overlay
- **Client-only on a server without the mod:** no server-authoritative results are available

---

## Important notes

Permission Preflight does not:

- Grant permissions
- Bypass protections
- Disable claims
- Override server rules
- Force interactions to succeed
- Block actions by itself

It only reports what its available checks can determine.

---

## Known limitations

- Without direct claim-mod adapters, some claim permissions cannot be predicted before the first attempted action.
- Some modded blocks may not expose enough vanilla information to classify every interaction perfectly.
- High latency can briefly delay overlay updates.
- Attack-entity checks are more limited than block and container checks.
- Unknown results are expected when no provider can verify the action.

---

## Version

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Loader:** Forge
- **Forge:** 47.4.20
- **Java:** 17
- **Mod version:** 1.0.0
- **Mod ID:** `permission_preflight`
- **License:** MIT
- **Creator:** Iljas

title: Blast Proof Saplings & Glass Panes
description: a mod that makes saplings and glass panes immune to explosions
body:
## Tired of a stray Creeper or a TNT cart wiping out the sapling farm you just planted, or that glass pane you spent an afternoon placing? Blast Proof Saplings & Glass Panes fixes that with one small, focused change.

### What it does

Saplings — every wood type (oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, cherry) plus mangrove propagules — survive explosions.
Glass panes — plain and every stained color — survive explosions.
Works against any vanilla explosion source: TNT, Creepers, Wither skulls, End Crystals, beds, respawn anchors, and anything else that goes through the normal explosion-resistance check.
Everything else in your world explodes exactly as vanilla intends — this mod only touches these two block types.

### How it works

A single lightweight Mixin raises the explosion resistance of these blocks to the same value as Bedrock (3,600,000) — high enough that no vanilla explosion can scratch them. Blocks are matched by their registry ID rather than by Java class, so saplings or panes added by other mods/datapacks are covered automatically too.

### installation

Install on both client and server in multiplayer — since explosion resistance is checked server-side, a client-only install will cause visual desyncs.

>Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.1.x
>Download and install Fabric API.
>Drop the mod's file .jar into your mods folder.

title: ForgeRTP

body:
ForgeRTP adds a simple, configurable random teleport system to Forge 1.7.10 servers.

Players can use `/rtp` to teleport to a safe random location within a configurable minimum and maximum radius around a customizable center point. The mod automatically searches for a safe landing location, avoiding dangerous terrain such as lava, water, cactus, fire, and other unsafe blocks based on your configuration.

Everything is configurable through an easy-to-edit config file, including teleport radius, cooldowns, maximum search attempts, allowed dimensions, biome and dimension blacklists, and various safety checks.

ForgeRTP also includes an optional persistent usage limit system, allowing server owners to restrict how many successful random teleports each player may use. Usage counts are tracked by UUID, saved across server restarts, and can be reset or inspected with administrator commands.

### Features

* Safe random teleportation
* Configurable minimum and maximum teleport radius
* Customizable teleport center
* Configurable cooldowns
* Automatic safe location detection
* Biome and dimension blacklists
* Optional persistent per-player teleport usage limits
* Administrator commands for configuration reloads and usage management

title: All My Need
description: A mod designed to provide players with a convenient and customizable creative inventory
body:
# All My Need

All My Need is a vanilla-friendly NeoForge mod that adds a customizable creative inventory tab. It is designed for players who often search for the same blocks, tools, or materials and want a personal, paged shortcut tab inside the creative inventory.

## Features

- Adds a dedicated creative tab for frequently used items.
- Starts with two empty custom pages and a `+` page button for adding more.
- Supports editing page names, up to 8 characters.
- Lets players place items into any slot while edit mode is enabled.
- Saves custom pages to the local client config folder.
- Supports deleting the current page and moving a page upward.
- Provides an optional config entry to place this mod's tab at the front of the creative inventory.
- Works without any required external mod dependency.
- Compatible with JEI when JEI is present.

## Usage

1. Open the creative inventory.
2. Select the All My Need tab.
3. Click `Edit` to enter edit mode.
4. Place items into the custom grid.
5. Rename, add, delete, or move pages as needed.
6. Click `Save` or switch pages to store the current layout.

After saving, items can be taken from the tab like normal creative inventory items.

## Configuration

The common config is generated at:

```text
config/allmyneed-common.toml
```

Available option:

```toml
registerTabAsFirst = false
```

When set to `true`, the All My Need creative tab is moved to the first visible creative tab position. The default is `false` to preserve the vanilla creative tab order unless the player chooses otherwise.

Custom page data is stored client-side at:

```text
config/allmyneed/client_items.json
```

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.1
- Mod loader: NeoForge 21.1+
- Java: 21
- JEI: optional, compatible when installed

## Building

```bash
./gradlew build
```

The built jar will be generated under:

```text
build/libs/
```

## License

All My Need is released under the MIT License. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.

title: Create: DataForge
description: This mod is an addon to Create. With it, you can create datacenters, mine cryptocurrency, hash, and more!
body:
# Create: DataForge

![Lg1](https://i.postimg.cc/RVJL7Xq3/lg1.png)
![Lg2](https://i.postimg.cc/tgpdHbkW/lg2.png)
![Lg3](https://i.postimg.cc/3N4mZx8f/lg3.png)

**For Minecraft NeoForge 1.21.1**  
**Requires Create**

Create: DataForge is a technology addon for Create that brings industrial data centers, server racks, fictional digital mining, compute contracts, cooling systems, and high-risk AI supercomputing to Minecraft.

Build your own server infrastructure, power it with Create machinery, connect it through data cables, cool it before it overheats, and turn raw computation into valuable in-game resources.

> **Important:** Create: DataForge does **not** mine real cryptocurrency.  
> All currencies, markets, mining systems, credits, and blockchain-inspired mechanics are entirely fictional Minecraft gameplay systems.

---

## About

Create: DataForge expands Create with a new industrial computing progression.

Instead of adding simple one-block generators, DataForge focuses on physical infrastructure: server racks, kinetic power conversion, data cables, cooling systems, market terminals...

The main resource of the mod is **Compute Units**. Server racks generate Compute Units, which can be used to mine fictional in-game currencies, complete compute contracts, render data drives, unlock advanced components, and progress toward larger computing systems.

Create: DataForge is designed to feel like a natural extension of Create: visual, mechanical, automatable, and satisfying to build.

---

## Content

### Server Racks

Server racks are the heart of your data center.

They can hold different components such as:

- Server Boards
- Processors
- Graphics Cards
- ASIC Miners
- Memory Modules
- Storage Modules
- Cooling Modules

Each component affects compute output, power usage, heat generation, and efficiency.

![Servers Rack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5bacfcd21ed0f910f12a543792f2f80611d5bea.png)

---

### Kinetic Data Dynamo

The **Kinetic Data Dynamo** converts Create-style mechanical power into DataForge power.

Use shafts, rotation, and Create contraptions to feed your data center.

A better mechanical setup means more available power, higher compute output, and more room for expansion.

![Kinetic Dyanmo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/302eacda3cb60e0d0b30bda311f16ad02ba424c2.png)

---

### Data Cables

Data cables connect your infrastructure.

They are used to link server racks, controllers, dynamos, market terminals, and advanced machines into larger data networks.

Cable tiers include:

- Basic Data Cable
- Reinforced Data Cable
- Fiber Data Cable
- Overclocked Data Cable

Higher-tier cables are designed for larger and more powerful data centers.

![Cables](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6edde40cbdd471012815e4446f139f1ee7f175ff.png)

---

### Hash Controller

The **Hash Controller** manages fictional digital mining.

It gathers compute output from connected server racks and converts it into mining progress.

When enough work has been completed, the system produces fictional in-game currencies such as DataCoins.

![Hash Controller](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75c20c3a6f8ee206a79fa97952d41df2d2602392.png)

---

### Market Terminal

The **Market Terminal** allows players to sell fictional currencies and processed data for Data Credits.

Market values can change over time, creating a simple in-game economy around computation and digital resources.

Data Credits are used for advanced crafting, upgrades, contracts, and future high-tier progression.

![Market Terminal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17532a029849e86731840e0568cd1df16e0415fc.png)

---

### Compute Contracts

Compute contracts turn raw processing power into useful outputs.

Examples include:

- Rendering jobs
- Data processing
- AI training jobs
- Simulation contracts
- Market prediction tasks
- Quantum optimization tasks

Contracts consume Compute Units and may require special items such as blank data drives, rendered data drives, neural matrices, or encrypted data fragments.


---

### Cooling and Heat

Powerful machines generate heat.

If cooling is insufficient, machines lose efficiency, throttle, shut down, or enter dangerous states.

Cooling systems include:

- Cooling Modules
- Cooling Fans
- Coolant Cells
- Coolant Tanks
- Coolant Pipes
- Radiators
- Liquid Cooling Pumps

Keeping your data center cool is essential for safe and efficient production.

![Cooling Systems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8de0cad7b061e90de64c8cba7213d96aa5e679d.png)

---

### Quantum Fabricator

The **Quantum Fabricator** is used for advanced crafting and high-tier technological progression.

It allows players to craft powerful processors, advanced modules, and components required for late-game computing systems.

![Quantum Fabricator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce9139da2704e18bd9e9821341a706dc694e730c.png)

---

### Contract Board

The **Contract Board** is used to manage advanced compute tasks and higher-tier jobs.

It is designed for players who want to turn their data center into a full industrial computing facility.


![Contract Board](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b99abddb89a980e76c8d62edc624925043c4a3d.png)![Contract Board GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ed023ed992adf606c0558569d26095f7207b71c.png)

---

## Advanced Components

Create: DataForge adds several electronic and computing components, including:

- Raw Silicon
- Silicon Wafers
- Printed Circuit Boards
- Basic Processors
- Advanced Processors
- Quantum Processors
- Graphics Cards
- RTX Graphics Cards
- Memory Modules
- 16GB Memory Modules
- 32GB Memory Modules
- Storage Modules
- Server Boards
- ASIC Miners
- Cooling Modules
- Encrypted Data Fragments
- Data Drives

These components are used to build and upgrade your computing infrastructure.

---

## Fictional Currencies

The mod includes fictional in-game currencies used only for gameplay.

Examples include:

- DataCoin
- Data Credits
- FluxCoin
- BrassBit
- ZincHash

These currencies do not represent real money, real crypto, or real blockchain assets.

They are purely Minecraft items and mechanics.

---

## Planned Endgame: Neural Core

The long-term endgame of Create: DataForge is the **Neural Core**.

The Neural Core is planned as a massive multiblock AI supercomputer. Instead of placing a single machine block, players will build a large structure around an empty central cavity.

When formed, the center will display a holographic AI field: a glowing geodesic sphere, rotating rings, data particles, and energy beams.

The Neural Core will be capable of producing enormous amounts of Compute Units and running advanced AI jobs, but it will also be extremely dangerous.

If poorly cooled, it may enter a meltdown sequence, charge an implosion, and trigger a catastrophic explosion.

The Neural Core is designed to be a high-risk, high-reward late-game machine.

---

## Safety Disclaimer

Create: DataForge does **not** mine real cryptocurrency.

The mod does not:

- Mine real crypto
- Connect to real wallets
- Use real blockchain APIs
- Ask for private keys
- Ask for seed phrases
- Connect to external mining services
- Generate real money
- Perform real Web3 transactions

All mining, markets, coins, wallets, and credits are fictional gameplay mechanics inside Minecraft.

---

## Compatibility

Create: DataForge is designed as a Create addon.

Required:

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- Create

Recommended:

- JEI, EMI, or REI for recipes
- Jade or The One Probe for machine information
- Create-based automation setups

Optional integrations may be expanded in future versions.

---

## FAQ


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### Does this mod mine real cryptocurrency?

No. Create: DataForge does not mine real crypto and never connects to real wallets, blockchains, or mining services. Everything is fictional and in-game.

### Is Create required?

Yes. Create: DataForge is built as an addon for Create.

### Can I use this in a modpack?

Yes. You may include Create: DataForge in modpacks, as long as you follow the license and provide proper credit.

### Is the mod server-friendly?

Yes. The mod is designed with multiplayer and server economies in mind. Destructive features such as major overheating failures or catastrophic explosions should be configurable.

### What is the main goal of the mod?

The goal is to build and automate a complete industrial data center using Create-style mechanics.

### What should I do if a recipe is missing?

Use JEI, EMI, or REI to view recipes. If something appears broken, please report it with your Minecraft version, NeoForge version, Create version, DataForge version, and logs if relevant.

---

## Credits

Create: DataForge is inspired by the mechanical creativity of Create and the idea of turning computation into a physical factory system.

Special thanks to the Create community and the Minecraft modding community for making ambitious automation mods possible.

</details>

title: ReHome
description: Automatic Teleport for /home system on disconects/kicks etc.
body:
## ReHome

You know the problem: you're AFK on a server and get kicked - that's what auto-reauth mods are for, reconnecting you automatically.

But what if the **world just restarts** and you get teleported to spawn? Then you have to manually get back to your farm yourself.

**ReHome** solves exactly that: it remembers a location and automatically teleports you back once you drift away from it - using your own server's home system.

### How To Video:
https://youtu.be/Yi6OZRceIII

### How it works

1. Set a home at your AFK spot: `/sethome farm1`
2. Stand exactly there and type: `/rehome set farm1`
3. Enable monitoring: `/rehome on`

From now on, ReHome checks your position every second. If it drifts too far, `/home farm1` is sent automatically - without spamming the chat, since after the first attempt it only re-checks every 60 seconds until you're back home.

### Commands

- `/rehome on` - enable monitoring
- `/rehome off` - disable monitoring
- `/rehome set <name>` - set the home point (name = your server home)
- `/rehome distance <blocks>` - set the allowed deviation
- `/rehome distance` - shows the current setting

### Important

`/rehome set` reads your current position - so stand exactly on your home point before entering the command.

Purely client-side, no server installation required.

title: Chaos Pack
description: Hostile mobs get a serious upgrade: armored zombies, homing-arrow skeletons, flying spiders, teleporting endermen, and explosive creepers, all running automatically. For 1.21.7-1.21.11.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6BELudDedpc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

CHAOS PACK is a datapack that completely transforms how hostile mobs behave in Minecraft. Every enemy you encounter has been upgraded to be stronger, faster, and more dangerous. There are no command blocks to set up and no configuration needed. Install the pack, reload, and the chaos begins immediately.


DIAMOND ZOMBIES

Every zombie that spawns will be equipped with a full set of diamond armor and a diamond sword. On top of that, their movement speed has been significantly increased, making them much harder to outrun than normal zombies. Do not underestimate them just because they look familiar.


SNIPER SKELETONS

Skeletons are no longer the easy targets they used to be. Every skeleton spawns wearing a netherite helmet and carrying a bow enchanted with Power V, Punch II, Infinity, and Flame. Their body constantly rotates to track the nearest player, and every arrow they fire will curve and home in on you mid-flight. There is almost no way to dodge.


FLYING SPIDERS

Spiders in this pack are no longer limited to the ground. They have no gravity and will fly directly toward you from any direction, including from above. Combined with their speed boost, they are one of the most unpredictable threats in the pack.


AGGRESSIVE ENDERMEN

Endermen in this pack are faster and far more aggressive. When a player is nearby, they will close the distance quickly and occasionally blink forward in short bursts, making them feel erratic and hard to deal with.


MEGA CREEPERS

Every creeper now carries an explosion radius equivalent to a vanilla charged creeper. If one happens to be struck by lightning and becomes a charged creeper on top of that, the explosion doubles again, resulting in a blast twice as large as anything you have seen from a charged creeper before.


HOW IT WORKS

The pack runs entirely through a tick function that executes every game tick. A tag system ensures that gear and stat changes are only applied once per mob the moment it spawns, so performance stays clean even with large numbers of enemies nearby. No command blocks, no setup, no manual work required.


INSTALLATION

Download the zip file and do not extract it. Place it directly into the datapacks folder inside your world save folder. The path is .minecraft then saves then your world name then datapacks. Open the world or run the reload command. If you see the CHAOS PACK banner appear in chat, the pack is active and working.


COMPATIBILITY

Built and tested for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11.
