body:
# SUG Survival Assistant PLUS

A client-side survival utility mod for Fabric 26.1.2. Provides various quality-of-life features with a configurable GUI and hotkeys via malilib.

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Auto Tool** | Automatically switches to the fastest tool in your hotbar when mining |
| **Auto Eat** | Automatically eats food when hunger or health is low |
| **Auto Totem** | Automatically equips totems to offhand; supports shulker restocking |
| **Freecam** | Detach camera from player for free movement; full key control |
| **HaoQiChongTian** | Freeze mid-air with third-person camera rotation and sound effect |
| **No Slow** | Disables slime block movement slowdown |
| **Silent Pearl / Firework** | Switch and use ender pearls / fireworks directly from inventory |
| **Pearl Trajectory** | Renders predicted ender pearl trajectory |
| **Firework Warning** | On-screen warning when fireworks are below threshold |
| **Totem Warning** | On-screen warning when totems are below threshold |
| **Better Chat** | Chat regex filtering and folding |
| **Command Completion Filter** | Block specified commands from tab completion |
| **Hide Entity Health** | Blocks FZ datapack health display under entity nametags |
| **Shulker Restock** | Auto-restock pearls/fireworks from shulkers (requires Quick Shulker) |

## Dependencies

- **Fabric Loader** >= 0.19.1
- **Fabric API** (latest 0.153.0+ recommended)
- **malilib** (required — provides config UI)
- **Mod Menu** (recommended for easy config management)
- **Quick Shulker** (optional — needed for shulker restock)

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Place the mod jar in `.minecraft/mods`
3. Download **malilib** and place it in the mods folder
4. (Optional) Install Mod Menu and/or Quick Shulker
5. Launch the game and press `Z + L` to open the config menu

## Configuration

All features are managed through the malilib config screen:
- Toggle switches and hotkey bindings
- Numeric sliders
- Color pickers
- String lists

Press `Z + L` (configurable) to open the settings.

## Notes

- Client-side only — no server installation required
- Shulker Restock requires the Quick Shulker mod to be installed

body:
# FoliaShop

A modern, high-performance shop plugin built for **Folia**, **Paper**, and modern Minecraft servers.

FoliaShop combines a powerful GUI shop, Worthify-style selling system, Auction House, BuffedItems integration, SmartSpawner support, advanced item matching, and an in-game editor into one complete economy solution.

---

# ✨ Features

## 🛒 Shop System

* Beautiful paged GUI shops
* Buy and sell items directly from categories
* Unlimited custom shop categories
* Search system with GUI and commands
* Per-category permissions
* Category shortcut commands
* Nested categories and subcategories
* Fully configurable menus

## 💰 Worth System

* Built-in Worthify-style worth values
* Shop sell prices take priority automatically
* Fallback `worth.yml` support
* Supports vanilla and custom items
* BuffedItems worth integration
* `/worth` GUI for browsing values
* Shared pricing system for `/sellall` and `/sellgui`

## 📦 Selling System

* `/sellall` inventory selling
* `/sellgui` drag-and-sell interface
* Bulk selling support
* Partial stack selling support
* Custom sell hooks and commands
* Action bar, chat, and sound feedback

## 🏷️ Auction House

* Player-driven economy
* Sell items with `/ah sell <price>`
* Auction search system
* Sorting and filtering options
* Personal listing management
* Configurable listing limits
* Expired item recovery
* Permission-based limits

## 🛠️ In-Game Editor

* Create categories without editing YAML
* Edit prices, slots, names, lore, and permissions
* Add held items instantly
* GUI-based administration
* Sign and chat input support
* Bedrock-friendly fallback editor

## ⚔️ Advanced Item Support

* BuffedItems integration
* SmartSpawner integration
* Saved custom items
* Custom model data support
* Namespaced tags
* NBT-aware item matching
* Advanced metadata handling

### Matching Options

Choose how selling and shop detection works:

* Material Matching
* Display Name Matching
* Lore Matching
* Custom Model Data Matching
* NBT / PDC Matching
* Exact Item Matching

Perfect for RPG, Survival, Skyblock, OneBlock, Prison, and custom economy servers.

---

# 🔌 Supported Integrations

## Economy

* Vault
* Any Vault-compatible economy plugin
* XP Levels Economy
* XP Points Economy

## Custom Items

* BuffedItems
* Saved Custom Items (Built-In)

## Spawner Plugins

* SmartSpawner

## Permissions

* LuckPerms
* Any Bukkit Permission Plugin

## Placeholder Support

## Bedrock Support

* Geyser
* Floodgate
* Bedrock Edition Clients

---

# 🖥️ Supported Server Software

* Folia ⭐ Recommended
* Paper
* Purpur
* Pufferfish

---

# 🎨 Supported Item Features

* NBT Data Matching
* Persistent Data Container (PDC)
* Custom Model Data
* Namespaced Tags
* Enchantments
* Attributes
* Item Flags
* Food Components
* Unbreakable Items
* Custom Metadata

---

# 💳 Economy Providers

Currently Supported:

* Vault
* XP Levels
* XP Points

---

# ⌨️ Commands

## Player Commands

```text
/shop
/fshop
/sellall
/sellgui
/worth
/ah
```

## Admin Commands

```text
/fshop editor
/fshop addheld
/fshop addbuffed
/fshop setprice
/fshop reload
```

---

# 🔐 Permissions

```text

foliashop.admin
foliashop.auction.use
foliashop.auction.sell
foliashop.auction.admin
```

Supports LuckPerms and permission-based shop access.

---

# 🚀 Why FoliaShop?

Unlike traditional shop plugins, FoliaShop was designed specifically for modern Minecraft servers and Folia's async architecture.

It provides a complete economy ecosystem:

* GUI Shops
* Worth System
* Sell GUI
* Sell All
* Auction House
* Custom Item Support

All while remaining lightweight, scalable, and highly configurable.

Whether you're running a Survival server, Skyblock, OneBlock, Prison, RPG server, or a custom SMP, FoliaShop provides everything needed to power your economy.

title: AFKay
description: Tired of getting kicked for being AFK? AFKay silently keeps you connected so you never lose your spot again.
body:
# AFKay

  Never get kicked for being idle again.

  ## What it does
  AFKay runs quietly in the background and sends tiny invisible packets to the server
  every few seconds, resetting its idle timer before it can kick you. There's no visible
  movement, no cheating — just you, staying connected while you step away.

  ## Features
  - Automatically active the moment you join a world
  - Toggle on/off with a keybind (default: K) without leaving the game
  - On/off status shown in your action bar when you press the key
  - Works on any server — no server-side install required
  - Zero performance impact

  ## How to use
  1. Install the mod (requires Fabric Loader + Fabric API)
  2. Join any server as normal
  3. AFK protection is on by default — you don't have to do anything
  4. Press K to toggle it off/on if needed

  ## Requirements
  - Minecraft 1.20.1
  - Fabric Loader
  - Fabric API

title: End Rtp
description: Teleport players to random safe locations when entering the End.
body:
# **EndRtp**

### **Overview**

EndRtp is a lightweight and highly configurable Paper plugin that distributes players across the main End island instead of spawning everyone at the default End platform.

During End Fight events or on large survival servers, dozens of players can enter the End at the same time. Vanilla Minecraft always places them on the same obsidian platform, creating congestion, PvP issues, and unnecessary server lag.

EndRtp solves this by teleporting each player to a random safe location around the End island as soon as they enter through an End Portal.

The result is a smoother, fairer, and more optimized End experience.


---

### **Features**

Random End spawn locations

Safe location detection

Avoid spawning in dangerous blocks

Configurable minimum and maximum spawn radius

Configurable maximum search attempts

Bypass permission support

Fully customizable messages

Chat & ActionBar events

Success / Failed / Bypass event system

Execute console or player commands

Enable / Disable plugin instantly

Lightweight and optimized

Clean and fully commented configuration

Performance-friendly implementation



---

### **Why EndRtp?**

Vanilla End spawning has several issues:

Every player spawns in the exact same location.

Large End fights create heavy player congestion.

PvP becomes chaotic immediately.

Large groups increase server lag around the platform.

Players can accidentally push each other into the void.


EndRtp completely removes these problems by distributing players safely around the island.


---

### **Configuration**

Everything can be customized.

Spawn distance

Dangerous blocks

Maximum search attempts

Enable / Disable

Success events

Failed events

Bypass events

Chat messages

ActionBar messages

Console commands

Player commands


No code editing required.


---

### **Permissions**

endrtp.use

endrtp.bypass

endrtp.reload

endrtp.info

endrtp.help

endrtp.admin


---

### **Performance**

EndRtp performs location calculations only when a player enters the End.

There are:

No scheduled tasks

No repeating timers

No unnecessary chunk scanning

No constant background processing


The plugin is designed to have virtually no performance impact during normal gameplay.


---

### **Perfect For**

Survival Servers

SMP Networks

Hardcore Servers

Lifesteal Servers

Public Servers

End Fight Events

title: Bean blaster calculator
description: Calculate easily the amount of windcharges needed to travel to your destination with the Iddiebean pearl Launcher
body:
# Bean Blaster Calculator

A simple client-side calculator for Bean Blasters / Pearl Launchers.

Use it to calculate how many **Wind Charges** must be placed in each dispenser to launch an Ender Pearl toward your target coordinates.

---

## Commands

### Setup the Bean Blaster

Look directly at the **magma block** of your Bean Blaster and run:

```text
/bb setup
```

You can also use:

```text
/beanblaster setup
```

The mod will save the magma block position for the current world or server.

---

### Calculate a launch

Run:

```text
/bb <x> <z>
```

Example:

```text
/bb 1250 -840
```

You can also use:

```text
/beanblaster 1250 -840
```

The mod will calculate which dispensers need Wind Charges and how many to place in each one.

---

### Help command

Run:

```text
/bb help
```

or:

```text
/beanblaster help
```

This shows the available commands and basic usage instructions in-game.

---

## Result Format

The result shows the raw amount and the Minecraft inventory version.

Example:

```text
Dispenser 1: 124 (1 Stack + 60 Items) Wind Charges
```

Inventory conversion:

```text
1 Stack = 64 items
1 Shulker Box = 27 Stacks = 1728 items
```

---

## How to Use

1. Build or find your Bean Blaster.
2. Look directly at the blaster's magma block.
3. Run:

```text
/bb setup
```

4. Choose the target coordinates where you want to launch the Ender Pearl.
5. Run:

```text
/bb <target x> <target z>
```

Example:

```text
/bb 3000 -1200
```

6. Put the shown amount of Wind Charges into the listed dispensers.
7. Use your Bean Blaster normally.

---

## Notes

* You must run setup before calculating a target.
* Setup is saved separately for each world or server.
* Setup is also separated by dimension.
* If you move or rebuild the Bean Blaster, run setup again.
* Use `/bb` instead of `/blaster` to avoid conflicts with other mods.

title: Wings Combat
description: A Brand new all in one combate plugin.
body:
# 🛡️ WingsCombat - Professional Combat Tagging System

**WingsCombat** is a lightweight, high-performance combat-tagging plugin designed to ensure fair PvP on your Minecraft server. It prevents players from escaping combat by logging out, running into protected regions, or performing unauthorized actions.

### ✨ Key Features

* **Anti-Combat Log:** Automatically kills players who attempt to log out while in combat (configurable).
* **Region Integration:** Seamlessly works with **WorldGuard** and **GriefPrevention**. If a player is in combat, they are blocked from entering protected areas/claims.
* **Visual Feedback:** Displays a temporary "Red Glass" wall at the border of protected regions when a player tries to enter while tagged.
* **Action Bar Timer:** Keeps players informed with a live countdown in their Action Bar.
* **PvP Control:** Options to disable item dropping, chat, and commands while a player is in combat to prevent "ghosting" or unfair advantages.
* **Highly Configurable:** Customize everything—from combat duration and death messages to granular feature toggles—all via the `config.yml`.
* **Lightweight:** Built to be efficient and lag-free, even on busy servers.

### 📋 Configuration & Customization

You have full control over the player experience. Easily modify these settings:

* **Combat Time:** Set the duration (in seconds) that the combat tag lasts.
* **Kill on Quit:** Toggle whether players die instantly upon disconnecting during a fight.
* **Death Settings:** Decide whether players should drop items or keep them upon death while tagged.
* **Message Customization:** Every message (prefix, combat warnings, denial messages) supports color codes and can be translated to any language.

### ⚙️ Commands & Permissions

* `/wc reload` — Reloads the plugin configuration.
* **Permission:** `wingscombat.admin`



### 🛠️ Installation

1. Drop `WingsCombat.jar` into your server's `/plugins` folder.
2. Start or restart your server to generate the default configuration.
3. Edit the `config.yml` to match your server's needs.
4. Run `/wc reload` to apply your changes.

### 🧩 Optional Dependencies

For the best experience, WingsCombat integrates with:

* [WorldGuard](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/worldguard)
* [GriefPrevention](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/griefprevention.1884/)

---

*Keep your PvP fair, prevent combat logging, and maintain order on your server with **WingsCombat**!*

title: Ender Teleport
description: Don't Waste time cause moving there...
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d0178f753f7d3dd00828a25e4cf6f29b4bb7814.png)

**Turn an Ender Pearl in your pocket into a personal teleporter.** Hold a Clock, Lodestone Compass, or Recovery Compass and crouch for 2 seconds — no commands, no crafting, no special items.

> A lightweight **data pack** for **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11**.

## ✨ What it does
While you are **carrying an Ender Pearl** (it is *not* used up), hold one of these everyday items and **hold Sneak/Crouch (Shift) for 2 seconds** to teleport:

| Hold this item | You teleport to… |
| --- | --- |
| 🕐 **Clock** | Your **respawn point** (your bed or respawn anchor) |
| 🧭 **Lodestone Compass** | The **lodestone** it is linked to |
| 🔮 **Recovery Compass** | The spot where you **last died** |

A countdown appears on your screen while you charge, so you always know it's working.

## 🎒 What you need
1. An **Ender Pearl** anywhere in your inventory — it stays, it's just the "key".
2. One of the three items above, held in your **main hand**.
3. That's it. These are normal vanilla items; no crafting or commands required.

For the Lodestone Compass, link a normal compass to a lodestone the usual way: right-click a placed lodestone block while holding a compass.

## 🎮 How to use (step by step)
1. Make sure you have an **Ender Pearl** in your inventory.
2. Hold the **Clock**, **Lodestone Compass**, or **Recovery Compass** in your hand.
3. **Hold the Sneak key (Shift by default) for 2 seconds.**
4. Watch the countdown — when it finishes, *poof*, you're there!

💡 **Tips**
- Release Sneak and press it again to teleport a second time.
- Releasing Sneak (or switching items) before the countdown ends cancels it.
- The Recovery Compass won't drop you into lava — if lava is above your death spot, it places you safely on top.

## 📦 How to install a data pack (for beginners)
Data packs go *inside a single world*, not in a mods folder.
1. **Download** this pack.
2. On the world you want, click **Edit → Open World Folder** (or open `.minecraft/saves/<your world>`).
3. Open the **`datapacks`** folder.
4. **Drop the pack inside** (the `.zip` or the `ender_teleport` folder — either works).
5. Back in game, run **`/reload`**, or leave and re-enter the world.

When it loads you'll see a purple message in chat. ✅
> **Servers:** put the pack in the server world's `datapacks` folder, then run `/reload`.

## 🔍 Handy command
- `/function ender_teleport:check_spawn` — shows your detected respawn point (coordinates + dimension).

## ❓ FAQ
**Does it use up my Ender Pearl?** No — it only needs to be in your inventory.

**Do I need special crafted items?** No — a normal Clock, Recovery Compass, and lodestone-linked Compass all work.

**Which dimensions work?** The Overworld, the Nether, and the End.

**Nothing happens when I sneak.** Check that you (1) have an Ender Pearl, (2) hold the item in your **main hand**, and (3) keep Sneak held for the full 2 seconds.

## 💬 Connects
- Discord: huyuk1_nat2uko
- Email: brown_too_good@naver.com

## 🧩 Compatibility
- **Minecraft:** Java Edition **1.21.11** (and recent 1.21 versions using pack format 88–99).
- **Type:** Data pack — no mods or mod loaders needed.

This mod allows you to edit, create, and load skins for your character directly while playing Minecraft. Now you can draw and customize your skin without ever leaving a world using a convenient, built-in interface! 

**Key Features:**
* **Built-in Editor:** Features a full color palette and a set of tools, including a brush, bucket fill, an eraser(for the 2nd layer of the skin), and more.
* **Quick Access:** Open the painting window directly from your inventory using the new "P" (Paint) button.
* **Save & Load:** Save and load your skins to/from a `skins` folder inside your `.minecraft` directory under custom names, without ever leaving the game.
* **Instant Updates:** Instantly display your newly painted skin on your character in the Minecraft world.
* **Undo/Redo:** Use Ctrl+Z for Undo and Ctrl+Shift+Z for Redo.

**Basically you:**
1. Open your inventory.
2. Click the "P" button located next to your character preview.
3. Use the color palette and tools to paint your skin.
4. Click "Back", and you're done!

**Important notes:**
* To display your custom skin on a server, this mod **MUST** be installed on the server as well. Otherwise, the changes will be client-side, meaning nobody will see your new skin except you.
* This mod will not work on TLauncher because their mod `tl skin cape` overrides vanilla skin mechanics, breaking skin mods. Use legacy launcher, prism launcher or vanilla minecraft launcher to avoid issues.

title: Farmalyze
description: Mod for analyzing and calculating farm rates.
body:
# Farmalyze
A farm analysis mod for Minecraft Fabric that measures item throughput of hoppers and containers in real-time.
## How It Works:
1. Press the **Block Key** (default: `V`) while looking at a hopper or container to select it for tracking
   
2. Press the **GUI Key** (default: `C`) to open the settings screen
   
3. Hit **Start Test** — Farmalyze will measure item flow for your configured duration
   
4. View results: items per minute, per hour, and per day
## Features
- **Real-Time Item Tracking** — Measures exact item throughput through hoppers and containers
  
- **Configurable Test Duration** — Slider from 5 seconds to 120 seconds
  
- **SMP Calculator** — Set custom prices per item to see earnings in $/MIN, $/HOUR, $/DAY. 
  
- **Supports shorthand input (1k, 2.5m, 1b)**
  
- **In-World Block Highlighting** — Selected blocks glow so you know what's being tracked
  
- **Rebindable Keybinds** — Change keys directly in the mod's GUI
  
- **Persistent Config** — All settings and prices are saved between sessions
## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
> ⚠️ This mod must be installed on **both client and server** to function.

title: Advanced Shadows
description: This project add´s an overlay for shadows in the Overworld.
body:
# AdvancedShadows

**See shadows. Find skybases.**

AdvancedShadows is a lightweight clientside mod that overlays colored carpets on the ground showing sky light levels — like a light level overlay, but for skylight. Perfect for hunting down skybase locations on survival or PvP servers.

---

## How it works

Press **F7** to toggle the overlay. Colored quads appear on all walkable surfaces around you:

- 🔴 **Red** — completely hidden from the sky (skylight 0)
- 🟠 **Orange** — heavily shadowed (skylight 1–7)
- 🟡 **Yellow** — partially shadowed (skylight 8–14)
- No overlay — full sky exposure

The overlay also renders on **tree leaves**, so you can walk through a forest canopy and immediately see which areas below are shadowed enough to hide a skybase.

---

## Features

- Toggle with **F7** (rebindable in Controls)
- Solid blocks + leaves support
- Overworld only (Nether/End auto-disabled)
- 16 block render radius
- Pure clientside — no mod needed on the server

---

## Installation

Requires **Fabric Loader** + **Fabric API** for Minecraft **1.21.11**.

1. Download the `.jar`
2. Place it in `.minecraft/mods/`
3. Launch → press **F7**

---

## Compatibility

Works alongside Sodium, Iris, and other rendering mods. Multiplayer-safe (clientside only).

title: Pragmatic Craft
description: The ultimate Vanilla+ experience focused entirely on performance, utility, and modern Quality of Life. Pragmatic Craft brings essential UI, inventory, and optimization tweaks to Fabric without ruining the classic Minecraft feel.
body:
# Pragmatic Craft

Welcome to Pragmatic Craft, a meticulously assembled Vanilla-Plus modpack designed for players who demand peak performance, sleek user interfaces, and meaningful quality-of-life additions without losing the classic soul of Minecraft survival. 

Rather than overwhelming the game with massive tech trees or game-breaking magic systems, Pragmatic Craft takes a practical approach: it leaves the core gameplay loop intact while systematically upgrading how the game runs, handles, and feels.

---

## Features

### Optimization
Say goodbye to stutubs, low frame rates, and poor chunk rendering. Pragmatic Craft integrates top-tier optimization engines to ensure the game runs as smoothly as possible, even on modest hardware:
* **Sodium & Lithium:** Total overhauls to the rendering engine and game physics calculus, drastically reducing CPU/GPU overhead.
* **BadOptimizations & FerriteCore:** Advanced memory and data-structure optimization to minimize RAM usage and eliminate sudden garbage-collection stuttering.
* **ImmediatelyFast & Entity Culling:** Speeds up immediate-mode rendering and stops rendering entities that aren't actively on your screen, saving precious frames in busy bases or mob farms.

### Content
Every piece of content added to the world is chosen for its utility, balance, and vanilla-friendly aesthetic:
* **Backpacked:** Adds fully balanced, wearable backpacks to cleanly expand your inventory while out on long mining trips or exploration treks.
* **Refurbished Furniture:** A beautiful selection of vanilla-styled furniture blocks to make your builds feel alive and functional without breaking the classic art style.
* **Goblin Traders:** Stumble across rare, underground goblin merchants offering unique, high-tier trades for adventurers willing to search the deep caves.
* **Tree Harvester & Ore Veines:** Streamlines the gathering loop by letting you cut down whole trees or mine cohesive ore veins with practical, balanced mechanics.

### Interface
Keep track of your world and manage your items with ultimate precision thanks to modern, intuitive UI overhauls:
* **Xaero’s Minimap & Worldmap:** Seamless, fluid radar and map overlays that track your surroundings, terrain elevation, and entities in real-time. 
* **Just Enough Items (JEI) & Searchables:** Instantly look up recipes, block uses, and filter your inventories cleanly.
* **Inventory HUD+ & Armor HUDs:** Keep an eye on your potion status effects, hand items, and armor durability directly on your main screen without constantly opening your inventory menu.

---

## Setup

### Requirements
* **Multiplayer Ready (Required on Both):** Pragmatic Craft is designated as a Client and Server modpack. Because it introduces tangible blocks, items, and entities (like furniture, backpacks, and goblins), both the server and the connecting clients must run this pack together to prevent registry mismatch errors.
* **Instance Synchronization:** This pack is precisely tuned to its environment target

title: AFKZonePlus
description: AFK Currency Rewards | Per-World Zones, Multi-Language & Folia
body:
![AFKZonePlus](https://i.imgur.com/GqGzClA.png)

## About AFKZonePlus

AFKZonePlus rewards players for staying AFK in the worlds you choose, with a fully customizable currency, an action-bar countdown and a reward sound.

Set your AFK zones, your reward rate and your own currency name, and let every player read the messages in their own language.

## Highlights

- **AFK currency rewards by world** earn while standing in any AFK zone
- **Per-player languages** messages shown in each player's own client language
- **Your own currency** the currency id is also its command (e.g. `/rune`)
- **Flexible storage** File, MongoDB or SQL, with optional Redis cache

## Compatibility

- Java 21 or higher
- Spigot, Paper and Folia (1.21+)
- **Requires the free Nexus core plugin** → [Download the latest Nexus](https://github.com/MrNickax/Nexus/releases/latest) (install it alongside AFKZonePlus)

## Features

- Reward a configurable amount on a configurable interval while in an AFK world
- VIP permission to keep earning outside AFK worlds
- Live action-bar countdown to the next reward, plus a reward notification
- Optional reward sound (configurable sound, volume & pitch)
- Name your own currency, it becomes the in-game command
- Per-player localization, drop a *lang/<language>.yml* file (English & Spanish included)
- Modern formatting with MiniMessage (gradients, HEX), plus Legacy and Mixed modes
- Pluggable storage: File, MongoDB or SQL, with in-memory or Redis cache and optional write-behind
- PlaceholderAPI support: `%afkzoneplus_balance%`
- Admin commands to check, add and take currency
- Folia-safe, reload-safe (PlugMan-friendly), with a built-in debug mode

## Commands

The currency command name is your configured currency id (default `rune`).

- `/<currency> balance [player]` → Show your balance, or another player's
- `/<currency> add <player> <amount>` → Add currency to a player
- `/<currency> take <player> <amount>` → Take currency from a player
- `/afkzoneplus reload` → Reload the configuration and language files

## Permissions

- `afkzoneplus.vip` → Keep earning outside AFK worlds (node is configurable)
- `afkzoneplus.currency.balance.others` → Check another player's balance
- `afkzoneplus.currency.add` → Use the add command
- `afkzoneplus.currency.take` → Use the take command
- `afkzoneplus.reload` → Reload the plugin

## Why AFKZonePlus?

AFK farming should feel rewarding, not generic. AFKZonePlus gives you a currency you fully own, your name, your reward rate, your zones, with modern formatting, real storage options and first-class per-player localization, all while staying lightweight and fully compatible with the latest server software, including Folia.

title: AeroFriends

body:
# 👥 AeroFriends | Authentic Hypixel-Style Friend System

AeroFriends is a highly optimized, fully customizable Minecraft server plugin that delivers an authentic **Hypixel** friend system experience. Built with performance and clean aesthetics in mind, it allows your players to seamlessly connect, track, and manage their in-game social circle.

Developed by **Aero's Creations**, this plugin features a signature deep blue color palette, real-time activity tracking, and dynamic dual-sided notifications.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🔹 **Authentic Hypixel Aesthetic:** Clean, beautifully formatted chat dividers (`&9&m------------------`) and layout copies that match the industry standard.
* 🔹 **Live Status & Location Tracking:** The friend list automatically tracks if a player is online and dynamically displays their active world/server node (e.g., `■ Player is in SkyBlock`).
* 🔹 **Interactive Chat Menus:** Typing just `/f` or `/friend` displays an interactive text layout with hoverable and clickable actions (`[ACCEPT]` / `[DENY]`) for friend requests.
* 🔹 **Smart Two-Way Removal Alerts:** When a player removes a friend (individually or via `/f removeall`), **both** screens are updated. The target player instantly receives a notification that they were removed.
* 🔹 **Robust Request Toggling:** Players can toggle incoming requests on or off. If disabled, incoming invites are completely blocked instantly.
* 🔹 **Soft PlaceholderAPI Support:** Works flawlessly out of the box using standard native `%player_name%` placeholders. If PlaceholderAPI is present on your server, it will automatically hook into it to parse custom prefixes, suffixes, and ranks without requiring it as a hard dependency!

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf6f147f26069bca44a20bb62bb2daced6f68463.jpeg)

| Command | Description | Permission | Aliases |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/friend` | Displays the help options menu in chat | `aerofriends.use` | `/f`, `/friends` |
| `/friend add <name>` | Sends a friend request to a player | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend accept <name>` | Accepts a pending friend request | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend deny <name>` | Declines a pending friend request | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend remove <name>` | Removes a player from your friend list | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend removeall` | Clears your entire friend list with dual notifications | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend list [page]` | Lists your friends, showing their online server/world | `aerofriends.use` | |
| `/friend toggle` | Enables/Disables incoming friend requests | `aerofriends.use` | |

---

## 📊 Placeholders (PlaceholderAPI)

If you have PlaceholderAPI installed, you can use these extensions anywhere on your server (Scoreboards, Tabs, Chat):

* `%friends_total%` - Total number of friends added.
* `%friends_online%` - Number of currently online friends.
* `%friends_offline%` - Number of offline friends.
* `%friends_limit%` - Maximum allowed friend limit.

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Drop the `AeroFriends 1.0.0.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Restart your server to generate the configuration files.
3. *(Optional)* Install **PlaceholderAPI** to unlock advanced rank/prefix integrations inside the friend notifications.
4. Enjoy a premium, seamless network experience!

---

## 💬 Community and support

**Dont Forget To join our discord server**
**[click here to join](https://discord.gg/6TRzGCYSe)**

---

**Created with ❤️ by Aero's Creations**

title: Ychat

body:
# 🚀 Ychat (by nuan)

**Ychat** is a lightweight, feature-rich, and highly customizable chat management plugin for Minecraft servers. Built entirely on the modern **Adventure API**, it replaces the boring vanilla chat with a fully interactive system featuring stunning HEX gradients, custom sound notifications, and dynamic clickable elements.

---

## ✨ Features

* 📍 **Local & Global Chats:** Easily split communication. Local chat works within a set radius (100 blocks by default), while global chat can be accessed by using the `!` prefix.
* 👥 **Friend Chat & Sync:** Quick messaging dedicated to friends using the `@` prefix. Friends also get a custom glowing potion effect when they log into the server.
* 🛡️ **Friendly Fire Prevention:** Built-in toggle to disable PvP between friends. Can be easily switched on/off using the `/f pvp` command.
* 🔗 **Interactive Names (Click & Hover):**
  * **Hover:** Hovering over a player's name in chat brings up a fully customizable stats card (showing HP, Ping, Exp Level, Kills, Deaths, etc.).
  * **Click:** Clicking a player's name automatically inserts a command into the chat bar (e.g., `/msg <player> ` or `/tpa <player>`), making communication seamless.
* 📢 **Advertisement System (`/ad`):** Allow players to broadcast shoutouts or ads with a configurable cooldown timer and dynamic pricing/formatting.
* 🔔 **Custom System Notifications with Sounds:**
  * Beautiful custom templates for Join, Quit, Death, and Advancement messages.
  * **Personal MOTD Welcome:** Send a unique greeting accompanied by a private sound effect visible *only* to the player logging in.
  * **Global Join Sounds:** Broadcast a specific sound notification to the rest of the server when a player arrives.
* 🎨 **Full HEX & MiniMessage Support:** Forget the old legacy color code limitations! Use modern HEX codes (`#FF9146`) to create unique gradient styles across all text components.
* 🧩 **PlaceholderAPI (PAPI) Integration:** Full support for any external placeholders to display customized statistics in the chat formats or hover menus.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

* `/chatx reload` — Reloads the plugin configuration. *(Permission: `chatx.admin`)*
* `/ad [text]` — Broadcasts an advertisement to the server.
* `/friend [add/remove/list/pvp]` — Manages the friend system.
* `/msg [player] [text]` — Sends a private message to a player.
* `/reply [text]` or `/r [text]` — Quickly replies to the last private message received.

---

## ⚙️ Dependencies

* **Server Software:** Paper, Purpur, or Spigot (Versions 1.19.x - 1.21.x+ supporting the Adventure API).
* **PlaceholderAPI** *(Optional)* — Required if you want to use external statistics placeholders (like player kills or deaths) in your hover stats menu.

---

## 💾 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar` file.
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server (or load it using a plugin manager).
4. Customize the generated `config.yml` to your liking and type `/chatx reload`.

---

## ✨ About

**Better Pets Paper** is a complete **Paper plugin rewrite** of the Better Pets datapack.

It does **not** require datapacks, command functions, minecart menus, or a manual resource pack.
Everything is handled directly through the plugin. Optional animated 3D models are handled through
**BetterModel** when that plugin is installed and the (experimental) module is enabled.

---

## 🎯 Target

| Requirement         | Version / Info                                            |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Minecraft / Paper   | `26.1.2`                                                  |
| Java                | `21` (Java `25` recommended when using BetterModel 3.x)   |
| Optional Dependency | LuckPerms for permission assignment                       |
| Optional Dependency | BetterModel `3.x` for animated `.bbmodel` pets            |

---

## 🌟 Features

* 🐾 `/pets` inventory GUI for owned pets
* 📖 Pet catalogue with per-level milestone pages
* 🎲 Per-pet chest spawn chance GUI
* 📢 Discovery broadcast GUI by rarity, with rarity-based sounds
* ✨ Pet XP multiplier GUI
* 💾 Persistent player pet storage with backups
* 🦙 Owner-only Alpaca storage using Paper item byte serialization
* 📦 Dynamic Alpaca storage size based on level
* 🐉 Dragon mount flight unlocked from level 50
* 🏛️ Chest loot integration for vanilla **and** custom structure containers
* 🧩 Optional 3D pet rendering through BetterModel, with a clean head fallback

---

## 💬 Commands

| Command                                  | Description                              |
| ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `/pets`                                  | Opens the main pet menu                  |
| `/pets version`                          | Shows version, active modules, updates   |
| `/pets update`                           | Downloads the latest version (admin)     |
| `/pets help`                             | Shows command help                       |
| `/pets info`                             | Opens the pet catalogue                  |
| `/pets chances`                          | Opens spawn chance settings              |
| `/pets notify`                           | Opens discovery broadcast settings       |
| `/pets drop`                             | Choose pet sources (chest/fishing/...)   |
| `/pets modules`                          | Opens optional module settings           |
| `/pets reload`                           | Reloads config, modules, models, pets    |
| `/pets give <pet\|all> [level] [player]` | Gives test pet items                     |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission                | Description                                                          |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `betterpets.command.pets` | Allows opening the main pet menu                                     |
| `betterpets.info`         | Allows opening the pet catalogue                                    |
| `betterpets.chances`      | Allows editing spawn chances, broadcasts, and XP multiplier         |
| `betterpets.give`         | Allows giving test pet items                                        |
| `betterpets.admin`        | Grants all admin actions, including `/pets modules` and `/pets reload` |

---

## ⚙️ Important Config

```yaml
max-pets-per-player: 45
chest-pet-chance-percent: 2.5
pet-xp-multiplier: 1.0
dragon-flight-speed: 1.5
dragon-flight-lift: 0.55
debug-loot-rolls: false

# External modules (BetterModel) are experimental and disabled by default.
experimental-modules: false

# Model rendering (only used when the BetterModel module is enabled)
model-ground-offset: 0.05
model-nametag-height: 2.6
model-facing-yaw-offset-degrees: 0.0

discovery-broadcasts:
  common: true
  rare: true
  epic: true
  legendary: true
  extraordinary: true

model-overrides: {}
```

---

## 🧩 Optional Modules

> **⚠️ Experimental.** External modules (such as BetterModel) are experimental and **disabled by default**. While `experimental-modules: false` in `config.yml`, the `/pets modules` command is blocked and no external module is activated, even if it is enabled in `modules.yml`. Set `experimental-modules: true` to opt in.

Module state is stored in:

```text
plugins/BetterPets/modules.yml
```

Modules are toggled in `/pets modules` (once `experimental-modules` is enabled). A module can only be enabled when its required plugin is installed and enabled. If a module is enabled in `modules.yml` but the required plugin is missing, Better Pets keeps the flag and skips activation until the dependency becomes available.

---

## 🪄 BetterModel Module

The `bettermodel` module requires the **BetterModel** plugin. When enabled, pets render as animated 3D `.bbmodel` models instead of floating pet heads.

Model folder:

```text
plugins/BetterPets/models/
```

File naming (the name without `.bbmodel` is matched case-insensitively to the pet id/name):

```text
ant.bbmodel
bat.bbmodel
blue_dragon.bbmodel
```

Override model names per pet in `config.yml`:

```yaml
model-overrides:
  Ant: tiny_ant
  Blue Dragon: blue_dragon_variant
```

### 🎞️ Animations & movement

Better Pets reads the animations declared inside each `.bbmodel` and drives them automatically:

| Animation         | When it plays                                       |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `idle`            | The owner is standing still                         |
| `walking`         | The owner is moving and the model is **grounded**   |
| `flying`          | The owner is moving and the model is **flying**     |
| `idle2` … `idle9` | Optional random idle variants while standing still  |

Whether a model is **grounded** or **flying** is decided automatically: a `flying` animation means it flies, a `walking` animation (without `flying`) means it walks on the ground. You can also **force** it through the model name: a model ending in `_grounded` always walks, and `_flying` always flies (e.g. `ant_grounded.bbmodel`).

### 🔄 Reloading models

When the module is enabled or `/pets reload` is run, Better Pets scans `plugins/BetterPets/models/`, copies changed `.bbmodel` files into BetterModel's `models/` folder, and reloads BetterModel. It first tries the BetterModel API reload and falls back to the console command:

```text
bettermodel reload
```

If BetterModel is missing, disabled, or has no matching loaded model, Better Pets falls back to the pet-head rendering.

### 📦 Resource pack note

BetterModel generates its own resource pack from the `.bbmodel` files and embedded textures. Vanilla clients still need BetterModel's **auto-send / host** resource-pack option enabled on the server.

---

## 🦙 Alpaca Storage

Alpaca storage is **owner-only** and saved inside:

```text
plugins/BetterPets/pets.yml
```

Items are stored with `ItemStack.serializeItemsAsBytes`, preserving modern item data such as custom enchantments, PersistentDataContainer values, plugin metadata, and Paper item data.

| Alpaca Level | Storage Size |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Level 1      | 9 slots      |
| Level 30     | 18 slots     |
| Level 50     | 27 slots     |
| Level 70     | 36 slots     |
| Level 100    | 54 slots     |

> An Alpaca with stored items cannot be switched away, despawned, or converted into an item until its storage is empty.

---

## 🛠️ Building

With Maven:

```powershell
mvn clean package
```

Local fallback build script:

```powershell
.\build.ps1
```

The output jar is created at:

```text
target/better-pets-26.1.2-plugin.jar
```

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Build the jar (or download it from the [latest release](https://github.com/yourShika/betterpets-paper/releases/latest)).
2. Put `better-pets-26.1.2-plugin.jar` into the Paper server's `plugins` folder.
3. Install **BetterModel** only if you want animated 3D models.
4. Start the server once to generate config and storage files.
5. Use LuckPerms or `paper-plugin.yml` defaults to assign permissions.
6. (Optional) Put `.bbmodel` files into `plugins/BetterPets/models/`, set `experimental-modules: true`, enable the module in `/pets modules`, then run `/pets reload`.

---

## 🏛️ Chest Loot Notes

Pet rolls happen when Minecraft generates container loot for unopened generated containers (chests, double chests, barrels, and other block containers), including custom structures from data packs.

* Existing opened containers will not reroll.
* Each generated container can get at most one Better Pets item.
* Enable `debug-loot-rolls: true` to see loot roll attempts in the console.

---

## 🐾 Pet Sources

Pets can drop from four sources, each toggleable and tunable in `/pets drop` (or `config.yml` under `pet-sources`):

| Source | How | Default chance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Chests** | Generated container loot (chests, double chests, barrels, custom structures) | `chest-pet-chance-percent` (2.5%) |
| **Fishing** | Fish one out (replaces the catch) | 1.0% |
| **Wandering Trader** | A spawned trader carries a one-time pet deal priced by rarity | 25% per trader |
| **Brushing** | Brush one out of suspicious sand/gravel | 1.5% |

Each find shows a broadcast (e.g. `Player fished out a Rare Pet: Axolotl!`), gated by the same per-rarity toggles as `/pets notify`.

---

## 🗒️ Previous Releases

* **v1.2.4** — Pets look at the player again (facing fix), `/pets update`, double-chest discovery broadcasts.
* **v1.2.3** — Mending-proof XP, lighter saving, `/pets version`, animation-driven model movement, ground-height caching.
* **v1.2.2** — Optional module system (experimental) + BetterModel module; particles stop when the pet is hidden.
* **v1.2.1** — Owner-only glow reveal (through walls) for Bat / Red Parrot / Warden.
* **v1.2.0** — Multiplayer fixes: personal Herobrine weather, Allay no longer takes others' items, crash-safe join cleanup, double chests + barrels.
* **v1.1.0** — Three new pets (Mole, Allay, Cursed Plushie), reworked Phoenix revive, rarity broadcast sounds, `EXP: MAXED`.

---

## 📜 Credits

This project is a Paper plugin rewrite inspired by the original **Better Pets** datapack.

🔗 [Better Pets on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/betterpets)

All rights to the original project, name, concepts, assets, and related content belong to their respective rights holders.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is **not an official update**, **not an official continuation**, and **not directly affiliated with the original Better Pets project**, unless explicitly stated otherwise. It does not claim ownership of the original project. If the original author or rights holder wants specific content removed, changed, or credited differently, please contact the repository owner.

title: iammojogo's Flashlight Mod
description: A craftable flashlight powered by redstone-and-copper batteries — toggle it on to light your way, and watch the charge drain with use.
body:
Flashlight Mod
A simple, survival-friendly flashlight. Craft it, load it with batteries, and toggle it on for a directional light that follows where you look. Power isn't free — the batteries drain while it's on, so you'll be crafting more.
Features

Craftable flashlight and rechargeable batteries
Toggle on/off with a rebindable key (default G) or by right-clicking
Light shines along your line of sight, out to a configurable range
Charge drains only while the light is on — a full charge lasts about 20 minutes of continuous use by default
Visual charge bar on the item (green → red as it empties)
In-game config screen (via the mod list) for battery life, light level, and beam range

How to use

Craft batteries from redstone and copper.
Craft the flashlight.
Hold it and sneak + right-click with at least 2 batteries in your inventory to charge it (uses 2 at a time).
Press G (or right-click) to toggle it on/off.

Recipes
Battery (yields 2) — vertical column: redstone, copper ingot, redstone.
Flashlight (empty) — iron ingots around the edges, glass pane top-center, redstone torch in the center.
Configuration
Adjustable in-game from the mods list, or in config/flashlightmod.properties:

Battery life — 10 / 20 / 30 / 60 minutes per full charge
Light level — 1–15 (default 15)
Beam range — how many blocks ahead the light reaches (default 8)

Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21.11, Forge 61+, Java 21
Works in singleplayer and on servers. For multiplayer, install on both the client and server.

title: MusicPlay
description: MusicPlay turns your Minecraft server into a fully-featured music platform. Upload OGG/MP3 tracks, manage personal playlists, and enjoy auto-switching playback — all through a beautiful inventory GUI.
body:
# 🎵 MusicPlay — Custom Music Player for Your Server

**MusicPlay** is a fully-featured, server-side music player plugin for Paper/Spigot servers. Upload your own `.ogg` tracks, serve them through a built-in HTTP server, and let players enjoy custom music through a beautiful inventory GUI — no client mods required.

> 🎧 Turn any Minecraft server into a real music platform.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎼 **Custom Track Library** — Upload any `.ogg` audio file via a chat link. Titles are read automatically from the file’s metadata (Vorbis TITLE tag).
- 🖥️ **Inventory GUI Player** — Open a clean music player interface by Shift + Right-clicking your jukebox, or using `/music play`.
- 📋 **Personal Playlists** — Every player has their own playlist (up to 45 tracks). Add tracks with Right-click in the library, remove them with Shift + Left-click in your playlist.
- ⏭️ **Auto Track Switching** — When a song ends, the next one plays automatically. Works in both Library mode and Playlist mode.
- 🔁 **Looping Playlists** — Playing your playlist? It loops seamlessly.
- 📦 **Built-in Resource Pack Server** — No external hosting needed. MusicPlay runs its own HTTP server and sends the pack to players on join.
- 🔤 **Readable Track Names** — Forget `custom.track_1`. Track titles are extracted from the `.ogg` file and shown everywhere in the UI.
- 🎵 **Audio Conversion** — Supports uploading MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A and other formats. If `ffmpeg` is installed on the server, the plugin automatically converts the track to **OGG Mono** (as required by Minecraft) at 192kbps quality.
- 🔊 **Mono Audio** — All converted tracks are forced to mono, ensuring correct 3D spatial positioning in-game.
- 🔗 **Smart Download** — Automatically follows HTTP redirects (301/302/307/308), sanitizes URLs from stray characters, and works with any CDN.
- 🌍 **Full Localization** — Every string in the UI and chat is stored in `lang.yml`. Translate the plugin to any language in minutes.
- 🎛️ **Per-Player Resource Pack Control** — Players can opt out of auto-loading and install the pack manually.

---

## 🕹️ How to Use

### For Players

1. Ask an admin to place a **Jukebox** and insert a custom disc (given via `/music disk`).
2. **Shift + Right-click** the jukebox to open the music player.
3. Use the GUI buttons to control playback:
   - ⏸ **Pause / ▶ Resume** — Stop or continue the current track.
   - ⏮ **Previous** / **Next** ⏭ — Switch tracks.
   - 📋 **Playlist** — Open your personal playlist.
   - 📄 **Track Library** — Browse all available tracks. **Right-click** a track to add it to your playlist.
   - ➕ **Add Track** — (Admins only) Upload a new `.ogg` track by pasting a download link in chat.

### For Admins

1. Place a Jukebox, insert a custom disc from `/music disk`.
2. Use `/music upload` and paste a **direct `.ogg` download link** in chat.

> ⚠️ **Important:** The link must be a **direct download URL** — it must end with `.ogg` and open the file immediately (not a page like Google Drive or YouTube). Services like [Dropbox](https://dropbox.com) (with `?dl=1`), [GitHub Releases](https://github.com), or a direct web server link work great.

3. The plugin downloads the file (following any redirects automatically), reads its title, rebuilds the resource pack, and notifies players automatically.

> 🎵 **Format Conversion:** If the link points to an MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, etc. — the plugin automatically converts it to **OGG Mono** if `ffmpeg` is installed on the server. Without ffmpeg — upload tracks in `.ogg` format directly.
> Mono is required for correct 3D spatial audio positioning in Minecraft.

> 🎨 **Custom Disc Texture:** After the first server launch, a file will appear at `plugins/MusicPlay/textures/custom_disc.png`. Replace it with your own 16×16 PNG texture to give your music disc a unique look! Rebuild the pack with `/music pack` after replacing.

---

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/music play` | Open the music player GUI | — |
| `/music disk [sound]` | Give yourself a custom music disc | `musicplay.disk` |
| `/music upload` | Upload a new `.ogg` track via chat link | `musicplay.upload` |
| `/music pack` | Rebuild the resource pack manually | `musicplay.upload` |
| `/music tracks` | List all available sound keys | — |
| `/music linkrp` | Get the resource pack download link | — |
| `/music skiprp` | Disable auto resource pack loading | — |
| `/music loadrp` | Re-enable auto resource pack loading | — |
| `/music help` | Show help message | — |

---

## ⚙️ Technical Details

### How It Works

1. You upload a `.ogg` file via a URL.
2. MusicPlay downloads it, parses the **Vorbis Comment headers** to extract the track title and duration.
3. It rebuilds a `.zip` resource pack containing the audio files and `sounds.json`, then serves it via a built-in **Java HTTP server**.
4. Players receive the pack on join. The plugin uses `world.playSound()` targeting the jukebox location for spatial audio.
5. A lightweight 1-second timer tracks playback progress per player and triggers auto-switching when a track ends.

### Resource Pack

MusicPlay generates and hosts its own resource pack. You need to expose the HTTP port (default: `25604`) so players can download it. Configure the public URL in `config.yml`:

```yaml
resource-pack-public-url: "http://YOUR_SERVER_IP:25604/musicpack.zip"
http-port: 25604
```

### Localization

All UI text lives in `plugins/MusicPlay/lang.yml`. On first launch the default file is extracted — just edit the values:

```yaml
menu.pause: "⏸ Pause"
menu.resume: "▶ Resume"
menu.playlist: "📋 Playlist"
# ... and so on
```

### Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|---|---|
| `musicplay.disk` | Give custom music discs |
| `musicplay.upload` | Upload tracks and rebuild packs |

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Server:** Paper 1.21+ (or compatible fork)
- **Java:** 21+
- **Port:** One open TCP port for the resource pack HTTP server (default `25604`)

---

## 🤝 Credits

Built with love using the **Paper API** and **Adventure** text components. No client mods required — pure server-side magic. 🪄

Requires Vault or EssentialsX for economy support. Creating a company costs $100,000.

Create your empire, invest wisely, and dominate the economy.

title: Custom Seeds
description: Adds 12 new seeds to Minecraft
body:
## What is this mod?

Tired of spending hours strip-mining just to get basic gear? This mod completely flips how you gather resources in your survival world. 

Instead of mining, you can craft **12 unique Custom Seeds** using raw base materials (like Raw Iron, Logs, or Diamonds) combined with a standard Wheat Seed. Plant them on farmland, wait for them to grow (or speed them up with Bone Meal), and right-click to harvest. 

Instead of dropping boring crops, harvesting triggers a "Lucky 7" loot explosion! A fully grown Diamond Seed might drop a Diamond Sword, an Enchanting Table, and diamond armor. A Log Seed drops crafting tables, shields, and wooden gear.

## 🛠️ How to Craft

Crafting your custom seeds is super simple. Open a Crafting Table and place **1 Vanilla Wheat Seed** right in the center slot. Then, surround it completely with **8 of the base material** you want to grow. 

*   *Example:* 8 Raw Iron + 1 Wheat Seed = 1 Iron Seed.
*   *Example:* 8 Diamonds + 1 Wheat Seed = 1 Diamond Seed.
*   *Note for Wood:* The Log Seed accepts any combination of vanilla logs!

## 🌱 The 12 Craftable Seeds
You can craft seeds for:
**Log, Cobblestone, Gravel, Dirt, Sand, Andesite, Coal, Raw Iron, Raw Gold, Diamond, Emerald, and Lapis.**

## ⚠️ Key Mechanics & Rules

* **The "Lucky 7" Drops:** Harvesting a fully grown crop rolls up to 7 random items from its specific OP loot pool. 
* **No Seed Duping:** To keep things somewhat balanced, a harvested crop will *never* drop the seed itself, and it will *never* drop the base block. You have to keep crafting to keep growing!
* **High Stakes Death Penalty:** Be careful out there! Dying instantly clears your inventory and aggressively destroys *every single custom crop* you have planted across your loaded chunks.
* **Anti-Cheat:** You can't break the system. Pistons will destroy the crops instead of moving them, water will not wash them away, and jumping on farmland will not trample the dirt beneath custom crops.

## 🎥 For Content Creators (YouTubers / Streamers)

We love seeing people use my work in videos! If you’re a creator and you use this mod for a challenge or a series, I just ask for one small favor:
**Please include the official links to this page in your video description.** It helps support my work and lets your viewers find the mod easily. To avoid copyright issues, simply including the official links to this page in your description is all you need to do!

## Installation Guide

1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the Versions tab.
2. This is a Fabric mod! Ensure you have **Fabric Loader (0.18.5+)** and the **Fabric API** installed for Minecraft 1.21.4.
3. Drop the mod into your `mods` folder.
4. Launch your world, grab a hoe, and start planting!

title: noUsernames
description: NoUsernames removes all player name tags above heads with zero setup and zero performance impact. Just install and play.
body:
# NoUsernames — Full Anonymity on Your Server

**NoUsernames** is a lightweight plugin for Minecraft servers (Paper/Spigot) that completely hides player usernames above their heads. Create an atmosphere of anonymity and mystery on your server!

---

## 📋 Features

- **Username Hiding** — player names disappear from above their heads, making the server more immersive
- **Full Compatibility** — works with Paper, Spigot, and any forks on versions 1.16.5+
- **Zero Overhead** — the plugin is optimized and has no impact on server performance
- **Simple Installation** — just drop the .jar into the plugins folder and restart the server
- **Automatic Operation** — no configuration or setup required
- **Compatibility** — works alongside any other plugins without interfering with their functionality

---

## 🎯 Why Use This?

- **PvP Servers** — hide opponent names for fairer battles
- **Streamers** — avoid showing other players' names on stream
- **Roleplay Servers** — full immersion without distracting nameplates
- **Minigames** — conceal information about opponents
- **Anonymous Servers** — create a mysterious, enigmatic atmosphere

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1. Download the latest version of the plugin
2. Place the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server (or use `/reload`)
4. Done! All usernames are now automatically hidden

---

## 📌 Commands & Permissions

The plugin requires no commands or permissions — it works "out of the box."

title: Item Delete HotKeys
description: ItemDelete is a Minecraft plugin that allows players to delete items directly from their inventory using a specific click action, featuring a double-press confirmation system to prevent accidental deletion.
body:
# ItemDelete

ItemDelete is a server-side Spigot/Paper plugin that allows players to permanently delete items from their inventory using a configurable click action or key combination (default: `Ctrl + Q`).

It is designed for inventory cleanup, with several safety features to prevent accidental item deletion.

## Features

* **Inventory Deletion:** Delete hovered items directly from the inventory using the configured hotkey.
* **Safety Toggle:** Players must run `/itemdelete toggle` to enable/disable deletion. While disabled, the hotkey retains its default Minecraft behavior (e.g., dropping item stacks).
* **Double-Press Confirmation:** Requires the player to trigger the deletion action twice within a configurable timeframe (default: 1.5s) to confirm.
* **Item Blacklist:** Block specific item types (e.g., bedrock, barrier) from being deleted.
* **World Filters:** Restrict deletion functionality to specific worlds using a whitelist or blacklist.
* **Audio Feedback:** Optional sound effects for confirmation prompts and successful deletion.
* **Customizable Messages:** All messages and colors can be customized in the configuration file.

## Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/itemdelete toggle` | Enable or disable item deletion mode | `itemdelete.use` |
| `/itemdelete reload` | Reload the configuration | `itemdelete.admin` |

* **Aliases:** `/id`, `/idelete`

## Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
# The action required to delete the item when hovered in the inventory.
# By default, this is CONTROL_DROP (Ctrl + Q).
delete-action: "CONTROL_DROP"

# Double click/tap check to prevent accidental deletion.
double-press:
  enabled: true
  time-window-ms: 1500

# Require players to run /itemdelete toggle to enable deleting.
require-toggle: true

# Permission settings
require-permission: false
permission: "itemdelete.use"

# Sound settings. Set to "NONE" to disable.
delete-sound: "ENTITY_ITEM_BREAK"
confirm-prompt-sound: "BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING"

# World restriction settings
worlds:
  mode: "BLACKLIST" # BLACKLIST or WHITELIST
  list:
    - "example_disabled_world"

# Block specific items from being deleted
blacklisted-items:
  - "BEDROCK"
  - "BARRIER"
  - "COMMAND_BLOCK"

# Message customization (supports color codes)
messages:
  prefix: "&8[&cItemDelete&8] &7"
  deleted: "&aItem &e%item% &ahas been deleted."
  confirm-prompt: "&6Press again within %time%s to confirm deletion of &e%item%&6."
  blacklisted: "&cYou cannot delete this item!"
  no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to delete items."
  reload: "&aConfiguration reloaded successfully."
  toggle-on: "&aDelete Mode ENABLED! Hovering and pressing Ctrl+Q will delete items."
  toggle-off: "&cDelete Mode DISABLED! Normal Minecraft key functions restored."
```

## Installation

1. Place `ItemDelete.jar` in your server's `plugins/` folder.
2. Restart the server.
3. Configure settings in `plugins/ItemDelete/config.yml` and run `/itemdelete reload` to apply.

title: TPS Warning
description: A lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin that alerts players in-game and via Discord Webhooks when server TPS drops below a set threshold. It features an integrated cooldown system and easy live customization using the /wc command.
body:
# SystemWarning

A highly efficient, asynchronous Paper/Spigot plugin designed to actively monitor your Minecraft server's performance. It broadcasts instant alerts to the in-game chat and triggers a custom Discord Webhook layout whenever the server's Ticks Per Second (TPS) drop below a customizable threshold.

## 🚀 Features

* **Real-time TPS Monitoring:** Autonomously tracks the server's 1-minute TPS average every 10 seconds.
* **Discord Integration:** Asynchronously dispatches performance warnings via Discord Webhooks, ensuring server main-thread operations are never blocked.
* **Smart Cooldown System:** Prevents message spamming by enforcing a rate limit (cooldown) between triggered alerts.
* **Dynamic Configuration:** Adjust all variables, payloads, text limits, and paths seamlessly.
* **Live In-game Customization:** Alter plugin settings on the fly through an interactive in-game administrator command setup.
* **Security First:** Built-in payload character sanitization preventing malformed parameters or JSON injection attempts over Discord webhooks.
* **Tab-Completion Engine:** Native command auto-suggestions for effortless configuration adjustments.

---

## 🛠️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

The default configuration file will automatically generate upon the plugin's initial startup:

```yaml
# The critical performance marker. Alerts trigger when current TPS falls below or matches this value.
threshold: 15.0

# Rate limiting parameter (defined in seconds) before another notification cycle can be invoked.
cooldown: 300

discord:
  webhook-url: "YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE"
  message: "⚠️ **Server Warning!** TPS have dropped to %tps%!"

minecraft:
  message: "&c⚠️ [Warning] Server TPS are critically low: &e%tps%"

title: E2EChat
description: A privacy-focused messaging plugin for SMP communities that want sensitive player conversations kept out of standard server logs and databases.​
body:
# E2EChat

**Private conversations. Zero persistence.**

A privacy-focused messaging plugin for SMP communities that want sensitive player conversations kept out of standard server logs and databases.

---

## Why E2EChat?

Not every conversation belongs in public chat, server logs, or databases.

E2EChat provides secure player-to-player communication channels designed for SMP servers where privacy matters. Whether players are discussing base locations, trading information, faction plans, or personal conversations, messages are handled through encrypted sessions and remain exclusively in memory.

---

## Key Features

* AES-256 GCM encrypted messaging
* Unique session key for every player pair
* No database storage
* No disk persistence
* Secure Focus Mode for private conversations
* Interactive connection requests and handshakes
* Bedrock support via Floodgate
* Paper 1.21+ compatible

---

## Privacy by Design

Messages are intercepted before reaching normal Paper chat and command logging pipelines, helping prevent accidental storage in console logs or databases.

---

## Trust Model

E2EChat protects against standard logging and persistence mechanisms. It does **not** protect against malicious or compromised plugins, or anyone with direct access to server memory.

---

## Commands

```text
/secure connect <player>
/secure focus <player>
/secure focus
/secure disconnect
```

Secure channels for trusted conversations.

title: DuckLink
description: Connects two or more players together to synchronize their health, food levels, inventory states, and track their distance in real-time.
body:
# 🔗 DuckLink | Player Status & Inventory Synchronizer

Bind players together for a true co-op survival challenge! `DuckLink` allows players to link their status attributes, making team survival highly interdependent. If one player takes damage, runs out of food, or updates their inventory, the changes dynamically sync to their linked partner.

***

## ✨ Features

*   **Attribute Synchronization:** Real-time synchronization of player health (`DamageSyncListener`) and hunger levels (`FoodSyncListener`) across linked players.
*   **Shared Inventory Management:** Keeps inventory status updated and secure using the built-in `InventorySaveListener` to prevent item desyncs.
*   **Proximity & Distance Tracking:** Utilizes a background `DistanceTask` to actively monitor and calculate the distance between linked players.
*   **Player Link Invites:** Features a structured invitation system managed by `LinkManager` and `InviteData` to handle connection requests safely.
*   **Connection Lifecycle Handling:** Automatically updates player link states upon server login or logout via the `ConnectionListener`.
*   **Simple In-Game Commands:** Quick and intuitive commands under `/link` to invite, accept, or manage active player connections.

***

## ⚙️ Dependencies

*   A compatible Minecraft server software supporting the Spigot or Paper API.

***

## 🚀 Installation

1.  Download the latest version of `ducklink.jar` (or your compiled snapshot).
2.  Stop your Minecraft server completely.
3.  Drag and drop the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins` directory.
4.  Start your server to generate the default configuration files.
5.  Use the `/link` command in-game to start connecting your players!

***

## 📜 Commands & Permissions

*   `/ducklink` (Aliases: `/dlink`) - The core and unique command to manage, invite, or disconnect player status linkages.
    *   _Permission:_ `ducklink.use` (Default: everyone)

title: Firefly
description: Hide and recolor your dot on Minecraft's 1.21.6+ locator bar. Real per-player position privacy, admin see-all bypass, and full customization. Server-side, no client mod. Paper, Spigot & Folia.
body:
Take back control of the Minecraft locator bar.
Hide your position, recolor your dot, and give players real privacy. No client mod required.

--- ## What is the locator bar? Minecraft **1.21.6** introduced the **locator bar**: the strip across the top of the screen that shows the direction and distance of every other player as a colored dot (a *waypoint*). It's handy for meeting up with friends, and a problem when you'd rather **not** be tracked. **Firefly hands that visibility back to your players.** Anyone can hide their own dot from everyone else's locator bar, or recolor it. Admins get a see-all override plus moderation tools. > **100% server-side.** Players join with an ordinary vanilla client. There is nothing for them to > install: no resource pack, no mod. Firefly does everything by rewriting the locator-bar packets on > the server. ## ✨ Features - 🙈 **Hide your location.** Disappear from every other player's locator bar with `/firefly hide`. Your position simply stops being broadcast. - 🎨 **Recolor your dot.** Pick any of the 16 named Minecraft colors *or* a full `#RRGGBB` hex code to stand out, blend in, or coordinate a team. - 🛡️ **Admin see-all bypass.** Staff can reveal hidden players for moderation. Each admin's on/off choice is **remembered** between logins, with a server-wide default you control. - 🔍 **See who's hidden.** `/firefly showhidden` lists every player currently hiding their dot. - 💾 **Persistent per-player preferences.** Hide state, colors, and bypass choices survive relogs and restarts. Store them in **YAML**, embedded **H2**, or shared **MySQL**. - 🌍 **Fully translatable.** Every message lives in `messages.yml`; edit the text, color it with legacy `&` codes, and reload live with `/firefly reload`. - ⚡ **Folia-ready & featherweight.** Built for modern high-performance servers and completely idle when nobody is hiding or recoloring. - 🔓 **Free & open source.** GPL-3.0, with signed, build-provenance-attested release jars. ## 🎯 Perfect for - **Survival & SMP servers.** Give players a genuine sense of safety and privacy on a shared map. - **PvP, anarchy & factions.** Stop the locator bar from turning everyone into a tracked target. Travel, raid, and ambush without broadcasting your coordinates to the whole server. - **Roleplay & adventure maps.** Preserve immersion; not every character should be a glowing dot. - **Minigames.** Make **hide-and-seek, manhunt, assassin, and stealth** modes playable again. ## ⌨️ Commands Base command: `/firefly` (alias `/ff`). | Command | Permission | What it does | | --- | --- | --- | | `/firefly hide` | `firefly.use` | Hide your dot from other players' locator bars. | | `/firefly show` | `firefly.use` | Show your dot again. | | `/firefly toggle` | `firefly.use` | Flip your hidden state. | | `/firefly color ` | `firefly.use` | Recolor your dot as others see it. | | `/firefly color reset` | `firefly.use` | Reset your dot to the vanilla color. | | `/firefly bypass ` | `firefly.admin` | See-all: reveal players who are hiding. | | `/firefly showhidden` | `firefly.admin` | List players who currently have their dot hidden. | | `/firefly reload` | `firefly.admin` | Reload `config.yml` and `messages.yml`. | **Colors:** `black`, `dark_blue`, `dark_green`, `dark_aqua`, `dark_red`, `dark_purple`, `gold`, `gray`, `dark_gray`, `blue`, `green`, `aqua`, `red`, `light_purple`, `yellow`, `white`, or any `#RRGGBB` hex value, e.g. `/ff color #FF8800`. ## 🔑 Permissions | Permission | Default | Grants | | --- | --- | --- | | `firefly.use` | everyone | Hide / show / toggle and recolor your own dot. | | `firefly.admin` | ops | Bypass hiding, list hidden players, reload config. | ## 🚀 Quick start 1. Install **[packetevents](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents)** (**2.10.1+** — 2.10.1 or newer) into your `plugins/` folder. It's a **required** dependency (Firefly drives the locator bar through it and won't enable without it). 2. Download **Firefly** and drop the `.jar` into `plugins/`. 3. Restart your server. That's it: Firefly works out of the box with **no configuration required**. ## ⚙️ Configuration Firefly generates `config.yml` and `messages.yml` (plus `playerdata.yml` on the default backend) in `plugins/Firefly/`. **Admin bypass default.** Decide whether admins start with see-all enabled when they join. An admin's explicit `/firefly bypass` choice is persisted and always wins on future logins; if they log in with bypass active, Firefly reminds them. **Storage backends.** Choose where per-player preferences live: - **`yaml`** *(default)*: a flat file, zero setup. - **`h2`**: embedded, file-based SQL database; no external server to run. - **`mysql`**: external server, HikariCP-pooled, so you can **share hide/color preferences across a whole network** of servers. All database I/O runs on a dedicated background thread, switching backends is non-destructive, and if a database can't be reached Firefly automatically falls back to YAML so the plugin keeps working. **Localization.** Every player-facing string is editable and translatable in `messages.yml`. Keys you don't touch fall back to the built-in English defaults, so the file never breaks across updates. ## ✅ Compatibility - **Minecraft 1.21.6 – 1.21.11** and **26.1 – 26.1.2**. The locator bar exists from 1.21.6 onward, including 26.1" - **Paper, Spigot, or Folia.** Folia is **fully supported**. - **Java 21+.** - Requires the **packetevents** plugin, **version 2.10.1 or newer** (2.10.1+). - **Vanilla clients.** No client-side mod or resource pack. ## 🛡️ Performance & safety - **Idle when unused.** The packet hot path short-circuits the instant nobody is hiding or recoloring, so there's effectively zero overhead in the common case. - **Never blocks the server thread.** All storage I/O runs on a dedicated worker thread. - **Folia-safe by design.** Firefly only ever touches player UUIDs, in-memory state, and packets, never region-locked world or entity state. - **Hardened storage.** Parameterized queries only, sanitized H2 file names, and TLS-secured MySQL with environment-variable password indirection. - **Trustworthy builds.** Every release ships a CycloneDX SBOM and a GitHub build-provenance attestation you can verify. ## ❓ FAQ
Do players need to install a mod or resource pack? No. Firefly is entirely server-side. Players connect with a normal vanilla client and everything just works.
Does hiding affect compasses, maps, or anything else? No. Firefly only changes the **locator bar** (the on-screen player-direction dots). Compasses, in-game maps, scoreboards, and tab list are untouched.
Can admins still see players who are hiding? Yes. Admins with `firefly.admin` can turn on **bypass** (`/firefly bypass on`) to reveal hidden players, and use `/firefly showhidden` to list exactly who is currently hidden.
Are a player's hide and color choices saved? Yes. Preferences persist per player and survive relogs and restarts, stored in YAML, H2, or MySQL.
Why does it need packetevents? There is no Bukkit API for per-viewer locator-bar control, so Firefly works by intercepting the server-to-client `WAYPOINT` packet through packetevents. It's a required dependency.
Does it work on Folia? Yes. Folia is fully supported and a first-class target, not an afterthought.
---

Source code & issue tracker: github.com/GooberCraft/Firefly
Found a bug or have a feature request? Open an issue on GitHub. Firefly is open source under GPL-3.0.

title: TimeScheduler
description: Schedules automatic world time changes with configurable difficulty, PvP, sounds, and announcement messages.
body:
# Time Scheduler

**Time Scheduler** is a plugin designed to schedule automatic actions based on the time of day in your server worlds.

With it, you can configure specific events such as **sunrise** and **sunset** to trigger predefined actions automatically. For example, the plugin can play a custom sound when the day starts, play another sound when night begins, enable or disable PvP, and send personalized messages to online players.

The plugin also supports **multiple worlds individually**, allowing each world to have its own configuration, messages, sounds, and event behavior. This makes it useful for servers with different game modes, survival worlds, RPG areas, event maps, or custom world-based rules.

## Features

* Schedule automatic actions for sunrise and sunset
* Play predefined sounds when specific day/night events happen
* Enable or disable PvP automatically
* Send custom messages to players
* Configure each world individually
* Customize messages and sounds per world
* Customize behavior for each event
* Useful for survival, RPG, event, and multi-world servers

## Multi-world support

Each world can have its own independent settings.
You can define different sounds, messages, and PvP behavior depending on the world and the event being triggered.

For example:

* A survival world can disable PvP during the day and enable it at night
* An RPG world can play immersive sounds at sunrise and sunset
* An event world can send special messages when night begins
* Each world can have its own unique atmosphere and rules

## Why use Time Scheduler?

**Time Scheduler** helps server owners automate world-based routines and create a more dynamic experience for players. Instead of manually changing PvP settings, sending messages, or triggering sounds, the plugin handles these actions automatically according to the time cycle of each configured world.

description: SlotBan is a unique survival plugin where players lose inventory slots instead of lives, use Slot Tokens to recover slots, and are automatically banned when no usable slots remain.
body:
# SlotBan

SlotBan is a unique survival plugin that replaces traditional lives with inventory slots.

Instead of losing hearts or lives, players lose access to inventory slots. Locked slots become unusable until they are unlocked with Slot Tokens. As players continue to lose slots, inventory management becomes increasingly difficult and every decision matters.

Once a player reaches **0 available slots**, they are automatically banned from the server.

## Features

- Lock and unlock inventory slots
- Slot Token system
- Withdraw slots into tradable tokens

title: OrangeKits
description: OrangeKits is a Spigot/Paper kit plugin with a drag-to-rearrange GUI, per-kit perms, cooldowns, one-time claims, sounds, kit-on-join/death, force-give, and left-click previews. Everything's configurable in settings.yml and reloads with /kit reload.
body:
# OrangeKits

A kit plugin for Paper, Purpur, and Spigot servers (1.20.x–1.21.x) that gives players a clean GUI to claim pre-made item sets and gives staff a fast way to build, edit, and rearrange those kits without ever leaving the game.

## What it does

Run `/kit` and players see a grid of every kit they can claim. Each tile shows the kit's icon and a quick summary of cooldown, one-time status, and required permission. **Left-click previews** the kit so players can see exactly what they'll get before committing; **right-click claims** it. Kits the player doesn't have access to appear as red tiles with a clear "No permission" note instead of being hidden — so they know what's available to earn or buy.

Behind the scenes, every kit has its own permission node, cooldown, one-time flag, claim sound, icon, and GUI slot. Staff create kits straight from their inventory with `/kit create <name>`, then tweak everything from an in-game Settings GUI — including dragging the kit to a new position in the menu using layout-edit mode.

## Why use it

- **Editable layouts.** Kit positions aren't hardcoded. Staff pick up tiles and drop them wherever in the GUI, and the order persists across restarts.
- **Real auto-give support.** Kit-on-join and kit-on-death are opt-in toggles that fully respect permissions, cooldowns, and one-time flags — and if an auto-give is blocked, the player sees the actual reason (`"Tried to give your on-join kit but it's on cooldown — 87s left."`) instead of silently getting nothing.
- **Admin overrides.** `/kit force` instantly gives a kit bypassing every check; `/kit forceload` queues a kit so the player gets it on their next join with no way to opt out — useful for first-join starter kits or compensation drops.
- **Fully configurable.** Every default, sound, GUI title, cooldown step size, and player-facing message lives in `settings.yml` with color codes and placeholders. `/kit reload` applies edits without a restart.
- **No dependencies.** Drop the JAR in, restart, done.

## At a glance

- Per-kit permissions (`orangekits.kit.<name>`), cooldowns, and one-time claims
- Left-click preview / right-click claim
- Green/red tile coloring by permission
- Settings GUI for icon, cooldown, one-time, sound, position, delete
- Kit-on-join + kit-on-death toggles with contextual failure messages
- `/kit force` (instant) and `/kit forceload` (queued, no opt-out)
- `kits.bypass.cooldown` permission for staff
- YAML-stored kits, players, and settings — easy to back up and edit by hand
