title: SilliestLib
description: A small Library mod for my own projects.
body:
#

SilliestLib is a small library mod made for the Silliest SMP team, reducing re-used code and making some things easier for us :p

##

Project Info

Features
### Misc Features - Double Handed Component - when added to an item and held, it makes the players armPose visually appear like you are holding the item with both hands. - Compat Blocks/Items - these blocks/items function almost identical to their vanilla counterparts, but instead being disabled if a modId isnt loaded into the game. - Custom wall model templates - these function identical to vanilla walls, with the addition of a seperate top texture. ### SilliestLibDataUtils Some simple utils for block model generation ### SilliestLibRegUtils A group of registry methods, made to avoid repetetive code - Blocks - BlockIds - BlockItems - BlockItemIds - Items - ItemIds - Entities - Entity Sub Predicates - Block Entities - EntityTypeIds - Components - Effects - Potions - Potion Recipes - Particles - Sounds - Jukebox Songs - Custom Stats - Recipe Serializers - Villagers - POIs - Keybinds - Armor Materials
How to add SilliestLib to your projects.
## build.gradle We start in your build.gradle, where you add this as your repositories block. ```gradle repositories { exclusiveContent { forRepository { maven { name = "Modrinth" url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven" } } filter { includeGroup "maven.modrinth" } } } ``` Then, in dependencies block, you add this. ```gradle dependencies { // SilliestLib implementation "maven.modrinth:silliestlib:${project.silliestlib_version}" } ``` ## gradle.properties In your gradle.properties, you now need to add the mod version, this changes with every update to the mod, so make sure to change it to update SilliestLib. ```properties silliestlib_version=WbsOyYkv ``` This is technically optional and can replace "${project.silliestlib_version}" in the build.gradle instead of being here, but is cleaner to do here. ## fabric.mod.json To make sure people can debug issues when SilliestLib is missing, remember to add the mod into the dependencies block, due to my versioning scheme not matching the semantic version format, make sure you have to version as "*" or it wont work :p ```json "depends": { "silliestlib": "*" } ``` ## Your ModInitializer Before you can start any modding, in the "onInitialize()" method of your ModInitializer you have to add one simple line. ```java SilliestLib.init(MOD_ID); ``` Alternatively, "MOD_ID" can be replaced with either a string of your modId or a call to where you store your modId.
for more information on how to use the mod, please go to the [wiki](https://github.com/HyperionDash/silliestlib/wiki) ##

Before You Ask

**

Q: Can i use this project in my published modpacks?

**

A: of course, you can do this with any of my projects aslong as the download stays hosted within the modrinth ecosystem :3

title: Pixelmon: CC's Adjustments
description: CC's Adjustments [Pixelmon Sidemod] stops duplicate legendary spawn occurances, trims PokeMarts inventory for balancing, reworks village chest loot, improves raid allies capabilities, and makes breaking Healers & PCs renewable in a fair way.
body:
![Banner for Pixelmon: Adjustments](https://github.com/ccdelic1/PixelmonAdjustments/blob/main/ccAdjustmentsBanner.jpg?raw=true) **Small fixes that make Pixelmon feel better (in my opinion).** *A side-mod for Pixelmon that cleans up a handful of things that I wanted changed. No huge overhaul, just fixes.* ---

### **⭐ So what does it do? 🤔**
This one's a grab bag. Five separate tweaks, each one solving something that annoyed me while playing Pixelmon. None of them are flashy on their own, but together they smooth out a lot of rough edges in my opinion.

Every feature has its own on/off switch in the config, so if you only want two of the five, just turn the rest off. Nothing here forces itself on you.
**Singleplayer** or **server-side**, works either way.
---
### **🌟 No More Legendary Deja Vu 🔁**
You know that feeling when you get a wild legendary spawn and it's Zacian or Zamazenta again like the last twenty times? This stops that.
The mod keeps track of the last few legendaries that actually spawned (3 by default, configurable up to 10) and won't let that same one show up again until it rolls off the list. If a spot only has one legendary that can spawn there anyway, it just lets it through instead of forcing nothing to spawn. It doesn't mess with the rarity odds either, it just rerolls in the background until it lands on something that isn't recent.
---
### **🛒 PokeMart Cleanup 💰**
PokeMarts now sell the standard Poke Ball and Revives, and that's it. All other balls are gone. No more buying Quick Balls, Timer Balls and Great Balls and buying your way past actually playing Minecraft in order to catch things. Grow apricorns and go mining... the RIGHT way to play.
Prices for both are configurable, and it only touches shops that already sell Poke Balls, so daycares and move tutors are left alone.
---
### **📦 Better Chest Loot 🗝️**
Arena and PokeMart chests had loot tables, but they're pretty awful. Another Big Malasada and Friend Ball lid? Great. Not anymore. This swaps them out for a curated tier list instead, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary, each with real weight behind it.
Roll counts and tier odds are all configurable, so you can make chests generous or make them rare finds, whatever fits your world.
---
### **🛡️ Raid Allies That Actually Help ⚔️**
Solo raids hand you AI partners, and sometimes those partners are literally throwing a Maractus at a Heatran just to make sure you don't get to catch it.
This filters that pool before an ally gets picked. No first-stage Pokemon (has to be single-stage, middle, or fully evolved), no allies that are weak to the boss's type, and Base Stat Totals get matched close to yours and the boss's so you're not getting carried by a dead weight partner. If tightening the filters would leave you with zero allies, it backs off instead of breaking the raid.
---
### **🔧 Healer & PC Drops 🔩**
Break a Healer or PC without Silk Touch and instead of an aluminum ingot, you get proper Healer or PC Parts.
**Healer Recipe using Parts + Dropped Item View:**

**PC Recipe using Parts + Dropped Item View:**



Craft it back into the machine whenever you want. Silk Touch still just gives you the block like normal.
---
### **🔨 Config for Everything 🔧**
Every single feature above has its own toggle, plus its own set of numbers to mess with. Anti-repeat count, shop prices, loot weights, raid BST range, all of it lives in `PixelmonAdjustments.toml` and reloads live with your server.
You don't have to touch a thing to get going. Defaults are already set up how I'd want to run it myself.
---
### **😐 So why did I make it? ❓**
- **Legendaries felt cheap when they repeated.** Getting the same one back to back kills the excitement of a legendary spawn, so I fixed that. I'm lying, I literally made this because I hate Zacian and Zamazenta spam spawning every single time. - **Shops were overpowered.** One Relic Crown and you literally have infinite balls. Not anymore. - **Chest loot was just annoying.** I wanted chests that actually felt worth opening but weren't OP or full of litter. - **Raid allies could be actively bad.** Getting handed a partner that just faints instantly isn't fun for anyone. - **None of this needed a huge mod.** These are small annoyances, so I built small, focused fixes instead of some giant rebalance mod nobody asked for.
---
### **🗃️ Versions, Compatibility and Other Nerd Stuff 🛢️**
- Built for **Minecraft: 1.21.1** on **NeoForge**. That's what I run, that's what this is made for. - Requires whatever the current Pixelmon version is for 1.21.1 NeoForge. I'll try to keep this updated as Pixelmon updates, no promises I won't slip up eventually. - Works fine alongside my other Pixelmon side-mods and shouldn't step on anyone else's toes either. - This one's a **server-side** mod through and through. All five features are server logic, nothing here needs to be on the client.
---
### **🪲 Bugs and questions 🙌** Found a bug or something feels off? Open an issue on GitHub and I'll look into it. - **GitHub:** [github.com/ccdelic1](https://github.com/ccdelic1/PixelmonAdjustments) - **My other mods:** [modrinth.com/user/ccdelic](https://modrinth.com/user/ccdelic)
---
### **❤️ Thanks to the Pixelmon team 😁**
None of this works without Pixelmon existing in the first place. The team behind it has put years into building and maintaining something this big and this polished, and I just get to tinker around the edges of it. Genuine thanks to everyone on the [Pixelmon](https://pixelmonmod.com/) dev team for the work they've put in and for still supporting it. Go check out the base mod if you haven't.
---
**Made for the Pixelmon community by CCDelic.**

![The minecraft head of the mod author, CCDelic.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a7b9bc354075663e2f489f6f42afdb2787a3afb.png)

title: Pixelmon: Legends Levelled
description: Legends Levelled [Pixelmon Sidemod] makes every wild Legendary and Ultra Beast the same level as the strongest Pokémon in the nearest player's party, no matter how it spawns.
body:
![Banner showing 'Pixelmon Legends Levelled' and the mod creators minecraft head.](https://github.com/ccdelic1/PixelmonLegendsLevelled/blob/main/legendsLevelledBanner.jpg?raw=true) **Legendaries that actually match your team.** *A side-mod for Pixelmon that levels every wild Legendary and Ultra Beast to match your strongest Pokémon, every time.* ---

### **⭐ So what does it do? 🤔**
You know that feeling when you get a Legendary spawn and it's level 70 while your team is level 12? And how you just get lucky enough to capture it in a Great Ball and now you're just cheesing bosses, mega-pokemon and raids? Yeah, enough of that OP power-levelling nonsense. This mod fixes that.

Every wild Legendary or Ultra Beast that spawns gets set to the level of the strongest Pokémon in the nearest player's party. Doesn't matter how it spawned, natural spawn, spawner block, shrine, altar, whatever. If it's a Legendary or Ultra Beast and it's wild, it matches your team.

No setup, no commands, no configuration needed. Just install it and play.
---
### **🎯 How it decides who to match 🎮**
- **Shrine or altar summon?** It uses whoever triggered it. Makes sense, you rang the bell, you get the fight that matches your team.
- **Natural spawn or spawner block?** It looks for the closest player in that dimension and matches their strongest Pokémon. No distance limit either, so it won't just give up and skip a spawn because a player is far away.
- **Level 100 party?** You're capped at 100 too, obviously. Can't go higher than the game allows.
---
### **🛡️ What it won't touch 🚫**
- **Your own Pokémon.** Anything owned or sitting in a box is left completely alone. This only affects wild spawns.
- **Regular wild Pokémon.** Non-Legendaries and non-Ultra Beasts aren't touched at all. This mod only cares about the big ones.
---
### **🧩 Built to actually catch everything 🔍**
Pixelmon has a bunch of different ways a Legendary can end up in your world, and a lot of them don't go through the same code path. So this mod hooks into two separate spots to make sure nothing slips through. The first one catches spawns before the Pokémon even exists in the world, which covers most of them cleanly. The second one is a backup that catches anything summoned directly, like shrines and altars, and makes sure the level actually shows up on the nameplate too.
You don't need to know any of that to use it. It's just there so a Legendary spawning from a Timespace Altar gets leveled just as reliably as one that spawns naturally in a swamp.
---
### **🔧 Config 🔨**
There's really only one setting, and it's just a debug logging toggle for if something ever looks off and you want to see what the mod is doing under the hood. Everything else runs automatically with no options to mess with.
---
### **😐 So why did I make it? ❓**
- **Legendary's are OP, but rarely fit on a team.** Stumbling onto a level 70 Zacian when your team is level 5 isn't fun, it's either a missed oppurunity or just a rampant power creep. That is annoying. This makes every Legendary encounter actually mean something.
- **It respects your progress.** As your team gets stronger, so does everything wild and legendary around you. The challenge scales with you instead of being stuck wherever the game decided to put it.
---
### **🗃️ Versions, Compatibility and Other Nerd Stuff 🛢️**
- Built for **Minecraft:** 1.21.1 and **NeoForge**. If you're on an older Pixelmon version, the source is open on GitHub, feel free to port it and I'll gladly link it here. - Requires **Pixelmon 9.0** or newer, built and tested on 9.3.16. - This is a **server-side** mod. It needs to run on the server (or your singleplayer world) to do its job. Clients don't need it installed to see the effect. - Plays fine alongside my other Pixelmon side-mods and shouldn't conflict with anything that isn't also touching spawn levels.
---
### **🪲 Bugs and questions 🙌** Found a bug or have an idea for something to add? Open an issue on GitHub and I'll take a look. - **GitHub:** [github.com/ccdelic1](https://github.com/ccdelic1/PixelmonLegendsLevelled) - **My other mods:** [modrinth.com/user/ccdelic](https://modrinth.com/user/ccdelic)
---
### **❤️ Thanks to the Pixelmon team 😁**
None of this works without Pixelmon existing in the first place. The amount of work that's gone into building and maintaining a mod this deep and this stable, for this long, is honestly kind of insane to think about. This is just a small add-on riding on top of everything they built. Huge thanks to the whole [Pixelmon](https://pixelmonmod.com/) dev team for the years of work and for still supporting it today. Go check out the base mod if you haven't.
---
**Made for the Pixelmon community by CCDelic.**
![The minecraft head of the mod author, CCDelic.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a7b9bc354075663e2f489f6f42afdb2787a3afb.png)

# Things pack

A small datapack that adds fun, lightweight extras to your world — starting with a free custom barrel.

## Features

/function things:free_barrel

1. Download the file below.

4. Confirm it's active with `/datapack list enabled`.

Built for the modern data pack format (107), compatible with recent 1.21.x snapshots/releases using the `min_format`/`max_format` pack.mcmeta structure.

This is a simple, low-overhead datapack — it only runs a couple of commands and doesn't add any recurring tick logic, so it has minimal impact on performance.

title: GL-EcoAudit
description: GL-EcoAudit logs all /pay transactions and allows players to view their sent and received payment history with /transactions.
body:
# GL-EcoAudit

**Audit, track, and browse every economy transaction on your Paper 1.21.4 server.**

GL-EcoAudit automatically records all `/pay` transactions between players and provides an intuitive in-game GUI menu system to browse sent and received payment history. Designed for performance and flexibility, it supports multiple database backends, configurable storage limits, automatic purging, and full Vault integration.

---

## Links

- **GitHub:** [https://github.com/GL-Systems/GL-EcoAudit](https://github.com/GL-Systems/GL-EcoAudit)
- **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/kCe9zg3mKB](https://discord.gg/kCe9zg3mKB)
- **Issues & Suggestions:** Use our Discord server or GitHub Issues.

---

## Features

### Automatic Transaction Recording
Every time a player executes `/pay`, the plugin captures the sender, recipient, amount, and exact timestamp, and stores it in the database. Works with online and offline players.

### In-Game GUI Menu
Players can open a graphical menu with `/transactions` to view:
- Their own head with current balance
- A **Money Sent** button → paginated list of all sent transactions (recipient head, amount, date)
- A **Money Received** button → paginated list of all received transactions (sender head, amount, date)
- Navigation buttons: next page, previous page, back, and close

### Multi-Database Support
Choose the storage backend that fits your infrastructure:

| Database | Type |
|----------|------|
| SQLite | Embedded (default) |
| H2 | Embedded (MySQL-compatible mode) |
| MySQL | Remote |
| PostgreSQL | Remote |
| MongoDB | Remote (NoSQL) |

### Configurable Transaction Limits
Control resource usage with:
- **MAX_PER_PLAYER** – Max stored transactions per player (sent and received tracked separately)
- **LIMIT_BEHAVIOR** – What happens when the limit is reached:
  - `DELETE_OLDEST` – Automatically removes the oldest record
  - `STOP_RECORDING` – Silently drops new transactions

### Auto-Purge
Enable automatic cleanup of old records by setting `PURGE_AFTER_DAYS` in `config.yml`. A background task runs every hour and deletes records older than the specified threshold.

### Vault Integration
Works seamlessly with any Vault-compatible economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.). Uses the Vault API to retrieve player balances and format currency amounts.

---

## Commands

| Command | Aliases | Description | Permission |
|---------|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/transactions` | `/trans`, `/tx` | Opens the transaction history GUI | `golden.ecoaudit.transactions` |
| `/ecoaudit reload` | `/ea reload` | Reloads all configuration files (config, language, database, menus) | `golden.ecoaudit.admin` |
| `/ecoaudit purge [days]` | `/ea purge [days]` | Purges transaction records older than the specified number of days (default: 90) | `golden.ecoaudit.admin` |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `golden.ecoaudit.transactions` | Allows the player to use `/transactions` and view their own transaction history | OP |
| `golden.ecoaudit.admin` | Allows the player to use `/ecoaudit` with reload and purge subcommands | OP |

---

## How to Use

### For Players
1. Type `/transactions` (or `/trans` or `/tx`) in chat.
2. The menu opens showing your head, your balance, and two buttons: **Money Sent** and **Money Received**.
3. Click a button to browse the corresponding transaction list.
4. Use the arrow buttons to navigate between pages.
5. Click the **Back** button to return to the main menu or **Close** to exit.

### For Administrators
- Use `/ecoaudit reload` after editing any configuration file to apply changes without restarting the server.
- Use `/ecoaudit purge 30` to manually delete all records older than 30 days.
- Configure auto-purge in `config.yml` using `PURGE_AFTER_DAYS`.

---

## Configuration

### `config.yml` – Main Configuration
```yaml
SERVER_NAME: "Survival"              # Server identifier stored in every transaction record

TRANSACTIONS:
  MAX_ENTRIES_PER_PAGE: 45           # Number of transactions shown per menu page
  MAX_PER_PLAYER: 100                # Maximum stored transactions per player (sent + received)
  LIMIT_BEHAVIOR: DELETE_OLDEST      # DELETE_OLDEST or STOP_RECORDING
  PURGE_AFTER_DAYS: 0                # Auto-purge after N days (0 = disabled)

FORMATTING:
  DATE_FORMAT: "dd/MM/yyyy hh:mm:ss a"   # Date/time format (SimpleDateFormat)
  ECONOMY_FORMAT: "#,##0.00"             # Economy amount format (DecimalFormat)
```

### `database.yml` – Database Configuration
```yaml
TYPE: "SQLITE" # SQLITE | H2 | MYSQL | POSTGRESQL | MONGO

INIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: 10

SETTINGS:
  SQLITE:
    FILE_NAME: "GL-EcoAudit"
  H2:
    FILE_NAME: "GL-EcoAudit"
  MONGO:
    AUTH_TYPE: "URI"
    URI: ""
    IP_ADDRESS: ""
    PORT: 27017
    DATABASE: "GL-EcoAudit"
    AUTH:
      USERNAME: ""
      PASSWORD: ""
  MYSQL:
    IP_ADDRESS: ""
    PORT: 3306
    DATABASE: "GL-EcoAudit"
    AUTH:
      USERNAME: ""
      PASSWORD: ""
  POSTGRESQL:
    IP_ADDRESS: ""
    PORT: 5432
    DATABASE: "GL-EcoAudit"
    AUTH:
      USERNAME: ""
      PASSWORD: ""

```

### `language.yml` – Messages
All user-facing messages are fully customizable with hex color code support (`&#rrggbb`). You can edit every command response, error message, and notification the plugin sends to players.

### `menus/` – Menu Layouts (one file per menu)
Each menu has its own YAML file inside the `menus/` folder:

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `transactions-menu.yml` | Main menu layout (player head, sent/received buttons, border) |
| `transactions-sent.yml` | Sent transactions paginated list (entry name, lore, nav buttons) |
| `transactions-received.yml` | Received transactions paginated list (entry name, lore, nav buttons) |

For each menu you can customize:
- **TITLE** – Inventory title
- **Slot positions** – Where each button appears
- **Material** – Item type for each button
- **Name and Lore** – Display name and description with placeholders (`{player}`, `{balance}`, `{target}`, `{amount}`, `{date}`)
- **Glow effect** – Enchantment glint on/off

---

## Installation

1. Download the plugin
2. Place the JAR in your server `plugins/` folder.
3. Ensure **Vault** is installed along with an economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.).
4. Restart your server or run `/reload confirm`.
5. The plugin will generate `config.yml`, `database.yml`, `language.yml`, and the `menus/` folder automatically.
6. Edit the configuration files to suit your server and run `/ecoaudit reload` to apply changes.

---

## Support

If you encounter bugs, have feature suggestions, or need help with configuration, join our Discord server:

[**https://discord.gg/kCe9zg3mKB**](https://discord.gg/kCe9zg3mKB)

---

*Developed by GL-Studio.*

# Alt Cursor Mod

Holding **Alt** brings up the mouse cursor without pausing or
interrupting gameplay.

## Features
- Hold Alt to show the cursor while the game keeps running normally.
- Release Alt to return to normal camera control.
- Won't trigger while other screens (inventory, chat, etc.) are open, to avoid conflicts.

## Why use this?
Vanilla Minecraft only shows the cursor when a GUI is open, which also
pauses camera movement. This mod lets you point at or inspect the screen
(for screenshots, spectating, checking UI, etc.) without interrupting gameplay.

## Dependencies
- **Fabric Loader** 0.19.3+
- **Fabric API** (required)
- Minecraft **1.21.4**

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader from fabricmc.net
2. Download Fabric API and place it in your `mods` folder
3. Place this mod's jar file in `.minecraft/mods`
4. Launch the game and press Alt to test

title: Saddle me Naturalist
description: this mod is an addon for nautralist that adds saddles to, boar, deer, lion, giraffe, hippo, rhino, and elephants.
body:
# Saddle Me: Naturalist

Ever chased a Naturalist deer through the forest and thought *"I should be riding that"*? Now you can. **Saddle Up: Naturalist** turns the wildlife from [Naturalist](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist) into proper mounts - each tamed its own way, each with its own riding feel.

## The Stable

| Animal | How to tame | How it rides |
|---|---|---|
| **Deer** | Sneak up feed it an apple and saddle it - the saddler becomes its owner | Fast and nimble, with a charged **leap** on the jump key |
| **Boar** | No taming - just saddle it | Pig-style: steer with a **carrot on a stick**, right-click to boost |
| **Lion** | Raw meat or fish (they're big cats - cod and salmon work) | Fast, with a powerful pounce |
| **Hippo** | **Melon slices** | Swims with you aboard - but only ferries you through shallower water |
| **Rhino** | **Wheat** | Camel-style, with a devastating **charge dash** |
| **Elephant** | **Hay blocks** (or wheat, if you're patient) | Slow, mighty, steps up 1.5 blocks - and hauls **two chests** (30 slots, visibly strapped to its flanks) |

## Lion Prides

Tame the **maned pride leader** and the whole pride half-tames with it: they'll let players ride along, they'll never hurt your owner, and they still follow their leader. Fully tame a follower and it leaves the pride to be yours alone. Keep a leader and three tamed followers near your bed, and the pride **hunts while you sleep** - wake up every ~3-4 days to a gift of meat... or occasionally a bone or a toy. If the leader dies without a tamed heir, the pride abandons you.

## How it works

- **Visible saddles** on every mount, painted onto the animated models
- **Horse-style inventory** - press your inventory key while riding (or sneak + right-click): saddle slot, elephant cargo, the works
- **Owners are sacred** - tamed animals never attack whoever tamed them, but keep their natural tempers with everyone else. Elephants still defend their calves; boars still hold grudges
- **Wild stays wild** - untamed animals keep 100% of their natural behavior. Deer still bolt (sneak up on them), hippos still hate swimmers, rhinos still charge
- Jump-bar **leaps** for deer and lions, camel-style **dashes** for the heavyweights
- Saddles drop on death; shears remove saddles and chests; tamed animals never despawn
- No mining slowdown while mounted

## Compatibility

- Requires **Fabric API** and **Naturalist 5.0pre3** (Fabric, 1.20.1) - GeckoLib comes along with Naturalist
- **[Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)** (optional): look at any mount to see its owner, speed, and jump height - same format as horses
- Plays nice with **HorseBuff**, lassos, and pick-up mods (zebras aren't touched - base Naturalist already makes them rideable horses)
- Install on **both client and server** - No new items or world gen - safe to add to existing worlds

---

title: Server Auctions
description: A lightweight Fabric economy mod featuring a global auction house GUI and physical, interactive shop stands styled with red carpets.
body:
# Server Auctions

A lightweight economy and trading mod for Fabric 1.21.4. Combine a global virtual auction house with physical, interactive player shop stands!

## Features at a Glance

*   **Global Auction House (`/auction`):** List and buy items from anywhere using an intuitive chest GUI. Filter by "My Listings" to easily manage your auctions.
*   **Auction Blocks (Bazaar Stands):** Placeable scaffolding stands with a red carpet. Players can walk through them (with a slight slowness effect) and climb them like ladders.
*   **Interactive Shops:** Place items in your block and set custom prices. Other players can hover to see the seller/price and click to buy instantly.
*   **Grief Protection:** Only the owner who placed the Auction Block (or an OP) can break it.
*   **Live Chat Feedback:** Sellers receive instant chat notifications showing who bought their items and how much they paid.
*   **Financial Stats (`/balance stats`):** Track detailed statistics showing exactly how you earned (sell, auction, block) and spent your money.
*   **Server Economy:** Precise balances down to the cent, direct player payments (`/balance pay`), and instant server selling (`/sell`).

## Commands

*   `/auction` — Open the global marketplace.
*   `/balance` — Check your pocket money.
*   `/balance stats` — View your earning and spending history.
*   `/balance pay <player> <amount>` — Send money to another player.
*   `/sell` — Instantly sell the item in your hand to the server.
*   `/balance <add/remove> <player> <amount>` — *(OP Only)* Edit player balances.

## Crafting

Craft the Auction Block using:
*   **2x Gold Ingots** (top left and top right slots)
*   **4x Wood Planks** (forming a U-shape in the middle and bottom rows)

title: Ars Dragongate
description: Locks Ars Nouveau (and its addons) content behind defeating the Ender Dragon.
body:
**Magic is sealed until the Ender Dragon falls.** Ars Dragongate locks Ars Nouveau and its addons behind killing the Ender Dragon - no spells, crafting, machines or recipes until the Dragon's Seal breaks. Built for tech-first and progression packs that want magic as a late-game reward.

_Ars Nouveau · works with all addons · supports JEI and EMI_

***

## While the dragon lives

*   **Recipes don't work** - crafting tables, furnaces and Ars machines find no recipe; gated items are genuinely uncraftable.
*   **Spells are cancelled**, with an on-screen message.
*   **Machines and items lie dormant** - GUIs won't open, baubles/tools/foci can't be used. Placing gated blocks stays allowed, so you can pre-build your setup.
*   **Hidden from JEI and EMI** - gated items and recipes disappear (search + show-recipe **R** / uses **U**) and return the instant the dragon dies.
*   **Lore tooltips** - sealed items show `✦ Sealed` (hold **Shift** for details).

When the dragon dies, every player gets an announcement and a sound as magic floods into the world.

***

## How it works

A single world-global flag flips when the Ender Dragon dies and syncs to all clients - one kill unlocks magic for the whole server, it's multiplayer-safe, and it fails open so it can never brick a world.

Worldgen isn't gated: Ars structures and Archwood trees still generate, but stay inert until the seal breaks.

***

## Config - `config/ars_dragongate-common.toml`

```toml
[gating]
	gateRecipes = true       # block crafting / processing
	gateSpells = true        # block spell casting
	gateInteractions = true  # block GUIs + item use (placing blocks still allowed)
	gatedNamespaces = ["ars_nouveau", "ars_elemental", "ars_additions", "ars_caelum", "ars_controle", "ars_technica", "starbunclemania", "arseng"]
```

The gate works purely by mod id - change `gatedNamespaces` to lock any other magic mod instead.

title: Apotheosis Bags
description: Bags containing randomly dropped gems appear. These bags have a chance to drop in chests.
body:
**Gem lootbox pouches for Apotheosis.** Right-click a pouch to get a random Apotheosis gem from its rarity tier. Four tiers plus configurable chest generation.

_Requires **Apotheosis**. The Artifact tier uses **Apotheotic Additions**._

![Подставьте сюда описание](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f742f3f4d2a149f0c2d34c174bf529e633521b54.png)

***

## The four tiers

Each pouch rolls a rarity from its own weighted table, then a random gem from the Apotheosis registry that supports it. Gems are read at open time, so anything added by Apotheosis or its addons is eligible.

| Pouch | Possible rarities (weight) |
| --- | --- |
| **Common Gem Pouch** | Common (70), Uncommon (30) |
| **Rare Gem Pouch** | Rare (65), Epic (35) |
| **Legendary Gem Pouch** | Mythic (60), Ancient (40) |
| **Artifact Gem Pouch** | Artifact (55), Heirloom (35), Esoteric (10) |

Weights are relative: a rarity's odds = its weight / the sum of the pouch's weights.

***

## Chest generation

Pouches can be injected into any chest loot table (vanilla and modded), with a chance and per-tier weights set in the config. No pouches generate if Apotheosis is missing.

**Artifact safety rule:** without **Apotheotic Additions**, the Artifact tier is excluded from generation, so players never find a pouch in a chest they can't open.

***

## Config: `config/apotheosis_bags-common.toml`

```toml
["Loot"]
    # If gem bags should be added to chests.
    do_loot_generation = true
    # Chance a bag appears in a chest (0.1 = 10%, 1.0 = always).
    loot_chance = 0.1

["Bag Weights"]
    # Which tier a bag is, once one spawns. Odds = weight / sum of weights.
    # With defaults the sum is 100 -> reads as percentages. Weight 0 disables a tier.
    weight_common = 60
    weight_rare = 25
    weight_legendary = 12
    # Artifact only works with Apotheotic Additions; without it the others are divided by 97.
    weight_artifact = 3
```

With the defaults a chest yields a pouch 10% of the time: common 6%, rare 2.5%, legendary 1.2%, artifact 0.3%. For comparison, Apotheosis itself drops a raw gem in ~25% of vanilla chests.

title: Asmyetric Co-op
description: Asymetric Co-op is a Minecraft Fabric (1.21.1) multiplayer mod designed to fundamentally change how players interact and survive together. By dividing core Minecraft mechanics among four distinct classes, the mod forces players to cooperate
body:
## ❗ Asymetric Co-op ❗
![Asmyetric Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/320f1f0d600707da80a4b6e7a12a1e1ddeb7db09_0.webp)

 Asymetric Co-op is a Minecraft Fabric multiplayer mod designed to fundamentally change how players interact and survive together. By dividing core Minecraft mechanics among four distinct classes, the mod forces players to cooperate, trade, and protect each other. No single player can survive alone; true progression is only possible through teamwork.

## 💎 Custom Items & Recipes
Class Reset Token
Made a mistake or want to switch roles with a friend? The Class Reset Token allows you to clear your current class and pick a new one.

Center: 1x Diamond
Corners: 4x Emeralds
Edges (Top, Bottom, Left, Right): 4x Gold Ingots
(Note: Add screenshot of the crafting table grid above)

![Crafting Recipe for changing your class](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10b49033c40d5655509ed345de4866c2fc178c69.png)

## **🌟 Core Mechanics:**
Class Interdependency: Essential survival mechanics (mining ores, farming, crafting, and combat) are strictly locked behind specific classes.

Basic Survival: Everyone can break basic building blocks (wood, dirt, stone, deepslate, obsidian) to build shelters, but specialized blocks and tools are restricted.

Dynamic Guide Books: Upon selecting a class, players automatically receive a specialized Guide Book explaining their role, abilities, and strict penalties.

Team System: Players are automatically assigned to colored teams based on their chosen class, making it easy to identify roles.

## 🎭 The Classes:

### ⛏️ The Miner
The backbone of resource gathering, the Miner is the only one who can delve deep and extract precious ores. However, they are completely defenseless against the horrors of the dark.

[ABILITY] Permanent Haste I: Mines blocks significantly faster than other classes.

[ABILITY] Exclusive Ore Mining: The only class capable of breaking ore blocks (Coal, Iron, Diamonds, Gold, Lapis, Redstone, Emeralds, Copper).

[ABILITY] End Portal Attunement: The only class that can place Eyes of Ender into End Portal Frames.

[PENALTY] Pacifist: Cannot deal physical damage to monsters (deals 0 damage, only applies knockback).

[PENALTY] Herbivore: Cannot digest meat. Eating any meat-based food causes severe food poisoning (Hunger, Nausea, Poison).

### 🌾 The Farmer
The provider of food, potions, and ranged support. The Farmer stays nimble and controls the battlefield from afar.

[ABILITY] Permanent Speed I: Moves faster than other classes.

[ABILITY] Featherweight: Completely immune to fall damage.

[ABILITY] Exclusive Farming: The only class capable of using Hoes and planting crops/seeds.

[ABILITY] Exclusive Ranged Combat: The only class that can shoot Bows and Crossbows.

[ABILITY] Exclusive Alchemy: The only class that can operate Brewing Stands.

[PENALTY] Armor Allergy: Wearing any armor heavier than Leather (Chainmail, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite) inflicts extreme Slowness.

### ⚔️ The Warrior
The shield of the group. The Warrior exists to slay monsters and protect the defenseless Miner in the dark caverns.

[ABILITY] Permanent Strength I: Deals significantly more melee damage.

[ABILITY] Permanent Health Boost: Spawns with +4 extra hearts (28 HP total).

[PENALTY] Heavy Hands: Strictly forbidden from using any ranged weapons (Bows/Crossbows).

[PENALTY] Carnivore: Cannot digest plant-based foods. Eating crops (bread, carrots, apples, potatoes) makes them sick.

### ⚒️ The Blacksmith
The master of the forge. The Blacksmith is the technological engine of the team, responsible for all advanced gear and progression.

[ABILITY] Exclusive Crafting: The only class capable of opening and using Crafting Tables and Anvils.

[ABILITY] Exclusive Fire Manipulation: The only class capable of using Flint & Steel and Fire Charges, making them the only ones who can ignite Nether Portals.

[PENALTY] Claustrophobia: Severely afraid of the deep underground. Going below Y=40 in the Overworld induces a panic attack, inflicting Permanent Blindness, Darkness, and Slowness until they return to the surface.

## Class Guide Books
Each player receives a beautifully animated, lore-friendly guidebook upon selecting their class. These books outline your exact abilities and limitations. (If you happen to lose it, server admins can grant them via the Creative Menu or commands).

## 📥 Installation & Setup
Download and install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.1.
Download the Fabric API and drop it into your mods folder.
Drop the Asymetric Co-op .jar file into your mods folder.
Launch the game! (This mod is required on both the Client and the Server).


## ❓ FAQ
Can this be played in Singleplayer? Technically yes, but you won't be able to beat the game! If you pick the Warrior, you can't craft. If you pick the Blacksmith, you can't mine ores. This mod is strictly designed for multiplayer servers with at least 3-4 players.

Is there a Forge/NeoForge version? Currently, this mod is exclusively developed for Fabric 1.21.1.

title: Empty Hand Keybind - Hold Onto THIS
description: A quality-of-life mod that adds a configurable hotkey to instantly empty your hand stashing your held item into your inventory and free up your hand, then press again to grab it right back.
body:
Ever tried to interact with a machine in a modpack, only to have it not work because your hand is full? Or wanted to grab a single item but couldn't, because every hotbar slot is already taken?

Empty Hand Keybind fixes both with a single key.

Press the keybind (default: \` / grave accent (fully rebindable in Options → Controls)) and the item in your selected hotbar slot is instantly swept into the rest of your inventory, leaving your hand empty. Press it again and that same item is pulled right back into the slot it came from.

Shift + the keybind locks the currently empty hotbar slot: it stays empty even when you pick items up off the ground, so it's always ready as your "empty hand" slot. Only one slot can be locked at a time, and manually placing an item into it breaks the lock. The locked slot gets a subtle red tint so you can always see which one it is, and an action-bar message confirms when you lock/unlock it.

## Why I made this

*   Right-clicking machines with a full hotbar. Tons of modpack blocks only respond to an empty hand, but your hotbar is always packed. Instead of shuffling items into your inventory by hand, just  
    tap the key, click the machine, and tap again to get your item back.
*   Picking things up when your hotbar is full. Want to grab a dropped item or pull something out of a container, but there's no free slot in your hand? Empty it with one keypress, there is no need to  
    open your inventory and rearrange everytime.

## How it works

*   Sweeps the held stack into matching stacks first, then any free slot (hotbar before main inventory).
*   The second press reclaims the exact item and returns it to its original slot.
*   Should your whole inventory be full, it drops the item, with a slightly longer pickup delay than normal.
*   Shift + tap locks the selected slot empty so it survives ground pickups; shift + tap again (or placing an item in it) unlocks it.
*   A quick tap toggles as usual; holding the key down (e.g. for FTB Ultimine, if bound to the same key) does not trigger the toggle.

## Requirements

None - other than the NeoForge Modloader

title: Create Safe Seating
description: Sit on a Create seat to go AFK safely: mobs ignore you, you slowly heal and refill hunger, and phantoms and lightning leave you alone.
body:
**Sit on a Create seat to go AFK safely: mobs ignore you, you slowly heal and refill hunger, and phantoms and lightning leave you alone.**

![Ideal setup](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1750/536/screenshot-png.png)

## At a glance

*   Hostile mobs stop noticing you once you've settled into a seat.
*   Slowly regain health and hunger while you rest. A campfire or cake speeds it up.
*   No phantoms spawn while you're seated.
*   Lightning leaves occupied seats alone.
*   Go AFK and the HUD hides, the camera pulls back, and your hunger stops draining.
*   Works on every Create seat. Server owners can tune or switch off each part.

## Why I made this

You hop on a seat to wait out a build, alt-tab for two minutes, and come back to a creeper crater where you used to be. Seats are where you idle, so they should be the one place the night can't get you.

## Setup

1.  Place any **Create seat**.
2.  Right-click it to **sit down**.
3.  Wait about **10 seconds** for the resting perks to kick in.
4.  Stay still for a minute to drop into **AFK** mode.

## How it works

*   **Mob safety** kicks in after the same ~10 second settle-in as resting. Once it's active, hostile mobs won't pick a seated player as a new target. It won't shake a mob that's already chasing you, so sit down in peace.
*   After roughly **10 seconds**, you slowly regain **health** and **hunger**. Sit by a lit **campfire** and you heal faster, sit by a **cake** and you fill up faster. The cake is never eaten.
*   **Phantoms** won't spawn over a seated player, and a seated player shrugs off **lightning**.
*   The resting perks need a **stationary** seat. The safety perks still cover you on a moving **contraption**, so a train ride keeps the mobs and storms off your back.
*   Take damage and the rest timer resets, so you can't heal your way through a fight. Standing up ends it too.
*   **AFK** mode triggers after about a minute of no input: the **HUD** hides, the view turns **third-person**, and hunger stops draining. Any key, click, or look snaps everything back.

Nothing here is rebalanced for anyone else, and every timer and feature lives in the config.

## Dev note

*   Mob safety only blocks new targeting, it never wipes a mob's current target. That keeps a seat a calm spot to settle into rather than a panic button you slam mid-chase. Sit down before things go wrong, not after.
*   Works with contraptions and stable sublevels.

## Requirements

*   **Create**: required, this is an add-on.
*   **NeoForge 21.1.233** or newer, for **Minecraft 1.21.1**.

## Modpacks

Feel free to use my mods in your modpack, just don't forget to give proper credit.

title: Safe Survival
description: A configurable plugin that blocks unsafe commands to ensure fair survival gameplay with friends.
body:
# 🛡️ Safe Survival

**Safe Survival** is a lightweight Paper plugin designed for private survival servers and groups of friends who want to ensure that nobody cheats.

The plugin blocks a configurable list of vanilla commands that could be used to gain unfair advantages, while still allowing useful plugin commands such as `/home`, `/spawn`, `/warp`, etc.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🚫 Blocks configurable vanilla commands
* ⚙️ Fully configurable through `config.yml`
* 👑 Works even if players have OP permissions
* 📢 Broadcasts attempted uses of blocked commands
* 🔒 Supports namespaced commands (`minecraft:`, `bukkit:`, `paper:`, etc.)
* ⚡ Lightweight and optimized for Paper servers

---

## 📋 Example blocked commands

Safe Survival can block commands such as:

* `/gamemode`
* `/give`
* `/gamerule`
* `/effect`
* `/enchant`
* `/summon`
* `/tp`
* `/teleport`
* `/time`
* `/weather`
* `/fill`
* `/setblock`
* `/execute`
* `/reload`
* `/debug`
* `/seed`

And many more.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

All blocked commands can be enabled or disabled individually in `config.yml`.

Example:

```yaml
commands:
  gamemode: true
  give: true
  gamerule: true
  tp: false
  teleport: false
```

* `true` = command is blocked
* `false` = command is allowed

---

## 📢 Attempt Detection

When a player attempts to execute a blocked command, the command is cancelled and a message is broadcast to all online players:

```text
[!] yopytuuh tried this: /gamemode creative
```

This allows everyone on the server to know when someone attempted to use a forbidden command.

---

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download the latest release.
2. Place the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start your server.
4. Edit the generated `config.yml` file if needed.
5. Restart or reload the server.

---

## 📦 Compatibility

- Spigot 1.8+
- Paper 1.8+ (recommended 1.20+ / 1.21+)
- Java 21+

*Tested on Paper 26.1.2*

---

## 📄 License

This project is released under the MIT License.

**CombatUtils** is a lightweight utility mod for Minecraft Forge 1.7.10 focused on fair PvP and server administration. It combines reliable combat logging protection with optional detection of repeated F3+A chunk reload abuse, helping server owners reduce common forms of unfair play without requiring invasive client modifications.

### Features

**Combat Logging Protection**

*   Tracks players while they are actively engaged in PvP.
*   Detects players who disconnect during combat.
*   Persists combat-log data across server restarts.
*   Configurable punishment when combat-logged players rejoin.
*   Reliable JSON-based persistence.

**F3+A Abuse Detection**

*   Combat log punishment

title: RelayLine
description: Relay chat across Velocity servers while keeping each backend server’s local chat formatting untouched.
body:
# RelayLine

**RelayLine** is a lightweight Velocity plugin for Minecraft networks that want clean cross-server chat without replacing, flattening, or interfering with each backend server's local chat formatting.

It is designed for networks where each server has its own identity, ranks, prefixes, colours, and chat style. Your Survival server can keep its Survival formatting, your Prison server can keep prison ranks and prestige formatting, and your Lobby can keep its own chat style. RelayLine simply relays a clean copy of global chat messages to players on other backend servers.

The player’s current server still sees the normal local chat message from that server’s own chat plugin.

---

## Example Remote Message

```text
[Survival] Zenova > hello
[Prison] BobJunior > Oh hey!
[Lobby] Noob123 > how do I join a server
```

A player on another backend server would see the relayed message, while players on the sender’s current backend server continue to see the normal local chat output from that server.

---

## Features

* Velocity-only proxy plugin
* Keeps backend server chat formatting untouched
* Relays chat to other backend servers only
* `/global` and `/local` player chat modes
* MiniMessage support for relay messages, server aliases, and notices
* Server switch notices
* Lobby-only join notices
* Leave notices from any backend server
* Player toggle for switch, join, and leave notices with `/servernotices`
* Console logging for relayed chat and notices
* Reload command with `/relayline reload`
* Simple permission support for toggle and reload commands
* No required dependencies

---

## Why Use RelayLine?

Many cross-server chat plugins try to fully control chat across the entire network. That can be useful, but it can also cause problems if your backend servers already have their own chat plugins, rank prefixes, suffixes, prestige tags, or custom formatting.

RelayLine takes a lighter approach.

It lets each backend server keep its own local chat exactly as it is, while still allowing players to speak globally across the network when they choose to use global mode.

This makes it ideal for Minecraft networks with different game modes.

---

## Example Format

RelayLine uses MiniMessage for relay formatting.

```properties
format=<gray>[</gray>%server_name%<gray>]</gray> <aqua>%player%</aqua> <gray>></gray> <white>%message%</white>

server-alias.lobby=<aqua>Lobby</aqua>
server-alias.survival=<green>Survival</green>
server-alias.prison=<red>Prison</red>
```

Available relay placeholders:

```text
%server_name%
%server%
%player%
%message%
```

Player names and messages are inserted as plain text, so players cannot inject MiniMessage tags into relayed chat.

---

## Server Notices

RelayLine can show small network notices when players move between backend servers, join through the lobby, or leave from any server.

```properties
server-switch-notices-enabled=true
default-see-server-switch-notices=true
server-switch-format=<dark_gray>(<gold>*</gold><dark_gray>) <gray>%player% <dark_gray>(<gold>%old_server%->%new_server%<dark_gray>)

join-leave-notices-enabled=true
join-notice-server=lobby
leave-notice-server=*
join-notice-format=<dark_gray>(<green>+</green><dark_gray>) <gray>%player%</gray>
leave-notice-format=<dark_gray>(<red>-</red><dark_gray>) <gray>%player%</gray>
```

Players can use `/servernotices` to toggle whether they see server switch, join, and leave notices.

---

## Installation

1. Download the RelayLine jar.
2. Put the jar in your Velocity proxy’s `plugins` folder.
3. Restart Velocity.
4. Edit the generated config file:

```text
plugins/relayline/config.properties
```

5. Make sure your server aliases match the server names in your `velocity.toml`.
6. Run `/relayline reload` after making config changes, or restart Velocity.

> RelayLine should only be installed on your Velocity proxy.
> Do not install it on backend Paper, Spigot, Purpur, or Folia servers.

---

## Upgrading From LocalGlobalChat

If you are upgrading from the pre-release **LocalGlobalChat** build, remove the old `LocalGlobalChat-*.jar` file first.

RelayLine will copy missing data files from:

```text
plugins/localglobalchat
```

into:

```text
plugins/relayline
```

on first startup.

---

## Commands

| Command                   | Description                                    |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `/global`                 | Enables cross-server relay for your messages   |
| `/local`                  | Keeps your messages on the current server only |
| `/servernotices`          | Toggles switch, join, and leave notices        |
| `/switchalerts`           | Alias for `/servernotices`                     |
| `/serveralerts`           | Alias for `/servernotices`                     |
| `/relayline reload`       | Reloads the config                             |
| `/rl reload`              | Alias for `/relayline reload`                  |
| `/localglobalchat reload` | Legacy alias for `/relayline reload`           |
| `/lgc reload`             | Legacy alias for `/relayline reload`           |

---

## Permissions

| Permission         | Description                                                                         |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `relayline.toggle` | Allows players to use RelayLine toggle commands when permission checking is enabled |
| `relayline.reload` | Allows access to the reload command                                                 |

`relayline.toggle` is only required if this is enabled in the config:

```properties
require-permission=true
```

If you use LuckPerms, set these permissions on your Velocity or proxy LuckPerms instance:

```text
/lp group default permission set relayline.toggle true
/lp group admin permission set relayline.reload true
```

---

## Important Notes

RelayLine respects chat messages that Velocity has already marked as cancelled or denied.

If your mute system only runs on a backend server and does not cancel the Velocity chat event, you should use a proxy-side mute setup or carefully test your mute plugin before relying on global relay.

RelayLine is not a Discord bridge. It works nicely alongside DiscordSRV or similar plugins, but Discord linking should be handled separately.

---

This is a Minecraft plugin for Spigot/Paper which allows server administrators to warn players when they join with deprecated or soon unsupported client versions.

**New in Version 1.0.0:**
- Join warnings for deprecated Minecraft client versions
- Fully configurable warning rules in `config.yml`
- Supports protocol-based matching for old and newer versions
- Custom warning messages with placeholders and color codes
- Optional admin notifications when deprecated clients join
- Console logging for detected deprecated client versions
- Self-toggle for players with permission using `/vw toggle`
- Reload command for config changes without restarting the server
- Debug mode for troubleshooting protocol detection
- Supports Minecraft versions from 1.17 up to 26.2

**Commands:**
- /versionwarning reload - Reload the plugin configuration
- /versionwarning check <player> - Check a player's detected client version
- /versionwarning list - Show all configured deprecation rules
- /versionwarning toggle - Toggle your own warnings on or off

**Permissions:**
- versionwarning.admin - Access to admin commands
- versionwarning.bypass - Allows toggling your own warnings with /vw toggle
- versionwarning.notify - Receive admin notifications for deprecated joins

**Important when updating:**
If you update from an older build, replace the old jar and review your `config.yml` settings. If needed, delete the existing config to regenerate the latest default values.

title: Totes
description: Storage mod for Minecraft 26.1+
body:
## **<center>Totes!</center>**


Tired of cluttered chests and overflowing inventories? Totes introduces a comprehensive, scalable, and intelligent storage system designed to streamline your Minecraft experience. From massive item capacities to wireless management and advanced automation, Totes offers a modern solution for all your storage needs.


## **<center>Key Features</center>**

## Totes:

◦ Massive Capacity: Each Tote starts with a base capacity of 2048 items.

◦ Tiered Upgrades: Enhance your Totes with Copper (2x), Iron (4x), Gold (6x), Diamond (8x), and Netherite (10x) upgrades. Stack up to 4 upgrades for truly colossal storage!

◦ Void Upgrade: Never worry about overflow again! Apply a Void Upgrade to automatically void any excess items when the Tote reaches its maximum capacity.

◦ Lockable: Lock a Tote to a specific item type, ensuring only that item can be stored.

◦ Visual Clarity: See at a glance what's inside, whether it's locked, the quantity, and what upgrades are within!

◦ Portable Inventory: Break and pick up Totes without losing a single item, upgrade, or lock status. They retain all their data, making relocation a breeze.

◦ Automation Ready: Easily pipe items in and out using your favorite logistics mods like Pipez or Mekanism.

## Tote Controller:

◦ Centralized Management: Link multiple Totes to a single Controller, creating a unified storage network.

◦ Intelligent Routing: Input items into the Controller, and it will automatically distribute them, prioritizing Totes that already contain the item, then filling empty Totes.

◦ Wireless Access: Connect your entire Tote network to your automation systems through a single block.

## Tote Linker:

◦ Intuitive Linking: Use the Tote Linker to easily connect Totes to your Controller. Right-click a Controller to set it as the target, then right-click Totes to link them.

◦ Mode Switching: Cycle between "ADD" and "REMOVE" modes by right-clicking the air.

◦ Clear Target: Shift-right-click the air to clear your active Controller target.

◦ X-Ray Vision: Holding the Linker provides an X-Ray highlight, displaying your Totes (Green) and Tote Controller (Blue):

## Plastic:

◦ Crafting material, essential for crafting items in this mod.

◦ Crafted by smelting Dried Kelp in a furnace or blast furnace.



## **<center>Beta</center>**

This is mod is currently in Beta. If there are bugs, or you have suggestions to implement, please leave a comment or submit an issue. I am not an artist, so some items do not look great at the moment. If you would like to contribute any art, please reach out and you will be credited.

title: Always-On Redstone Lamps
description: A tiny texture swap that makes every redstone lamp look lit all the time, no redstone required.
body:
## What it does

This is a pure texture swap — nothing more. It replaces the "unpowered" 
redstone lamp texture with a glowing, always-lit look, so every redstone 
lamp in your world **appears turned on 24/7**, even with zero redstone 
signal. No wiring, no redstone torches, no daylight sensors needed just 
to keep your lamps looking lit.

## Features

- 🔶 Redstone lamps always look powered/lit
- 🪶 Single-texture edit — lightweight, no performance impact
- 🧱 Works with any build, any world, survival or creative

## Installation

1. Download the `.zip` file — **do not unzip it**.
2. Drop it into your resource packs folder:
   - **Windows:** `%appdata%\.minecraft\resourcepacks`
   - **macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/resourcepacks`
   - **Linux:** `~/.minecraft/resourcepacks`
3. In-game: **Options > Resource Packs**, move it to Selected, click Done.

## Compatibility

Works on any version from **1.13 onward** (when Minecraft moved to 
folder-based resource packs). On versions before 1.21 you may see a 
harmless "made for a different version" warning — just click **Yes** 
and it will load and work identically.

## Important note

This only changes the *texture* — it can't make unpowered lamps actually 
emit light, cast glow, or affect redstone logic in any way. That would 
require a datapack or mod, not a resource pack.

## Uninstalling

Remove the pack from Selected (or delete it from the resourcepacks 
folder) to restore vanilla lamp behavior.

title: Chiseled Enchanting Table — Unofficial Port
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.1.2 (Fabric). No-RNG enchanting via a custom table that unlocks enchantments from nearby chiseled bookshelves. Not affiliated with the original author.
body:
> ⚠️ **Unofficial community port.** This is an **unofficial** community port of Sacramentix's
> *Chiseled Enchanting Table* to Minecraft **26.1.2** on Fabric. It is **not affiliated with,
> endorsed by, or maintained by the original author**. All original mod design, code, and assets
> © Sacramentix.
> **Please direct bug reports about this 26.1.2 port to [this repository](https://github.com/q14433686-arch/chiseled-enchanting-table-26.1.2-source), not to the upstream project.**

---

## What this mod does

Replaces vanilla enchanting RNG with a **deterministic, library-driven** workflow:

- Adds a new block, the **Chiseled Enchanting Table**.
- Place enchanted books into nearby **chiseled bookshelves** to **permanently unlock** those
  enchantments for the table.
- Open the table and **pick exactly the enchantment you want** from a scrollable list — no slot
  randomness, no re-rolling.
- The applied enchantment **consumes the matching enchanted book** (which is why building a
  bookshelf library matters), plus a small XP and material cost shown in the UI.
- Some enchantments are unlocked by default (the vanilla `#minecraft:non_treasure` tag, plus a
  small set of treasure-only enchantments the table chooses to also unlock); the rest you collect
  by exploring and looting enchanted books, just like vanilla — but you keep them forever.
- Includes a small set of **item transformations** that share the same table UI
  (e.g. Golden Apple → Enchanted Golden Apple, Glass Bottle → Bottle o' Enchanting).
- Anvil change inherited from upstream: you can **no longer combine two same-level books at an
  anvil to bump the level**. Use the bookshelf library + table instead.

## How to play (quickstart)

1. **Craft** the Chiseled Enchanting Table (vanilla-style recipe; see the in-game recipe book).
2. Build a small library of **chiseled bookshelves** next to it (vanilla bookshelves still give
   the baseline level boost).
3. Drop enchanted books into the chiseled-bookshelf slots — each book's enchantments become
   pickable at the table.
4. Open the table, put the item to enchant in the left slot, scroll the list, click the
   enchantment you want, pay the XP + materials it shows, and the enchantment is applied
   (consuming the matching book).
5. Use the table for the small set of built-in item transformations whenever they show up in the
   list with no item in the input slot.

## Why a port

The upstream project currently targets Minecraft `1.21.x` and depends on Fabric Language Kotlin.
This 26.1.2 port does three things:

1. **Updates the toolchain** to Minecraft 26.1.2 / Fabric Loader 0.19.3 / Fabric API 0.151.0+26.1.2 /
   Loom 1.16.3 / Gradle 9.4.1 / **Java 25**.
2. **Drops the Kotlin runtime dependency** so the only hard dependency is Fabric API.
3. **Hardens data-driven content**: default unlocks, costs, and item transformations are loaded
   from JSON data tables (see [the source repo's `docs/EXTENDING.md`](https://github.com/q14433686-arch/chiseled-enchanting-table-26.1.2-source/blob/main/docs/EXTENDING.md)),
   and a cross-mod compatibility extension lets third-party enchantment mods that tag their
   enchantments into `#minecraft:non_treasure` get picked up automatically.

## Compatibility status

- **Vanilla 26.1.2 + Fabric API 0.151.0:** core gameplay paths (place block, open menu, scroll
  list, apply enchantment, apply transformation, mining drop, floating book renderer) have been
  confirmed working live by the maintainer prior to this 1.0.0 release.
- **Third-party enchantment mods that add enchantments to `#minecraft:non_treasure`:** designed
  to be auto-picked-up by this table's default-unlock list; **awaiting live verification**.
- **Universal Enchants** style item/exclusivity rewrites: expected to work without any port-side
  changes because `Enchantment.canEnchant` / `areCompatible` is read from the live registry;
  awaiting live verification.
- **Merge Enchantments** style anvil mods: operate on the vanilla anvil, a separate interaction
  path from this table; expected to coexist; awaiting live verification.

See [`docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`](https://github.com/q14433686-arch/chiseled-enchanting-table-26.1.2-source/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)
in the source repo for the full investigation.

## Known port-side temporary boundaries

Carried over from the porting work and not yet re-enabled in this 1.0.0 build:

- **Mixins are intentionally disabled** (`"mixins": []` in `fabric.mod.json`) until upstream
  injections are retargeted and live-tested on 26.1.2.
- **Loot-table modification hooks** (enchanted-book injection into vanilla loot tables) and
  **structure-processor bookshelf replacement** (bookshelves in generated structures becoming
  chiseled-bookshelf-with-book) are not yet wired in this port.
- Final tuning of the shelf-power formula and a dedicated multi-slot cost panel are tracked in
  the source repo's `NEXT_TASK.md`.

These are documented limitations, not bugs — please mention them on any feedback.

## Credits

- **Original mod:** [Sacramentix](https://modrinth.com/user/Sacramentix) — design, code, assets
  (MIT). The original mod is at <https://modrinth.com/mod/chiseled-enchanting-table>.
- **Unofficial 26.1.2 port:** `q14433686-arch`. Source:
  <https://github.com/q14433686-arch/chiseled-enchanting-table-26.1.2-source>.
- **License:** MIT, same as upstream.

If you like this mod, please go support the original author too.

title: FluidCore
description: FluidCore optimizes Minecraft fluid ticks using a smart sleep/wake system. Water and lava blocks far from players or stabilized are put to sleep, reducing fluid tick CPU usage by 13%+ without breaking vanilla behavior.
body:
![FluidCore - Minecraft fluid performance optimization mod banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a61777501daa50ab007f96782074f97e5337ad59_0.webp)

# FluidCore

FluidCore is a lightweight Fabric performance mod that 
optimizes Minecraft's vanilla fluid tick system for both 
singleplayer and multiplayer servers.

## How It Works

Vanilla Minecraft ticks every single water and lava block 
every few game ticks — even blocks that haven't changed in 
minutes, and even when no player is nearby. FluidCore 
introduces a smart sleep/wake system that eliminates this 
wasted CPU time.

- **Distance-based sleeping** — Fluid blocks farther than 
96 blocks from any player are put to sleep and stop ticking
- **Stability counter** — Fluid blocks that haven't changed 
for 60 ticks are gradually put to sleep, even near players
- **Event-driven wake-up** — Sleeping fluids instantly wake 
up when a nearby block changes, ensuring correct behavior
- **Chunk unload cleanup** — Sleeping fluid data is 
automatically cleaned when chunks unload, preventing memory 
leaks
- **Both source and flowing blocks** — Optimizes both water/
lava source blocks and flowing blocks

## Benchmarks

Tested with Spark profiler on Fabric 1.20.1:

| Metric | Vanilla | FluidCore | Improvement |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| Fluid tick CPU usage | 2.63% | 2.29% | **~13% reduction** |

*Tested on a flat world with a large water area. 
Results may vary depending on world complexity.*

## Compatibility

- ✅ Fabric 1.20.1
- ✅ Works in singleplayer
- ✅ Compatible with vanilla clients (server-side only)
- ✅ Compatible with Sodium, Lithium, and other 
performance mods

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Drop FluidCore into your mods folder
4. Launch the game

**Enjoy!**

🇷🇺 Описание для Modrinth (Russian)
🎯 One-Tap Rule — Ударная механика выживания!
One-Tap Rule — это легковесный мод для Fabric, меняющий геймплей Minecraft. Он заменяет стандартный расчет урона на фиксированную систему "хитов" (как в старых аркадных играх или кастомных PvP-режимах).

В связи с этим работа мода может быть не до конца оптимизирована, а в процессе игры могут возникать непредвиденные сбои.

⚙️ Основные функции:
💔 Фиксированный урон: Каждый удар по игроку наносит ровно столько хитов (урона), сколько задано в его настройках. Броня, щиты, зелья сопротивления и другие ванильные факторы полностью игнорируются!
🍎 Блокировка регенерации: При включенном режиме сытость больше не восстанавливает здоровье игрока. Выживайте только на том, что есть!
🔧 Динамическое управление: Режим легко включается и выключается на лету с помощью игрового правила.
💬 Удобные команды: Настройки игроков регулируются стандартными серверными командами на английском языке.
🎮 Команды и Управление (требуются права оператора):
Включение / Выключение режима:

/gamerule hitModeEnabled true — включить One-Tap Rule (регенерация отключается, игроки переходят на систему хитов).
/gamerule hitModeEnabled false — выключить режим (здоровье всех игроков сбрасывается до стандартных 20.0 хитов, они полностью исцеляются).
Настройка максимального здоровья игрока (в хитах):

/hit <targets> hitpoint <amount>
Пример: /hit @a hitpoint 10 — установить максимальное здоровье всех игроков в 10 хитов (5 сердец) и полностью вылечить их.
Настройка сносимого здоровья за удар:

/hit <targets> hitsperstrike <amount>
Пример: /hit @p hitsperstrike 2 — теперь при любом ударе по игроку у него будет списываться ровно 2 хита (1 сердце).
🛠️ Требования:
Minecraft: 1.21.10 (совместимо с 1.21.2+)
Зависимости: Fabric Loader, Fabric API

🇬🇧 Description for Modrinth (English)
🎯 One-Tap Rule — Arcade-style Survival Mechanics!
One-Tap Rule is a lightweight Fabric mod that changes Minecraft gameplay. It replaces the vanilla damage calculations with a fixed "hitpoint" system (similar to old-school arcade games or custom PvP modes).

WARNING

Warning: This mod is the result of a "vibecoding" experiment. The code was written by an artificial intelligence during live brainstorming sessions, without deep manual architectural design. Consequently, the mod's operation may not be fully optimized, and unforeseen issues or crashes may occur during gameplay.

⚙️ Main Features:
💔 Fixed Damage: Every hit to a player deals exactly the configured amount of damage (hits). Armor, shields, resistance potions, and other vanilla factors are completely bypassed!
🍎 No Saturation Healing: When the mode is enabled, players will no longer regenerate health from food saturation. Survival is key!
🔧 Dynamic Toggle: Easily enable or disable the mode on the fly using a gamerule.
💬 Clean Commands: Player configurations are managed using standard server commands in English.
🎮 Commands & Configuration (requires OP level 2):
Toggle the mode:

/gamerule hitModeEnabled true — enables One-Tap Rule (disables saturation healing, activates the hit damage system).
/gamerule hitModeEnabled false — disables One-Tap Rule (resets all players' max health to vanilla 20.0 hitpoints and heals them fully).
Set Player Max Health:

/hit <targets> hitpoint <amount>
Example: /hit @a hitpoint 10 — sets max health of all players to 10 hitpoints (5 hearts) and fully heals them.
Set Hits Dealt Per Strike:

/hit <targets> hitsperstrike <amount>
Example: /hit @p hitsperstrike 2 — sets the target player to lose exactly 2 hitpoints (1 heart) per strike.
🛠️ Requirements:
Minecraft: 1.21.10 (compatible with 1.21.2+)
Dependencies: Fabric Loader, Fabric API

title: MultiFabricServer
description: Experimental Fabric mod exploring integrated multi-server orchestration in one JVM.
body:
# MultiFabricServer

Experimental Fabric server-side mod for running multiple lazy-loaded Minecraft server instances, called clusters, inside one JVM.

Players use `/cluster travel <target>` or `/cluster tp <target>` to move between the host and cluster nodes. Nodes start on demand and stop after they have been empty for the configured idle delay. Player list, player count, chat, join/leave messages, advancement messages, and command feedback are shared across running clusters.

## Velocity And Standalone Modes

The mod can run without Velocity. In standalone mode, use Minecraft transfer packets and, for a public server, the built-in gateway:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "gatewayEnabled": true,
  "transferHost": "play.example.com",
  "gatewayBindHost": "0.0.0.0",
  "gatewayBindPort": 25565,
  "nodeIdleStopSeconds": 300,
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "creative",
      "worldName": "creativeworld",
      "enabled": true
    }
  ]
}
```

With this setup, the gateway listens on `gatewayBindPort` and forwards players to the host or their target lazy cluster. The host Minecraft server must listen on a different port, for example `25566`, because the gateway owns the public port.

Velocity can still be used for extended behavior such as preserving chat UI/history during switches. Install the companion Velocity plugin built by this repo and Velocity only needs the host server in `velocity.toml`.

When `seamlessProxySwitchEnabled` is enabled, the Fabric mod sends the companion plugin a dynamic backend registration immediately before it sends Velocity's normal `Connect` plugin message. That lets newly-created clusters work without manually adding each cluster to `velocity.toml`.

Without the companion Velocity plugin, `seamlessProxySwitchEnabled` still requires each target cluster name to be registered in Velocity. If Velocity only has the host server configured and you do not want the companion plugin, disable `seamlessProxySwitchEnabled` and use the transfer/gateway path instead.

## Config File

On first server start, this file is generated in the active world root:

```text
multifabricserver-cluster.json
```

Default content is disabled and safe to edit:

```json
{
  "enabled": false,
  "gatewayEnabled": false,
  "seamlessProxySwitchEnabled": false,
  "proxyHostServerName": "host",
  "transferHost": "127.0.0.1",
  "gatewayBindHost": "0.0.0.0",
  "gatewayBindPort": 25565,
  "nodeIdleStopSeconds": 300,
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "creative",
      "worldName": "creativeworld",
      "enabled": true
    }
  ]
}
```

`proxyServerName` is optional per node. If omitted, seamless Velocity mode falls back to the node id as the Velocity server name.

## Velocity Companion Plugin

Build both the Fabric mod and Velocity companion plugin:

```bash
./gradlew clean build
```

Install:

```text
build/libs/multifabricserver-mc26.1-1.0.0.jar -> Fabric server mods/
velocity/build/libs/multifabricserver-velocity-1.0.0.jar -> Velocity plugins/
```

Then keep only the host backend in `velocity.toml`, for example:

```toml
[servers]
host = "127.0.0.1:25566"
try = ["host"]
```

Cluster nodes can omit `proxyServerName`; the node id becomes the dynamic Velocity server name.

## Commands

- `/cluster status`
- `/cluster players`
- `/cluster reload`
- `/cluster enable`
- `/cluster enable <node>`
- `/cluster disable`
- `/cluster disable <node>`
- `/cluster start <node>`
- `/cluster stop <node>`
- `/cluster remove <node>`
- `/cluster travel <host|node>`
- `/cluster tp <host|node>`

Admin commands require command-level `GAMEMASTERS`.

## Development

Build:

```bash
./gradlew clean build
```

Current local test loop:

```bash
./gradlew clean build && cp build/libs/multifabricserver-mc26.1-1.0.0.jar server-test/mods/ && cp velocity/build/libs/multifabricserver-velocity-1.0.0.jar server-test/velocity/plugins/ && docker compose -f server-test/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f server-test/docker-compose.yml up
```

# Bad Mod

Bad Mod is designed to make Minecraft worse... on purpose.

It adds intentionally annoying, unfair, and unreasonable features that create unexpected and often ridiculous situations. Everything is intentional, even if it feels unfair.

This mod is not designed to be balanced. It is designed to be fun, chaotic, and sometimes frustrating.

## Features

* Trying to eat bread causes all bread in your inventory to disappear.
* Carrying any bucket other than an empty bucket slows you down.
* Sending a chat message usually deals 2 damage. In Nightmare Mode, it deals 4 damage.
* Using a hoe to till farmland immediately breaks the hoe.
* Experience slowly decreases while you are sleeping. In Nightmare Mode, it decreases continuously.
* Water and rain become dangerously hot and deal damage, while lava becomes cold.
* Blocking an attack with a shield summons 3 Creepers. In Nightmare Mode, it summons 6 Creepers.
* Catching something while fishing launches you high into the air.
* The Ender Dragon is much stronger than normal.
* Use the `/nightmare` command to enable Nightmare Mode.

## Nightmare Mode

Nightmare Mode is a joke mode.

It is not intended to be a serious or balanced difficulty. Many mechanics are intentionally exaggerated, unfair, or completely ridiculous.

If something makes you say "Why?", that's probably the intended reaction.

Play Nightmare Mode if you want maximum chaos and don't mind a lot of suffering.
