title: Noctara Holograms
description: Noctara Holograms is a Fabric 1.20.1 hologram mod made by vxrcy for Noctara SMP.
body:
Noctara Holograms

Noctara Holograms is a Fabric 1.20.1 hologram mod made by vxrcy for Noctara SMP. It adds editable floating holograms, item holograms, scoreboard leaderboards, particles, floating animation, typewriter text effects, text display controls, and style syncing for server owners.

Requires Fabric 1.20.1 and Java 17.

Features

Create floating holograms with multiple editable lines
Create item holograms
Create scoreboard leaderboard holograms
Edit, insert, remove, and list hologram lines
Armor stand and text display render modes
Floating/bobbing animation
Typewriter text reveal animation
Particle effects and particle presets
Per-line X/Y/Z offsets
Text display scale, alignment, rotation, billboard, and background controls
Copy/sync hologram styling without copying text
Placeholder support
Server-side management commands

Main Commands

/nh help [page]
Shows the command help menu.

/nh create <id> [text]
Creates a hologram. If no text is provided, it creates an empty hologram so you can add lines one at a time.

/nh createitem <id> <item> <text>
Creates a hologram with an item display.

/nh createscoreboard <id> <objective> <top> <seconds> [theme]
Creates a scoreboard leaderboard hologram.

/nh delete <id>
Deletes a hologram.

/nh copy <source> <newid>
Duplicates a hologram.

/nh list [page]
Lists all holograms.

/nh near [page]
Lists nearby holograms.

/nh info <id>
Shows info about a hologram.

/nh reload
Reloads holograms from config.

Line Editing

/nh lines <id>
Shows numbered lines for editing.

/nh addline <id> <text>
Adds a new line.

/nh edit <id> <line> <text>
Changes the text on a specific line.

/nh setline <id> <line> <text>
Same as edit.

/nh insertline <id> <line> <text>
Inserts a line at a specific position.

/nh removeline <id> <line>
Removes a line.

/nh lineoffset <id> <line> <x> <y> <z>
Moves one line independently.

/nh lineoffset <id> reset <line>
Resets a line offset.

/nh lineoffset <id> info
Shows line offsets.

Animations

/nh float <id> on|off|toggle [amount]
Turns floating animation on/off.

/nh float <id> speed <speed>
Changes float speed.

/nh float <id> amplitude <amount>
Changes float height.

/nh float <id> phase <offset>
Offsets the float timing.

/nh float <id> mode sine|bounce|linear
Changes float motion style.

/nh float <id> info
Shows float settings.

/nh typewriter <id> on|off|toggle [ticks]
Turns the typewriter reveal loop on/off.

/nh typewriter <id> info
Shows typewriter settings.

/nh animateline <id> <line> <seconds> <frame1|frame2|frame3>
Cycles one line through text frames.

Particles

/nh particles <id> on|off|toggle
Turns particles on/off.

/nh particles <id> type <particle>
Sets particle type.

/nh particles <id> count <amount>
Sets particle count.

/nh particles <id> interval <ticks>
Sets how often particles spawn.

/nh particles <id> speed <speed>
Sets particle speed.

/nh particles <id> offset <x> <y> <z>
Moves particle position.

/nh particles <id> shape center|line|ring|halo|box|sparkle
Sets particle shape.

/nh particles <id> radius <radius>
Sets particle radius.

/nh particles <id> height <height>
Sets particle height.

/nh particles <id> color <hex>
Sets dust particle color.

/nh particles <id> preset magic|mystic|ender|fairy|fire|portal|dragon|off
Applies a particle preset or disables particles.

/nh particles <id> info
Shows particle settings.

Text Display Controls

/nh rendermode <id> armorstand|textdisplay
Switches render style.

/nh rendermode <id> info
Shows render mode.

/nh scale <id> <size>
Changes text display size.

/nh scale <id> info
Shows scale.

/nh align <id> left|center|right
Sets text alignment.

/nh billboard <id> center|fixed|vertical|horizontal
Changes how text display faces players.

/nh rotation <id> <yaw> <pitch>
Sets text display rotation.

/nh rotation <id> facehere
Matches the hologram rotation to where you are looking.

/nh rotation <id> info
Shows rotation.

/nh background <id> on|off|toggle
Toggles text display background.

/nh background <id> opacity <percent>
Sets background opacity.

/nh background <id> color <hex>
Sets background color.

/nh background <id> shadow on|off
Toggles text shadow.

/nh background <id> see-through on|off
Toggles see-through rendering.

/nh background <id> info
Shows background settings.

Movement

/nh movehere <id>
Moves a hologram to your position.

/nh movevertical <id> up|down <amount>
Moves a hologram up or down.

/nh teleport <id>
Teleports you to a hologram.

/nh viewdistance <id> <blocks>
Sets hologram view distance. Use 0 to disable.

Style Copying

/nh copystyle <from> <to>
Copies style/settings from one hologram to another without copying text.

/nh style copy <from> <to>
Same as copystyle.

/nh sync <from> <to>
Copies full style by default without changing text.

/nh sync <from> <to> float|particles|background|display|effects
Copies only one style section.

Lighting

/nh backlight <id> on|off|toggle [height]
Adds or removes a light column behind a hologram.

Placeholders

Supported placeholders include:

%server:online%
%server:max%
%server:tps%
%server:uptime%
%server:memory%
%server:time%
%world:time%
%player:name%
%player:ping%

Also supports older placeholders:

%players%
%maxplayers%
%tps%
%uptime%
%memory%
%server_time%

Permissions

NoctaraHolograms commands require operator permission level 2 or higher.

That means anyone with normal Minecraft OP level 2, 3, or 4 can use the commands. Regular players without OP cannot create, edit, move, delete, or manage holograms.

Formatting

Supports common color and style formatting, including legacy & codes, hex colors, and MiniMessage-style tags such as:

<gold>Gold Text</gold>
<aqua>Aqua Text</aqua>
<gradient:#a600ff:#d078ff>Purple Gradient</gradient>
<rainbow>Rainbow Text</rainbow>
<bold>Bold Text</bold>

Multiple formatting sections can be used on the same line.

Credits

Made by vxrcy for Noctara SMP.

This mod adds new commands:

/antimace <name> true/false <time>
To allow/disallow the mace usability for a player. The status is saved so that it remains in effect even after rejoining. Keep in mind that the player can still attack other mobs, but can no longer attack other players.


/plugin antimace toggle true/false
To enable/disassenble the mod
	
/plugin antimace allow <name> true/false
To grant a player permission to execute the /antimace command—since, by 			default, it is only visible and executable by players with operator rights.
Keep in mind that the player retains this right even after rejoining, until you take it 		away again.


/Timeout <name> true/false
To give a player a timeout: the player cannot move or use any items. This can only 		be activated from players with operator privileges.

The mod works on Singelplayer and Multiplayer.

This mod is designed to prevent players from simply "macing" other players. It also aims to ensure that the fun of the game isn't ruined for others.

title: Moderation tool
description: A complete and lightweight moderation tool
body:
## Overview
**ModeratorTools** is a lightweight, efficient, and easy-to-use moderation plugin designed to keep your server chat clean and safe. It provides server moderators with commands to filter out unwanted words and mute players.

## Features
* **Chat Filter (Blacklist):** Blocks custom words or phrases.

* **Mute System:** Easily mute or unmute players using commands.

* **Configurable Messages:** Fully customize messages sent to players directly from the `config.yml` file.

* **Performance Optimized:** Designed to be lightweight without causing server lag.

## Commands and Permissions

`/mute <player>`  Mutes a specific player.  `moderator.mute`

`/mute <player> remove`  Unmute a specific player. `moderator.mute`

`/warn add <player> [reason]`  Warns a specific player. `moderator.warn`

`/warn remove <player>`  Removes a warning from a player. `moderator.warn`

`/warn list <player>`  Checks the warning count of a player. `moderator.warn`

`/moderator`  Manages the blocked words system. `moderator.admin`

`/moderator_reload`  Reloads the plugin configuration. `moderator.reload`


## Configuration
The plugin includes a simple and fully customizable configuration file. You can translate each message and change chat prefixes.

title: yourShika's Backpacks
description: A standalone, server-side backpack system for Paper/Spigot
body:
# yourShika Backpack's

> A standalone, **fully server-side** backpack system for **Paper/Spigot**.
> Players do **not need a client mod**.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.4.0-6E5BC8)](https://github.com/yourShika/yourShika-Backpacks/releases)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Plattform-Paper%2026.1.2-5BE8D4)](https://papermc.io)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-25-orange)](https://adoptium.net)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lizenz-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

---

## 📦 Description

**yourShika Backpacks** brings high-quality, **customizable** backpacks with their own
inventories to your survival server—protected against duplication bugs, persistently
saved, and ready for your own custom textures.

The plugin is **inspired by [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)
([GitHub](https://github.com/P3pp3rF1y/SophisticatedBackpacks))**, but is a
**completely independent new development**. **No code, no assets, and no
textures** were taken from that mod. **This is not a Forge/Fabric/NeoForge mod, but
a Paper/Spigot plugin.**

---

## 🧱 Minecraft/Paper Version

- **Target platform:** Paper (also runs on Spigot, though MiniMessage appearance may be limited there)
- **Built against:** `io.papermc.paper:paper-api:26.1.2.build.72-stable`
- **Java:** **25** required (Minecraft 26.1.x requires Java 25, Microsoft OpenJDK 25)
- **Versioning scheme:** Since the introduction of the new `YY.D.H` scheme, the Paper API uses
  `<version>.build.<n>-<stage>` instead of `-R0.1-SNAPSHOT`. The target version can be
  easily changed via the `paper.version` property in the [`pom.xml`](pom.xml).

---

## ✨ Features

- ✅ Backpacks as **regular items** with a **unique, tamper-proof ID** (PDC)
- ✅ **Separate inventory per backpack** – same items, different contents
- ✅ **Persistent storage** (SQLite or YAML)
- ✅ **Secure GUI** with comprehensive duplicate/loss protection
- ✅ **Double-chest layout (54 slots)** – only unlocked slots are usable
- ✅ **Higher tiers = more space**; automatic **paging** when a page is exceeded
- ✅ **6 backpack tiers** (Leather, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite)
- ✅ **Truly customizable** using dyeable leather items (DyeColor **or Hex `#RRGGBB`**) –
  Color visible **even without a resource pack**
- ✅ **Crafting recipes** (configurable, can be enabled/disabled)
- ✅ **Open via right-click** (main & off-hand) **and command**
- ✅ **Admin give command** and **open by ID**
- ✅ **CustomModelData + `item_model` component per tier** – ready for resource packs
- ✅ **Modular hook system** – all external hooks **disabled by default & experimental**,
  Live status via **`/bp modules`**
- ✅ **German, configurable messages** (MiniMessage + `&` codes)
- ✅ **Protection against backpacks-in-backpacks**
- ❌ **No Vault** anymore (intentionally removed)

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Download the plugin JAR from [Releases](https://github.com/yourShika/yourShika-Backpacks/releases)
   (`yourShika-Backpacks-0.1.0.jar`).
2. Place it in the `plugins/` folder of your **Paper 26.1.2 (Java 25)** server.
3. Start the server—the **`plugins/yourShika Backpack's/`** data folder will be automatically
   created with `config.yml`, `messages_de.yml`, and the database.
4. Optionally customize `config.yml` and run `/bp reload`.

---

## ⌨️ Commands

Main command: `/backpack` · Aliases: `/bp`, `/ybackpack`, `/ysbackpack`

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/bp help` | Show help |
| `/bp open` | Open the backpack in your hand |
| `/bp info` | View backpacks, upgrades, and **recipes** in a GUI |
| `/bp list [player]` | List backpacks |
| `/bp color <color> [accent]` | Dye the backpack (DyeColor name **or** `#RRGGBB`) — **Admin** |
| `/bp give <player> <tier> [quantity] [color] [accent]` | Give a backpack (Admin) |
| `/bp openid <ID>` | Open a backpack by ID (Admin) |
| `/bp modules` | Enable/disable external modules **via GUI** (Admin) |
| `/bp update` | Load the latest version from GitHub (Admin, restart required) |
| `/bp reload` | Reload configuration (Admin) |
| `/bp version` | Plugin info |

> **Dyeing for players** is done via the **Crafting Table** (see below); the
> command `/bp color` is intentionally a **admin** function.

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `yourshika.backpack.use` | Use backpacks | all |
| `yourshika.backpack.open` | Open your own backpack | all |
| `yourshika.backpack.list` | List your own backpacks | all |
| `yourshika.backpack.place` | Place/pick up backpacks | all |
| `yourshika.backpack.craft.<tier>` | Craft a specific tier | all |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.color` | Color a backpack via command | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.give` | Give backpacks | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.openid` | Open by ID | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.openother` | Open other players' backpacks | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.listother` | List other players' backpacks | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.modules` | Open/switch module GUI | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.update` | Self-Updater | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.reload` | Reload | OP |
| `yourshika.backpack.admin.debug` | Debug | OP |

---

## 🎒 Backpacks, Tiers, Size & Paging

Each backpack opens as a **double chest (54 slots)**. The bottom row (9 slots)
is the **control bar** (Scroll, Info, Upgrade Preview). Of the remaining
**45 slots**, only as many are **unlocked** as the tier allows—the rest are
locked. Tiers with more than 45 storage slots are automatically split across multiple
**pages** (◀ / ▶).

| Tier | Storage Slots | Pages* | Upgrade Slots | CustomModelData |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leather | 9 | 1 | 1 | 1001 |
| Copper | 18 | 1 | 2 | 1002 |
| Iron | 27 | 1 | 3 | 1003 |
| Gold | 45 | 1 | 4 | 1004 |
| Diamond | 54 | 2 | 5 | 1005 |
| **Emerald** | 81 | 2 | 6 | 1006 |
| Netherite | 108 | 3 | 6 | 1007 |

\* With 45 usable slots per page (`gui.storage-slots-per-page`).
The upgrade slots can be accessed via the **Upgrades button** in the backpack GUI as
a separate inventory.

### Identity & Security

Each backpack stores its **ID, tier, and colors in the PersistentDataContainer**—not in
its name or lore. This means backpacks **cannot be spoofed by renaming**.
**The contents are never stored in the item** itself but are bound to the ID on the server side.
This is the core of the anti-duplication protection: A copied item shares the same inventory.
When scrolling, only the visible page is synchronized between the inventory and the buffer
—the operation remains atomic and dupe-proof.

### Colors (truly dyeable)

Backpacks are based by default on a **dyeable leather item**
(`LEATHER_HORSE_ARMOR`). The **main color actually dyes the item**—visible
**even without a resource pack**—and can be changed using `/bp color`. Both
**DyeColor names** (`BROWN`, `CYAN`, …) and **hex values** (`#A0703C`)
are allowed as colors. Leather horse armor cannot be equipped by the player and is therefore
ideal as a backpack base.

---

## 🎨 CustomModelData, item_model & Resource Packs

- Each animal has its own **CustomModelData** (1001–1007) and can optionally
  set a modern **`item_model` component** (`item-model: “namespace:path”`).
- **Without a resource pack**, backpacks function as normal (colored) leather items.
- **With a resource pack**, they appear as unique items.
- **External item systems** (Nexo, ItemsAdder, Oraxen) are **optional** and
  experimental—see Hooks. The default is always the built-in vanilla provider.

### Oraxen Assets

In the `src/main/resources/oraxen/` directory, you’ll find a complete Oraxen add-on with
64x64 vanilla-style PNGs for all backpack tiers, tier upgrade items, and
52 pre-made function upgrades (Pickup, Magnet, Filter, Void, Transfer,
Crafting/Processing, Stack, Utility, Tank/Energy/XP). The textures have been intentionally
upscaled from 16x16 pixel art to match Minecraft items. The backpack textures
use three layers: a dyeable base (`*_base.png`), fixed accent variants
(`accents/<tier>_<dye>.png`), and an overlay for outlines, tier metal, and
shiny details. The plugin config references the base IDs via `provider-id`;
for different accent colors, the plugin automatically uses provider IDs such as
`ysbp_leather_backpack_accent_red`. Real backpacks are still created
via plugin crafting, smithing, or `/bp give`, so that the ID, contents, owner, and
color are preserved.

The feature upgrades are set up as model/texture providers
(`ysbp_upgrade_<upgrade_key>`, CustomModelData `2100-2151`); their gameplay logic
can be integrated with them later.

---

## 🧰 Crafting, Upgrade Chain & Dyeing

**Only the leather backpack** is crafted directly (8× leather at a **chest**).
All higher tiers are created via the **upgrade chain** at the Smithing Table.
Newly crafted backpacks display their **ID immediately** in the lore.

**Upgrade Chain** — Leather → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Emerald → Netherite:

1. Craft **Leather Upgrade**: 1× Leather (center) + 4× Thread (Crafting Table).
2. Craft a **Tier Upgrade**: Upgrade Leather + 8× Tier Material (e.g., Copper) →
   *Copper Upgrade* (Crafting Table). **Netherite Upgrade**: **Smithing Table** –
   Upgrade Leather (Template) + Netherite Ingot (Base) + Thread (addition).
3. **Refining at the Smithing Table:** **Regular Leather** (template) + **previous
   backpack** (base) + **Tier Upgrade** (addition) → next backpack.
   **ID, contents, and color are retained.** (Upgrade leather is not accepted in the template slot
  —real leather belongs there.)

**Dyeing (Crafting Table):** Place the backpack in the **middle column**, dyes in
the **left column** = main color, **right column** = accent color. Within
a column, the position doesn’t matter; multiple dyes are mixed into a single **hex value**
. The backpack’s contents remain completely intact.

> The actual recipes appear in the **Recipe Book** and in **JEI/REI/EMI**. The
> position-independent dyeing is not a fixed recipe and is therefore not listed there.

---

## 💾 Storage

- **SQLite** (default, recommended) → `backpacks.db`
- **YAML** (alternative) → `backpacks.yml`

Data is saved when **closing**, when **changing pages**, upon **logout**,
**plugin deactivation**, **server shutdown**, and via **autosave**.

**Update-safe (MUST):** Content is stored in the **versioned Paper-Byte format**
(`serializeAsBytes`)—including the Minecraft data version. Upon loading,
DataFixer automatically migrates to the current version, ensuring that items with any
custom NBT/components **are not lost or corrupted** after updates. Older data in the old format is still read and automatically migrated the next
time you save.

---

## 🔌 External Modules / Hooks (Automatic)

The plugin runs **completely independently**. External hooks are encapsulated as **modules**
and activate **automatically** as soon as the respective plugin
is installed and the module is enabled in the config (**default: enabled**).
If the plugin is missing, the module remains inactive.

Live status & switching **via GUI**: **`/bp modules`** (Clicking on a module
toggles it and reloads it).

| Module | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **PlaceholderAPI** | `%ysbp_count%`, `%ysbp_highest_tier%`, `%ysbp_open%` | auto |
| **PacketEvents** | Packet display of placed backpacks (Roadmap) | auto |
| **Oraxen** | Custom models/textures | auto |

> **Custom Items:** **Oraxen** is the only supported custom item hook
> (free to use, mature API). **Nexo** (paid) and **ItemsAdder** (Premium)
> have been intentionally removed. A `provider-id` can be set per tier, which only
> takes effect if the Oraxen module is active. **Vault is intentionally not supported.**

Disable a single module (example):

```yaml
hooks:
  modules:
    oraxen: false
```

---

## 📄 License

Published under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

> Inspired by Sophisticated Backpacks—but an independent implementation
> with no reused code, no assets, and no textures.

title: AdvancedChatFormatter
description: Ultra-lightweight, high-performance chat formatting plugin built for Paper servers running Minecraft 1.21 up to 26+, supporting Java 21 through Java 25.
body:
# Advanced Chat Formatter (ACF)

**Advanced Chat Formatter (ACF)** is an ultra-lightweight, high-performance chat rendering solution built for modern Paper networks. It seamlessly bridges the gap between old-school server configurations and modern UI styling frameworks, allowing full cross-compatibility without breaking a sweat.

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/BLtoqzo7?style=for-the-badge&color=00AF5C&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/BLtoqzo7) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/web-aboutcapy.dev-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge&logo=icloud&logoColor=white)](https://aboutcapy.dev) [![Wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/wiki-docs.aboutcapy.dev-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=readme&logoColor=white)](https://docs.aboutcapy.dev/acf) 

## Features

* **MiniMessage:** Full compatibility with modern tags like `<rainbow>`, `<gradient:#ff0000:#00ff00>`, `<bold>`, and `<italic>`.
* **Legacy Codes:** Out-of-the-box support for classic standard ampersand styling (`&a`, `&l`, etc.).
* **Hex RGB Formats:** Automatically translates standard community color strings like `&#ff5555` and `{#ff5555}` into modern formats.
* **LuckPerms Meta Injection**
  Automatically hooks into LuckPerms to pull and display user group metadata, dynamically injecting player `prefixes` and `suffixes` cleanly into the chat layout.
* **Async Event Execution**
  Built entirely on Paper's modern `AsyncChatEvent` API. By offloading chat text parsing completely from the main server thread, ACF guarantees maximum performance and **0 TPS lag** even on masive servers.

## Configuration

ACF keeps things completely customizable and straightforward with a lightweight `config.yml`.

```yaml
# Placeholders: {name}, {displayname}, {message}, {world}, {prefix}, {suffix}
default-format: "{prefix}{displayname}{suffix}<dark_gray> »<reset> {message}"

messages:
  no-permission: "<red>You do not have permission to run this command."
  reload-success: "<green>ACF configuration reloaded successfully!"
```

## Commands & Permissions

ACF features smart, permission-aware **tab-completion** so administrators can effortlessly run commands.

| Command | Alias | Description | Permission Required |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/chatformatter reload` | `/cf reload` | Reloads the `config.yml` setup live. | `chatformatter.admin` |

body:
## Description
This is the Caio's Labradors mod!

It adds labrador dogs to the game. The dogs spawn wild across the world. You can tame them with beef, cod, salmon or apple and their pack will follow you and your orders. 

They are usefull against any hostile mobs, fighting against them to help you. If they suffer damage, you can heal them with the same food you can use to tame them.

description: A simple and smooth cinematic camera zoom
body:
## 🔍 ZoomEx

**ZoomEx** is a lightweight, highly optimized client-side mod that adds a smooth cinematic camera zoom to Minecraft. Inspired by classic features like OptiFine zoom, it provides a seamless transition without bloating your game.

------------

### 🐛 Found a bug?
If you encounter any issues, glitches, or crashes, please report them on our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/3DjPbjEnVk). We'll help you fix it as soon as possible!


### ✨ Features:
* **Smooth Camera Animation:** The camera smoothly glides in and out instead of abruptly snapping, giving you a premium, cinematic feel.
* **Cinematic Mouse Smoothness:** Automatically enables smooth mouse tracking while zooming, making it easy to look at distant objects.
* **FPS-Independent Smoothness:** Uses delta-time calculations to ensure the zoom speed remains perfectly identical whether you play at 30 FPS or 300 FPS.
* **100% Client-Side:** This mod runs entirely on your computer. It is completely safe for multiplayer and **does not** need to be installed on the server!
* **No Dependencies:** Completely standalone. Just drop it into your mods folder and play.

------------

### 🎮 How to Use:
1. Open Minecraft and go to **Options -> Controls -> Key Binds**.
2. Scroll down to find the ZoomKey.
3. Bind your preferred key (Default might need to be set).
4. Hold the key to smoothly zoom in, release it to smoothly zoom out!

title: Pra'Hyu Suite
description: Quality-of-life tweak suite for Minecraft: freecam, zoom, improved HUD, inventory management, and more, in a single JAR per version.
body:
# Pra'Hyu Suite

Pra'Hyu Suite is a collection of quality-of-life tweaks for Minecraft, designed to make your everyday gameplay smoother and more comfortable. Distributed as a single JAR per version for Fabric, the mod brings together dozens of independent modules that you can enable or disable as you see fit, without ever weighing down your setup.

## Supported Versions

Pra'Hyu Suite is built for Minecraft 1.21 and later versions. Earlier versions are not supported.

## Visual & Camera

**Freecam.** Fully detaches the camera from the player, letting you move freely through the world. Perfect for exploring, filming, or admiring a build from every angle.

**Zoom.** Provides a smooth scroll-wheel zoom with a precisely adjustable level, without ever affecting your regular FOV.

**Fullbright.** Fully illuminates the scene so you can see clearly even in total darkness.

**Clear Lava View.** Removes the fog and the red lava overlay while you're protected by fire resistance.

**Block Overlay.** Highlights the targeted block with a fully customizable outline and fill.

**See Invisible.** Reveals normally invisible players on the client side.

## Inventory & Equipment

**Inventory Manager.** Reimagines inventory management with improved drag-and-drop, smoother scrolling, quick-craft, and automatic highlighting of matching items.

**Tool Changer.** Automatically selects the best available tool before mining or interacting.

**Favorite Slots.** Lets you mark certain slots as favorites so they're never accidentally moved or dropped.

**Elytra Swap.** Instantly swaps between elytra and chestplate with a single keypress.

**Stack Refill.** Automatically replaces an empty stack with an identical one from your inventory.

**Container Preview.** Shows the contents of shulker boxes, ender chests, and bundles as soon as you hover over them.

**Slot Preview.** Gives you a preview of regular inventory slot contents.

**InvMove.** Lets you keep moving even while a container is open.

**Armor Visibility.** Gives you fine control over the opacity of each piece of armor, your cape, and your elytra.

## HUD & Interface

**Mace Meter.** Estimates in real time the damage your mace will deal based on fall height.

**Potion Bar.** Displays all your active potion effects clearly and in a customizable way directly in the HUD.

**Entity Vitals.** Projects entity health bars in 3D within the world, with fully customizable styles and colors.

**Player Locator.** Adds a discreet marker showing the direction of nearby players above your XP bar.

**Keybind Atlas.** Offers an interactive atlas bringing together all your keybinds at a glance.

## Social

**Friend Highlight.** Colors your friends' names in the tab list and above their heads, with a customizable color for each one.

**Macros.** Provides ten fully configurable slots to automate your most-used commands or chat messages.

## Ambiance

**Better Smoke.** Extends the lifespan of campfire smoke particles for a more immersive atmosphere.

**Sea Surface.** Animates the water's surface with realistic splash and foam effects.

**Tools On My Back.** Displays the last tool or weapon you used on your character's back whenever you switch slots.

## Compatibility

**Replay More.** Extends Replay Mod's capabilities by giving you control over time, weather, and FOV during playback.

## Configuration

All settings are managed directly in-game, either through ModMenu if you have it installed, or by simply pressing the H key by default. Each module remains independent and can be enabled, disabled, or customized at your own pace, with keybinds you're free to remap.

## Author

Pra'Hyu Suite is developed by "Vayuu". All rights reserved.

title: FracturedMines
description: A modern, lightweight and highly configurable mine regeneration plugin for Paper servers.
body:
# ⛏️ FracturedMines

## The Ultimate Mine Regeneration Plugin for Paper

**FracturedMines** is a powerful, lightweight, and highly configurable mine regeneration plugin designed for modern Paper servers. Create unlimited regenerating mines with automatic resets, randomized ore layouts, configurable countdown warnings, and safe player teleportation.

Whether you're running a Prison, Survival, Skyblock, or OP Prison server, FracturedMines makes managing mines simple while delivering excellent performance.

---

# ✨ Features

* ⛏️ Unlimited regenerating mines
* 🎲 Random ore generation every reset
* ⏱️ Fully configurable regeneration timers
* ⚠️ Configurable countdown warnings before regeneration
* 📍 Multiple teleport spawn locations per mine
* 🎯 Players are randomly distributed across all configured spawn points
* 📦 PlaceholderAPI support
* 🔒 Permission support
* ⚡ Lightweight and optimized
* 🌍 Supports multiple worlds
* 🛠️ Easy configuration
* ✅ Paper 1.21+ support

---

# 🚀 How It Works

Create a mine, select its region, configure the blocks you want it to generate, choose how often it should regenerate, and start mining.

When the regeneration timer reaches zero:

1. Players receive configurable warning messages.
2. Any players inside the mine are automatically teleported to a safe location.
3. If multiple teleport locations are configured, each player is sent to a random one.
4. The mine instantly regenerates using your configured ore layout.

This creates a smooth mining experience with no manual intervention.

---

# 📦 PlaceholderAPI

Display the remaining regeneration timer anywhere PlaceholderAPI is supported.

```
%fm_timer_<mine>%
```

Example:

```
%fm_timer_spawn%
```

---

# 💻 Commands

## Create a Mine

```
/fracturedmines create <name>
```

Creates a new mine.

Example

```
/fracturedmines create spawn
```

---

## Delete a Mine

```
/fracturedmines delete <name>
```

Permanently removes the mine.

Example

```
/fracturedmines delete spawn
```

---

## List Mines

```
/fracturedmines list
```

Displays every created mine.

---

## Reload Plugin

```
/fracturedmines reload
```

Reloads all configuration files without restarting the server.

---

# 🔐 Permissions

| Permission              | Description                   |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `fracturedmines.admin`  | Access to all plugin commands |
| `fracturedmines.create` | Create mines                  |
| `fracturedmines.delete` | Delete mines                  |
| `fracturedmines.reload` | Reload the plugin             |

---

# 📖 Getting Started

### Step 1

Install the plugin inside your server's `plugins` folder.

Restart the server.

---

### Step 2

Create your first mine.

```
/fracturedmines create spawn
```

---

### Step 3

Select your mine region using the plugin's selection tool (or the configured selection method).

---

### Step 4

Configure:

* Regeneration timer
* Ore percentages
* Warning messages
* Teleport locations

---

### Step 5

Start mining!

Players can now mine normally while the plugin automatically handles regeneration.

---

# ⚙️ Requirements

* Paper 1.21+
* Java 21
* PlaceholderAPI *(Optional)*

---

# ❤️ Why Choose FracturedMines?

FracturedMines was built with performance and simplicity in mind. Unlike many older mine plugins, it focuses on fast regeneration, clean configuration, and modern Paper compatibility while remaining easy to use for server owners of any size.

Whether your server has 20 players or 2,000, FracturedMines is designed to scale with your network.

---

## ⭐ Support the Plugin

If you enjoy using FracturedMines, consider leaving a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review. Your feedback helps improve the plugin and supports future updates.

title: TeamStorage
description: A plugin that adds shared city storage, local city chat, and colored city tags before player names in the tab list
body:
# TeamStorage

**TeamStorage** is a Paper/Purpur plugin that adds shared city storage integrated directly into Minecraft ender chests.

When a city member opens an ender chest, they can choose between their personal ender chest and the shared storage of their city. Players who do not belong to a city keep the standard vanilla behavior.

## Features

- Shared storage for every city
- Personal ender chests remain unchanged
- 9–54 configurable storage slots
- Real-time synchronization between city members
- Reliable SQLite data storage
- Automatic and immediate inventory saving
- Detailed item deposit, withdrawal, and access logs
- Administrative city management
- Configurable Russian and English messages
- Customizable GUI items, sounds, titles, and model data
- Optional colored city tags in the player list
- Local city chat using `@message`
- Persistent city-chat mode
- Administrative city-chat spy
- Legacy CityStorage data migration

## City Management

Cities are created and managed by server administrators:

- `/city create <name> <tag>`
- `/city delete <name>`
- `/city add <player> <city>`
- `/city remove <player>`
- `/city info <city>`
- `/city list`
- `/city tag <city> <tag>`
- `/city tagcolor <city> <color|#hex>`

Each player can belong to only one city. Adding a player to another city automatically transfers them from their previous city.

A city cannot be deleted while its shared storage contains items.

## Storage Commands

- `/teamstorage toggle` — enable or disable the storage selection menu
- `/teamstorage open [city]` — open city storage as an administrator
- `/citystorage` remains available as a legacy alias.

Players cannot open shared storage through commands. Regular access is provided only through an ender chest.

## City Chat

Prefix a message with `@` to send it only to members of your city:

```text
@Hello, city!
```
Use /citychat or /cc to toggle persistent city-chat mode.
If a player does not belong to a city, the @ character is removed and the message is sent to global chat.

## Player List Tags
TeamStorage can display a colored city tag before each player's name:
```text
[TAG] Player
```
This feature does not use scoreboard teams and can be disabled completely:
```text
tab:
  enabled: false
```
Disable it when TAB or another plugin should have full control over player-list names.

## Requirements
- Paper or Purpur 26.2
- Java 25 or newer

title: Secret's of the Stone
description: This story is yours to uncover in the stone, explore a new dimensions, craft new help, and reveal what lies in secret. (Exploratory dungeonlike + story)
body:

**--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**

![Title Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15620d71c108d21a568f9f898f729bdc7539841c.png)

This is as I'd like to call it: a exploratory dungeonlike mod, with story~

You spawn with a guidebook to help you along your journey! As well as an all new advancement tab.

In a dimension of Solitude you will find a new resource known as Ayre, craft all new weapons, tools and armor along with much more to come. In ancient text's you will gain the newfound knowledge of the Poison, Frost, Stoned, and Brutality enchants! Along your journey you will fine four key structures that will be the "key" to crafting something... Not only that but new food too, like the Plurple Fruit, Baked Plurple, Cooked Plurple from the Plurple Plant. This mod also add's different recipes that should be in vanilla like wool giving you string since you can make wool with string. Even craftable chainmail, and rotten flesh being useful?

**---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**

This mod only supports 1.21.1 and 1.21.8 as of right now. (1.21.1 for wide range of mod compatibility and 1.21.8 for all the people who want spears, copper armor and things alike while playing.)

title: PluralBackupJava
description: PluralBackup is an automatic hot backup plugin for Minecraft Java Edition servers
body:
## Features

- **Scheduled Automatic Backup**: Configurable backup interval, default 60 minutes
- **Time-Based Backup Mode**: Trigger backups at specific times in a specified timezone (supports 24/12-hour format)
- **Manual Backup Trigger**: Execute backup immediately via command
- **Startup Backup**: Auto-execute backup on server start (optional)
- **Hot Backup**: Asynchronous execution, non-blocking main thread
- **World Save Control**: Save worlds before backup, pause autosave during backup to prevent data inconsistency
- **Compressed Backup**: Support compressing backups as zip format to save disk space
- **Backup File Management**: Auto-clean old backups, keep specified count of recent backups (also cleans after manual GitHub upload)
- **Multi-Cloud Upload**: Local directory, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV, Baidu Netdisk, 123 Cloud
- **GitHub Backup**: Upload/download backups via GitHub Release API, supports auto-creation of private repository
- **Alert Notifications**: Send alerts via Email, Lark bot, DingTalk bot on backup failure
- **Backup Restore**: Restore world data from specified backup (will reload worlds)
- **Hot Config Reload**: Reload config without server restart
- **Status Query**: View plugin status and scheduler info

## Installation

1. Download the latest `PluralBackupJava-1.0.0.jar`
2. Place the jar file in the server's `plugins/` directory
3. Start the server, the plugin will auto-generate default config at `plugins/PluralBackup/config.yml`
4. Edit the config file as needed
5. Execute `/backup reload` or restart the server to apply changes

## Commands

All commands require `pluralbackup.admin` permission (default: OP).

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/backup now` | Execute a backup immediately |
| `/backup list` | List all backups |
| `/backup restore <backup-name>` | Restore specified backup |
| `/backup clean` | Clean old backups |
| `/backup reload` | Reload configuration file |
| `/backup status` | View plugin status |
| `/backup github-list` | List backup versions on GitHub |
| `/backup github-download <version>` | Download specified version from GitHub |
| `/backup github-upload` | Backup server and upload to GitHub |

Aliases: `/pbackup`, `/pluralbackup`

## Configuration

Config file located at `plugins/PluralBackup/config.yml`:

```yaml
# Basic Backup Settings
backup:
  auto-backup: true              # Enable automatic backup (interval mode)
  interval-minutes: 60           # Backup interval in minutes (interval mode only)
  backup-on-start: false         # Execute backup on server start
  broadcast-message: true        # Broadcast backup messages
  # Scheduled backup (time-based trigger, independent from interval mode, can be enabled together)
  schedule:
    enabled: false               # Enable time-based mode
    timezone: "Asia/Shanghai"    # Trigger timezone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai, America/New_York, Europe/London
    use-24-hour-format: true     # Use 24-hour format (false for 12-hour format with AM/PM)
    times:                       # Trigger times list
      - "00:00"                  # 24-hour examples: ["00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00"]
      - "12:00"                  # 12-hour examples: ["12:00 AM", "06:00 AM", "12:00 PM", "06:00 PM"]

backup-dir: "backups"            # Backup directory (relative to plugin data folder)
max-backups: 10                  # Maximum backup count (0 = unlimited)
compress: true                   # Compress as zip

exclude-dirs:                    # Excluded directories (relative to server root)
  - "plugins/PluralBackup/backups"

# Backup Behavior
save-world-before-backup: true   # Save all worlds before backup
pause-autosave-during-backup: true  # Pause autosave during backup
file-copy-retry-count: 3         # File copy retry count
file-copy-retry-delay-ms: 500    # Retry delay in milliseconds

# Cloud Upload
cloud:
  enabled: false
  type: "local"                  # local / ftp / webdav / baidu / pan123
  local:
    path: "cloud-backups"
  ftp:
    host: "127.0.0.1"
    port: 21
    username: "ftpuser"
    password: "ftppass"
    remote-dir: "/backups"
    use-ssl: false
  webdav:
    url: "https://dav.example.com/backups"
    username: "user"
    password: "pass"
  # Baidu Netdisk (https://pan.baidu.com/union/console)
  baidu:
    app-id: ""
    app-secret: ""
    app-folder: ""               # Product name, files stored at /我的应用数据/{app-folder}/
    access-token: ""             # Leave empty for auto-fetch and cache
  # 123 Cloud (https://www.123pan.cn/developer)
  pan123:
    client-id: ""
    client-secret: ""
    access-token: ""             # Leave empty for auto-fetch and cache
    parent-folder-id: 0          # Target folder ID, 0 for root

# Alert Notifications
notification:
  enabled: false                 # Enable backup failure notifications
  # Email notification
  email:
    enabled: false
    smtp-host: ""                # e.g. smtp.qq.com
    smtp-port: 465
    use-ssl: true
    username: ""                 # Sender login account
    password: ""                 # Authorization code (QQ Mail requires auth code)
    from: ""                     # Sender email
    to: ""                       # Recipient email
    subject: "PluralBackup Backup Alert"
  # Lark bot
  feishu:
    enabled: false
    webhook: ""                  # Custom bot Webhook
    secret: ""                   # Signing secret (leave empty if not using signature)
  # DingTalk bot
  dingtalk:
    enabled: false
    webhook: ""                  # Custom bot Webhook
    secret: ""                   # Signing secret (leave empty if not using signature)

# GitHub Backup
github:
  enabled: false
  token: "your-github-token"     # PAT with repo permission
  owner: "your-username"
  repo: "PluralGamneBackup"
  auto-create-repo: true         # Auto-create private repo if not exists

# Message Settings
backup-start-message: "§e[Backup] §bServer is performing automatic backup..."
backup-done-message: "§e[Backup] §aBackup complete! Time: {time}s"
backup-fail-message: "§e[Backup] §cBackup failed: {error}"
```

## GitHub Backup Instructions

1. Create GitHub Personal Access Token with `repo` permission, recommend no expiration
2. Configure `token`, `owner`, `repo` in config file
3. Enable `github.enabled: true`
4. Private repo auto-created if not exists (requires `auto-create-repo: true`)
5. Empty repo auto-initialized (README.md written), otherwise Release creation fails
6. Backup files uploaded as Release Assets, single file limit 2GB
7. GitHub scheduled backup shares `interval-minutes` with local backup
8. All network operations (upload/download) execute asynchronously, non-blocking main thread
9. Manual `/backup github-upload` will auto-clean local old backups (subject to `max-backups` limit)

## Dual-Mode Scheduled Backup

The plugin supports two independent trigger modes that can be enabled simultaneously:

**1. Interval Mode** (`backup.auto-backup: true` + `backup.interval-minutes: 60`)
- Execute backup every N minutes
- Suitable for high-frequency backup scenarios

**2. Time-Based Mode** (`backup.schedule.enabled: true`)
- Execute backup at specific times in a specified timezone
- Supports custom timezone (e.g. `Asia/Shanghai`, `America/New_York`, `Europe/London`)
- Supports 24-hour format (`HH:mm`, e.g. `00:00`, `12:00`, `18:30`)
- Supports 12-hour format (`hh:mm a`, e.g. `12:00 AM`, `06:00 PM`)
- Multiple trigger times configurable

Both modes can be enabled together without conflict. Example: interval mode backs up every hour, time-based mode adds extra backups at 00:00 and 12:00 daily.

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `pluralbackup.admin` | OP | Use all backup management commands |

## Build

```bash
mvn clean package
```

Generated jar file at `target/PluralBackupJava-1.0.0.jar`.

title: Obscure RTPQ
description: ObscureRTPQ is a high-performance, asynchronous matchmaking queue extension built for modern Spigot and Paper Minecraft server platforms targeting Minecraft 1.21+.
body:
ObscureRTPQ

ObscureRTPQ is a high-performance, asynchronous matchmaking queue extension built for modern Spigot and Paper Minecraft server platforms targeting Minecraft 1.21+.

It provides a competitive "Crystal PvP" style matchmaking loop that pairs players using non-blocking concurrent collection arrays. Matched players are seamlessly distributed into identical random coordinates with a structural safety coordinate offset. The plugin features full runtime customization using an in-game GUI inventory menu that interfaces natively with both default server worlds and custom worlds managed by Multiverse-Core.
🛠️ Features Implemented

    Thread-Safe Matchmaking Queue: Backed by an isolated ConcurrentLinkedQueue sequence inside the QueueManager to manage swift entry updates cleanly without thread contention, memory deadlocks, or lag spikes.
    Asynchronous Coordinate Processing (RtpProvider): Offloads heavy world block verification calculations to a background CompletableFuture worker thread, ensuring main-thread TPS remains unaffected while processing teleport safety frames.
    Seamless Multiverse-Core Integration: Built to load post-world (POSTWORLD), allowing it to automatically recognize, register, and interface with custom imported or generated Multiverse worlds right out of the box.
    In-Game Admin Configuration GUI Menu: Administrators can execute /rtpq config to pull up an interactive chest inventory displaying all active worlds. Clicking options dynamically updates and saves active matching worlds to the server disk in real-time.
    Strict World Guard Restrictions: Restricts queue actions via dedicated runtime validation checks. Players cannot join the queue from unlisted worlds, and players who shift between worlds while sitting in the queue are automatically filtered out safely.
    Isolated Administrative Debug Layer: Admins can trigger /rtpq debug to toggle a solo matching script. While active, joining the queue simulates finding a dummy match instantly to test chat strings, target locations, offsets, and audio sound mechanics completely alone.

In vanilla Minecraft, copper oxidizes on its own — but it takes forever. This plugin lets you fast-forward the process: dip a copper block into a water cauldron and instantly receive the next oxidation stage.

Supports all stages and all types of copper blocks: normal → exposed → weathered → oxidized. Waxed and fully oxidized copper are ignored — just like you'd expect from game logic.

## Features:

- Supports all copper block types and slabs
- Full four-stage oxidation chain
- Waxed blocks are ignored (prevents accidental use)
- Cauldron loses one water level per use
- Smoke particles and sound effects

title: Mini Nations
description: A Minecraft Nations Based Mini plugin
body:
# 🏰 Mini Nations

**Mini Nations** is a fast-paced Minecraft Nations PvP gamemode plugin built for Paper 1.21.x.

Compete in one of four powerful nations, defend your Nexus, and conquer enemy kingdoms in strategic battles where teamwork, roles, and survival matter.

The world is divided into four nations:

- 🌳 Jungle Nation (Green)
- 🏜️ Desert Nation (Yellow)
- ❄️ Ice Nation (White)
- ⛰️ Mountain Nation (Gray)

Each nation fights to protect its Nexus — the core of their kingdom. Destroy the enemy Nexus to eliminate their nation. The last surviving nation wins the game.

---

## ⚔️ Core Gameplay

Every player belongs to a nation and a role:

- 👑 King (3 Hearts)
- ⚔️ General (2 Hearts)
- 🛡️ Player (1 Heart)

The heart system is a custom progression system that replaces vanilla survival balance.

Players lose hearts on death. When hearts reach zero, the player is eliminated (configurable: Ban / Spectator / Temporary Ban).

---

## 💙 Heart System

- Custom hearts stored per player (UUID-based)
- No vanilla health dependency
- Hearts decrease on death (configurable)
- ActionBar displays current status:

Example:
💙💙🩶

- 💙 = remaining hearts
- 🩶 = lost hearts
- Updates every second
- Always synchronized with player data

---

## 🧿 Nexus System

Each nation has exactly ONE Nexus.

The Nexus is NOT a block, but a visual entity system using:

- ItemDisplay (main core)
- TextDisplay (label)

Features:

- Large floating object (2.5x - 4x scale)
- Smooth continuous rotation
- Nation-specific particle effects
- Visible from long distance

Example:
🌳 Jungle Nation
NEXUS

---

## ⛏️ Nexus Capture System

Nexus capture is the core mechanic of the game.

To capture a Nexus:

- Player must sneak (shift) continuously for 10 seconds
- Progress is shown via BossBar (0% → 100%)
- Capture is interrupted if:
  - Player stops sneaking
  - Player takes damage
  - Player dies
  - Player leaves range

If interrupted:
- Progress resets
- BossBar is removed
- Capture task is cancelled

---

## 🏆 Capture Result

When capture is successful:

- Nexus is destroyed (all display entities removed)
- Nation is marked as eliminated
- Player receives the Nexus item in their inventory

The Nexus item is a normal item representing the conquered nation. It includes name, lore, and future-proof metadata (CustomModelData + PersistentDataContainer).

No trophy system is used — only the item reward.

---

## 🔁 Recapture System

- Nations can be captured again at any time
- No cooldowns
- Infinite war cycles possible
- Nations can fall and rise repeatedly throughout the match

---

## 🧠 Features

- Fully configurable system (config.yml)
- Role system (King, General, Player)
- Custom ActionBar HUD
- BossBar capture system
- Display entity Nexus system
- Smooth rotation + particles
- Clean modular architecture
- Fully expandable for future features

---

## ⚙️ Technical Requirements

- Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21+
- Gradle (Kotlin DSL preferred)
- Adventure API for messaging
- Bukkit Scheduler for tasks (ActionBar, rotation, capture logic)
- PersistentDataContainer for player data

---

## 🚀 Planned Features

- Alliances system
- War declarations
- Territory claiming system
- Seasons / resets
- Economy system
- Advanced nation upgrades

---

## 📌 Summary

Mini Nations is a strategic PvP nations plugin focused on:

- Team-based warfare
- Tactical Nexus captures
- Custom progression system
- Fast-paced competitive gameplay
- Unique visual Nexus mechanics

title: TentSystem
description: 🏠 TentSystem — Portable Dwellings Plugin (Tents & Caravans)
body:
🏠 TentSystem — Portable Dwellings Plugin (Tents & Caravans)
TentSystem is an advanced gameplay plugin for Minecraft servers that completely redefines survival, raiding, and player positioning. It allows players to craft, deploy, siege, and carry their own mobile bases (tents, caravans, outposts) right in their pockets.

A player can set up camp anywhere in the world with a single click, instantly teleport to it, and fold the entire structure back into an item when it's time to move. However, these homes are no longer invulnerable: they feature a built-in durability system, meaning they can be besieged, destroyed, or repaired using iron.

🛠 Administrator Guide: Creating Templates via WorldEdit
The process of creating new dwelling types is fully integrated with the popular WorldEdit plugin, eliminating the need to manually configure block coordinates in configuration files:

1. Build the Structure: Build a tent, caravan, or tactical outpost directly in-game.

2. Select the Region: Select your build using the WorldEdit wooden wand (//wand).

3. Set the Center Point: Stand exactly where you want the player to land when teleporting (or at the center of the future foundation) and type the save command:

## /tent save <template_name>

The plugin will automatically copy the blocks within the selection, bind them to the relative coordinates of your current position, and save it as an internal schematic file.

4. Configure Durability: You can set individual "health" (HP) values for each template in the config.yml file:


```
tents:
  kibitka_medium:
    max-durability: 500  # The maximum durability of the dwelling
    repair-material: IRON_INGOT # The material required for repairs
    repair-amount: 25   # How much durability one iron ingot restores
```
5. Bind CustomModelData: Assign a unique model ID to the template in the config. This allows a standard Minecraft item to turn into a beautiful 3D weapon/item model of a tent in the player's hands via your server's resource pack.

🎒 Player Mechanics: Management, Sieges, and Repairs
🚀 1. Deploying the Dwelling
How to place: Hold the item with the 3D tent model in your hand and Right-Click (RMB) on the ground.

What happens: The item is consumed from your inventory, and a complete structure instantly generates on the spot. Simultaneously, the entire building is automatically protected by a private region assigned to the owner's UUID.

⚔️ 2. Durability and Raiding (Siege System)
Every deployed dwelling has its own durability pool specified in the configuration.

How to destroy: Enemy players can attack the structure (damage mechanics are fully customizable, such as hitting the central control block with weapons or using TNT/artillery explosions).

What happens: Taking damage lowers the home's durability. If the durability drops to 0, the dwelling is completely demolished, the protection claim vanishes, and all chests and resources inside become fair game for the attackers.

🛠️ 3. Repairing the Dwelling
The owner (or players with trusted access) can restore their shelter's durability after a rough siege or general wear and tear.

How to repair: Approach the central control block inside the house with iron ingots in your inventory and type /tent repair (or click the control block with an iron ingot). Each ingot restores a fixed amount of durability specified in the config.

📦 4. Packing Up (Folding the House)
How to retrieve: Approach the central control block inside the house, hold Shift (Crouch) + Left-Click (LMB).

Condition: You can only pack up the dwelling if you are the rightful owner and its durability is at maximum health (or above a specific threshold). Once packed, the structure vanishes from the world, and the deployment item is returned to your inventory.

🛡 Security and Anti-Griefing Protection
The plugin features an intelligent validation system to prevent any attempts to grief the world map or exploit claims:

Overlap Check: The dwelling will only deploy if there is enough space in the chosen location. If the structure's blueprint overlaps with another player's claim (WorldGuard / Towny / custom regions) or solid terrain (mountains, existing buildings, trees), the plugin will block the installation and display an error.

Foliage Bypass: To save players from manually clearing fields, the plugin ignores grass, ferns, and tall grass. When generating the house, these blocks are simply overwritten by the structure's blocks.

Smart Teleportation (/tent tp): When teleporting to a dwelling, the plugin calculates coordinates precisely to the center of a safe block, eliminating suffocation damage or getting stuck inside walls.

title: Octaves of the One
description: A Fabric tech mod for Minecraft 1.21.4 themed on Walter Russell's two-way universe of rhythmic balanced interchange. Draw Light from the still centre, wind it through the octaves, and spend it across a wired and wireless grid.
body:
# Octaves of the One

A Fabric tech mod for Minecraft **1.21.4**, themed on **Walter Russell's cosmology** — the *two-way universe* of **rhythmic balanced interchange**. Draw **Light** from the still centre of zero, wind it up through the octaves by **generation** (compression), pour it back out by **radiation** (expansion), and spend it across a wired *and* wireless grid to run machines, fly, farm, and transmute matter.

> Light is **carried, not consumed**. The cosmology is flavour, not physics — but every block maps to one of Russell's ideas, so the tech tree reads as a working model of his system.

## The loop, end to end

Everything is craftable from scratch in survival, and the in-game **Great Work advancement tree** guides you through it step by step.

- **Mine & refine** — Echocite ore → Echo Ingot, the core of every recipe. Drumstone and Silentite (Deep Dark) add further branches.
- **Generate Light** — the Resonant Coil winds ambient sound into stored Light; the Stillness Core trickles it from rest; the Octave Coil and Storm Caller power the late game.
- **Carry & bank** — Wave Conduits move Light on a network with fair, no-starvation distribution; Resonance Cells bank it; the Balancer keeps cells even.
- **Spend it** — the Compressor doubles ore, the Transmuter smelts with no fuel, and the radiation family (Growth/Warmth Radiator, Polarity Field) pours Light back into the world. The Resonant Thrusters give look-direction flight.
- **Go wireless** — tune devices to a shared channel and beam items, fluids, and Light with no conduit: the Wave Relay and a full family of channel gadgets.
- **Transmute** — every item has a **Light Value**; the Transmutation Table is your personal Bound-Light account: dissolve matter to bank it, withdraw Mote coins, or condense anything you've attuned.
- **Build the garden** — the glowing Lumewood set, Lumebloom, Lume Lantern, Echocite Bricks, and Verdant Loam.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.4** (Fabric) · **Fabric API** (required) · Java **21**

## Links

- 📖 Wiki: https://trystar360.github.io/echoes-of-the-deep/
- 💾 Source: https://github.com/Trystar360/echoes-of-the-deep

*Open-source under the MIT license.*

title: OGDeathSwap
description: OGDeathSwap is a lightweight, free Minecraft plugin built for 1.21+ (requires Java 17) that allows players to run custom DeathSwap matches.
body:
# OGDeathSwap

**OGDeathSwap** is a lightweight, high-performance DeathSwap plugin built for modern Minecraft servers. Inspired by popular content creators, this plugin allows you to easily host intense, automated DeathSwap matches with your friends or community with zero hassle. 

Every few minutes, players are randomly swapped into each other's positions—your only goal is to set deadly traps right before the swap occurs and be the last player standing.

![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a97ce059330b7998923b49600ccca8c505dd3af0.png)

---

## 🚀 Features

* **Modern Version Support:** Built from the ground up to natively support **Minecraft 1.21 and above**.
* **Flexible Team Dynamics:** Supports standard 1v1 play as well as asymmetric challenges like 1v2 or custom group setups.
* **Fully Configurable Timers:** Easily alter the game pace by changing the swap intervals directly in the configuration.
* **Lightweight & Optimized:** Runs efficiently on modern server software without causing performance drops during teleports.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

Get your game set up in less than two minutes using these straightforward commands:

* `/ds addplayer <player>` – Adds a specific player to the upcoming match. *Note: You must manually add all participating players, including yourself.*
* `/ds team <player>` – Groups a player into a team for multi-player swap challenges.
* `/ds start` – Commences the match and starts the swap countdown.
* `/ds reload` – Instantly applies changes made to the configuration file without needing a server restart.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

By default, the plugin is configured with a **5-minute** swap interval. To customize the game length:

1. Open the plugin's generated `config.yml` file.
2. Locate the interval setting and enter your desired time **in seconds** (e.g., for a 15-minute game, set it to `900`).
3. Save the file and run `/ds reload` in-game to apply the changes.

---

## 📌 Requirements & Installation

* **Server Software:** PaperMC, Purpur, or Spigot (**1.21+** recommended).
* **Java Version:** Requires **Java 17** or higher.
* **Installation:** Drop the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins` folder and restart your server.

body:

# Aevum ⏳

Create, manage, and track **timers** and **stopwatches** — global, per-player, or per-team.

---

## What it does 💫

- **Timers & stopwatches** — countdowns that end, or clocks that count up.
- **Pick a scope** — one **global** instance, one **per player**, or one **per team** (via [Stella](https://wiki.drygo.dev/stella)).
- **Target anyone** — a player, a team, or `@all` at once; players act on their own by default.
- **Checkpoints** — record named **marks** (e.g. "time to reach the Nether") with their time and timestamp.
- **They stick around** — every timer, stopwatch, and mark is saved and restored after a restart.
- **Config-driven rewards** — run commands/messages on tick, on end, or on a mark, with simple `%placeholder%` conditions.
- **No commands to memorize** — tab-completion suggests names, scopes, and targets as you type.
- **Make it yours** — change every message and the action config; reload live.
- **Placeholders & a developer API** — show times anywhere, or drive Aevum from your own plugin via events and `AevumAPI`.

## Commands

Everything lives under `/aevum`.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/aevum timer create <name> <time> [scope] [target]` | Create a countdown timer |
| `/aevum stopwatch create <name> [scope] [target]` | Create a stopwatch |
| `/aevum <type> add\|remove\|set <name> <time> [target]` | Adjust the time |
| `/aevum <type> status <name> [target]` | Show time and state |
| `/aevum <type> pause\|resume <name> [target]` | Pause or resume |
| `/aevum stopwatch reset <name> [target]` | Reset a stopwatch to zero |
| `/aevum <type> mark <name> <label> [target]` | Record a checkpoint |
| `/aevum <type> marks <name> [target]` | List checkpoints |
| `/aevum <type> unmark <name> <label\|*> [target]` | Remove a checkpoint (`*` = all) |
| `/aevum <type> list` | List all timers / stopwatches |
| `/aevum <type> delete <name> [target]` | Remove an instance |
| `/aevum help` | Show the command list |
| `/aevum reload` | Reload config & messages |

*(`<type>` is `timer` or `stopwatch`.)*

**Scopes:** `global` (default), `player`, `team`. **Targets:** a player name, a team id, or `@all` — omit it and you act on your own instance. **Time:** `90`, `90s`, `5m`, `1h30m`, `2d`.

Type `/aevum help` in-game to see everything.

## Placeholders 🪧

Resolve to the viewing player's own instance (or their team's):

```
%aevum_timer_<name>_time%        %aevum_stopwatch_<name>_time%
%aevum_timer_<name>_seconds%     %aevum_stopwatch_<name>_seconds%
%aevum_timer_<name>_status%      %aevum_stopwatch_<name>_status%
%aevum_<type>_<name>_mark_<label>%   (+ _seconds, _at)
```

## Links 🔗

- **[Wiki](https://wiki.drygo.dev/aevum)** — setup, commands, and the developer API.
- **[GitHub](https://github.com/33drygo/aevum)** — source code and bug reports.

---

*Aevum — timers and stopwatches with scopes, checkpoints, and an API.*

title: Raft
description: A paper plugin that adds a minigame survival experience inspired by the video game Raft.
body:
# Raft
Raft is a Minecraft paper plugin that adds a minigame survival experience inspired by the video game Raft
## Gameplay
- You start on a raft in the middle of the ocean, gathering supplies that the current brings you to survive.
However, that same current can mean your doom so don't fall in!
- Survive random events that range from helpful, to silly, to deadly.
- Head out on expeditions to explore mysterious islands and wrecks, but be back before the boat leaves...
- Defeat monsters in events to gather enough obsidian to build a nether portal, which will bring you to a boss fight to win the game!

## Setup/usage
- Download the JAR and put it into your server's `plugins` folder.
- Set `allow-flight=true` in your `server.properties` file to avoid kicking players
- It is recommended to install `NoteBlockAPI` as certain events have music, but the game will run without it
- Once in the game, run `/raft start` to begin! (op needed) If you stop the server and then restart it, you will need to run `/raft start` again but the world and player inventories will be saved
- You can use `/raft event` to manually trigger an event
- You can use `/raft resetWorld` to fully reset the game and player inventories
- You can change game settings in the plugin's `config.yml`
## Notes
Raft is meant to be a standalone experience and not part of a larger server.

Specifically, it will automatically put all players on the server into the world the plugin made
and override some other things. 

However, the plugin won't mess with other worlds or settings on the server
so if you install Raft and then uninstall it, your server will not be affected.

# ✨ SparkTPA

A modern, feature-rich teleport request plugin for Paper, Spigot, and Purpur servers. SparkTPA replaces outdated TPA systems with beautiful GUIs, clickable chat buttons, BossBar warmups, sounds, titles, particle effects, and a fully customizable experience.

## 🚀 Features

* 📨 Send teleport requests with `/tpa`
* 📍 Request players to teleport to you with `/tpahere`
* 🌐 Request all online players with `/tpahereall`
* 🖱️ Modern GUI Accept/Deny menu
* 💬 Clickable chat buttons
* ⏳ Teleport warmup system
* 📊 BossBar teleport countdown
* 🔊 Custom sounds with SoundManager caching
* ✨ Particle effects for teleport events
* 🎨 MiniMessage support
* 📢 Titles & ActionBars
* 🔇 Ignore specific players
* 🔒 Toggle incoming requests
* 🛡️ Anti-spam protection with CooldownManager
* ⚡ Lightweight & optimized with batch async saving
* 🔧 Fully configurable
* 🚨 Teleport safety checks (lava, magma, campfire, void, solid blocks)
* 🔄 Modrinth update checker (OP-only notifications)
* 📝 Tab completion for all commands

---

![Accept/Deny GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16d1a35bb56114af9e8f478d05d4f51f2ea64611.png)

## 📖 Commands

| Command               | Description                     |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `/tpa <player>`       | Send a teleport request         |
| `/tpahere <player>`   | Ask a player to teleport to you |
| `/tpahereall`         | Request all online players      |
| `/tpaccept <player>`  | Accept a request                |
| `/tpadeny <player>`   | Deny a request                  |
| `/tpacancel`          | Cancel an outgoing request      |
| `/tpaignore <player>` | Ignore/unignore a player        |
| `/tpatoggle`          | Toggle all incoming requests    |
| `/sparktpa reload`    | Reload configuration files      |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission                | Use              |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `sparktpa.tpa`            | Use `/tpa`               |
| `sparktpa.tpahere`        | Use `/tpahere`           |
| `sparktpa.tpahereall`     | Use `/tpahereall`        |
| `sparktpa.accept`         | Use `/tpaccept`          |
| `sparktpa.deny`           | Use `/tpadeny`           |
| `sparktpa.cancel`         | Use `/tpacancel`         |
| `sparktpa.ignore`         | Use `/tpaignore`         |
| `sparktpa.toggle`         | Use `/tpatoggle`         |
| `sparktpa.admin`          | Access admin commands    |
| `sparktpa.bypasscooldown` | Bypass request cooldowns |
| `sparktpa.bypassdelay`    | Bypass teleport warmups  |
| `sparktpa.safety.bypass`  | Bypass teleport safety checks |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

SparkTPA is fully configurable:

* 🎨 Messages with MiniMessage formatting
* 🔊 Sounds with SoundManager caching
* ⏳ Cooldowns with centralized CooldownManager
* ⏰ Request expiration
* 📊 BossBar settings (color, style, title, sounds)
* 🖱️ GUI settings (title, accept/deny items)
* 📢 Titles & ActionBars
* 🚀 Teleport warmups
* ✨ Particle effects (request-sent, request-accepted, request-denied, teleport, arrival)
* 🛡️ Safety checks (lava, magma, campfire, void, solid blocks)
* 🔄 Update checker (Modrinth integration)

---

## 📦 Supported Versions

* Paper 1.21+
* Purpur 1.21+
* Spigot 1.21+

---

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download the latest `sparktpa-1.0.0.jar`
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure the plugin in `plugins/SparkTPA/config.yml` and `plugins/SparkTPA/messages.yml`

---

## ⚡ Performance Optimizations

SparkTPA is optimized for small servers and SMPs:

* 🔄 Single cleanup task for request expiration (instead of per-request tasks)
* 💾 Batch async saving every 5 minutes (reduces disk I/O)
* 🔊 SoundManager caching (avoids repeated enum lookups)
* 🚫 Particle effects disabled by default (can be enabled in config)
* ⚡ Removed unnecessary synchronization (ConcurrentHashMap is thread-safe)
* 📦 Lightweight memory footprint
* 🎯 Minimal CPU overhead

---

title: SovaAntiLag
description: Heuristic anti-lag against redstone lag machines — without breaking legit farms.
body:
# 🦉 SovaAntiLag

**Heuristic anti-lag for redstone lag machines — without breaking legitimate farms.**

Most anti-lag plugins use hard limits (e.g. "max 8 hoppers per chunk") that punish honest
players as much as griefers. SovaAntiLag takes a different approach: it measures how *useful*
a chunk's activity actually is, and only intervenes when a chunk is clearly burning ticks for
nothing — and even then it reacts **softly and gradually**.

## How it works

Every chunk gets a **Productivity Score**:

```
P = U_redstone / (A_useful + 1)
```

- **U_redstone** — redstone churn: piston/dispenser/dropper firings, redstone signal changes.
- **A_useful** — real work: hopper item transfers, crop growth, block breaking, mob deaths.

A high score means *lots of activity, no payoff* → a likely lag machine. A productive farm has
plenty of `U_redstone` **and** plenty of `A_useful`, so its score stays low and it is left alone.

> The plugin only starts actively scanning when the server is genuinely struggling
> (`MSPT > 40 ms` by default). When the server is healthy, it stays out of the way.

## Soft, staged response

1. **Throttle** — suspicious chunk's redstone events are skipped with an 80% chance. The machine
   slows down instead of dying.
2. **Freeze** — if MSPT still doesn't recover, redstone in that chunk is fully paused for 5 minutes.
3. **Recovery** — once the server is healthy again, restrictions lift automatically.

## Specialized modules

- **🔁 Idle Loop Detector** — empty dispensers/droppers fired in a tight loop get silenced until
  an item actually enters them.
- **💡 Light Spam Limiter** — redstone lamps flickering many times per second get locked ON briefly.
- **🧍 Entity Physics Capping** — huge stacks of entities (armor stands, etc.) in one block get
  their collision temporarily disabled.

## Compatibility

- **Cores:** Bukkit · Spigot · **Paper** · Purpur · Pufferfish. **Folia** supported (experimental).
- **Minecraft:** 1.20.6 – 1.21.x (Java 21).

## Commands & permissions

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/sal status` | Show MSPT, detected core, tracked chunks |
| `/sal top` | List the most suspicious chunks |
| `/sal reload` | Reload config and language |

Permission: `sovaantilag.admin` (default: OP).

## Languages

Ships with **English (default), Русский, Deutsch, Español, Français, 简体中文, Português (BR), Українська**.
Set `language:` in `config.yml`, or edit any file in `plugins/SovaAntiLag/lang/`.

## Configuration

Everything is tunable — thresholds, throttle chance, freeze duration, per-module toggles, and an
optional Discord webhook for chunk alerts. See `config.yml`.

---

*Open to issues and translation PRs. "Sova" (сова) means "owl" — the watchful kind.*

# TravelTools

**Four travel utilities in one jar — for Paper/Spigot 1.26.x.**

TravelTools merges four small quality-of-life plugins into one, with each module individually toggleable in `config.yml`.

## Modules
- 🧭 **spawn** — `[Spawn]` signs that teleport players to spawn. Command-free for players.
- 🧭 **compass** — a distributed compass item that points players to targets; managed via signs (`[Compass]`).
- 🌀 **portalvis** — renders particles around Multiverse-Portals regions so players can actually *see* portals. Auto-disables itself if Multiverse-Portals is absent (other modules unaffected).
- 🔥 **nether** — announces a player's **first** nether entry server-wide (tracked via PDC, so it never re-announces, even across restarts).

## Design
- Players interact through signs and items only; commands are OP-only by default.
- One failed module never affects the others.
- Per-module configs in `plugins/TravelTools/modules/<id>.yml` — the old PortalVisualizer config can be reused by renaming it to `modules/portalvis.yml`.

## Setup
Drop the jar in `plugins/`, restart. Toggle modules via `modules.<id>.enabled` in `config.yml`.

title: Locked Crafting
description: This plugin allows you to make crafting recipes only work if you have specific items in your inventory.
body:
# Locked Crafting
A paper plugin

---

If you use this plugin in your paper server, 
you can make some crafting recipes only work if you have
set required items in your inventory.

By default, after trying to craft a locked recipe,
it will tell you what items you are missing,
and what required items you have.
You can stop it from telling you either or both of these.

---

## Some Uses:

One use for this plugin is to control the flow of powerful items, such as the mace. You would choose an item there is only one of on the server (either the dragon egg or a creative-only item you give to someone), and lock the use to that. That would be a way to give these rare but useless items a use, and keep players' power in check. If there is an economy plugin and some form of trade (such as an auction house), both the locked item and the key could sell for lots of money.

You could also use this plugin to lock items behind hard-to-get items, such as a spear behind a netherite block, without requiring you to do all that again if you lose it or it breaks. 

---

## How To Configure Messages

To configure this plugin, go to your server directory, then go to: \
    /plugins/LockedCrafting/config.yml

In the config.yml file, there is a section called _messages_.
You can configure these.

### Missing Requirements (messages.missingReqs)

When a player tries to craft an item but is blocked by this plugin,
the player will be sent a message in chat telling them why.
You can configure this message however you want, under messages.missingReqs \
The message goes like this:

1. It sends the message in pre
2. If sayMissing is set to true, it tells the player what items they are missing, with each item separated by a new line
3. It sends the message in between
4. If sayThere is set to true, it tells the player what required items they have, with each item separated by a new line.

---

## How to Configure Locked Recipes

To configure this plugin, go to your server directory, then go to: \
    /plugins/LockedCrafting/config.yml

In the config.yml file, there is a section called _recipes_. This is how you change recipe requirements.

### Recipes

Each recipe takes two layers of YAML code.
The first layer is the namespace of the recipe. In most cases, this namespace is _minecraft_, 
so if this is the case you can omit the namespace and just use the recipe name (as shown in the diamond_spear recipe in the default).
> #### How to find recipe names
> 
> When you put a recipe in the crafting grid, the logger will say: \
> _Crafting recipe namespace:key_ \
> You can use this to find the name of a recipe

If the namespace isn't minecraft, the outer layer is the namespace and the inner layer is the key, also known as the name. 
You can do this if the namespace is minecraft, as well, as shown by the mace recipe in the default.

### Requirements

Under a recipe, there is a list called _itemReqs_. 
Each element in the array corresponds to an item you need to have in order to craft this recipe.
Lists can be formatted in square brackets, like the diamond_spear example, or with dashes, like the mace example.

* **Built-in Login/Register:** Protect player accounts on your server without needing extra plugins.
* **Admin Controls:** Admins can reset player passwords instantly via `/resetpassword` (with shorthand aliases like `/rep` and `/rsp`).

* **Flight:** Toggle `/fly` for yourself or other players.
* **Settings GUI:** Use `/dcore` to open a master control panel where you can enable or disable any command in the plugin on the fly.

### ✨ Polish & Immersion
* **Stylized Messages:** Custom Join/Quit alerts and enhanced death messages (with icons!).

* **Minecraft Versions:** 1.17.x – 1.21.11 (Full cross-version support).

Command 1: The Next Stop Announcement
Use this when the train is moving between stations to announce where it is heading.

The Syntax: /subwaybound <target> <bound-name> <line-name> <local|express> nextstop <nextstop-name>

Example: /subwaybound @a Manhattan A express nextstop Times Square

What it prints in chat: > this is a Manhattan bound A express train, the next stop is Times Square.

Command 2: The Current Stop Announcement
Use this when the train arrives at a station to announce the current stop and any available transfers.

The Syntax (Without Transfers): /this-stop <target> <stop-name>

Example: /this-stop @a Times Square

What it prints in chat: > this is Times Square

The Syntax (With Transfers): /this-stop <target> <stop-name> transfer <lines...>

Example: /this-stop @a Times Square transfer the N Q R W 1 2 3 and 7 trains

What it prints in chat: > this is Times Square, transfer is available to the N Q R W 1 2 3 and 7 trains
