description: This mod adds more scoreboard criteria for creating different scoreboards on custom servers, allowing for personalized rankings and more.
body:
<details>
<summary>Mod Introduction (Machine translation)</summary>

This mod adds more scoreboard criteria for creating different scoreboards on custom servers, allowing for personalized rankings and more.

## Core Features

### New Criteria

- `[Namespace]_by_tag:[Name]`：Statistics based on tags. For example, `minecraft.mined_by_tag:minecraft.base_stone_overworld` represents the total number of blocks of stone in the Overworld mined by a player.

### Special Placeholders

- `morescoreboards.total`：Used for the name part of `[Namespace]_by_tag:[Name]`, representing the total sum of all contents under this statistic.

## Example

```mcfunction
/scoreboard objectives add used minecraft.used_by_tag:morescoreboards.total "Usage Items Ranking"
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>模组介绍</summary>

本模组增加了更多计分板准则，用于在定制服务器组合不同的计分板，提供个性化排名等。

## 核心功能

### 新准则

- `[命名空间]_by_tag:[名称]`：统计信息的标签版。例如，`minecraft.mined_by_tag:minecraft.base_stone_overworld`
  表示某玩家挖掘主世界石头的个数之和。

### 特殊占位符

- `morescoreboards.total`：用于`[命名空间]_by_tag:[名称]`的名称部分，表示该统计信息下的所有内容之和。

## 示例

```mcfunction
/scoreboard objectives add used minecraft.used_by_tag:morescoreboards.total "使用物品榜"
```

</details>

title: Teleport
description: A new & revised version of teleportation.
body:
A replacement for Minecraft's vanilla teleport commands. Everything runs through a single `/tp` command that handles player teleports, teleport requests, random teleports, coordinates, and entity selectors. Messages use MiniMessage and are fully configurable.

## Features

- **One command.** `/tp` works out what you mean from the arguments: players, coordinates, `random`, entity selectors, or the mob you're looking at.
- **Teleport requests.** Players without force permission send a request instead of teleporting someone directly. The target gets clickable `[ Accept ]` / `[ Decline ]` buttons.
- **Random teleport.** Per-dimension toggles, configurable radius and cooldown, and a safe-spot finder that avoids lava, water, and the void. Chunks load off the main thread, so it won't lag the server.
- **Coordinate teleports.** Absolute or `~` relative, with vanilla-style block centering.
- **Entity teleports.** Full vanilla selector support (`/tp @e[type=zombie] me`), plus `/tp look` for whatever mob is in your crosshair.
- **Configurable messages.** Every message supports MiniMessage gradients, hover text, and click actions, and can be routed to the action bar instead of chat.
- **Toggleable features.** Requests, coordinates, RTP, and entity teleports can each be turned off in the config.
- **No dependencies, no database.** Drop the jar in and go.

## Commands

Everything runs through `/tp` (alias `/teleport`):

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/tp <player>` | Teleport to a player, or send a request if you can't force |
| `/tp <player> me` | Bring a player to you, or request it |
| `/tp <x> <y> <z>` | Teleport to coordinates (`~` relative supported) |
| `/tp <player> <x y z>` | Move a player to coordinates |
| `/tp <player> <player2>` | Move a player to another player |
| `/tp random [dimension]` | Random teleport in the current or named dimension |
| `/tp @e[...] [destination]` | Teleport entities matched by a vanilla selector |
| `/tp look [destination]` | Teleport the mob you're looking at |
| `/tp accept` \| `deny [player]` | Respond to an incoming request |
| `/tp reload` | Reload the configuration |

## Permissions

| Node | Default | Grants |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `teleport.use` | everyone | Base `/tp` access |
| `teleport.coordinates` | everyone | Teleport yourself to coordinates |
| `teleport.request` | everyone | Request to teleport to a player |
| `teleport.summon` | everyone | Request to bring a player to you |
| `teleport.rtp` | everyone | Use random teleport |
| `teleport.rtp.dimensions` | everyone | Choose the random-teleport dimension |
| `teleport.rtp.cooldown.bypass` | op | Skip the random-teleport cooldown |
| `teleport.force` | op | Teleport players instantly, without a request |
| `teleport.entities` | op | Teleport entities via selectors / `look` |
| `teleport.reload` | op | Reload the configuration |

Players with `teleport.force` teleport others instantly. Everyone else automatically gets a prompt to *request* the teleport instead, with no extra config needed.

## Configuration

Everything is editable in `config.yml`. A few of the main options:

```yaml
features:
  coordinates: true
  requests: true        # /tp <player>  -> request to go to them
  summon-requests: true # /tp <player> me -> request to bring them
  entities: true

rtp:
  enabled: true
  min-radius: 500
  max-radius: 5000
  cooldown-seconds: 30
  dimensions:
    world: true
    world_nether: false
    world_the_end: false
```

- Restyle any message with MiniMessage (gradients, hover, click actions).
- Route messages to the action bar by adding their keys to the `action-bar` list.
- Enable RTP per dimension by world name.

New message keys added in updates are filled in automatically, so your edits are never overwritten.

## Installation

1. Download `Teleport.jar`.
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins/` folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. (Optional) Edit `plugins/Teleport/config.yml`, then run `/tp reload`.

Requires a [Paper](https://papermc.io/) server, or a Paper-based fork such as Purpur.

---

Made by Zero Development. Released under the MIT License.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/yapalmuffiny/Teleport) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/yapalmuffiny/Teleport/issues)

title: Join Effects
description: A modern, lightweight, and incredibly flexible plugin for creating unique player join effects on your server!
body:
JoinEffects is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable Paper plugin that allows server owners to create unique join effects for players. Unlike traditional join plugins that rely on hardcoded settings, JoinEffects uses a fully modular YAML-based engine. This allows you to create an unlimited number of custom effects, animations, and sequences directly from your configuration files.

### Core Features * **Modular Configurations:** Each effect is defined in its own YAML file. Keep your setups clean and organized. * **Sequence Engine:** Every effect runs step-by-step. You can sequence titles, sounds, particles, fireworks, and delays easily. * **Modern API Support:** Fully supports the Adventure API for MiniMessage formatting (gradients, hex colors) and PlaceholderAPI for dynamic text. * **LuckPerms Priority:** Effects are permission-based. The plugin automatically checks a player's permissions and plays the highest priority effect available to them. * **Performance Focused:** Built natively for Paper 1.21+ using Java 21. No outdated NMS, ensuring stability and long-term compatibility. ### Configuration Example ```yaml name: Owner Effect permission: joineffects.effect.owner priority: 100 sequence: - title - sound - delay:20 - message title: title: "Welcome, Owner!" subtitle: "All systems are online." fade-in: 10 stay: 60 fade-out: 10 sound: name: "entity.ender_dragon.growl" volume: 1.0 pitch: 1.0 ``` ### Commands and Permissions * `/joineffects` - View plugin information. * `/joineffects reload` - Reload all configurations. Requires `joineffects.reload`. * `/joineffects preview ` - Preview an effect before applying it. Requires `joineffects.preview`. To assign an effect to a player or group, give them the permission `joineffects.effect.`.

If you need support, have feature requests, or want to report a bug, feel free to join the Zenith Plugins Discord server.

body: ## [WARNING] This mod is currently in beta and is not considered stable. It is not recommended to include it in production servers or modpacks until a stable release is available. This version is provided for testing and preview purposes if you're interested in following its development. Please note that future updates may introduce breaking changes and could require creating a new world. --- **Echoes of Adventure: Runix Matrix** is a magic-themed portal mod focused on creating teleportation formulas using chalk-drawn magical patterns and rune manipulation. Players can draw portal formulas directly in the world using regular Chalk. These formulas create magical teleportation structures that range from simple portals to highly advanced rune-enhanced networks. The mod also introduces magical crafting formulas drawn on the ground. Instead of using traditional crafting tables, players create symbolic patterns using Chalk to craft special magical components. **Runic Chalks** are crafted through dedicated formula patterns and are later used to draw runes inside special portal nodes that are part of portal formulas. **Mana Stones** act as the primary magical fuel required for teleportation and portal activation. Basic portals come with standard parameters, but they can be heavily modified using runes. Different rune combinations influence portal behavior, magical effects, stability, efficiency, risks, and environmental interactions. ### Planned Features Checklist - [+] Ability to draw portal formulas. - [-] Ability to draw crafting formulas (patterns). - [-] Ability to craft Runic Chalks using magical formulas. - [-] Ability to draw runes inside special portal nodes. - [-] Ability to modify portals using runes. - [-] Portal modification with unique runes. - [-] 29 ready-to-use runes (*3 tiers). - [-] 29 Runic Chalk items. - [+] Mana Stone item. - [+] Chalk item. - [-] Guide Book item. - [-] Server config settings for Admin Chalk, allowing players to use admin portals. - [-] Datapack configuration support. --- ### Environmental Rune Influence - [-] Context-sensitive rune parameters. - [-] Biome-based rune parameter influence. - [-] Dimension-based rune parameter influence. --- ### Portal Risks & Debuff Effects - [-] Poison effects. - [-] Blindness effects. - [-] Weakness effects. - [-] Knockback effects. - [-] Burning effects. - [-] Direct damage effects. - [-] Portal explosions. - [-] Lightning strikes. - [-] Mob summoning events. --- ### Core Gameplay 1. Draw a magical formula using Chalk. 2. Activate the portal structure. 3. Craft Runic Chalks through magical crafting formulas. 4. Draw runes inside portal nodes. 5. Fuel teleportation using Mana Stones. 6. Modify and stabilize the portal. 7. Unlock stronger and more dangerous teleportation systems. # Bugs & Suggestions Found a bug? Something feels off? title: Cheati
description: Cheati - The best anticheat solution for paper servers
body:
Cheati

A configurable, false-positive-conscious anticheat for Paper servers — covering movement, combat, and world/inventory exploits.

Cheati watches the same player data your server already produces and flags suspicious activity to your staff in real time. It's built around one principle: catching cheaters shouldn't mean punishing legitimate players. A huge amount of Cheati's design goes into not firing on lag, knockback, sprint-jumps, or the dozens of normal-but-unusual things players do every day.

You decide how far it goes — from quiet staff alerts, to actively blocking cheated movement, to running your own punishment commands automatically. All per-check, all configurable, all reloadable live.


What it checks

Movement — Speed, Fly, NoFall, Jesus (water-walk), Phase (wall-clip), Step, NoSlow (including cobwebs, soul sand, berry bushes, and powder snow)

Combat — Reach, KillAura, AutoClicker

World & inventory — FastBreak, Nuker, Scaffold, AutoTool

Optional packet-level — Timer (requires PacketEvents)


More than alerts


Staff alerts with a decaying violation buffer and a non-decaying lifetime count, so isolated false reads fade out while sustained cheating keeps surfacing.
/cheati vl <player> to review a player's lifetime violations per check.
Opt-in action prevention, per check. Movement violations are corrected with a tracked setback to the player's last known-good position (not a crude rubber-band); combat and world violations cancel the offending action; NoFall applies the fall damage that was dodged. Enable it only where you want it.
Opt-in auto-punish. Instead of reinventing bans, Cheati runs your console commands at violation thresholds you set — so it plugs straight into whatever punishment plugin you already trust (LiteBans, AdvancedBan, vanilla /ban, anything).



Built to avoid false positives

This is where most of the work went:


Centralized exemptions for states where normal movement rules don't apply — flight, elytra gliding, vehicles, riptide, levitation, and more.
Grace windows after teleports, respawns, knockback, world changes, logins, flight toggles, gamemode changes, and trident launches.
Velocity/knockback tracking — server-applied velocity (knockback, explosions, fishing-rod pulls, wind charges) widens the relevant caps for the few ticks it actually matters, so legitimate launches don't read as Speed or Fly.
Latency compensation — grace windows scale with each player's real ping, so high-latency players aren't flagged for what's really just lag.
Gravity-based vertical prediction in the Fly check, compared against Minecraft's actual movement physics rather than a loose heuristic.
Per-check bypass permissions — exempt a trusted account from one specific check (cheati.bypass.<check>) without dropping every other protection.



Requirements

ServerPaper 1.21+ (or a fork such as Purpur / Pufferfish)Java21+PacketEventsOptional — only needed for the packet-level Timer check


Cheati uses Paper-specific API and does not run on plain Spigot or Bukkit.




Commands & permissions

/cheati reload — live-reload the configuration
/cheati alerts — toggle alert visibility
/cheati vl <player> — view a player's violations


cheati.alerts — receive alerts and use /cheati alerts / /cheati vl (default: op)
cheati.admin — use /cheati reload (default: op)
cheati.bypass / cheati.bypass.<check> — exempt from all, or one specific check (default: false)



Configuration

Everything is configurable and documented inline in config.yml — check toggles, sensitivity thresholds, per-check prevention, grace windows, latency scaling, and auto-punish ladders. Edit and run /cheati reload to apply without a restart.

A note on tuning: every server's playerbase moves differently. Cheati ships with sensible defaults, but enforcement (prevention and auto-punish) is best switched on after watching alert traffic for your own players first. The config comments call out which values to adjust if you see a false positive or a miss.

title: Chat Manager
description: Staff can clear, stop, or resume global server chat instantly. It also includes a permanent system to chat-ban players, unban them, and view the muted list.
body:
# ChatManager

A lightweight, modern, and highly efficient chat moderation plugin. Take complete control over your server's communication channel, stop spammers instantly, and keep your community safe.

This plugin uses Paper's native **Adventure API**, ensuring smooth, asynchronous, thread-safe chat manipulation and full support for modern text formatting.

---

## Features

* **Clear Chat:** Instantly wipe the global chat history to hide malicious links, severe spam, or rule-breaking content.
* **Mute/Resume Global Chat:** Freeze the entire chat instantly during important announcements or server emergencies.
* **Permanent File-Backed Chat Bans:** Permanently chat-ban individual players. Mutes persist cleanly through server reboots and reloads via a local file (`config.yml`).

---

## Commands & Permissions

By default, all staff have access to the commands.

| Command | Description | Default Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/chat clear` | Wipes active chat. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chat stop` | Halts global chat for non-staff. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chat resume` | Unfreezes global chat. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chatban <player>` | Bans a player from using chat. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/unchatban <player>` | Restores chat access for a player. | `chatmanager.staff` |
| `/chatbanlist` | Lists all currently chat-banned UUIDs/Names. | `chatmanager.staff` |

### Bypass Node
* **`chatmanager.bypass`**
  Give this permission to senior staff, administrators, or automated system accounts. Players with this permission node can still send messages even when global chat has been locked with `/chat stop`.

---

## Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar` file.
2. Drop it directly into your server's `/plugins/` folder.
3. Restart or start your server.
4. Configure permissions

title: Biomes SMP
description: This plugin makes the server a lot more interesting with biomes, including teams of the biomes and a huge battle!
body:
This plugin is for paper 1.21.11.

What happens when you join the server for the first time, you get shown a wheel with four biomes, forest (oak), taiga (spruce), dark oak, and jungle.

If you roll one of them, you get teleported to that biome and you have to build a base there and gather loot there.

The plains biome is free roam, you can loot anything in this biome and build a base there too.
However, some biomes are completely locked off, like birch, ice biomes, and cherry blossoms, and you can't do anything in them.

After two weeks of the server being up and on also, the battle begins, and everyone gets teleported to 0, 0.

If one biome wins, they get bragging rights.

There are also team leaders, being rolled one hour after the server starts.

However, you can still raid people and break and loot player-made builds and chests and anything!

title: BiomeModes
description: A configurable Paper plugin that assigns different gameplay modes to different biomes.
body:
# BiomeModes v1.0.0 – Initial Release

BiomeModes is a configurable Paper plugin that assigns different gameplay modes to different biomes. As players move through the world, the plugin automatically detects the biome they are in and activates the gamemode assigned to that biome. This allows every biome to provide a unique survival experience without requiring separate worlds or servers.

For example, a server owner can configure:

* Desert → Lifesteal
* Taiga → Headsteal
* Deep Dark → Hardcore
* Mushroom Fields → Keep Inventory
* Ocean → Adventure

Every biome-to-gamemode mapping is fully configurable, allowing server owners to create their own gameplay combinations.

## Features

* Automatic biome-based gamemode switching
* Fully configurable biome-to-gamemode mappings
* Lifesteal, Headsteal, Hardcore, Keep Inventory, and Adventure modes
* BossBar displaying the current biome and active gamemode
* Offline and online player revival using player heads
* Anti-farming protection for Lifesteal
* Configurable sounds, messages, and gameplay settings
* Automatic data saving and persistent player progress

## Tested On

* Paper 1.21.4

## Feedback

This is the first public release of BiomeModes. Feedback, bug reports, and feature suggestions are greatly appreciated and will help improve future updates.

# RiftMace RiftMace Plugin – Quick Summary Main Feature A custom “Rift Mace” weapon that can be wielded by players. It has a built‑in cooldown, special hit effects, and can be given or toggled via a simple comm ## What it does RiftMace Plugin – Quick Summary Main Feature A custom “Rift Mace” weapon that can be wielded by players. It has a built‑in cooldown, special hit effects, and can be given or toggled via a simple command. Commands Command Description Usage /riftmace Main command for the plugin. /riftmace give – gives the Rift Mace to a player.
/riftmace reload – reloads the plugin’s config.
/riftmace cooldown – changes the global cooldown time. /riftmace help Shows a short help page. /riftmace help All sub‑commands are optional; just typing /riftmace opens a help menu. Permissions Permission What it Allows riftmace.use Use the Rift Mace (hit detection & cooldown). riftmace.admin Access all /riftmace sub‑commands (give, reload, set cooldown). Configuration (config.yml) cooldown: 5 # default cooldown in seconds mace-name: "&6Rift Mace" mace-lore: - "&7A weapon forged from the void." - "&7It cracks reality on each hit." Changing the cooldown value updates the wait time between successful hits. Important Behaviors Cooldown Management – CooldownManager tracks each player’s last hit and blocks further damage until the configured time has passed. Event Listener – RiftMaceListener listens for EntityDamageByEntityEvent; when a player hits with the Rift Mace it: Checks the cooldown. Applies a small knock‑back and a visual particle burst. Sends a brief “Rift activated!” message to the attacker. Command Handling – RiftMaceCommand processes all /riftmace sub‑comman ## Compatibility - Paper 1.21.4 - Folia and Purpur supported via Paper API ## Source Generated and live-tested on https://pluginsmith.net before publishing. --- *Generated and live-tested with [PluginSmith.net](https://pluginsmith.net). title: Simple CTF
description: A simple Capture the Flag system for server events
body:
# Simple CTF

**Simple CTF** is a lightweight Capture the Flag plugin designed for survival, SMP, and roleplay servers that want a persistent objective instead of a separate minigame. Rather than creating teams, arenas, countdowns, and rounds, Simple CTF turns a flag into a living part of your world.

Players can hunt for the flag, steal it, move it, hide it, protect it, or build entire conflicts around it. The flag exists continuously, creating an ongoing experience that integrates naturally into normal gameplay.

----------

# Why Simple CTF?

Most Capture the Flag plugins are designed as minigames:

-   Separate arenas
-   Temporary matches
-   Team-based gameplay
-   Round timers
-   Scoreboards and lobbies

Simple CTF takes a different approach.

The flag is a physical object that exists in your world at all times. There are no teams, no rounds, and no resets unless you choose to move the flag yourself.

This allows players to:

-   Organize their own factions
-   Create rivalries naturally
-   Build defenses around the flag
-   Launch raids to steal it
-   Hide it in secret locations
-   Track it across the world using special compasses

Whether you're running an SMP, geopolitical server, roleplay server, or a custom adventure experience, Simple CTF gives players a shared objective without changing the way they normally play.

----------

# Creating a Flag

Creating a flag only takes a few seconds.

### Step 1: Choose an Item

Any item can become a flag:

-   Diamonds
-   Nether Stars
-   Custom items
-   Seeds
-   Bedrock
-   Player Heads
-   Modded resource-pack items
-   Etc.

The item you choose will be what players fight over.

### Step 2: Hold the Item

Place the item in your main hand.

### Step 3: Run the Command

```
/create_flag
```

The item in your hand is now marked as a flag. The item will have an enchanting glint and you will be given the glowing effect

### Step 4: Place the Flag

Place the flag item anywhere in the world.

When placed, the plugin creates a flag marker that players can discover and capture.

----------

# Finding the Flag

Players can craft a **Flag Compass**, a special compass that always points toward the active flag.

The compass automatically updates to track:

-   The flag's current location
-   The player carrying the flag
-   Any new location where the flag is moved

This means the flag can never truly disappear—it can always be tracked.

## Flag Compass Recipe

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/157ca882164422d7e7765d5b70fe944b2f2b920b_0.webp)

The Flag Compass is the primary tool players use to hunt down the flag. Players can use any banner to craft the Flag Compass

----------

# Capturing the Flag

When players locate the flag:

1.  Find the flag marker.
2.  Break the flag stand.
3.  Pick up the flag item.

The player is now the flag carrier.

Because the compass tracks the carrier, everyone else can see where the flag has gone and begin the chase.

----------

# Moving the Flag

One of the core features of Simple CTF is that the flag is always mobile.

Players can relocate the flag in several ways:

### Place the Flag

Place the flag item somewhere else in the world.

This creates a new flag location and updates every Flag Compass automatically.

### Drop the Flag

Throwing the flag on the ground relocates it to that position.

This allows players to:

-   Pass the flag to allies
-   Hide it temporarily
-   Abandon it while escaping

### Disconnect While Carrying

If a player logs out while carrying the flag, the flag will remain in the world instead of disappearing with them.

This prevents players from hiding the flag by simply disconnecting.

----------

# Flag Tracking

The Flag Compass is always aware of the flag's current state.

It will point to:
| Flag State |Compass Target  |
|--|--|
| Placed in world |Flag location  |
| Carried by a player |The carrier  |
| Dropped on the ground |Dropped flag  |
| Moved to a new location |New location  |

Players never need to craft a new compass when the flag moves.

----------

# Gameplay Ideas

Simple CTF can be used in many different ways:

### SMP Objective

Hide the flag somewhere in the world and let players compete to control it.

### Faction Warfare

Allow factions to fight over ownership of the flag and establish territory around it.

### Kingdom Servers

Use the flag as a symbol of power. Whoever controls it controls the kingdom.

### Roleplay Servers

Create story events centered around recovering or protecting the flag.

### Adventure Servers

Build quests that require players to locate and transport the flag to a destination.

----------

# Commands

`/create_flag`
Converts the item in your hand into a flag

----------

# Frequently Asked Questions

### Can any item become a flag?

Yes. Any item can be converted into a flag.

### Can there be multiple flags?

Currently, Simple CTF is designed around a single global flag, but you can have mukltiple, the compass will just choose which one to point to at random

### Do players need permissions to use the compass?

Only if your server's permission system restricts crafting or item access.

### Can players hide the flag?

Yes—but the Flag Compass will always reveal its general location, and the flag/flag carrier will always be glowing.

### Does the flag survive server restarts?

Yes. The flag's location and state are saved automatically.

----------

# Summary

Simple CTF transforms Capture the Flag from a minigame into a persistent world objective. Create a flag from any item, place it anywhere, and let your players decide what happens next. Whether they defend it, steal it, trade it, or wage wars over it, the story of the flag is created entirely by your community.

# DimensionTP

This plugin adds commands and a GUI for dimension travel and enables player teleportation via names or selectors. 

While designed for administrators, it can be granted to regular players by configuring permissions with tools like LuckPerms.

---

## Features

- **Admin GUI / Commands** — Accessible via command line, command blocks, or the GUI.
- **Multiple Profiles** — Up to 5 profiles per player (configurable). Each profile stores inventory, ender chest, health, hunger, XP, and game mode independently.
- **Per-player Permission System** — Disabled by default. Admins can grant access individually via LuckPerms.
- **Admin Detection** — Based on OP level (default: 4) and a UUID whitelist.
- **Language Support** — Supports English and Japanese (automatic switching).

---

## Quick Start
```bash
# Help(dimtp.use default true)
/dimtp
/dimtp help

# Teleports the specified player to the specified dimension(dimtp.others + dimtp.admin.world.<dim>)
/dimtp <player> <dimensionName>

# Teleports yourself to the specified dimension(dimtp.self + dimtp.world.<dim>)
/dimtp <dimensionName> 

# Opens the GUI for general users (dimtp.gui.personal)
/dimtp gui

# Opens the management GUI for administrators(dimtp.gui.admin)
/dimtp admin

# ReloadPlugin(dimtp.reload)
/dimtp reload

# KeepPositon
/dimtp *** *** keep
```

title: Nerfstick Remastered
description: A maintained fork of Nerfstick updated for modern Minecraft versions with Paper 1.21+ support and improved compatibility.
body:
# Nerfstick

Nerfstick is a modern Paper plugin that gives server owners fine-grained control over the vanilla Debug Stick.

It allows debug sticks to be safely used in survival environments while preventing abuse in protected regions such as WorldGuard regions or GriefPrevention claims.

Unlike vanilla behavior, Nerfstick lets you define exactly which block properties can be modified, and under what conditions, making it ideal for survival servers, admin tools, and controlled building environments.

---

## ✨ Key Features

* 🧪 Safe Debug Stick usage in Survival mode
* 🔐 Permission-based control over block state editing
* 🧱 Fine-grained whitelist for block properties
* 🌍 Protection-aware (WorldGuard / claim systems compatible via hooks)
* ⚙️ Fully configurable per-block and per-property rules
* 🚀 Updated for modern Paper (1.21+)

---

## 🧠 How it works

Nerfstick intercepts Debug Stick interactions and applies server-defined rules at runtime.

It evaluates every interaction before any block state mutation occurs.

This includes:

* Preventing usage in protected regions
* Restricting which blocks can be modified
* Restricting which block properties (e.g. facing, powered, waterlogged) can be changed
* Allowing safe, controlled cycling of block states in survival mode

---

## 🔐 Permissions system (LuckPerms recommended)

Nerfstick supports hierarchical and regex-based permission nodes for advanced control.

To allow Debug Stick usage outside of creative mode, grant:

```
minecraft.debugstick.always
```

### Core structure

```
nerfstick.use.minecraft.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.lever.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.furnace.facing
```

---

## 🧱 Recommended whitelist (blocks)

```txt
nerfstick.use.minecraft.barrel.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.bell.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.furnace.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.ladder.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.lectern.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.lever.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.lightning_rod.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.note_block.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.observer.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.rail.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.redstone_comparator.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.tripwire_hook.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.redstone_lamp.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.ender_chest.*
nerfstick.use.minecraft.dispenser.facing
nerfstick.use.minecraft.dropper.facing
nerfstick.use.minecraft.dried_ghast.facing
nerfstick.use.minecraft.leaf_litter.facing
nerfstick.use.minecraft.wildflowers.facing
```

---

## 🌿 Block families (regex-based permissions)

```txt
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_chest.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_fence.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_gate.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_glazed_terracotta.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_lantern.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_leaves.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_log.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_rail.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_repeater.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_sign.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_stairs.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_slab.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_trapdoor.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_wall.*
r=nerfstick.use.minecraft.*_door.hinge
```

---

## 🔄 Fork information

This project is a maintained fork of the original Nerfstick plugin, updated for modern Minecraft versions.

Key improvements:

* Paper 1.21+ compatibility
* Removal of deprecated NMS usage
* Improved permission resolution system
* Safer and more predictable block state validation logic
* Enhanced integration hooks for protection plugins

---

## 🙏 Credits

Nerfstick was originally created by **akdukaan** and **Reimnop**.

* [Original GitHub Repository](https://github.com/akdukaan/Nerfstick?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
* [Modrinth Project Page](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nerfstick?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

This fork continues development with modern updates and compatibility improvements for Paper 1.21+.

title: ReportHub
description: A complete report management system with interactive GUIs, spectate mode, offline inventory viewing, and Discord notifications. Full IT/EN language support.
body:
![reporthub.banner.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0df6a58df1f221956a5c4f7ee9d2f8e84e4b8744.png)

---

# Description

**ReportHub** è un plugin completo e leggero per la gestione delle segnalazioni sul tuo server Minecraft. Grazie a GUI interattive, modalità spettatore per vedere con gli occhi del giocatore segnalato e lettura inventario anche offline, lo staff può investigare e agire in pochi click, senza mai dover scrivere comandi a memoria.

**ReportHub** is a complete and lightweight plugin for managing player reports on your Minecraft server. Thanks to interactive GUIs, a spectator mode that lets you see through the reported player's eyes, and offline inventory viewing, staff can investigate and act in just a few clicks, without ever having to memorize commands.

---

### 🚀 Funzionalità Principali / Key Features

* **GUI Interattive / Interactive GUIs:** Segnalazioni, gestione ticket e azioni staff, tutto tramite click, senza digitare comandi a memoria. / Reports, ticket management and staff actions, all via clicks, no commands to memorize.
* **Modalità Spectate / Spectate Mode:** Entra nella visuale del giocatore segnalato per vedere esattamente cosa sta facendo. / Enter the reported player's view to see exactly what they're doing.
* **Inventario Offline / Offline Inventory:** Visualizza l'inventario di un giocatore anche se è disconnesso, leggendo i dati salvati su disco. / View a player's inventory even while they're offline, reading the data saved on disk.
* **Assegnazione Ticket / Ticket Claiming:** Gli staff possono segnare un ticket come "in gestione", evitando di intervenire in doppio sullo stesso caso. / Staff can mark a ticket as "being handled", avoiding duplicate intervention on the same case.
* **Notifiche Discord / Discord Notifications:** Ogni nuova segnalazione viene inviata automaticamente su Discord tramite webhook, con tutti i dettagli. / Every new report is automatically sent to Discord via webhook, with full details.
* **Copia Coordinate / Copy Coordinates:** Un click per copiare negli appunti la posizione esatta del giocatore segnalato. / One click to copy the reported player's exact position to clipboard.
* **Pulizia Automatica / Automatic Cleanup:** I ticket chiusi più vecchi di X giorni vengono rimossi automaticamente, per mantenere i dati sempre ordinati. / Closed tickets older than X days are automatically removed, keeping data tidy over time.
* **Multilingua / Multilingual:** Supporto completo a Italiano e Inglese, cambiabile in tempo reale con un comando — messaggi, GUI e webhook Discord incluso. / Full support for Italian and English, switchable in real time with a command — including messages, GUIs and Discord webhook.
* **Persistenza Completa / Full Persistence:** Tutti i ticket restano salvati e recuperabili anche dopo un riavvio del server. / All tickets remain saved and recoverable even after a server restart.

---

### 💻 Comandi e Permessi / Commands & Permissions

| Comando / Command | Permesso / Permission | Descrizione / Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/report <player>` | `reporthub.use` | Apre la GUI per segnalare un giocatore. / Opens the GUI to report a player. |
| `/reports` | `reporthub.staff` | Mostra la lista dei ticket aperti tramite GUI. / Shows the list of open tickets via GUI. |
| `/reportlang <it\|en>` | `reporthub.admin` | Cambia la lingua di tutto il plugin. / Changes the language of the entire plugin. |
| `/unspectate` | — | Esce dalla modalità spectate. / Exits spectate mode. |

---

### ⚙️ Configurazione / Configuration

Il file *config.yml* permette di personalizzare ogni aspetto: comando di ban da richiamare, categorie di segnalazione con relative icone, dimensioni della GUI, webhook Discord, pulizia automatica dei ticket vecchi e lingua predefinita. Tutti i testi del plugin si trovano nei file *lang/it.yml* e *lang/en.yml*, completamente modificabili con pieno supporto ai codici colore di Minecraft.

The *config.yml* file allows you to customize every aspect: the ban command to invoke, report categories with their icons, GUI dimensions, Discord webhook, automatic cleanup of old tickets, and default language. All plugin text is located in *lang/it.yml* and *lang/en.yml*, fully customizable with full Minecraft color code support.

---

### 🔌 Compatibilità / Compatibility

* **Piattaforme / Platforms:** Paper.
* **Versioni / Versions:** Sviluppato e testato specificamente su **1.21.6**, con piena compatibilità garantita per le versioni **1.21.x**. / Developed and tested specifically for **1.21.6**, with full compatibility guaranteed for **1.21.x** versions.

---

title: Berlioz - Server
description: Berlioz is a mod + server plugin for playing music in-game: define zones with ambient tracks, or broadcast songs to nearby players from YouTube, SoundCloud, or direct audio links.
body:
# Berlioz
Berlioz lets you play real music on your server. Ambient tracks tied to specific areas, or live broadcasts to players around you, streamed from YouTube, SoundCloud or a direct audio link.

This is the server side (Paper plugin). It does the coordination: who hears what, where, and when. The actual audio is played by the Berlioz client mod, so each player who wants to hear the music needs it installed. Players without the mod still get a clickable chat link to the current track, so nobody is left out.

The client side can be found [Here !](https://modrinth.com/mod/berlioz)

## What it does
### Ambient zones.
Pick two corners, give it a list of songs, done. Anyone standing inside the box hears it, and it switches off cleanly when they leave. Good for taverns, dungeons, boss arenas, etc.

### Local broadcasts.
A player with permission opens the in-game panel, builds a playlist and broadcasts it to everyone nearby. They can pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, seek. All stays in sync for listeners. Tracks are pre-loaded a bit ahead of time so there's no big gap between songs.

### Command broadcast.
For minigames or shows you can do /berlioz play <radius> <url>. It overrides everything else in range and loops until you /berlioz stop. There's also a cache subcommand to warm a track up before you need it and make sure everyone hears the start of the song at the moment the play command is sent.

## Commands and permissions
/berlioz play <radius> <url> | stop | cache <radius> <url>

Permissions:
berlioz.playlist -> Run a DJ broadcast
berlioz.ambient -> Create / edit / delete ambient zones
berlioz.command -> Use /berlioz (command blocks are always allowed)

Zones are stored in zones.yml (with a .bak backup).

---

Notes :
Built for the Berlioz client mod. Install it on the clients that should hear the music.
The server never downloads or decodes anything itself. It only tells clients what to play.
Found a bug or want a feature? Open an issue, or contact me on discord (vainerii).

Players can use /games to access a sleek menu featuring 10 fun minigames like Tic Tac Toe, Flappy Bird, Totem Clicker, Memory Match, and more — all designed to be played entirely through custom GUIs with smooth animations, sounds, and rewards.

Each game gives players Vault money based on performance, creating a fun and rewarding progression system that keeps players engaged on your server. From fast reaction challenges to strategy-based games against AI, Jobsy Games turns downtime into an addictive experience.

⚠️ Requirements:

Vault (required for economy rewards)
EssentialsX (recommended for economy support and commands)

Perfect for survival, SMP, and hub servers looking to add fun, replayable content that boosts player activity and retention.

title: VoxPopuli
description: VoxPopuli is the ultimate safeguard for your survival world. Tired of friends sneaking in commands? Every restricted command now triggers a democratic vote: the people decide its fate!
body:
# **🗳️ VoxPopuli: Democracy over Dictatorship** #

Tired of that one friend who keeps **giving themselves items** the second your back is turned? Or the one who keeps trying to **switch to Creative** mode when you specifically promised an _"honest"_ survival experience?


**We all have that player in our group.** With VoxPopuli, we’re putting an end to command-line tyranny. If someone wants to cheat, **they have to answer to the people**. No more solo decisions: either everyone agrees, or the command stays locked away!

## **How it works** ## 
The concept is simple: the plugin **intercepts restricted commands** before they are processed by the server, whether they are typed by a _player_ or executed via the _console_.

**The people's verdict:** As soon as a sensitive command is detected, all connected players are notified. Each player can vote to "**Accept**" or "**Deny**" the command.
![Remplacez ceci par une description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80e65fa17a91c7414547eec5478c226e9d47fd7d.png)

**Validation or Rejection:** 
If everyone agrees, the command is executed. However, if the majority refuses or if no consensus is reached within _2 minutes_, the command is flat-out blocked.

**Built-in intelligence:** Don't worry, the game stays fluid! Over **100 vital** server management commands _(restart, reload, etc.)_ and essential commands from over 10 popular survival plugins _(hub, shop, msg, pay, tpaccept, etc.)_ are allowed by default.

## **Protection & Security** ##
True democracy must be rock-solid. VoxPopuli includes essential **safeguards** to prevent fraud:

**Anti-Multi-Account (IP Check):** The plugin checks player IP addresses to prevent multi-accounting. It’s impossible to vote multiple times for yourself and skew the results!

**Minimum Quorum:** To prevent a player from granting themselves privileges while alone on the server, the system requires at least **2 players** to be online to validate any vote.

**Guaranteed Integrity:** Every attempt is scrutinized. If the requirements aren't met or the vote fails, the server remains locked.

## **🚨 Your last line of defense** ##
The only theoretical weakness is if a cheater maliciously deletes the plugin from the server files. **But don't worry: VoxPopuli has your back.**

Every time you log in, the plugin sends a confirmation message to ensure it is **active**. **You become the ultimate safeguard.** If you connect and don't see this message, you'll immediately know the plugin has been neutralized, giving you full control to react and counter your friends' schemes.
![Remplacez ceci par une description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00f5190d74451ca2bac1dfdbfd8cd5733d374c2b.png)

title: Cracked Life
description: A brand new Life Series, brought to you by WaffleHere. Welcome to Cracked Life, a new, harrowing, and hilarious datapack best experienced with friends. Enjoy the chaos.
body:
# **Cracked Life Rules**

Hey! Whoever you are, thanks for taking a look at my pack. This is Cracked Life, a new season of the Life Series, designed by me, WaffleHere. If you don't know what the Life Series is, I would highly recommend giving it a watch and checking out the subreddit and wiki.

[Grian's First Season of the Life Series](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nszciRXXJZk&list=PLU2851hDb3SHLdAlj8dxqHPeT_qIBbRBv)

[r/ThirdLifeSMP](https://www.reddit.com/r/ThirdLifeSMP/)

[r/LifeSeriesSMP](https://www.reddit.com/r/LifeSeriesSMP/)

[Life Series Wiki](https://the-life-series.fandom.com/wiki/The_Life_Series_Wiki)


Every season of the Life Series is different, however, let me explain this one.

(I have already explained it once, so I'll link that video here. I still highly recommend reading the rest of this page, as it is filled with updated information.)

[How to play Cracked Life](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Eo6q89EXXNmT_KWZR31GCe19MoM3QFWl/view?usp=drive_link)

You can use this command to see a list of steps for how to start, manage, and alter the series on the fly in game.
```
/function crackedlife:help
```

## The Session System and Worldborder

- To ensure that all drama and gameplay happens involving all players, the Life Series is played in a series of 'sessions.' These sessions are typically 3 hours long and ideally have all players present. Players should only be allowed to join the game during these sessions.

- For the best experience, the player list should be locked down quickly. Players joining 1 session late is one thing, but joining 3-5 sessions late is not very fun.

- A Worldborder is usually set in place before the series starts. No border means much less interactions with each other, so a border forces interactions and conflicts. Typical size is around 600x600, but you could go larger.

## **Lives**

- Each player starts on Six Lives. Players are Dark Green when on 6, 5, or 4 lives, Green when on 3 lives, Yellow when on 2, and Red when on their final life.
  
- Dark Greens and Greens are peaceful. They should gear up and try to survive.

- Yellows can kill Dark Greens in order to steal one of their lives. This can happen through PVP, traps, or any kind of shenanigans that were directly caused by the Yellow and led to the Dark Green's death.

- Reds are hostile and can kill anyone they want. Reds will also gain back a life if they kill a Dark Green.

- When you lose your final life, you are set to Spectator mode, and you are out of the series.


## **Social Rules**

While these may not be hardcoded rules, the honor system should be in place. It is much more fun if all players follow the rules. Ensure that someone who is very familiar with the rules has admin and can decide on punishments for any rule-breaking.

- Being "peaceful" means that you can not initiate combat on someone, nor have an intention to kill them. For example, a Dark Green can not begin critting out a thief in their home, but they can punch a thief away from their chests. A Yellow can not drop a TNT minecart on a Red's head, but they can bomb or burn down their base.
  
- Being "hostile" means that you CAN initiate combat on people with intention to kill. Reds can begin to attack Greens or Yellows, plant bombs, create deadly traps, or pour lava on people. Be careful of retaliation, though.
  
- Retaliation and Self Defense are NOT prohibited. If a Green gets jumped by a Red, they most certainly can pull out their own sword and even end up eliminating the Red. However, if the altercation is over, (the Red runs away, pearls out, or otherwise exits the fight), the fight is OVER. No further attacks can be made by the Green name. This means no tracking the Red down and killing them, no blowing up their base in retaliation, etc.

- Team fights will definitely happen. In cases like those, the two sides are considered to be in a fight together. While a Green teammate of a Red cannot help that Red jump someone else, they can help that Red defend their base if another group is attacking. (And by attacking I mean actual pvp, not a TNT cannon, for example.) Similarly, if two Greens are teamed up and one gets jumped, the other Green can get in between the fight and get the attacker to back off. They cannot help the original Green 2v1 the Red.

## **Secret Roles**

- A rule that you should definitely implement (but is technically optional) is the Boogeyman and the Cursed, two secret roles which trigger each session to cause mayhem and move players' life counters along, so to speak.

###   The Boogeyman

 - At the beginning of each session, an admin should run this command once for each Boogeyman. 
```
/function crackedlife:giveboogeytag
```
 - Each time it is run, the command will mark a random non-red player as a Boogeyman. The Boogeyman has one job: kill a non-red before the end of the session.

 - The Boogeyman must kill a non-red player either through pvp or traps before the end of the session. If they fail, they will be set directly to Red life at the end of the session. If they succeed in killing someone, however, they are rewarded with three bonus hearts.

 - The Boogeyman is a SECRET ROLE. While they are not disallowed from telling their allies or others, revealing themselves is probably not a good idea. Failure means an extreme punishment.

- The Boogeyman is one of the only times Greens are allowed to kill people. Enjoy it.

![A title telling the player that they are The Boogeyman in red text.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55652572fb6196664d1bdda236661e08ff3a819f_0.webp)

###   The Cursed

 - At the beginning of each session, an admin should run this command once for each Cursed. 
```
/function crackedlife:givecursedtag
```
 - Each time it is run, the command will mark a random non-red player as a Cursed. The Cursed, similar to the Boogeyman, must kill another non-red player before the end of the session. However, the Cursed has a catch.
  
- When marked as the Cursed, the player will be given an invisible timer between thirty minutes and two and a half hours. When this timer runs out, they are given a 5 minute timer to kill a non-red player, or they will lose two lives. If they succeed in killing someone in this time period, they are rewarded with four bonus hearts. The punishment can not eliminate players.

- Keep in mind, the Cursed does not know when their Curse will activate. While they can set up traps or otherwise prepare to kill before they receive the message, they MAY NOT initiate combat or arm a trap until the Curse activates. 

![A title telling the player that they are Cursed in purple text.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c308cfd93e7c3261a9f4c0302f7b5e1979d33054_0.webp)

### Activating Roles

 - Roles can be activated partway into the session by running the command below. This should be run after giving out roles secretly.
```
/function crackedlife:rolesactivate
```
 - When this function is run, players will be told their roles. Most players, including all Reds, will be 'Nothing!' and their session will continue normally. Random non-reds will be picked to be Cursed or Boogeymen. Feel free to switch up how many of each role are enabled each session!

![A title anticipatorily reading "You are..." in yellow text.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45beb72b27e03c0ba3ec9a969294e916aaa7f9e0_0.webp)

## **Crack!**

- Once the series has been started, you will notice a timer above your hotbar. This is the Crack! timer. When the timer runs out, (every 15 minutes by default) 5 random players will Crack. When a player cracks, they lose two of their permanent hearts. While your health is reset upon death, this slow deterioration will lead players to kill to regain their hearts.

![A title displaying "Crack!" in red text.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3fa00da7f26dd759c4d6157b517dfc20bffbd99_0.webp)

- Players above 10 hearts will be guaranteed to lose hearts on every Crack, so players can't stockpile health.

- Every so often, a random non-cracked, non-red player will be instantly reduced to 4 hearts.

![A title displaying "The curse consumes you" in purple and red text.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02c861c5a39ecf1c83aa3b03d9f7029174abb381_0.webp)

### Cracked Players

- When a Dark Green, Green, or Yellow name inevitably drops to four maximum hearts, they become Cracked. Cracked players have a pink name, and will stop losing hearts. The only way for them to get their hearts back is to kill non-red, non-cracked players. If a Cracked player kills someone else, either through PVP or traps, they will gain 10 hearts, putting them at 14.

- While Cracked players cannot be killed by Yellows, Boogeymen, or Cursed players, they can be killed by Reds. When a Cracked player is killed, their killer gains 3 bonus hearts. So be careful!

### Shattered Players

- When a Red name drops to 5 hearts, they become Shattered. Shattered players, like Cracked players, must kill non-cracked players to regain health. Every player a Shattered player kills earns them 5 hearts.
  
- However, unlike Cracked players who cannot drop below 4 hearts, Shattered players will continue to lose health, one half heart at a time. If they do not kill someone to regain health, they will run out of health and be eliminated.

### The Timer

- The Crack timer can be altered. At default, the time for the timer to elapse is 15 minutes. By using either
```
/function crackedlife:fastertimer
```
or
```
/function crackedlife:fastesttimer
```
 an admin can change the timer to 10 minutes or even 5 minutes.

- All timers can also be paused or resumed by running
```
/function crackedlife:starttimer
```
or
```
/function crackedlife:stoptimer
```

### The Slice of Life

- Players that are not confident in their trapping or PVP abilities can still regain health. By crafting and consuming a Slice of Life, players can regain 2 hearts per Slice, though this cannot raise them above 10 hearts.

- Slices of Life are understandably expensive, costing 5 gold blocks, 3 gold ingots, and 1 melon slice. (It is recommended that an admin grant all players the recipe with the following command.)
```
/recipe give @a crackedlife:glistering_melon_slice
```
![A crafting recipe for the Slice of Life, containing 5 gold blocks, 3 gold ingots, and a melon slice, resulting in an enchanted glistering melon slice.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d576dce83f302c08c95191d72d1b59786cde9ae8_0.webp)

![The description of the Slice of Life item in the player's inventory.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/137d67f87450c68cef6382485de49712c3254e01_0.webp)

## Giving Lives

- Players may also give lives to their allies or trading partners by using this command.
```
/trigger givelife
```
- This will lose the user 1 life and give 1 life to the nearest person within 3 blocks. Make sure to stand within range, otherwise the command will fail.

![A title displaying "You gained a life!" in green text.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e97d755eb99036b6780c551f9864f0b63a3ca80b_0.webp)

![A title displaying "You lost a life..." in red text.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a0f6050fa64c012e1007e595f8ea1fe06e5daf0_0.webp)

## Finale and End Fight

- Both the Ender Dragon fight and a Finale sequence are included in this season. Activate either of them using
```
/function crackedlife:end_timer_init
```
or
```
/function crackedlife:finale_init
```

### The End Fight

- When activated, a timer between 15 and 5 minutes will start in the background, at the end of which an end portal will open at the location marked by using
```
/function crackedlife:portal_marker
```
- This portal marker will replace all water blocks within 5 blocks of it with end portal when the end countdown is activated.

- Any player left in the Overworld when the portal closes after 5 minutes will lose two lives. This punishment can not eliminate you.

- This punishment can also be disabled by simply using this command when all players are online.
```
/advancement grant @a only minecraft:story/enter_the_end
```



### The Finale

- When it comes time for the Finale session, the Finale sequence can be activated using the above command, after which all players can kill anyone, regardless of life count. This is best run either when some players have been eliminated and there are almost no Greens and few Yellows, or when there is around 45 minutes to an hour remaining in the final session. Enjoy the sequence, it's very dramatic.

## Recommendations

- One definite recommendation is to install Simple Voice Chat or some other proximity chat mod. (Unless you don't want to/can't use voice chat.) This makes the series much better. I typically set the voice range to about 32 blocks and the whisper range to about 12. I usually disallow groups, but you can do whatever makes the most sense for you.

- Think about installing a recipe pack, such as my Life Series recipes pack, which rewrites TNT, horse armor, and netherite upgrade template recipes and adds an (albeit expensive) recipe for the heavy core, or my Affordable Templates pack, which makes duplicating templates no longer require diamonds.

- Life Series are best experienced with 12 to 18 people. The worldborder size should be set accordingly, (I go with around 600x600) and try to center it on some kind of structure. (I usually go with a Trial Chamber or Ancient City.)

## Credits

- If you do end up using this Life Series in a video series or a video in general, make sure to credit me, WaffleHere, as designer and creator as well as @Grian as the original creator of the life series.
- If you are posting on Youtube, go ahead and give me a ping in the description at @wafflesarehere. Thanks!

Other than that, enjoy the chaos. Welcome to Cracked Life.

title: WatchCat

body:
# Watchcat

Server-side anti-cheat for Paper 1.21.11. By @Az7car.

Website: https://watchcat.gg
Discord: https://discord.gg/2hPbabJ9jP

## Features

### Combat Detection (53 checks)
- Killaura, AimAssist, Reach, Hitbox, AutoClicker, Triggerbot
- Velocity, AntiKnockback, Criticals, BowAimbot, AutoShield
- AutoTotem, AutoArmor, FastBow, MultiAura, ShieldBreaker
- MaceSwitch, NoSlow, FastEat, FastHeal, KeepSprint
- AimLock, Regen, SuperKnockback, WTap, Backtrack
- PitchLimit, NoMiss, InvisibleAim, ReachMulti, CPSLimit
- Delay, AutoBlock, Combo, DoubleHit, PerfectBlock
- ShieldBlock, AutoWeapon, AutoPot, AutoPearl
- ReachOverride, HitBoxOverride, NoHurtCam, AntiWeakness
- AntiHunger, NoFire, NoPush, SmoothAim, RageAura
- ClickPattern, TickShift, AutoSoup, AutoLeave

### Movement Detection (44 checks)
- Speed, Fly, NoFall, Step, Jesus, Spider, Glide, HighJump
- BunnyHop, FastLadder, Phase, Blink, LongJump, ElytraFly
- BoatFly, NoWeb, Strafe, SafeWalk, EntitySpeed, Derp
- AntiVoid, Motion, Gravity, AirJump, FastFall, Collision
- Prediction, TimerBalance, TimerAccel, Swim, Ascension
- JumpCheck, VehicleSpeed, IceSpeed, SlimeBlock, WaterSpeed
- LavaSpeed, WallClimb, Clip, YPort, SpeedLimit
- AntiLevitation, DolphinJump, Sneak, PingSpoof, PacketDelay
- NoDrag, NoJumpDelay, SpeedField, EnderPearl, AutoWalk

### World Detection (34 checks)
- Scaffold, FastPlace, InventoryMove, FastBreak, Nuker
- AirPlace, Tower, ChestStealer, BuildReach, NoSwing
- AutoFarm, AutoFish, AutoMine, InventoryActions, AutoTool
- BlockInteraction, FastConsume, GhostBlock, RotationPlace
- InstantMine, MultiTask, Direction, PacketOrder, RotationBreak
- BreakPattern, ChestAura, AutoRespawn, FastDoor, Surround
- PistonPush, AutoSign, AutoDoor, AutoBrew, AutoEnchant
- AutoAnvil, BoatGlitch, ContainerSort, AutoSmithing
- PickRange, ExpPickup

### Mod & Injector Detection (87 checks)
- BrandDetector, PayloadProber, TickTimerAnalyzer, BadPackets
- Freecam, AntiAFK, Timer, MorePackets, InvalidInteract
- Disabler, SkinBlinker, SpinBot, HeadRoll, NoRotateSet
- Flight, AntiSwear, AntiFlood, AntiAd, Aimbot, GroundSpoof
- XRay, Baritone, AutoCrystal, AntiAntiXRay, OreBot
- NoRender, Trajectory, ClickTP, AntiInvis, Proxy
- AntiAntiCheat, ScreenShare, PluginDetector, ClientSpoof
- PacketMani, ForceOP, NoPitchLimit, AntiFirework
- ResourceSpoof, NameSpoof, NoAttackCooldown, AntiCactus
- AntiBerry, NoPortalOverlay, NoPumpkin, NoFireOverlay
- AntiFog, NoScoreboard, AntiPotion, CrashPayload, ESP
- Tracers, NoFov, NoBob, AntiBlind, TimeSpoof, AntiShield
- BookExploit, NoWeather, AntiWDL, SoundPos, PacketSpam
- AntiResourcePack, NoPotionLabel, AntiBot, Raid

### Machine Learning Brain
- 32-dimension feature vector (rotation deltas, GCD, click variance, acceleration, packet rate, velocity std/mean/trend, pitch entropy, convergence)
- ONNX Runtime inference (in-JVM, no external dependencies)
- Isolation Forest anomaly detection blending with heuristic scores
- CSV training data export for offline model training

### Punishment System
- Shadow flagging with configurable confidence thresholds
- Randomized ban wave execution (30min-6hr jitter)
- Severity-based duration tiers: 30 days to permanent
- Offense multiplier: 1st=1x, 2nd=2x, 3rd=4x, 4th+=permanent
- IP bans alongside UUID bans
- Unique 7-character alphanumeric appeal code per player
- Non-deterministic scheduling to blind cheat developers

### Architecture
- Direct Netty pipeline injection (no ProtocolLib dependency)
- Fully asynchronous check execution (off-main-thread)
- 100% reflection-based, no Mojang-mapped dependencies
- Maven build, Java 21, Paper 1.21.11
- 218 checks total | 265+ Java files

## Building

```
mvn clean package
```

Output JAR in `target/watchcat-1.0.0.jar`.

## Configuration

Edit `config.yml` in the plugin data folder. Each check has:
- `enabled` - toggle
- `severity` - critical/high/medium/low (affects ban duration)
- `weight` - contribution to confidence score
- Check-specific thresholds

## Commands

- `/watchcat alerts` or `/watchdog alerts` - toggle alert messages
- `/watchcat stats` or `/watchdog stats` - check performance statistics  
- `/watchcat profile` or `/watchdog profile` - detailed check profiling
- `/watchcat checks [category]` or `/watchdog checks [category]` - list checks with status
- `/watchcat player <name>` or `/watchdog player <name>` - per-player check state
- `/watchcat reason <player> <reason>` or `/watchdog reason <player> <reason>` - ban a player with reason
- `/watchcat reload` or `/watchdog reload` - reload configuration
- `/watchcat whitelist <check|all> <player>` or `/watchdog whitelist` - exemption management
- `/watchcat report <check> <player>` or `/watchdog report` - report a false positive
- `/watchcat banwave` or `/watchdog banwave` - trigger manual ban wave

## Dependencies

- Paper 1.21.11 (required)
- ONNX Runtime 1.26.0 (bundled via Maven shade plugin)
- Java 21 (required)

title: FoKillstreak
description: A configurable PvP killstreak plugin with leaderboards, milestone rewards, anti-farming protection, and PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
![FoKillstreak cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XC8tv8GZ/images/93a8093d4baef62ec7726272ecf320f2201b3e56.png)

FoKillstreak is a lightweight PvP progression plugin for servers that want killstreak competition without bulky setup. Players build current and best streaks, admins can configure anti-farming protection and rewards in-game, and PlaceholderAPI support makes streak stats easy to show across the server.

![FoKillstreak leaderboard showing current and best streak rankings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XC8tv8GZ/images/2e390def2bd464839ad907434ff0b2a741ba7f7b.png)

## Features
- Track both current killstreaks and all-time best streaks.
- Show players a clean `/killstreak` leaderboard with current and best rankings.
- Broadcast configurable milestone streaks like 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 50 kills.
- Run reward commands at exact streak milestones from console or as the player.
- Use `{player}`, `%player%`, `{uuid}`, `{streak}`, and `{best_streak}` in reward commands.
- Prevent farming the same victim repeatedly with a configurable cooldown.

![Admin editor with death reset, broadcasts, cooldown, milestones, and rewards controls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XC8tv8GZ/images/c84a3d14b3cb990e11a314f10356c4d5d244222f.png)

## Admin Tools
- Edit core settings from `/fokillstreakadmin editor`.
- Manage reward commands through a searchable reward GUI.
- Choose whether natural deaths reset streaks or only PvP deaths do.
- Edit milestone broadcasts and same-victim cooldown seconds without touching the jar.
- Reload `config.yml`, `messages.yml`, `guis/`, and `dialogs/` live.
- Manually set a player's current or best streak when staff need to correct data.

![Reward editor showing streak reward command, sender, and delete controls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XC8tv8GZ/images/a8c4ccd4c0b027008125ec4a85e487d7b84dd7de.png)

## Configuration
- `config.yml` controls death resets, same-victim cooldowns, milestone broadcasts, native dialogs, and reward commands.
- `messages.yml` controls player messages, admin messages, GUI text, color tokens, and update notices.
- `guis/leaderboard.yml` lets server owners edit the public leaderboard GUI layout.
- `dialogs/` controls native dialog text for supported Paper servers.
- SQLite storage is included in the jar, so no external database setup is required.

## Dependencies
- **Optional:** PlaceholderAPI for streak placeholders.
- Native dialogs are used when supported by the server. Older or unsupported servers fall back to chat/inventory input.

## Commands
- `/killstreak` - Open the player leaderboard.
- `/ks` - Alias for `/killstreak`.
- `/fokillstreakadmin version` - Check the plugin version and Modrinth update status.
- `/fokillstreakadmin reload` - Reload config, messages, GUI files, and dialog files.
- `/fokillstreakadmin editor` - Open the admin editor GUI.
- `/fokillstreakadmin set <player> <streak> <best|current>` - Set a player's stored streak.
- `/killstreakadmin` and `/ksadmin` - Admin command aliases.

## Permissions
- `fokillstreak.use` - Allows players to open the leaderboard. Default: everyone.
- `fokillstreak.admin` - Allows access to admin tools. Default: operators.

## Placeholders
Requires PlaceholderAPI.

- `%fokillstreak_killstreak%` - Current killstreak.
- `%fokillstreak_best%` - Best stored killstreak.
- `%fokillstreak_rank%` - Current-streak leaderboard rank, or blank if unranked.

description:

Minecraft Visual Command Editor | Graphical Editing for Vanilla Commands | Fabric 1.21.11 | 25 Commands | Presets/History | Pure Client-Side | Makes it easy for beginners
body:
# EasyCommand

**可视化 Minecraft 命令编辑器** — 让小白玩家也能轻松自定义原版命令。

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-brightgreen)](https://minecraft.net)
[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-orange)](https://fabricmc.net/)

## 功能

- 🎨 **可视化 GUI** — 所有命令参数都通过图形界面选择，无需记忆复杂语法

title: advancement gaurd
description: This plugin is custom made for the paper servers who need to stop players getting nertherite and going to the end, both of these will result in a insta temp ban of 30 days
body:
# AdvancementGuard

A lightweight and highly configurable Paper plugin that prevents players from accessing restricted game progression by automatically detecting and punishing forbidden advancements.

## Features

✔ Instant detection of forbidden advancements

✔ Automatic temporary bans

✔ Configurable ban duration

✔ Persistent ban storage

✔ Automatic unban after expiration

✔ Staff and console logging

✔ Configurable advancement blacklist

✔ Lightweight and optimized

✔ No database required

✔ Modern Paper support

## Default Protected Advancements

AdvancementGuard comes configured to detect:

* Hidden in the Depths (`minecraft:nether/obtain_ancient_debris`)
* The End? (`minecraft:end/root`)

When a player completes one of these advancements, the plugin instantly issues a temporary 30-day ban and prevents rejoining until the punishment expires.

## Why Use AdvancementGuard?

Perfect for:

* Custom SMPs
* Hardcore Servers
* Challenge Servers
* Progression-Locked Worlds
* Lifesteal Networks
* Unique Server Concepts

If your server restricts Netherite, The End, or specific stages of progression, AdvancementGuard provides an automatic and reliable enforcement system.

## Commands

### Admin Commands

`/ag reload`

* Reloads plugin configuration and ban data.

## Permissions

`advancementguard.admin`

* Access to administrative commands.

## Configuration Example

```yaml
ban-duration-days: 30

broadcast-enabled: true

broadcast-message: "&c%player% was banned for obtaining a forbidden advancement."

forbidden-advancements:
  - minecraft:nether/obtain_ancient_debris
  - minecraft:end/root
```

## Automatic Ban System

When a forbidden advancement is detected:

1. Advancement completion is logged.
2. The player is instantly banned.
3. The player is kicked from the server.
4. Ban data is saved automatically.
5. Expired bans are removed automatically.

## Built For Performance

AdvancementGuard uses Paper's native advancement events and only performs checks when advancements are completed, resulting in virtually zero performance impact on your server.

Simple. Fast. Reliable.

Protect your server's progression with AdvancementGuard.

- Adding participants to the city list.

 - ```cityregion.create``` — Permission to create cities

 - ```cityregion.removemember``` — Permission to remove members from cities
 - ```cityregion.info``` — Permission to view city info
 - ```cityregion.list``` — Permission to view list of cities

max-city-radius: 50

 - Shop items

title: SulfurLab
description: Your personal lab for crafting Sulfur Cubes with custom physics. 🧪
body:
![Header](https://assets.drygo.dev/uploads/sulfurlab/modrinth/og.png)

[![Source Code in GitHub](https://assets.drygo.dev/uploads/sulfurlab/modrinth/badge-github.png)](https://github.com/33drygo/sulfurlab)
[![Available for Jitpack](https://assets.drygo.dev/uploads/sulfurlab/modrinth/badge-jitpack.png)](http://wiki.drygo.dev/sulfurlab/en/api/sulfurlab-api)
![Requires Java 25](https://assets.drygo.dev/uploads/sulfurlab/modrinth/badge-java-2.png)
![Requires Minecraft 26.2+](https://assets.drygo.dev/uploads/sulfurlab/modrinth/badge-mc-3.png)

# SulfurLab 🧪

Create and play with **Sulfur Cubes** that bounce, slide, and float however you want.

> For **Minecraft 26.2+** (the *Chaos Cubed* update) on Paper/Spigot.

---

## What it does 💫

- **Make your own Sulfur Cubes** — choose how much they bounce, slide, and float.
- **Give them a block** — pick any block for the cube to show.
- **They stick around** — your cubes are saved and come back after a restart.
- **Easy to manage** — list, teleport to, glow, rename, or remove any cube.
- **No commands to memorize** — tab-completion suggests everything as you type.
- **Make it yours** — change the messages and toggle the sounds in the config.

## Commands

Everything lives under `/sulfurlab` (alias `/slab`).

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/sulfurlab new [name] [-b/-f/-a value] [-i block]` | Create a cube (auto-named if omitted) |
| `/sulfurlab set <name> <property> <value>` | Set `bounciness` / `friction` / `airdrag` |
| `/sulfurlab unset <name> <property>` | Reset a property to its default |
| `/sulfurlab block <name> <id>` | Set the block the cube shows |
| `/sulfurlab list` | List all cubes (click to teleport) |
| `/sulfurlab info <name>` | Inspect a single cube |
| `/sulfurlab rename <name> <new>` | Rename a cube |
| `/sulfurlab tp <name>` | Teleport to a cube |
| `/sulfurlab tphere <name>` | Bring a cube to you |
| `/sulfurlab glow <name> [seconds]` | Make it glow (`0` = off) |
| `/sulfurlab kill <name\|@all>` | Remove a cube — or all of them |
| `/sulfurlab editor <name>` | Cube editor *(coming soon)* |
| `/sulfurlab help` | Show the command list |
| `/sulfurlab reload` | Reload config & messages |

**Properties & ranges:** `bounciness` `0–1`, `friction` `0–10`, `airdrag` `0–100`.

Type `/sulfurlab help` in-game to see everything.

## Links 🔗

- **[Wiki](https://wiki.drygo.dev/sulfurlab)** — setup, commands, and the developer API.
- **[GitHub](https://github.com/33drygo/sulfurlab)** — source code and bug reports.

---

*SulfurLab — your personal lab for crafting Sulfur Cubes with custom physics.*

title: ClanPlus
description: A Clan Plugin which is completly Customizable and uses Minecrafts Color Codes for Names.
body:
---

# 🛡️ ClanPlus

**The ultimate, lightweight, and highly customizable clan system for your Minecraft server!**

ClanPlus provides everything you need to build strong communities. With support for both simple flat-file storage and robust database systems, it scales perfectly from small private servers to larger networks.

---

### ✨ Core Features

* **Flexible Storage:** Choose between **YAML** for quick setups or **MySQL** for high-performance database management.


* **Complete Clan Management:** Create, manage, invite, and remove members with ease.


* **Fully Customizable:** Tweak every message, prefix, and notification to match your server's unique identity.


* **Integrated Chat & Tab:** Built-in support for clan-specific chat formatting and colored tab list tags.


* **Advanced Security:** Includes built-in name and tag validation (via Regex) to ensure your server stays organized.


* **Smart Notifications:** Players receive clear, time-stamped notifications for clan activities.



---

### ⚙️ Highly Configurable

Customize the experience directly in **config.yml**:

* Define clan name and tag length limits.


* Set maximum member counts per clan.


* Configure invitation expiry times to keep your server clean.


* Choose your own color palette for clan customizations.



---

### 🔑 Permissions

Manage access effortlessly using **plugin.yml**:

* `lyvtclan.use`: Grants access to basic clan commands (Default: true).


* `lyvtclan.admin`: Grants access to administrative clan commands (Default: OP).



---

### 🚀 Get Started

1. Install the plugin in your `plugins/` folder.
2. Restart your server.
3. Edit the **config.yml** to configure your storage backend and messages.


4. Enjoy building your community!

---

title: Bingo Gacha
description: An Minecraft Plugin That Inspired By Bingo System Gacha
body:
Introduce a fun, engaging, and addictive gameplay loop to your server! **Bingo Gacha** gives players their own interactive progression cards where they roll random slots to build lines and win epic custom rewards.

---

## How It Works (For Players)

1. **Get a Card:** Open the card menu `/bingo` and purchase or claim a card.
2. **Roll the Gacha:** Pay server money (Vault) or items to roll. Watch the board spin with custom flickering glass panes and sound effects as it picks your next slot!
3. **Get a Bingo:** Connect lines horizontally, vertically, or diagonally (or unlock the entire board) to claim completion rewards.
4. **Extra Rewards:** Any slots left unrolled when you complete a straight line can grant bonus prizes!

---

## Features for Server Owners

title: Potion Box
description: A potion storage and management plugin designed for Minecraft servers, allowing you to store potions in a virtual warehouse and gain permanent potion effects based on the amount stored.
body:
# xH_PB Potion Box Plugin

A potion storage and management plugin designed for Minecraft servers. Store potions in a virtual warehouse and gain permanent potion effects based on the stored amount.

## Features

- **Potion Storage System**: Store excess potions in a virtual warehouse to save inventory space
- **Permanent Effect System**: Automatically gain permanent potion effects of corresponding levels based on stored potion count
- **GUI Management**: Intuitive graphical interface supporting click-to-deposit/withdraw
- **Batch Operations**: Supports Shift+click for batch deposit/withdraw
- **Highly Configurable**: Effect level thresholds, maximum storage amounts, etc. are all customizable
- **Data Persistence**: Player data is automatically saved and will not be lost after server restart

## Supported Potion Types

- Speed
- Strength
- Regeneration
- Fire Resistance
- Night Vision
- Water Breathing
- Jump Boost
- Resistance

## Effect Level System

| Level | Required Potion Count | Effect Level |
|-------|----------------------|--------------|
| I     | 5 bottles            | Effect I     |
| II    | 15 bottles           | Effect II    |
| III   | 30 bottles           | Effect III   |

*Thresholds can be customized in the configuration file*

## Installation

1. Download the `xh_pb-0.0.1.jar` file
2. Place the JAR file into the server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server or load the plugin
4. Edit `plugins/xH_PB/config.yml` for custom configuration (optional)

## Usage

### Open Potion Box
```
/xhpotionbox
```
Or use the shorthand:
```
/xhpb
```

### Deposit Potions
1. Open the Potion Box GUI
2. Click potions from your inventory into the lower slots of the GUI
3. Potions will be automatically stored in the corresponding warehouse

### Withdraw Potions
1. Open the Potion Box GUI
2. Click the potion icon in the upper slots
3. Left-click to withdraw one bottle, Shift+click to withdraw a stack (16 bottles)

### View Effects
After storing enough potions, permanent effects will automatically take effect. You can view current effects in the game's effect bar.

## Configuration File

```yaml
# Potion Box GUI settings
potionbox:
  title: "&aPotion Box"
  size: 54
  shift-click-amount: 16
  max-storage-amount: 9999

# Allowed potion types
allowed-potions:
  - SPEED
  - STRENGTH
  - REGENERATION
  - FIRE_RESISTANCE
  - NIGHT_VISION
  - WATER_BREATHING
  - JUMP_BOOST
  - RESISTANCE

# Effect level threshold settings
effect-levels:
  SPEED:
    level-1: 5
    level-2: 15
    level-3: 30
  # ... other potion types
```

## Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `xhpb.use` | Use the Potion Box command |
| `xhpb.admin` | Admin permissions (reload config, etc.) |

## Command List

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/xhpotionbox` | Open the Potion Box GUI |
| `/xhpotionbox reload` | Reload the configuration file (requires admin permission) |

## Technical Information

- **Development Platform**: Paper/Spigot 1.21+
- **Java Version**: Java 21
- **Development Method**: AI-assisted development
