title: Atlas Stats
description: This Plugin brings a new way of viewing and sharing your Player Stats with anyone on the server, you can view such things as Kills, Deaths, EXP, LEVEL, Blocks Mined, Ores Mined, And Every Mob Killed.
body:
# AtlasStats

AtlasStats provides a clean and interactive way to view and share player statistics across your server. Players can track everything from kills and deaths to mined blocks and mob statistics, all through an easy to use GUI.

It also includes a toggleable compass display above the hotbar that shows useful real-time information.

---

## Features

- Full player statistics GUI  
- Public stat sharing in chat  
- View your own or other players' stats  
- Server statistics command  
- Toggleable compass overlay above the hotbar  
- Tracks blocks mined, ores, mobs killed, and more  
- Fully configurable messages and menus  

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|------------|------------|
| `/astats help` | Show all commands | `atlasstats.help` |
| `/astats stats` | Open your stats GUI | None |
| `/astats statsspy <player>` | View another player's stats | `atlasstats.statsspy` |
| `/astats reloadconfig` | Reload config files | `atlasstats.reloadconfig` |
| `/astats serverstats` | View server statistics | `atlasstats.serverstats` |
| `/astats compass` | Toggle compass display | None |

---

## How It Works

- Use `/astats stats` to open your personal stats menu  
- Click any stat to send it into public chat  
- Use `/astats statsspy <player>` to view other players  
- Toggle the compass display to see coordinates and info in real time  

---

## Tracked Stats

AtlasStats tracks a wide range of data including:

- Player kills and deaths  
- Experience and levels  
- Distance traveled  
- Blocks and ores mined  
- Mob kills across all dimensions  
- Damage dealt and taken  
- Raid statistics and more  

---

## Server Stats

The `/astats serverstats` command provides:

- Server IP and port  
- Player count  
- Server version  
- RAM usage  
- TPS and lag information  

---

## Configuration

The plugin is fully customizable through configuration files:

- Command messages  
- GUI titles and layouts  
- Compass display format  
- Stat categories and formatting  

All values can be edited to match your server style.

---

## Notes

- Works out of the box with minimal setup  
- Designed to be lightweight and efficient  
- All messages and menus support full customization  

---

## Support

For help or suggestions, join the Discord:  
https://discord.gg/f9swPR7NnV

---

AtlasStats adds a simple and powerful way to track and share player progress on your server.

title: Atlas Deaths
description: This Plugin brings a new way of dying in Minecraft, If you die you get given a challenge to complete and the whole server can see what challenge you have been given. all challenges are customizable and you can add as many as you'd like.
body:
# AtlasDeaths

AtlasDeaths introduces a new way of handling death in Minecraft. When a player dies, they are given a random challenge to complete. The entire server can see the challenge, creating fun, competitive, and sometimes chaotic gameplay.

All challenges are fully customizable and you can add as many as you want.

---

## Features

- Random challenges assigned on player death  
- Server-wide challenge announcements  
- Player screen challenge display  
- Fully customizable challenge list  
- Tracks total player deaths  
- Configurable messages and formatting  
- Supports unlimited challenges  

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|------------|------------|
| `/help` | Show all commands | `atlasdeaths.help` |
| `/reloadconfig` | Reload config files | `atlasdeaths.reloadconfig` |

---

## How It Works

- When a player dies, they are assigned a random challenge  
- The challenge is shown on their screen  
- The server receives a broadcast with the player's challenge  
- Players must complete the challenge as part of gameplay  

This adds a risk and reward system to death and encourages interaction between players.

---

## Example Challenges

- Delete all diamond items from your inventory  
- No food for 20 minutes  
- Use only wooden tools for 1 hour  
- Drop your inventory and survive one night  
- Build a structure or complete a task  
- Let another player take items from your base  

You can fully edit or replace these with your own challenges.

---

## Configuration

Everything is configurable through YAML files:

- Challenge list  
- Player screen messages  
- Broadcast messages  
- Death tracking  
- Formatting and colors  

You can easily expand the system by adding more challenges.

---

## Additional Features

- Title message shown to players on death  
- Broadcast system for server announcements  
- Update notifications for new versions  
- Placeholder support  

---

## Dependencies

- PlaceholderAPI  
- bStats  

---

## Notes

- Designed for SMP servers but works on any server type  
- Challenges are purely configurable and expandable  
- Encourages player interaction and unique gameplay  

---

## Support

For help or suggestions, join the Discord:  
https://discord.gg/f9swPR7NnV

---

AtlasDeaths adds a fun and challenging twist to dying, turning every death into a new objective.

title: SCP-055
description: Replaces all letters, numbers, and symbols with block textures for Minecraft 1.20.1. Perfect for SCP and puzzle maps.
body:
# 方块字体 / Block Font

**Minecraft 1.20.1 Resource Pack**

---

## 中文介绍

### 功能说明

本材质包通过替换原版游戏的字体贴图(`assets/minecraft/textures/font/`),将游戏中所有可见的 **英文字母(A–Z, a–z)、数字(0–9)以及常用符号** 全部转换为 **方块 (Block)** 样式。

### 特色

- **完全替换**:覆盖 `ascii.png`、`ascii_sga.png`、`unicode_page_00.png`、`unicode_page_01.png` 等核心字体文件
- **沉浸式体验**:聊天栏、物品名称、告示牌、书与笔、命令方块…… 所有文字都将以方块形式呈现
- **玩法扩展**:非常适合用于:
  - 密室逃脱 / 解谜地图
  - SCP 主题冒险
  - 视觉解谜与符号破译
  - 整蛊 / 搞笑生存
- **纯客户端**:无需安装任何模组,放入 `resourcepacks` 文件夹即可启用
- **兼容性好**:基于 1.20.1 资源包格式,可与大多数原版及模组材质包共存

### 安装方法

1. 将本资源包文件放入 `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` 目录
2. 在游戏选项 → 资源包中选择并启用
3. 进入世界,所有文字即刻变成方块!

> ⚠️ **注意**:由于文字被替换为方块,游戏内信息阅读将变得困难,请根据玩法需要合理使用。

---

## English Description

### Overview

This resource pack replaces the vanilla font textures in `assets/minecraft/textures/font/`, transforming **all English letters (A–Z, a–z), numbers (0–9), and common symbols** into **block-style** characters throughout the game.

### Features

- **Complete Override**: Replaces core font files including `ascii.png`, `ascii_sga.png`, `unicode_page_00.png`, and `unicode_page_01.png`
- **Full Immersion**: Chat, item names, signs, books & quills, command blocks — every text becomes blocks
- **Perfect For**:
  - Escape rooms / puzzle maps
  - SCP-themed adventures
  - Visual decoding & symbol puzzles
  - Pranks & chaotic survival challenges
- **Client-side Only**: No mods required — just drop it into `resourcepacks` and play
- **Highly Compatible**: Built on the 1.20.1 resource pack format, works alongside most vanilla and modded texture packs

### Installation

1. Place the `.zip` into your `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` folder
2. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs**
3. Launch a world — all text is now blocks!

> ⚠️ **Note**: Since all readable text becomes blocks, in-game information will be unreadable. Use intentionally for the best experience.

---

**Made with ❤ for the Minecraft community / 献给热爱 Minecraft 的玩家**

title: PlunderPixels Shader - Reimagined
description: Revived and reimagined from over a decade, a cutting edge gorgeous and immersive shaderpack.
body:
# PlunderPixels Shaders - Reimagined

**The shader you remember, back from the dead after more than a decade, and better than it has ever been.**

Years ago, PlunderPixels gave countless worlds their glow. Then it went quiet. Now it is back, rebuilt from the ground up by its original creator and re-engineered for modern Minecraft on the latest OptiFine and Iris. Same soul, brand new engine. Everything you loved is here, and everything that felt dated is gone.

This is not a re-upload. It is a top-to-bottom rebuild, in active development, with frequent updates and genuinely cutting-edge features landing all the time.

## Water like you have never seen in a legacy pack

- **Organic, reflective water.** The surface rolls with natural, wandering waves and mirrors the sky and the world around it. Clear looking straight down, a true mirror at a grazing angle.
- **Real caustics.** Sunlight caustics ripple across the shallow floor, projected from the sun's actual angle so they slide as the day turns, fading in the shade and with depth.
- **Underwater light shafts.** Dive under and shafts of light spear down through the water, toward the sun by day and the moon by night, cut off wherever a shadow falls. Murky water catches more of them, and at night you can still see up to the surface and the sky.
- **A dark, mirror-still night ocean** that catches the moon, the stars and the whole Milky Way on its surface.

## A sky worth looking up at

- **True volumetric clouds.** Soft, puffy 3D cumulus with real depth and self-shadowing, drifting on the wind. Warm sunlit tops, soft shadowed undersides, and clear blue gaps between them.
- **A dense night sky.** A custom, seam-free sky with a Milky Way packed with stars like a deep-field photograph, brighter toward the core, twinkling and wheeling overhead through the night.

## Everything you expect from a modern shader

- **Real soft sun shadows** that ground everything to the world, with adjustable softness and depth.
- **Full PBR (labPBR).** Drop in a PBR resource pack for deep normal-mapped detail, per-material reflectivity, ambient occlusion in the crevices, and true emissive blocks that glow on their own.
- **Cinematic light.** Filmic tonemapping, warm and cool grading, volumetric godrays, HDR bloom and lens flare.
- **A living, breathing world.** Grass, crops, leaves and flowers sway in a shared wind and stay rooted at the base like real plants.
- **Tune everything.** Nearly every look is a live in-game slider. Dial the mood, the shadows, the water, the clouds and the glow without editing a file.

## Frequent updates

PlunderPixels is being actively pushed forward. Water, sky and lighting get real, visible upgrades on a regular cadence, and new features are always in the pipeline. Follow the project to catch each drop.

## Companion mods in development

PlunderPixels is growing beyond the shader itself. A set of lightweight, client-side companion mods is currently in development, built to unlock effects a shader cannot pull off on its own and push the visuals even further. They are made by the same creator to drop straight into the pack, with no server changes needed. Follow the project to catch them as they land.

## Editions

![Golden Hour version](https://fecironworks.com/cdn/golden%20d.png)
![Golden Hour version](https://fecironworks.com/cdn/golden%20n.png)

![Vivid version](https://fecironworks.com/cdn/vivid%20d.png)
![Vivid version](https://fecironworks.com/cdn/vivid%20n.png)

![Legacy version](https://fecironworks.com/cdn/legacy%20d.png)
![Legacy version](https://fecironworks.com/cdn/legacy%20n.png)

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition with a recent **OptiFine**, or **Iris + Sodium**
- Works across the current 1.21 range on both loaders
- A **PBR (labPBR)** resource pack is optional but recommended to see the full normal, specular and emissive detail

Welcome back to PlunderPixels.

## Visually Refined

Visually Refined is a Minecraft modpack focused on improving the vanilla experience with better visuals, animations, atmosphere, and performance optimizations.

The goal of this modpack is to make Minecraft look more polished and immersive while keeping the game smooth and accessible. Instead of adding new content, mechanics, or changing the way Minecraft is played, Visually Refined focuses on refining the experience you already know.

Unlike many visual-focused modpacks that heavily impact performance, this modpack combines lightweight graphical improvements with optimization mods to achieve a balance between visual quality and FPS.

### Features
🎨 Visual Enhancements
- Improved entity models and textures
- Better animations for mobs and the player
- Connected textures and visual improvements
- Enhanced particles and environmental effects
- Shader support with lightweight options

⚡ Performance Improvements
- Optimized rendering and chunk loading
- Reduced memory usage
- FPS and stability improvements
- Designed to provide better performance while keeping visual quality

🌎 Immersive Vanilla Experience
- Dynamic ambient sounds
- Improved sound experience
- More detailed environments
- Small visual improvements that make the world feel more alive

⚙️ Quality of Life Improvements
- Better information displays
- Improved interfaces
- Vanilla-friendly enhancements

This modpack is still in development. Since this is my first modpack project, some bugs or issues may occur. Feedback is appreciated and helps improve future updates :)

title: Chunk Animator Embeddium Compat
description: Adds compatibility between the Chunk Animator mod and Embeddium/Xenon/Rubidium/Magnesium.
body:
![Chunk Animator Embeddium Compat Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/363627aa7ce6ec8e9d96ca2601714ef1d33aeb97.png)

Chunk Animator Embeddium Compat allows the Chunk Animator mod to work with the Embeddium mod as well as Xenon, Rubidium, and Magnesium.

Chunk Animator crashes on startup when Embeddium or Xenon is installed. Both replace vanilla's chunk-rendering pipeline with their own GPU-instanced per-region rendering. This makes Chunk Animator's mixin unable to find the vanilla call to hook to. 

A Mixin plugin stops Chunk Animator's incompatible LevelRenderer mixin at load time when Embeddium or Xenon is detected. New chunks are tracked, and their per-section offset is applied during Embeddium's render pass via a separate draw per animating chunk. The fast batched path still runs for every static section. 

Oculus runs without Embeddium when Xenon is installed; this mod supports either renderer.

This has been tested with multiple shaders.

Configuration:

- enabled: The master toggle.
- animationDurationMs: This is how long each chunk's animation lasts.
- startOffsetX / startOffsetY / startOffsetZ: Control the direction and distance to slide from.
- easing: This is animation curve options. LINEAR, QUAD_OUT, CUBIC_OUT, QUART_OUT, QUINT_OUT, SINE_OUT, EXPO_OUT, CIRC_OUT, BACK_OUT, BOUNCE_OUT.
- disableAroundPlayer + playerRadius: This suppress animations near the player.

Requirements:
Chunk Animator by Lumien231: [Chunk Animator](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chunk-animator)
One of these:
Embeddium by FiniteReality: [Embeddium](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/embeddium)
Xenon by Txni: [Xenon](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/xenon)

Notes:
This mod is client side only. Servers don't need it.
This mod replaces Chunk Animator's render hook with its own; you don't need to remove Chunk Animator. Both need to be installed.

If you have any incompatibilities or issues with this mod, leave a comment!

description: Adds unique plank textures for every wood type!
body:
**Nifty Planks** is a tiny texture pack that adds unique planks for every type of wood!

Well, some types remain unaffected, like Oak, which simply uses the default pattern, and Bamboo, since it was already unique. (Does it even count as a wood type? I'm still confused about that.)

Gameplay screenshots describe things much better than words, but I'd still like to explain how every block changes in this texture pack:

Oak - (unchanged)
Spruce - 2 rows, has an undulating pattern
Birch - 2 rows, has a wavy, triangular pattern
Dark Oak - Basically has bigger planks than Oak
Jungle - The texture is turned on its side with slight alterations
Acacia - The planks are diagonal

Bamboo - (unchanged)
Cherry - Planks' orientation alternates between horizontal and vertical
Mangrove - Planks take the shape of a Z piece
Pale Oak - A little worn, eyes can be seen peeking through

Crimson - The way the colors are used compared to Oak is inverted
Warped - The wood is completely deformed and swollen up

Poplar - Includes arrows in the rows, but otherwise pretty basic.

Note that the textures have no added or modified colors, only the way the patterns are drawn is what changes.
This was done to remain close to the Vanilla experience.
This texture pack should work for any Minecraft version, despite the warnings.

title: Create: Quarry
description: A Create addon that adds an automated, rotational-power-driven Quarry: link two Quarry Stakes to define a rectangular mining area, then let the Quarry excavate it layer by layer, filtering ores, replacing mined terrain, and optionally draining fluids.
body:
Create: Quarry

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gLTAirKi/images/1c202792924d4fba8065d8179ea75ee38691826b.gif) **A Create addon that adds a fully automated Quarry, powered by rotational force.** Link a pair of Quarry Stakes to mark out an area, connect the Quarry to a Create kinetic network, and watch it methodically strip-mine the ground below, layer by layer.
## ✨ Features * Link two **Quarry Stakes** to define a rectangular mining area of (almost) any size * Scans and extracts layer by layer, replacing mined blocks with a configurable fallback (stone, deepslate, netherrack, end stone, …) * Filter what gets extracted with a single item or any Create Filter — or default to mining ore tags automatically * Powered entirely by Create rotational force; scan speed scales with RPM * **Enchantable Quarry block** — apply Efficiency, Fortune or Silk Touch at an enchanting table to boost mining speed and change the drops * Optional fluid collection into an adjacent Fluid Tank * Optional chunk loading so the Quarry keeps working while you're away * Live tooltip readout: current state, progress, Y level, blocks scanned and ores extracted * Deeply configurable: stress impact, scan speed, ore tags, blacklists, dimension fallbacks and more
## ⚙️ How to Use Place two **Quarry Stakes** at opposite corners of the area you want mined, and right-click each with a **Wrench** to link them together. Place the **Quarry** block above the area, connect it to a Create rotational power source, and give it an adjacent inventory (like an Item Vault) to store its output. Optionally right-click the Quarry's front face with a single item — or any Create Filter — to restrict what it mines, and connect a Fluid Tank if you want it to also collect fluids it drains. The Quarry itself can be enchanted at an enchanting table (or with an anvil/enchanted book) just like a tool: **Efficiency** speeds up scanning (at the cost of extra Stress Impact), **Fortune** boosts ore drops, and **Silk Touch** collects blocks as-is instead of their normal drops.

title: Rocket Disable Tag
description: A minecraft plugin that disables the usage of rockets during combat.
body:
# RocketDisableTag

A PaperMC plugin for Minecraft 26.1 that prevents combat-tagged players from using firework rockets.

## Features

- Tags both the attacker and victim on melee or projectile hits.
- Maintains independent per-pair timers.
- Resets an existing pair timer to the configured duration when the same pair hits again.
- Blocks firework rocket use for tagged players.
- Shows each tagged player the longest remaining tag time on a draining boss bar.
- Plays a configurable sound when rocket use is blocked.
- Clears all tags involving a player when that player dies.
- Provides `/rdt cleartag`, `/rdt list`, and `/rdt reload` admin commands.

## Configuration

```yaml
tag-duration: 30
boss-bar-message: "You are combat tagged! No rockets for {time}s"
boss-bar-color: "RED"
boss-bar-style: "SOLID"
blocked-sound: "ENTITY_VILLAGER_NO"
blocked-sound-volume: 1.0
blocked-sound-pitch: 1.0
```

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/rdt cleartag <player>` | `rdt.admin` | Clears all active combat tags for the specified player. |
| `/rdt list` | `rdt.admin` | Lists all active tagged player pairs and remaining time. |
| `/rdt reload` | `rdt.admin` | Reloads `config.yml`. |

## Behavior Notes

- A player with multiple active pair tags sees the longest remaining tag time on the boss bar.
- Self-damage does not create a tag.
- Disconnecting does not clear active tags; a rejoining player remains tagged until the timer expires.
- Expired tags are pruned automatically.

# FastlyGrass

FastlyGrass is a lightweight resource pack that improves the look of grassy terrain by extending the top textures onto the sides of selected blocks for a cleaner, more seamless appearance.

### Affected blocks:

- Grass Block
- Dirt Path

Dirt Paths also extend their texture to the block below, creating smoother transitions in villages and pathways.

Unlike OptiFine's Better Grass, FastlyGrass is made entirely with vanilla block models. It requires no mods, uses no custom textures, and stays fully compatible with most resource packs.

### FAQ

- Q: Does this work with my resource pack?
- A: Yes. Since FastlyGrass only edits block models, it works with most texture packs.

- Q: Do I need OptiFine or any mods?
- A: No. It works in vanilla Minecraft.

- Q: Does it replace any textures?
- A: No. The pack only modifies block models, keeping the original textures from your resource pack.

### Why use FastlyGrass?

- Uses only vanilla block models
- No OptiFine or mods required
- Compatible with most resource packs
- Cleaner grass block and dirt path transitions
- Lightweight with virtually no performance impact

title: Kaze's Kit Setup
description: A datapack that adds the ability to create and load kits withoout using mods.
body:
This datapack adds the ability to save and load kits, mostly used for dueling players in private LAN worlds.

### **IMPORTANT** 
**This datapack requires the command to be enabled, as well as creative mode for the user.**

### **Installation Guide**
1. Download the ```.zip``` file for your version of Minecraft
2. Open Minecraft, select your world, click **Edit**, then **Open World Folder**
3. Open the datapack folder and drop the .zip file inside
4. Launch the world or ```/reload``` if your are already in the world


### **How to use**
1. Run command: ```/function setup:setup```
2. Place down the barrel, the white shulker box, and the chest you got from step 1.
3. In the white shulker box, replace the armor slots with yellow glass panes, the offhand slot with a green glass pane, and hotbar slots 1–9 with light blue glass panes. If you want to leave a slot empty, replace it with a yellow glass pane for armor slots, a green glass pane for offhand slots, and a light blue glass pane for hotbar slots.
4. In the chest, fill the slots you want for your inventory, and replace the empty/unwanted slots with dark gray glass panes. (Items will be placed into your inventory in this exact layout). If you want to leave a slot empty, replace it with a gray glass pane.
5. Hold CTRL and press pick-block (middle mouse button by default) on the chest and the white shulker box to save the items with their NBT data to your hotbar.
6. Put those saved items into the barrel you placed in Step 2. Then, use CTRL + pick-block on the barrel to save it to your hotbar. Finally, save your updated hotbar to your creative saved hotbars (by default, hold C and press 1).
7. To load the kit, simply place the barrel down, then place the Load Kit command block next to it.

This datapack limits how riptide works. When the player is outside of water and it is raining, the riptide enchantment for the trident will be disabled. This can be undone by entering water, waiting for the rain/thunder to stop or by changing dimension (Not sure if this works or not for other dimensions where it can rain. Only tested in overworld.)

The datapack does this by temporarly removing the riptide enchantment when the conditions are fulfilled (out of water and raining/thundering). It then gives the enchantment back when the conditions are unfullfilled (in water or clear weather (keep in mind you still won't be able to use riptide in clear weather unless you're in water)).

This datapack are for people that prefer only using riptide in the oceans or those who think it is too OP to be able to fling themselves around during rain.

title: RationalCraft

body:
A Minecraft Fabric mod that modifies an unreasonable original recipe and adds missing recipes.



Changes Included:

• Stairs: 3 blocks to make 4 stairs (originally 6), 2 × 2 to combine them

• Signboard: 1 Half-Brick + 1 Stick to make 1 Signboard

• Carpet: 2 wool to make 6 carpets (originally 3)

• Glass panels: 4 glass pieces combined into 12 glass panels (originally 6 → 16)

• Cutting copper: 4 copper blocks make 16 cut copper

• Half Brick: Added 2 blocks to combine into 4 half blocks, and 2 half blocks to reverse to merge into 1 block



New content:

• Stone cutters can process wood (planks→ half-bricks/stairs/fences)

• Stone cutters can peel logs

• Stone cutters can remove copper rust and apply wax

• The stone cutter can break down various blocks (coral, quartz, ice, drip stone, amethyst, etc.)

• The blast furnace can recover metal products as corresponding ingots per pellet

• The furnace can burn wool into dye

• Chests/Funnels/Shadow Boxes can be crafted using barrels instead

• Chain armor can be crafted using iron chains

• Deepslate can be converted from cobblestone in blast furnaces to achieve renewability

# Forecast!
Forecast is a small library for datapack users adding plenty of new function tags (similar to `tick` or `load`) for convience, hopefully.

## All Tags
- `entity_damaged` (when any entity takes damage)
- `entity_died` (when any entity dies)
- `player_joined` (when any player joins)
- `player_disconnected` (when any player leaves)
- `begin_sleeping` (when any player begins sleeping)
- `stop_sleeping` (when any player stops sleeping)
- `use_item` (when any player right clicks with an item)
- `use_entity` (when any player right clicks on an entity)
- `use_block` (when any player right clicks on a block)
- `hit_block` (when any player left clicks on a block)

This mod is intended to run on servers and **only** be used by datapacks!

title: The Mine Block
description: TheMineBlock adds simple, clean decorative metal plates in every color. Each base color can be transformed into an exclusive variant block using the stonecutter, and all variants have matching slabs.
body:
# TheMineBlock

**TheMineBlock** is a decorative block mod that adds **13 colorful metal plate blocks**, each with a unique stonecutter variant and slab.

All blocks have the same properties: **hardness 5.0**, **resistance 6.0**, **netherite-like sound**, **mineable with pickaxe** (requires iron tier+).

---

## 🔨 Crafting Recipe

Each base block is crafted with the same pattern:

```
  n       n = Iron Nugget
I d I     I = Iron Ingot
  n       d = Dye (matching color)
```

![craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54624b0e721b43251a86220ac1efff3e8136cbfd.jpeg)
**→ 3 blocks per craft**

---

## 🔪 Stonecutter Recipes

Each base block can be transformed into its variant using the stonecutter:

| Base Block | Dye | → Stonecutter | Slab |
|------------|-----|---------------|------|
| 🔴 Red Plate | Red | Crimson Plate | ✅ |
| 🟢 Green Plate | Green | Jade Plate | ✅ |
| ⚫ Black Plate | Black | Onyx Plate | ✅ |
| ⚪ White Plate | White | Platinum Plate | ✅ |
| 🔵 Blue Plate | Blue | Sapphire Plate | ✅ |
| 🟡 Yellow Plate | Yellow | Gold Plate | ✅ |
| 🟣 Purple Plate | Purple | Amethyst Plate | ✅ |
| 🔷 Cyan Plate | Cyan | Teal Plate | ✅ |
| 🩷 Pink Plate | Pink | Rose Plate | ✅ |
| 🟠 Orange Plate | Orange | Amber Plate | ✅ |
| 🍋 Lime Plate | Lime | Peridot Plate | ✅ |
| 🟤 Brown Plate | Brown | Umber Plate | ✅ |
| 🔘 Gray Plate | Gray | Pewter Plate | ✅ |

Each stonecutter recipe gives **1 variant block** or **2 slabs** per input block.

---

## 📦 Slab Recipes

- **Crafting table:** 1 block → 2 slabs
- **Stonecutter:** 1 block → 2 slabs

---

## ⛏️ Block Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Hardness | 5.0 |
| Resistance | 6.0 |
| Sound | Netherite Block |
| Mining tool | Pickaxe |
| Mining level | Iron or above |
| Drop | Itself (with silk touch or any pickaxe) |

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Install **NeoForge** for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Download the mod jar
3. Place it in your `mods` folder
4. Enjoy!

---

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- **NeoForge** 21.1.233+

---

## 🎨 About

TheMineBlock adds simple, clean decorative metal plates in every color. Each base color can be transformed into an exclusive variant block using the stonecutter, and all variants have matching slabs.

Perfect for builders who want consistent metallic decoration blocks across all color schemes!

# Indestructible Straw Beds
Straw Beds are great for skipping the night without setting your spawn point — but vanilla makes them break after a single use. This mod removes that limitation: sleep in a Straw Bed as many times as you want, and get out early without losing it either.

## Compatibility

Requires Fabric Loader + Fabric API.
Built for Minecraft 26.3-snapshot-3 and later 26.3 snapshots (may work on future 26.3 builds, but isn't guaranteed until tested).

## Notes

Straw Beds still can't be used in the Nether or the End — that vanilla restriction is untouched, only the "breaks after one use" behavior is removed.
This is a snapshot-era mod for a very new Minecraft feature; expect it to need updates as Straw Bed mechanics get tweaked in future snapshots.

title: Factory Forcer
description: completely bans lawn bases! aka, HOAs in Minecraft!
body:
Tired of seeing all your friends build lawn bases? Add HOAs to Minecraft!

Factory Forcer intends to force players to build actual factories, or at least houses, around their workstations and machines. Because minecraft has no weathering mechanics, players can build nuclear reactors, enchanting setups, steam engines, and various other unsightly contraptions smack dab in the middle of their lawn, driving down local property value!

The mod works by checking blocks that have the "factory_forcer:indoor_only" tag for a roof over them, and preventing the player from placing it if there is no roof, as well as giving them a message and returning the item. Furthermore, if a player tries to place a block on top, and then break it, all tagged blocks will break until the next roof as well. I highly recommend using a mod like KubeJS to add the tag to whatever blocks you may want to have this property, as well as modifying the blocks already included in the mod.

# Out of My Way

* Tamed animals (wolves, cats and parrots) are relocated behind you when they get too close or in your way.
* Configurable per-animal-type

title: FishingStats
description: Automatically tracks and analyzes all your fishing activity, recording casts, catches, bite times and treasure rates in real-time with a detailed session history, statistics and HUD overlay.
body:
# FishingStats

**Track every cast. Know every catch. Master the art of fishing!**

This client-side Fabric mod automatically tracks and analyzes all your fishing activity, recording casts, catches, bite times and treasure rates in real-time with a detailed session history, statistics and HUD overlay.

## Features

### Catch Tracking
- **Automatic detection** - Every cast and catch is recorded instantly, purely client-side (works in singleplayer and on servers)
- **Catch categories** - Fish, Books, Rods & Equipment, Other Treasure and Junk, with per-species counts
- **Bite timing** - Time from cast to bite is measured for every catch
- **Rod awareness** - Luck of the Sea, Lure and Unbreaking levels are stored with each catch
- **Open water detection** - Records whether a catch happened in open water
- **Session management** - Start, pause, and resume tracking sessions with a single keybind; the ESC menu pauses automatically and resumes when you return to the game
- **Session persistence** - Optionally save the active session across world closes

### HUD Overlay
- **Full mode** - Session duration, casts, catches, treasure rate and the last caught item
- **Compact mode** - Clean one-line summary with casts and catches
- **Customizable** - Position, opacity, scale, and visibility all adjustable

### Session History & Statistics
- **Sessions screen** - Browse all fishing sessions with date, duration, catches and treasure rate
- **Session details** - Time range, biome and dimension, cast/catch counts, category breakdown and full catch list per species
- **Enchantment statistics** - Catch rates compared by rod enchantment combination
- **Bite time analysis** - Average time to bite, broken down per Lure level
- **Session comparison** - Latest session vs. your all-time average (catches/h, treasure share)
- **Rare finds** - Treasure catches with biome and coordinates, so you can find that spot again

### Player-Friendly
- **In-game config** - Full YACL config screen via ModMenu
- **Keybinds** - Dedicated "FishingStats" category in controls
- **Localization** - English and German language support
- **Client-side only** - No server installation required

## Customization

Configure everything in-game via ModMenu:

**Tracking**
- Track treasure only (fish and junk still update the HUD)
- Session auto-split after configurable minutes of inactivity
- Session persistence on/off

**HUD**
- Position: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right
- Opacity: 0-100%
- Scale: 50-150%
- Visibility: always visible or only while fishing

**Keybinds** (Controls > FishingStats)
- `O` - Open the FishingStats window (Sessions & Statistics)
- `K` - Toggle compact HUD mode
- `J` - Start/pause/resume session
- `R` - Reset session (in sessions screen)

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 26.2
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.19.2 or higher
- **Fabric API**: Required
- **Java**: 25 or higher
- **ModMenu** + **YACL**: Recommended (for in-game config screen)

## Perfect For

title: VillagerTradeEditor
description: Villager Trade Editor is a server-side Fabric mod that lets server operators edit trades of ordinary villagers.
body:
# Villager Trade Editor

Villager Trade Editor is a server-side Fabric mod that lets server operators edit trades of ordinary villagers.

Players do not need to install this mod. It only has to be installed on the server.

## Features

- Sneak + right-click an ordinary villager to select it
- Add, replace, remove, list, and clear villager trades
- Create trades from hotbar slots
- Restrict trade editing to server operators only
- Add global timed trade limits
- Timed limits use Minecraft in-game time, so sleeping advances timers

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 21

## How to select a villager

Sneak + right-click an ordinary villager.

Only players with command permission level 2 or higher can select villagers and use the commands. By default, this means server operators only.

## Creating a trade

The mod creates trades from your hotbar:

- Hotbar slot 1: first cost
- Hotbar slot 2: optional second cost
- Hotbar slot 3: result item

Example:

If you want a villager to sell an enchanted diamond sword for 25 emeralds:

1. Put 25 emeralds in hotbar slot 1.
2. Leave hotbar slot 2 empty.
3. Put the enchanted diamond sword in hotbar slot 3.
4. Sneak + right-click the villager.
5. Run:

```mcfunction
/vtrade add
```

## Commands

```mcfunction
/vtrade help
```

Shows the help message.

```mcfunction
/vtrade list
```

Lists all trades of the selected villager.

```mcfunction
/vtrade add
```

Adds a new trade to the selected villager using items from hotbar slots 1, 2, and 3.

```mcfunction
/vtrade replace <number>
```

Replaces an existing trade with a new one using items from hotbar slots 1, 2, and 3.

Example:

```mcfunction
/vtrade replace 2
```

Replaces trade number 2.

```mcfunction
/vtrade remove <number>
```

Removes one trade from the selected villager.

Example:

```mcfunction
/vtrade remove 3
```

Removes trade number 3.

```mcfunction
/vtrade clear
```

Removes all trades from the selected villager.

title: OOUndeadExpansion
description: Undead mobs expansion for the upcoming modpack Ominous Odyssey.
body:
# OOUndeadExpansion
OOUndeadExpansion turns the animal life of your world into part of the undead threat.

Zombies and zombie animals can infect supported animals, creating hostile undead variants with their own behavior, visuals, and configurable stats. Infected animals use vanilla friendly yet deadly abilities and can easily become a formidable source of danger in the world. With the right items, they can also be cured back into living animals.

The mod was commissioned for the Ominous Odyssey modpack and is built for hostile survival gameplay, horror-leaning packs, and worlds where infection should feel like an active part of the ecosystem.

![OOUndeadExpansion.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/206c1801c20a8bad839a531fe59ca40f9444ef92.png)

## Features:
- Hostile zombie variants for many vanilla animals.
- Infection when supported animals are killed by zombies or zombie animals.
- Curing with Weakness effect and a Golden Apple.
- Configurable stats, loot, natural spawning, biome lists, and group sizes.
- Zombie animal reinforcements and help calls.
- Villager avoidance and zombie villager conversion support.

## Mobs:

### Vanilla-Based
- Zombie Chicken
- Zombie Cow
- Zombie Pig
- Zombie Sheep
- Zombie Wolf
- Zombie Ocelot
- Zombie Llama
- Frozen Polar Bear
- Zombie Horse - replaces vanilla zombie horse. Updated model and texture not included.

### Compatibility Mobs
- Zombie Panda - requires Future MC.
- Drowned Turtle - requires Oceanic Expanse.
- Drowned Dolphin - requires Oceanic Expanse.
- Glow Squid - replaces Oceanic Expanse glow squid when Oceanic Expanse is installed.

## Infection And Curing:
Infection is the main threat loop: animals killed by zombies or zombie animals can come back as hostile undead variants.

Animals can also be cured using Weakness effect and a Golden Apple, similar to vanilla zombie villagers, with unique animal data restored where supported.

![Bob.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/549f05be3db599df849287d8a2259bff9dda59b4_0.webp)

## Compatibility:

### Required
- Minecraft 1.12.2
- Minecraft Forge 14.23.5.2847 or newer
- MixinBooter
### Optional
- Future MC - enables zombie panda support.
- Oceanic Expanse - enables drowned dolphins, drowned turtles, hostile glow squid replacement, OE sounds, OE loot fallback, and OE mob conversions.
Optional compatibility content is only enabled when the related mod is installed.

## Configuration:
The mod includes configuration for natural spawning, mob stats, loot, biome lists, group sizes, and several mob-specific behaviors.

Examples include:

- Llama spit behavior.
- Pig death cloud behavior.
- Wolf healing.
- Ocelot spawn effects.
- Polar bear effects.
- Dolphin's Grace support.
- Aquatic spawn heights.

# ToolTiers ToolTiers brings RPG-style item quality to Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric. Every tool, weapon, armor piece, and utility item can roll a tier like Common, Rare, Legendary, or Mythic. Better tiers can give stronger bonuses, while lower tiers can come with tradeoffs. The result is a progression loop where gear feels less static and loot feels more exciting. ToolTiers is a continuation of the Tiered lineage, updated for modern Minecraft with active balancing and expansion. The original concept is inspired by Quality Tools.

title: Create: Hydraulics
description: Hydraulics, Fluids and Pressure, For The Create Mod!
body:
A hydraulic pressure expansion for the Create mod. Pressure and Hydraulics, brought to life.


     

--- ## About Create: Hydraulics adds a **hydraulic pressure network** to Minecraft as a companion system to Create's rotational kinetics. Build pipelines from Hardened Iron Pipes, source pressure from submerged intakes or a kinetic compressor, and drive a set of heavy industrial machines that press, punch, drill, and assemble. Every machine has full Ponder support. Press **W** while hovering any item from this mod to open its scene. --- ## Installation Requirements

 

Install **NeoForge 21.1.219** and **Create 6.0.x** for Minecraft 1.21.1, then drop the Create: Hydraulics `.jar` into your `mods/` folder alongside them. No additional setup is required. Optional configuration lives in `config/createhydraulics-common.toml` after the first run. --- ## The Pressure System Hydraulic pressure is measured in **PU (Pressure Units)**. Pipes carry pressure between segments, sources push it in, and machines draw from it. If the total load on a line exceeds its supplied pressure, every machine on that line stalls until the balance is restored. --- ## Community Join the Discord server to ask questions, share builds, report bugs, or follow development.

body:
# HideMyArmor

Client-side Fabric mod to selectively hide armor pieces on your player. Supports individual toggles for helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, and elytra — all configurable via ModMenu, in-game command, or keybind.

## Features

- Toggle each armor slot independently (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots)
- Elytra toggle separate from chestplate
- `/hidemyarmor` client command — toggle from chat without opening menus
- Configurable keybind (default: `H`) — press to show all armor, press again to restore
- Integrates with **ModMenu** + **Cloth Config** for a visual settings screen
- Lightweight: single mixin, ~15 KB jar, zero runtime overhead when not toggling

## Usage

### Commands

| Command | Action |
|---------|--------|
| `/hidemyarmor` | Show usage |
| `/hidemyarmor head` | Toggle helmet visibility |
| `/hidemyarmor chest` | Toggle chestplate visibility |
| `/hidemyarmor legs` | Toggle leggings visibility |
| `/hidemyarmor feet` | Toggle boots visibility |
| `/hidemyarmor elytra` | Toggle elytra visibility |
| `/hidemyarmor all` | Show all armor (saves current settings), run again to restore |
| `/hidemyarmor config` | Open settings screen |

### Keybind

Press `H` (configurable in Controls → Key Binds → Misc) to toggle all armor visibility.  
First press: saves your current settings and shows everything.  
Second press: restores your previous settings.

### ModMenu

title: Something Watches 2.0
description: A slow-burn horror mod that transforms your world into a paranoia-inducing nightmare. Featuring custom entities, random horror events, creepy signs, screen glitches, a horror dimension, and admin troll commands. Something is always watching.
body:
**Something Watches 2.0** is a slow-burn horror mod inspired by ARG-style Minecraft creepypastas like The Broken Script. It transforms your world into a paranoia-inducing nightmare where something is always watching.

## Entities
- **The Stalker** — A pitch black figure with red eyes that **silently follows you** from a distance. It knows where you are.
- **The Watcher** — Spawns suddenly **5 blocks away**, forces you to look at it, then **vanishes without a trace**.
- **The Victim** — A corrupted Steve who survived the incident. Type `help!` in chat and he will appear with a warning... then disappear.
- **Error666** — Something worse is out there. It watches from a distance and **vanishes the moment you get close**. The rumors are true.
- **Error666 (Boss)** — The thing behind everything. **Summonable only through ritual.** Do not seek this out unprepared.

## Paranoia
Hidden. Always tracking. The longer you survive, the worse it gets. Every scare, every sleepless night, every whispered warning pushes you closer to the edge — **Calm → Uneasy → Paranoid → Breaking → Corrupted**. Eating well can bring you back from the brink. Or it can consume you entirely.

## Events
- **Creepy signs** spawn randomly near you with messages like "Run" and "Death Is Near"
- **Random chat messages** appear from unknown sources
- **Screen glitch effects** with nausea and darkness
- **[REDACTED] joined the game** — but nobody joined
- **Good Luck.** — the sky turns to midnight instantly
- **Sleep is no longer safe** — try it enough times, and something will come for you
- **Fake lag** — your game "struggles" to keep up... or does it?

## Dimensions
- **StalkingHell** — A pitch black dimension **you were never meant to enter**, now reachable if sleep betrays you.

## The Ritual
Find the code. Speak it. Complete the circle. Hold the eye. **Some doors should stay closed.**

## Commands
| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/spawnwatcher` | Spawns The Watcher on a player |
| `/randomsign` | Spawns a creepy sign nearby |
| `/scarychatmessage` | Sends a random scary message |
| `/redactjoin` | Fakes a player joining |
| `/jumpscare` | Triggers a jumpscare |
| `/fakelag [player]` | Forces a fake lag spike |
| `/paranoia set/get` | View or set a player's paranoia level |
| `/death [player]` | Summons Death Is Near |

## Warning
Play at your own risk. Something Watches is designed to make you paranoid and uncomfortable. **You will never feel safe again.**

Compatible with multiplayer. Works best with headphones. 🎧

## Version 2.0
Something Watches has grown considerably since 1.0. It now includes:
- **6+ custom entities** — The Stalker, The Watcher, The Victim, Error666, Error666 (Boss), and more
- A **hidden paranoia system** with 5 escalating tiers
- **1 custom dimension** — StalkingHell
- A **full ritual system** to summon and defeat a final boss
- **New lore to uncover** — abandoned structures, coded messages, recovered logs
- **10+ admin commands**
- **10+ random events**, all scaling with paranoia
- Custom advancements, blocks, fluids, and biomes carried over and expanded from 1.0

More entities, events, dimensions, structures, and scares planned for future updates.

*Something is already watching you. It has been since you downloaded this.*
*It just got a lot more patient.*

title: Coordboard
description: A lightweight Create Aeronautics addon that lets Navigation Tables read coordinates directly from Create Clipboards.
body:
# Coordboard
![Logo Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/fKymtMde/images/cb85f707dc2fcd044fc1715bf4abe0db21d77004.png)
**Coordboard** is a small server-side addon for **[Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics)** that allows a **Navigation Table** to use a **[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) Clipboard** as a navigation target.

Instead of crafting or carrying dedicated navigation targets, simply write your destination coordinates on a Clipboard, check the desired entry, and insert it into the Navigation Table.

---

## Features

* Use a **Clipboard** directly in the **Navigation Table**.
* Read navigation coordinates from a checked Clipboard entry.
* Supports multiple coordinate formats.
* Reads the **top-most checked entry** on the **last opened Clipboard page**.
* Fully server-side; clients do not need to install the mod.

---

## Usage

1. Write one or more coordinates on a Clipboard.
2. Make sure each coordinate entry is written on a **single line**.
3. Check the coordinate you want to navigate to.
4. Make sure it is on the **last page you opened**.
5. Insert the Clipboard into a Navigation Table.

The Navigation Table will use the selected coordinate as its navigation target.

---

## Supported Coordinate Formats

### Labeled coordinates

```text
X: 120, Z: -450
```

```text
My Sweet Home: x=120 z=-450
```

### Two-coordinate format (X Z)

```text
120 -450
```

```text
120, -450
```

### Three-coordinate format (X Y Z)

```text
120 64 -450
```

```text
120, 64, -450
```

The **Y** value is ignored.

---

## Notes

* Coordinates must be written on a **single line**.
* Only **integer** coordinates are supported.
* The **Y coordinate is ignored**.
* If multiple entries are checked, the **top-most checked entry** on the **last opened Clipboard page** is used.
* Only checked entries are considered.

---

## Dependencies

* Create **6.0.10+**
* Create Aeronautics **1.2.1+**
* Minecraft **1.21.1**
* NeoForge

---

## Screenshots
![Coordinates in Clipboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86210882392655d2f14e569bf0ef1b46346c9bf4_0.webp)
* Clipboard containing coordinate entries.

![Clipboard fit in Navigation Table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/362bfe4a923cd6c21cab0a348adf91f9ae469e95.png)
* Navigation Table successfully recognizing a Clipboard as a navigation target.

---

# Rare Salty

Have you ever wanted to lower your Pokemon's level?

Have you ever looked at your team and thought:  
"What if my Dragonite was level 3?"

Probably not. But now you can.

Rare Salty adds a new Cobblemon item that works like a reversed Rare Candy. Instead of leveling your Pokemon up, it lowers the selected Pokemon by 1 level.

## Why?

If you play with mods inspired by difficulty hacks like Radical Red, or if your server uses level caps for gyms, tournaments, story progression, or competitive events, you may have run into situations where a Pokemon accidentally goes past the allowed level.

Rare Salty is meant to solve that in a clean, simple way.

Use the item, select a Pokemon from your party, and its level goes down by one. It will not reduce Pokemon below level 1.

## Features

- Adds the Rare Salty item
- Lowers a selected Cobblemon by 1 level
- Uses Cobblemon's party selection UI
- Prevents Pokemon from going below level 1
- Useful for level cap servers, challenge runs, tournaments, and custom economies
- Designed with server owners in mind

## Important

This mod currently does **not** add a crafting recipe.

Right now, Rare Salty is mainly intended for server owners who want to distribute or sell the item through commands, server shops, NPC shops, CobbleDollars, crates, rewards, or other economy systems.

Example command:

```mcfunction
give <player> reverse_rare_candy:reverse_rare_candy 1

# 🧩 DyhrTrivia

A lightweight, automated chat game plugin for your Minecraft server. **DyhrTrivia** periodically drops trivia questions directly into the server chat. The first player to type the correct answer wins a customizable reward, keeping your chat active, engaged, and competitive!

* **Fully Automated:** Questions are sent automatically based on your configured timer.
* **First-to-Respond Wins:** Rewards the fastest player to type the exact correct answer in chat.
* **Complete Customization:** Easily add your own questions, tweak the time intervals, and set the rewards.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Usage

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/dyhrtrivia reload` | Reloads the `config.yml` file to apply changes without restarting. |
| `/dyhrtrivia about` | Display the current plugin version and information. |

Everything you need to customize the game can be found in the `plugins/DyhrTrivia/config.yml` file. You can easily adjust:

* **Questions & Answers:** Create your own pool of custom trivia.
* **Intervals:** Choose exactly how often a new question appears in chat.
* **Rewards:** Set up what the winning player receives (e.g., in-game currency, items, or custom server commands).

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the `DyhrTrivia.jar` file.
2. Place the file into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server to generate the default folder and `config.yml`.
4. Customize your questions in `plugins/DyhrTrivia/config.yml`, then use `/dyhrtrivia reload` to apply them!

title: Ourcraft营造九州
description: Ourcraft公益服务器，无收费项目，15+原创插件，欢迎游玩。
body:
# Ourcraft

**本服为完全公益服务器，无付费项目**



## 序·九州邀约

昔有桃源避世，今筑九州琼台。Ourcraft经三载春秋，自三五知己竹马之戏，渐成科举功名之境。朝堂巍峨隐于枝桠，市廛琳琅藏于藤蔓。今启天门，邀四海君子共赴此九州，纵览八荒风月，品万物皆税之**乐**。



---
![Server screeshot 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81109f719ebb310f27b34a0f6d4f0307b183e7f9.webp)

![Server screeshot 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/289b90208d0d978491a8d2100640819ba39ec7b2.webp)

![Server screeshot 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c6d0655f97d09b022293bd29be32537bca2f50f.webp)

![Server screeshot 4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7e1814706bcdd2ec344c2cb7caaf69c2a4d5f2d_0.webp)

![Server screeshot 5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09331a24e547cbcd9d3ee5a98e98bcef8f0e9575.webp)

## ◇ 栖世四章 ◇





### 九州之境

主城初为青衿论道处，琉璃飞檐犹存墨香。后辟顶部为功名府，金榜题名映日月，恰如"春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花"之势。西北隅新起税课司，又有自制科举商城，星琼流转不过朝笏轻颤，凡功名权益皆明码于浮空玉牍，往来君子自可观星辰定价。

（科举功名系统、税课司、双货币经济）





### 四时之序

晨露未晞时，春耕者可执耒耜拓荒；暮云合璧处，秋狩者能挽雕弓逐鹿。垂纶碧潭可见金鳞化龙，熔炉锻铁偶得天外玄铁。更有二十四节气携异象，时而骤雨摧花，忽而霜雪覆枝，万物皆循天道轮转。季节副本限时启扉，节气祥瑞如约而至。

（二十四节气、季节副本、节日气泡粒子）





### 匠造之道

- 九重藤梯贯天地，金榜题名入琼宇（功名府·科举）
- 寒潭淬火生紫烟，千锤百炼出龙泉（淬炼系统·原版熔炉）
- 三阶宝石映朱紫，铁砧镶嵌显神威（宝石系统·功名分级）
- 万卷竹简悬空列，成就金榜现真章（OurcraftAchievement·原创插件十四类成就）





### 六合之约

虽言"大道至简"，然法度自在：

- 封地结界如金城汤池，箱箧封印似九重玄锁（Residence 封地、LWC 保护）
- 秦晋之约需三媒六聘，月色真美自天而降（婚姻系统·结婚送称号）
- 旧版通达如履平地，新版玄妙触手可及（全版本贯通，1.12+客户端均可游玩）
- 万言书悬于主城玉璧，百技要诀隐于全息星图（TrMenu 全中文菜单·/cd 一键直达）

---



## ◇ 栖游九鉴 ◇





### 易物之乐

树心藏玲珑阁，素绢轻裹奇珍：

自南海夜明珠至北冥玄冰刃，标价不过晨露数滴。星琼为日常通宝，创世结晶乃稀世之珍。钱庄票号汇通天下，星琼可兑结晶，结晶可兑星琼，典当、贷款、水滴筹一应俱全。更有抽奖补给箱，最稀之物乃工部尚书一日体验牒。

（双货币体系、钱庄兑换、抽奖补给箱）





### 竞技之仪

- 百步穿杨竞箭术，流矢划空若流星雨
- 双剑交击迸雷火，剑气纵横裂金石（生存小副本）
- 御风腾挪赛轻功，踏叶无痕胜凌波（功名飞行·进士免费）
- 潜渊闭气比龟息，浪涌千钧显真章





### 清修之趣

厌烦纷争者，可：

- 结庐云海间，朝采霞光暮煮雪（PlotSquared 家园·建筑月赛）
- 垂钓寒江畔，静观锦鲤化蛟龙（钓鱼税·两种钓鱼系统）
- 驯养玄狐随，夜探古墓觅遗简（BabyPets 宠物·副本探险）
- 雕琢机关兽，木牛流马自奔走（mcMMO 六艺修为·百工等级）

---



## ◇ 科举之路 ◇

九州以科举立国，功名乃君子立身之本：

- **庶民**踏入九州之地，公民之路始于足下
- **秀才**金榜初题，飞行二星琼每刻，领地十块
- **举人**乡试得中，可踏升迁工部之路，宝石一级可用
- **进士**殿试登科，飞行免费，宝石二级可用
- **工部侍郎**营造有功，领俸禄三成，宝石三级可用
- **工部尚书**工部之长，领俸禄六成，月赛建筑评审

进士权益满九十九日（即购十次），直晋工部侍郎。**卖官鬻爵亦非不可**，创世结晶可加速功名。更有弹劾之制——千星琼可弹劾他人，五成胜算，成则分其一日俸禄；剥削之术——百星琼可剥削指定之人，六成胜算，成则其税归己，一时辰方休。

（科举功名六阶、工部晋升、弹劾剥削、俸禄分配）



---



## ◇ 税课司志 ◇

普天之下，莫非王土；率土之滨，莫非王臣。

九州税制，万物皆税，然取图一乐之旨，税轻而乐大：

- 砍树一税，过门二税，钓鱼三税，打怪四税
- 传送五税，建造六税，交易七税，红包八税
- 在线每刻一税，离线每日一税，会员每月一税
- 富者多纳，贫者少纳，资产分级，五等定税

欠税一日，授"失信被执行人"之号；欠税千金不还，每次上线全服广播"超级老赖某某上线了"。失信之人，称号粒子会员工部之权皆没收，工部成员须重考。然天无绝人之路——水滴筹可向全服求援，抵押贷款可领地家园物品乃至本人作抵，利率每日一成。

（OurcraftTax 原创插件万物皆税、资产分级、失信执行、水滴筹贷款）



---



## ◇ 栖心之约 ◇

常驻君子若怀瑾握瑜，经三秋考验，自当授以「斫木斧」。然须谨记：

- 不坏阴阳平衡
- 不破山水脉络
- 不欺稚子初心



漏夜寅时常驻，月移花影可寻。若有疑难：

1. 抚主城中央，观万物典章（/cd 主菜单·驿传司/功名府/工部衙门/票号钱庄/玩乐坊/百宝囊）
2. 刻竹简投天信箱，不日必得回音（/bzzx 帮助中心）
3. 燃传讯烟花，千里瞬息相会（群号 1031761951）



---



> 此间非蓬莱胜似蓬莱，无丝竹而有清泉漱玉。



> 枝桠间悬吊床可揽星月，科举中藏金榜能悟玄机。



> 但携半卷诗书、三分侠气，便可：



> 上穷碧落下饮黄泉，科举功名笑傲九天。



> 古藤已结秋千待客至，金榜新刻契约为君留。

title: DiscordInGameConfig
description: DiscordInGameConfig is a simple plugin that adds Discord channel integration and full administration capabilities, including bans and mutes to your server.
body:
# DiscordInGameConfig 
**is a lightweight, modular administration utility designed to bridge your Minecraft server with Discord. It moves 100% of your daily loggingsetup, bot linking, word filtering, and punishment configurations into anelegant, animated in-game interface.**


No FTP configurations, no file reloads, no syntax errors. Just pure, real-time

control.



 **🌟 Standard Loggers vs. DiscordInGameConfig**


> 
**⚙️ Configuration**

❌ *Traditional Loggers: Open FTP ➔ Edit complex .yml ➔ Reload command ➔ Fix syntax errors ➔ Restart.

✅ DiscordInGameConfig: Type ``` /discordconfig``` ➔ Click a button in a beautiful GUI ➔ Saved instantly!



─── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ───



**🤬 Swearing & Ban Filters**

❌ Traditional Loggers: Hardcoded text configs, manual file additions.

✅ DiscordInGameConfig: Swearing & Ban Filters Hub with 1-click additions/removals.



─── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ───



**🎟️ Two-Way Moderation**

❌ Traditional Loggers:Flat text alerts, copy-paste commands manually.

✅ DiscordInGameConfig: Dynamic Discord Buttons ([Mute], [Ban], [Ignore]) that update states in real-time.



─── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ───



**🛡️ Security & Privacy**

❌ Traditional Loggers: Accidental password logging on /login or /register.

✅ DiscordInGameConfig: ProtocolLib Packet Interception (hides sensitive command packet arguments entirely).



─── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ───



**⚡ Anti-Cheat Checks**

❌ Traditional Loggers: Relies on heavy external anti-cheats to log actions.

✅ DiscordInGameConfig: Built-in action checks (Nuker, FastPlace, AutoClicker, Chat Spam) with Discord alerts.


#  **🚀 Key Features**



## **🛡️ Packet-Level Security Core**



Instead of relying on

simple chat listeners, the plugin intercepts command packets at the network

protocol layer (PacketType.Play.Client.CHAT_COMMAND) using ProtocolLib. When a

player types a registered private command (like /login or /register), our system

captures the base command and immediately drops logging for it before it even

hits the server logs or Discord.



## **🎨 Premium, Blurple-Themed Hub Layouts**



 All menus utilize a modern 54-slot inventory with custom styled Discord-colored borders

(Blue and Cyan stained glass). Buttons are mapped symmetrically to avoid

crowding, using 1.21-themed blocks (Recovery Compasses, Mace, Echo Shards,

Spyglasses). The transitions are animated sequentially, playing a soft crystal

amethyst sound (BLOCK_AMETHYST_BLOCK_STEP).

![Demo](https://i.postimg.cc/tTDGzYPP/0706.webp)


## **🎟️ Dynamic, State-Mutating Discord Buttons**


When an alert is sent, Discord displays buttons to your staff. Clicking [Mute] or [Ban] immediately triggers the corresponding in-game punishment console command. Simultaneously, the Discord button itself mutates (e.g., Mute changes to a green Unmute button, and Ban changes to Unban), keeping your staff synced on the current status of the

offender.

![Demo](https://i.postimg.cc/k5f1q23P/0706(1).webp)

**⚙️ Built-In Lightweight Anti-Cheat Actions**

Includes highly reliable, lightweight performance checks:



  - Nuker: Flags players breaking blocks too fast.

  - FastPlace: Flags block placing rate limits.

  - AutoClicker: Detects entities hit above CPS limits.

  - Chat Spam: Flags rate limits for spamming text messages. Limits can be

    toggled on/off and updated directly from the Filters Hub in-game.

![Demo](https://i.postimg.cc/J0gcw5ZW/input-(1).webp)



## **🗺️ Multi-Language Out of the Box**



Swap system languages instantly using the Language Selector. Supporting English,

Russian, Spanish, German, French, and Chinese.


![Demo](https://i.postimg.cc/T25mygXZ/0706(3).webp)


**📦 Default Configuration**




```
lang: "en"

bot-token: "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN"

channel-id: "YOUR_CHANNEL_ID"



settings:

  log-chat: true

  log-commands: true

  log-join: true

  log-quit: true

  log-suspicious: true



punishments:

  auto-punish: false

  mute-cmd: "mute %player% %duration% %reason%"

  ban-cmd: "ban %player% %duration% %reason%"

  mute-time: "1h"

  mute-reason: "Chat violation"

  ban-time: "perm"

  ban-reason: "Suspicious activity"

  unmute-cmd: "unmute %player%"

  unban-cmd: "unban %player%"



filters:

  banned-words:

    - "hack"

    - "cheat"

  ban-words:

    - "ddos"

    - "swat"

  suspicious-commands:

    - "/op"

    - "/stop"



anticheat:

  nuker-enabled: true

  nuker-limit: 20

  clicker-enabled: true

  clicker-limit: 25

  fastplace-enabled: true

  fastplace-limit: 15

  spam-enabled: true

  spam-limit: 5



privacy:

  hidden-commands:

    - "/login"

    - "/register"

    - "/l"

    - "/reg"
```




## **💬 Support & Community**



Need help with configuration, or want to suggest a new feature? [Join our Discord Server](https://discord.gg/KsbRusxeck)



[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Onayty/DiscordInGameConfig)

# ⚙️ Step-by-Step Discord Bot Setup

Step 1: Create the Discord Application

1. Go to the Discord [Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications)
2. Click New Application (top-right), name it (e.g., Server Logs), and click
Create.

Step 2: Retrieve Token & Enable Intents

1. In the sidebar, select Bot.
2. Click Reset Token and copy the generated key.
3. Scroll down to Privileged Gateway Intents and enable Message Content Intent
(required for Discord buttons to read clicks). Click Save Changes.

Step 3: Invite the Bot to Your Server

1. Go to OAuth2 -> URL Generator in the sidebar.
2. Select bot under Scopes.
3. Select Administrator under Bot Permissions (or View Channels, Send Messages,
and Embed Links).
4. Copy the URL at the bottom, open it in your browser, and authorize the bot.

Step 4: Link to Minecraft

1. Enable Developer Mode in Discord (User Settings -> Advanced).
2. Right-click your desired logging channel and click Copy Channel ID.
3. In-game, type /discordconfig -> Click Link Discord (Diamond) -> Left-click
Bot Token and paste it, then Left-click Channel ID and paste the ID. Your
bot is now connected!

title: PaperActions
description: This Plugin adds a Small API System to Paper called Actions. This allows Plugin developers to integrate Actions that Other Plugins can use without knowing what it does
body:
[![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bffca6484c864e8d6e3b2c35a5983ec367b6a29.png)](https://discord.gg/tUBAaKPut4)
[![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48679661883a8572b1d51d0ffea02c3c45d68126.png)](https://patreon.com/village_of_mods)                                                          
[![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62fa91ce9990762a42bf1b6ff2e7afee6e8c2be1.png)](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMqkL-SySug592UKcv8r29Q)
[![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40ef94cb4ed85adcb9c773b5b653be2e2bc21553.png)](https://github.com/Villagerzock/PaperActions)

# PaperActions

**PaperActions** is a lightweight API for Paper that allows plugins to expose and execute actions without depending directly on each other.

Instead of checking whether another plugin is installed and calling its API, plugins can simply register named actions that any other plugin can invoke.

## Features

* Annotation-based action registration
* Cross-plugin communication
* Named parameters
* Optional parameters
* Automatic type validation
* Lightweight with no configuration
* Designed for plugin interoperability

## How it works

Plugins register actions during startup. Other plugins can execute those actions using the action's unique identifier.

Every action is identified by:

`PluginName:ActionName`

This makes it easy for plugins to communicate without creating hard dependencies.

## Example Use Cases

* NPC interaction systems
* Custom event callbacks
* Minigame integrations
* Cross-plugin compatibility
* Placeholder or command callbacks
* Generic plugin APIs

## Requirements

* Paper
* Java 21 or newer

## Why PaperActions?

PaperActions provides a simple, standardized way for plugins to communicate. Rather than exposing large APIs or depending on implementation details, plugins can offer small, reusable actions that are easy to discover and execute.

The result is cleaner integrations, fewer hard dependencies, and a more modular plugin ecosystem.

title: ArgentinaCS
description: The biggest CS community in Argentina is now in Minecraft with protected land, proximity voice chat, and skills that level up as you play — plus quirky extras like TreeTwerk. Every new player starts with 3 days of free VIP
body:
**The biggest CS community in Argentina is now in Minecraft.**
*A Counter-Strike community (ArgentinaCS) — now also on Minecraft. Heads up: the community and staff are primarily Spanish-speaking (Argentina).*

## What is ArgentinaCS Minecraft?

A **Survival** server open to the whole community. No Premium account required — offline (cracked) accounts are supported via password registration — and you can also join from **Bedrock Edition** thanks to cross-play support.

## 🧭 Features

- **Land protection**: place a Protection Stone and no one else can break, build, or loot your chests. Sizes from 8 to 256 blocks, earned by playing.
- **Skills that level up on their own**: mining, farming, fishing, combat and more level up automatically as you play, with real in-game bonuses.
- **Death graves**: your items aren't lost on death — they're saved in a grave you can recover with `/graves`.
- **Homes, warps, and teleporting**: `/sethome`, `/warp`, `/tpa` and friends, like any serious survival server.
- **Playtime rewards**: `/playtime` gives you claimable rewards just for logging hours.
- **Proximity voice chat**: hear nearby players by installing the free Simple Voice Chat mod (optional — without it you play normally, just without voice).
- **Multi-version support**: join with almost any Minecraft Java version thanks to extended compatibility.

## 🕺 TreeTwerk

Our own custom mechanic: crouch repeatedly next to a crop or a tree sapling and it grows faster. No commands, no fuss — just twerk near it.

## 🎁 Start with an edge

- New players automatically get **3 days of free VIP** on first join, so you can try every perk.
- Invite friends with your `/referral` code: once your referral hits 1 hour of playtime, you get 5 days of VIP + a free Protection Stone (up to 5 referrals).

## ⭐ VIP rank (optional)

Purchased via `/vip`, lasts 30 days, and is paid through MercadoPago (QR code), with automatic, instant in-game delivery. It's not required to play — it's a supporter rank with quality-of-life perks:

| Benefit | Regular player | VIP |
|---|:-:|:-:|
| Protection stones | 2 | 7 |
| Homes (`/sethome`) | 3 | 5 |
| `/back` (return after death/teleport) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Night vision (`/nv`) | ❌ | ✅ |
| VeinMiner (mine a whole ore/tree vein at once) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Silk Spawner (move spawners) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Elytra Fusion (fly while wearing armor) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Skill XP | normal | +5% |

Every VIP purchase also comes with a free 32-size Protection Stone.

## 🛡 Serious moderation

Active anti-cheat and an appealable punishment system, plus staff available in-game via `/helpop`. We play clean here.

title: Tophat
description: Adds various utilities for datapacks, such as /gui, /motion, player data, and more
body:
# 📖 About
Adds various commands and other utilities. Datapackers and mapmakers may find this useful.

# 👀 Main Features

- **Player Data Access:** Gives ability to read and modify the player using the vanilla `/data` command
![Player data showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/eK23YiDJ/images/509ddc2cdb4e2146d534a5d3edeec9b418222a15.gif)

## Commands
- `/motion <add/set> <entity> <momentum>` - Applies the given momentum to the entity.
- `/gui <open/close> <player> <menu> <name> <force>`
  1. `close` - Closes a menu for the player. You can optionally specify the type of menu that should be closed.
  2. `open` - Opens a menu for the player. You can optionally specify the name of the container and whether it should open on top of other menus (`false` by default).
- `/eval <expression> <scale> <arguments/with>` - Evaluates mathematical and logical expressions represented as a string and returns its completion value. Supports variables via `arguments` and `with` macros.
- `/provoke <victim> <provoker>` - Provokes `victim` against `provoker`. If `victim` is a passive entity, it will panic instead.
- `/findblock <from> <to> <block> store <block/entity/storage>` - Searches for specific blocks within a defined cuboid. If the `store` argument is provided, it stores all found block IDs and their coordinates in the specified destination, returning the total count. Otherwise, returns 1 or 0 based on success.

**Full functionality is described on the [wiki](https://github.com/JustJabka/Tophat/wiki)** 💡

title: Death Trace
description: DeathTrace is a clean client-side Minecraft mod that saves your death location, shows a HUD tracker, and detects dropped items nearby — perfect for SMP servers without needing server installation.
body:
# DeathTrace

**DeathTrace** is a clean and lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that helps you find your death location on SMP servers without requiring anything to be installed on the server.

When you die, DeathTrace saves your exact death coordinates, dimension, and time of death. After respawning, it displays a simple HUD tracker with distance, coordinates, direction, and item status, making it much easier to return to your loot.

The mod is designed to feel fair and SMP-friendly. It does not teleport you, does not use server-side commands, and does not give admin-like tools. Everything works only on your client.

## Features

- Saves your death location automatically
- Shows the dimension where you died
- Displays a clean HUD tracker
- Shows distance to your death location
- Includes a smooth rotating direction arrow
- Lets you copy your death coordinates
- Detects dropped items near your death location
- Shows a list of detected items with item icons
- Supports customizable HUD positions
- Adds keybinds for HUD settings, item list, and stopping tracking
- Works on multiplayer servers without server installation
- Fully client-side

## Item Detection

DeathTrace can scan for dropped items near your death location when you get close enough. If the dropped items are visible to your client, the mod can show how many item stacks were detected and display them in a small GUI.

Because DeathTrace is client-side only, it cannot know what happened to your items from far away. If the chunk is not loaded or the server does not send the item entities to your client, the mod cannot detect them. This keeps the mod fair and prevents it from acting like a cheat.

## Keybinds

DeathTrace includes keybinds that can be changed in Minecraft controls:

- Open HUD Settings
- Open Detected Items
- Stop Tracking

The detected items GUI can be opened when nearby items are found. The GUI shows the item names, amounts, and icons.

## Why DeathTrace?

Most death coordinate mods only print your coordinates in chat and stop there. DeathTrace adds a cleaner and more modern experience with a HUD tracker, direction indicator, item detection, and a proper item list GUI.

It is made for players who want a helpful death tracker for survival and SMP gameplay without needing server-side support.

## Client-side only

DeathTrace only needs to be installed on your client. Other players on the server do not need the mod, and the server does not need to install anything.

This makes it perfect for SMP servers, private survival worlds, and multiplayer gameplay where you just want a better way to find your death location.

title: Grinding Station
description: The Grinding Station brings a vanilla+ way to turn your raw ore into ore dust, that then can be smelted into ingots! Also allows for processing other items as well.
body:
# The Grinding Station [fabric]

## Welcome to the Grinding Station Mod.
This mod intends to bring a vanilla friendly way to process your raw ore into a more efficient yield. By inserting a raw ore into this machine, once it process it you will be given 2 ore dust. This dust can now be smelted in a furnace or blasting station to generate 1 ingot per dust, making your mining excursions more efficient!

## Crafting the Grinding Station
To craft the Grinding Station, you will need is; a hopper, glass block, and a stonecutter. 


## Using the Grinding Station
Once you have crafted and placed a Grinding Station in your world, you will need to *power* the machine in order to start processing raw ores. To do this, you need to provide the Grinding Station with a redstone signal. A redstone signal can be a lever, plate, redstone torch, or redstone block.

Once the Grinding Station is powered, you can begin processing ore by loading the Grinding Station. The Grinding Station can be loaded by hand or by a hopper.
- **By hand**: Loading ore by hand is done by right clicking on the Grinding Station while an ore is equipped in the player's right hand (manual)
- **With Hopper**: place a hopper on the top and/or bottom of the Grinding Station, and load ore into the hopper (simple automation)
 
Once the Ore has been processe, ore dust will be ejected out of the front of the machine. Placing a hopper under the Grinding Station will collect the dust.

## Processing Recipes 

| Input              | Output        |
|--------------------|---------------|
| 1 raw iron         | 2 iron dust   |
| 1 raw copper       | 2 copper dust |
| 1 raw gold         | 2 gold dust   |
| 1 cobble stone     | 1 gravel      |

title: Perfect Homes
description: A highly customizable, GUI-based home management plugin featuring dynamic player limits, locked slot barrier indicators, and seamless teleport countdowns!
body:
#  ✨ **Features**

### 🏠 Core Functionality
* **GUI-Driven Selection** - A completely visual chest menu interface that replaces old-school chat commands.
* **Dynamic Slot Selection** - Freedom to choose any slot you want. If your limit is 3, you can use slots 1, 9, and 20 perfectly fine.
* **Smart Teleportation** - Standard teleport handling built specifically to prevent player confusion.

### 🎮 Player Experience
* **Interactive Management** - Right-click any set home to instantly open a sub-menu for advanced controls.
* **Visual Limit Indicators** - Locked empty slots automatically turn into Barrier blocks when a player hits their home limit.
* **Live Action-Bar Countdown** - Displays real-time countdown alerts straight to the player's action bar.
* **Movement Detection** - Automatically cancels an active teleport if the player walks away or jumps.

### ✏️ In-Game Customization
* **Chat Renaming Integration** - Players can click a button in the GUI and type the name directly into the game chat.
* **One-Click Deletion** - Simple and secure confirmation menus to prevent accidentally deleting an active home.

### 🛠️ Administration
* **Permission-Based Limits** - Dynamically controls how many homes a player rank can have using home.limit.<number>.
* **Admin Reload Command** - Update configuration files seamlessly without rebooting the entire game server.
* **Universal Configurations** - Change every message, material, and countdown timer directly in the config.yml file.
# ⚙️Config:


```
# Number of seconds before teleporting: 1 = 1 second
teleport-delay-seconds: 5
# If set to false, players will be able to move while teleporting. If set to true, teleportation will be canceled when moving.
cancel-teleport-on-move: true
# Number of homes in the /home GUI. Maximum amount of homes: 28!
max-allowed-homes: 5

gui-materials:
  filler-glass: "GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"
  home-set-bed: "RED_BED"
  home-unset-bed: "GRAY_BED"
  manage-rename-sign: "OAK_SIGN"
  manage-delete-item: "BARRIER"
  confirm-cancel-pane: "RED_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"
  confirm-delete-pane: "GREEN_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"

gui-titles:
  main: "Your Homes"
  manage: "Manage Home"
  confirm-delete: "Are you sure?"

messages:
  no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use this command."
  reload-success: "&aConfiguration reloaded successfully!"
  chat-prompt-rename: "&eType your new home name in chat. Type 'cancel' to exit."
  rename-success: "&aHome successfully renamed to &r%name%&a!"
  rename-cancelled: "&cHome renaming cancelled."
  teleport-start: "&aTeleporting to &r%name%&a..."
  teleport-countdown: "&eTeleporting in %time% seconds..."
  teleport-success: "&aTeleported successfully!"
  teleport-cancelled: "&cTeleport cancelled because you moved!"
  home-deleted: "&cHome successfully deleted."
  home-set: "&aHome successfully saved!"
  limit-reached: "&cYou have reached your maximum home limit of %limit%!"
```

# 🛠️Permissions
| Permission | Description | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `home.use` | Use the main home GUI interface | `true` |
| `home.admin` | Access administrative commands (reload) | `op` |
| `home.limit.<number>` | Sets custom maximum home limits for ranks | `none` |

title: Ultrabright Lib
description: Adds support for light levels above 15.
body:
# Ultrabright Lib

A library mod that extends Minecraft's light level system from the vanilla limit of **15** all the way up to **127**.

![Comparison between Ultrabright Torch and Regular Torch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c01f7f5e6eddd685416462fd713d8846cf42fd83.png)

## Features

- **Extended Light Levels** — Push the maximum light level from 15 to 127, enabling ultra-bright light sources
- **Easy Integration** — Other mods simply register blocks with light emission values above 15, and Ultrabright Lib handles the extended lighting automatically
- **Ultrabright Torch** — A creative-only test torch with a light level of 30, included to demonstrate the library's capabilities

## How It Works

Ultrabright Lib patches the vanilla light engine at the bit level, widening the internal storage from 4-bit to 8-bit. Extended light data is persisted to chunks and synchronized to clients seamlessly.

## Compatibility

Works with any NeoForge mod that registers blocks with light emission values above 15. No configuration required — simply install and enjoy.

title: WhiteLabelEconomy
description: WhiteLabelEconomy is a white-label, multi-currency economy plugin for Paper servers. It is built for server owners who want a branded economy system with configurable currency names.
body:
## Features

- Multi-currency economy
- Configurable currency names, symbols, decimals, and starting balances
- White-label branding through config.yml and messages.yml
- Fully editable player-facing messages
- Player-to-player payments
- Configurable transfer taxes with percentage and flat fees
- System tax collector account, such as system:tax
- Currency exchange with configurable rates and exchange fees
- Admin commands to set, give, and take balances
- Flatfile balance storage
- Unit-tested economy core

## Commands

Player commands:

- /eco help
- /eco balance [player] [currency]
- /balance [player] [currency]
- /bal [player] [currency]
- /money [player] [currency]
- /pay <player> <amount> [currency]
- /eco pay <player> <amount> [currency]
- /eco exchange <amount> <from_currency> <to_currency>
- /eco currencies

Admin commands:

- /eco admin set <player> <amount> [currency]
- /eco admin give <player> <amount> [currency]
- /eco admin take <player> <amount> [currency]
- /eco reload

## Permissions

wle.balance, wle.balance.others, wle.pay, wle.exchange, wle.admin, wle.reload

## White-label configuration

You can change the economy name, message prefix, colors, currency names, symbols, decimals, starting balances, and all player-facing messages without recompiling the plugin.

Example currency configuration:

currencies:
  coin:
    singular: "Coin"
    plural: "Coins"
    symbol: "⛃"
    decimals: 2
    starting-balance: "100.00"
  gem:
    singular: "Gem"
    plural: "Gems"
    symbol: "◆"
    decimals: 2
    starting-balance: "0.00"

## Installation

1. Download the plugin jar.
2. Place it in your Paper server's plugins folder.
3. Start the server once.
4. Edit config.yml and messages.yml.
5. Run /eco reload or restart the server.

## Compatibility

Built against Paper API 1.20.4 and Java 17.

## Current limitations

This is an early functional release. Vault, PlaceholderAPI, SQL storage, and persistent transaction audit history are not included yet. Real command aliases still come from plugin.yml, while branding, messages, and currencies are white-label configurable.
