# CobbleAdventures — Your Pokémon Journey Starts Here

Welcome to **CobbleAdventures** — a community-driven Cobblemon server where your Pokémon adventure truly comes to life. Explore a **vast, handcrafted world**, catch hundreds of Pokémon, battle your way to the top, and build something worth calling home — all alongside a growing community of trainers just like you. Whether you're here to compete, explore, or just vibe with your Pokémon, CobbleAdventures has something for everyone.

---

## 🌍 Explore a Living World

The CobbleAdventures world is built for **discovery and adventure**. Rare Pokémon hide in unexpected places, **custom structures** reward trainers who wander off the beaten path, and every biome feels alive with encounters waiting to happen. No two play sessions are the same — the world always has something new to offer.

---

## ⚔️ Battle & Compete

Think you have what it takes to be the best? **Challenge our server gyms**, climb the trainer rankings, and compete in **regular tournaments with real rewards** on the line. With **Mega Evolution and Z-Moves** all available, battles on CobbleAdventures have real depth, strategy, and stakes. Every win means something here.

---

## 🤝 Trade, Breed & Team Up

Some Pokémon are easier to find with a little help. Our **trading and breeding systems** make it easy to connect with other players, complete your Pokédex, and build the team you've always dreamed of. The CobbleAdventures community is **friendly, active, and always up for a trade** — you're never on this journey alone.

---

## 🏡 Build Your Base

CobbleAdventures isn't just about battling. **Claim your land**, build your dream base, set up your own Pokémon ranch, or even create a **player-run gym** for others to challenge. The world is yours to shape, and your mark on it is permanent.

---

## ✅ Server Features

- **1000+ Pokémon** catchable across the world
- **Mega Evolution, Dynamax & Z-Moves** for competitive depth
- **Player gyms & server-run tournaments** with real rewards
- **Full trading & breeding systems**
- **Land claiming & grief protection** — your builds are safe
- **Custom structures & rare hidden spawns**
- **Active, welcoming community**
- **Regular updates, events & seasonal content**
- **Balanced economy & progression systems**
- **High uptime & low latency** — always online when you are

---

## ⚙️ How to Join

1. Download the **CobbleAdventures modpack** from Modrinth
2. Install it with **one click** via the Modrinth App, Prism, or CurseForge
3. Launch the game, connect to the server, and **start your journey**

**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1 | **Modloader:** Fabric

---

## 💬 Join the Community

Connect with the rest of the CobbleAdventures community on our Discord at **discord.gg/cobbleadventures** — find teammates, arrange trades, sign up for tournaments, and stay up to date with **server news, events, and modpack updates**. Whether you're brand new or a seasoned trainer, there's a place for you here.

**Come catch 'em all. See you on CobbleAdventures.** 🎮

A whitelisted, community-driven survival SMP built for players who actually want to play — no client mods required.

**[tsnsmp.online](https://www.tsnsmp.online)**

title: CRUCIBLE
description: A semi-anarchy Economy SMP inspired by DonutSMP, featuring a fully-fledged player-driven economy with shops, auctions, spawners, and a bounty system. PvP, griefing, and scamming are all fair game — trust no one, build your empire.
body:
# Crucible

A semi-anarchy Economy SMP inspired by DonutSMP. Build your wealth, dominate the market, and eliminate your competition — Crucible has no rules, only winners and losers.

---

## World
- Open world with no land claiming or protection
- Griefing, raiding, and scamming are permitted
- Spawn is protected — everything beyond it is fair game

---

## Economy
- **Player Shops** — set up your own chest shop anywhere in the world
- **Auction House** — list and bid on items across the entire server
- **Admin Shop** — convert your loot into cash at /warp shop
- **Dual Currency** — earn Money through trading and Shards through PvP
- **Crates** — redeem Shards for randomized high-value rewards

---

## PvP
- Open PvP across the entire map outside of spawn
- **Bounty System** — place bounties on players, collect on kills
- **Duels** — structured 1v1 combat with optional monetary wager
- **Combat Logging** — disconnecting mid-fight results in automatic death
- **Teams** — form alliances to control territory and dominate rivals

---

## Progression
- **Spawners** — automate resource generation for passive income
- **Leaderboards** — global rankings for wealth, kills, and playtime
- **Daily Rewards** — consecutive login bonuses with escalating value

---

## Rules
- Hacking, exploiting, and cheating are strictly prohibited
- Griefing, scamming, and PvP are fully permitted
- Spawn zone is a no-PvP, no-grief safe area

---

*Build. Grind. Dominate.*

title: LurialCraft
description: LurialCraft is a classic survival Minecraft server featuring optional PvP via commands, full land protection, a player-driven marketplace, clans, weekly events, and organized clan wars.
body:
O **LurialCraft** é um servidor de Minecraft focado **100% em Survival Puro e Clássico**. O propósito do projeto é resgatar a essência da sobrevivência tradicional, eliminando sistemas complexos ou mecânicas que poluem a jogabilidade. O servidor funciona como um ambiente focado na comunidade, onde os próprios jogadores moldam o mundo, a economia e as interações.

Aqui, o progresso depende do seu esforço, seja jogando sozinho ou em equipe.

### 🛡️ Funcionamento e Principais Recursos

O servidor opera com sistemas diretos e práticos para garantir uma jogabilidade segura, divertida e competitiva na medida certa:

* 🏠 **Proteção de Terrenos Absoluta:** Um sistema simples de reivindicação de blocos que garante a segurança total das suas construções e baús. Jogue em paz sabendo que suas criações estão protegidas contra griefers.
* ⚖️ **Mercado Livre entre Jogadores:** A economia do servidor é totalmente movida pela comunidade. Você pode criar suas próprias lojas, definir seus preços, vender recursos excedentes e comprar o que precisa direto de outros players.
* ⚔️ **PvP Opcional no Mundo Aberto:** O controle está nas suas mãos. Ative ou desative o PvP quando quiser para explorar e minerar no seu próprio ritmo, sem o risco de ser pego de surpresa.
* 👥 **Sistema de Clãs:** Junte-se aos seus amigos para fundar clãs, organizar equipes de construção e centralizar o comércio de grandes recursos no servidor.
* 📈 **Economia Balanceada:** Um sistema financeiro limpo e direto, projetado para valorizar o tempo de jogo e o comércio justo, sem facilidades que estraguem a graça do Survival.

---

### ⚔️ Competição e Comunidade: Eventos e Guerras

Mesmo sendo um servidor focado em Survival, a diversão e a disputa saudável têm espaço garantido através de eventos organizados:

* 🏆 **Eventos Semanais:** Todo final de semana o servidor conta com eventos especiais valendo recompensas exclusivas, itens raros e dinheiro para a economia do jogo. São desafios que testam as habilidades de sobrevivência, parkour, mineração ou agilidade da comunidade.
* 🏹 **Guerras de Clãs:** Para os clãs que buscam provar sua supremacia, o servidor conta com arenas e eventos dedicados de guerra. Nesses momentos, o PvP opcional fica de lado e os clãs se enfrentam em combates estratégicos e organizados para disputar o título de grupo mais poderoso do LurialCraft.

### 🚀 Propósito do Projeto

> Nosso foco é a estabilidade, o respeito ao tempo investido pelo jogador e uma comunidade unida. Aqui você escolhe o seu caminho: enriquecer pelo comércio, vencer eventos com seu clã ou apenas construir sua base em paz.

title: Knopia
description: A non-profit smp, est. Jan 2023, supports offline & Bedrock.
body:
# **Basic Information**
Launched on 2023/1/19, formerly known as Supercharge / Maintrav / MaintravWorld. A non-profit vanilla survival server funded and maintained solely by the owner. The server uses only lightweight plugins that slightly enhance vanilla gameplay — no land claiming or economy plugins. It relies on operation logging and chunk rollbacks to prevent griefing.
## **Server Software Information**
Uses the Luminol, which runs multi-threaded while preserving vanilla mechanics as much as possible, and supports the vast majority of redstone machines.
## **Server Hardware Information**
Self-built physical machine, China Telecom home broadband, Intel 11900F processor, 32GB RAM, 1TB storage, 7x24H stable operation.
## Server Plugin Information
### **Geyser**
Bedrock interoperability, supports multi-platform play.
### **EasyBot**
Bridges server with chat groups; requires linking a social account to play.
### **CoreProtect**
Logging and inspection; all actions are traceable, area rollback available.
### **Authme**
protects offline-mode accounts from theft; Bedrock players skip login.
### **Simple Voice Chat**
easier communication via voice chat.
### **Other Small Features Include:**
1.Use a command to consume ancient debris and teleport to spawn or world spawn point.
2.When a tree's trunk is chopped down, its leaves decay quickly. Using a tool with Silk Touch to chop the trunk drops the leaves.
3.Right-click while holding a shulker box, crafting table, etc., to open them directly.
4.Restrict certain item operations for new players who haven't played enough total time.
5.Using a goat horn calls all pets within a 64‑block radius to your side, and they follow you for a short while.
6.While leading a tamed pet, sneak+right-click on another player to transfer the pet to them.
7.Loyalty‑enchanted tridents will return even if thrown into the void.
8.Most mobs have a chance to drop their own head upon death.
9.When a player is killed by another player, the victim drops their head.
10.Fire charges can be thrown with an empty hand.
11.Sneak+click on an armor stand to change its pose.
12.Breaking a painting with a Silk Touch tool yields that specific painting variant.
13.Spawners can be mined and dropped with Silk Touch (decorational only).
14.Right‑click an item frame with shears to make it invisible.
15.During thunderstorms, lightning strikes have a chance to spawn a zombie riding a zombie horse.
16.Villagers are attracted to players holding an emerald block.
17.Right‑click a named mob with shears to remove the name tag.
18.Restores the 1.8 sword blocking mechanic, slightly adjusted to fit the new version.
19.Removes the “Too Expensive!” limit on anvils, and provides a clever way for players to put conflicting enchantments together.
20.When enough players sleep, a short animation plays and the night is skipped.
21.Explosions from creepers, ghast fireballs, withers, etc., do not destroy blocks.
### **Server Operation Policy**
Non‑profit, forever; world save, long‑lasting.
Follow original game principles, strive for goodness and beauty.
Rules are established; mistakes will be addressed.
Act according to regulations; rights and responsibilities are clear.
### **Current Server Status**
The server spawn has been changed, new players can start with a fresh experience.
Updated some plugins, still improving server functionality.
Developing useful and interesting small features.
### **Future Server Plans**
Planned upgrade to a 9950X platform (and related components) from late April to mid‑June.
Develop a series of unique items, enchantments, and features that don’t interfere with vanilla gameplay.
Build a creative server (identical to the main survival server) for players to test their machines.
# **服务器基本信息**
2023/1/19开服，曾用名Supercharge Maintrav MaintravWorld，为公益性的原版生存服务器，由服主独自出资与维护，服务器插件仅轻量改良原版玩法，无圈地经济等插件，以操作查询和区块回档防止恶意破坏
## **服务端信息**
使用luminol服务端，多线程运行的同时尽可能还原了原版特性，且支持绝大部分生电机器
## **服务器主机信息**
自建物理机，中国电信家用宽带，11900f处理器，32G内存，1T储存，7x24H稳定运行
## **服务器插件信息**
### **Geyser**
基岩互通，支持多平台游玩
### **EasyBot**
群服互通，游玩需绑定社交账号
### **CoreProtect**
操作留痕有迹可循，可局部回档
### **Authme**
登录，离线服务器防止盗号
## **其他小特性包括：**
1.通过命令消耗远古残骸传送到出生点与世界生成点
2.砍掉树干的树，其树叶会快速腐烂，使用精准采集工具砍掉树干则掉落树叶
3.手持右键直接打开潜影盒工作台等道具
4.限制不满游戏时长的新玩家操作某些物品
5.手持山羊角使用，即可把周围64格内的宠物唤到身边并跟随一小段时间
6.牵着已驯服的宠物，潜行+右键另一位玩家，即可把宠物转交给对方
7.附魔忠诚的三叉戟掉入虚空也能返回
8.大部分生物死亡时有概率掉落自己的头

title: CivMC
description: A hardcore nation-building experience! Running for 4 years, and the map has never reset! 100+ players at peak times every day!!
body:
CivMC is a long-term civilization simulation server. The server (and map) are almost 4 years old now, and the map has never reset! At the moment we have 100+ players at peak times every day!!

The server is sometimes referred to as “semi-anarchy” because although the admins will take action against harassment, hacking and cheating there is very little else that will get them involved. Griefing and raiding are therefore allowed, but don’t let that trick you! Player enforced justice is very much possible on CivMC. So don’t think a powerful nation is just going to let you get away with raiding or griefing them, you might just find yourself a one way ticket to hell!.

With this concept of player enforced justice CivMC takes the world of “towny” and “factions” to greater heights, with more freedom and flexibility for the players without devolving into a completely lawless land like 2b2t. With nations and organisations arising across the server!

We have multiple plugins developed over the course of many years that give you the power to control the world in the ways most other Minecraft servers do not:

- Citadel allows you to reinforce blocks, chests, doors etc... with a limited amount of health!
- Enforce justice using ExilePearl, allowing you to imprison your fellow players in the nether by killing them with a pearl in your hotbar and then fueling their pearl.
- Defend against grief with bastions which provide regional protection with limited health.
- Create custom groups using Namelayer, allowing you to distribute permissions to other players and chat from across the map. You also have your own private group by default, to view the GUI for groups do /nl.
- Climb the tech tree with FactoryMod which gives you the power to harness industrial power and surpass vanilla efficiency.
- Custom ore generation to help combat x-ray using HiddenOre. This generates ores as you mine. Some ores also spawn in massive veins (and diamonds only spawn in veins) where if you mine in the area around an ore once you find a vein you’ll find more ore. Veins contain multiple stacks of ore if you can figure them out!!!
- Experiment with and discover brew drinks using the breweryx mod, some of which confer useful benefits!
- Farm crops with realistic biomes which creates biome diversity and increases the growth times of crops. Using greenhouse blocks (glowstone) crops can even grow underground. See what grows in your biome using /rb then mass produce and trade crops with nations who can’t produce what you can!
- Buy and Sell goods with ItemExchange, which lets you setup shop chests for trading.

Explore a map that is now over three years old, filled with ruins of forgotten civilizations, massive bustling cities full of activity and commerce, long forgotten monuments, huge farms and military installations of a level you won't see on any other server! 
You can explore our world map in this player-created and maintained map which shows you the many nations of the world, as well as transport routes and individual settlements. Political scandals, military coups, ancient ruins to explore, untapped mercantile opportunities, strange nations with alien architecture and expansive cities full of activity and community. 

CivMC contains many opportunities and niches in which you can carve out a space; how will you leave your mark on the server!?

Races Introduction
In Hope Kingdom, you can choose from the following races, each with unique abilities and lore:

Angel: A benevolent race that came into being after a human accidentally transformed into a kind creature.

Origin: Humans who wore leather armor, held a feather, and died from a fall.
Racial Talents: Quickly regenerates energy over time.
Passive Skills: No fall damage, no water damage.
Active Skills: Flying Dash, Summon Cow, Summon Pig, Energy Recovery, Health Recovery.
Weaknesses: Cannot harm animals or humans, can only wear leather armor.
Demon: A sinister race transformed through a mysterious ritual.

Origin: Humans wearing chainmail, transformed after perishing in Nether lava.
Racial Talents: Naturally regenerates energy over time and regenerates energy quickly in lava.
Passive Skills: Immune to fire, immune to lava, quickly regenerates health in lava.

Weaknesses: Cannot wear armor other than chainmail.
Vampire: A dark creature with great power but a fear of sunlight.

Origin: Created by using the item "Blood of Cain." The first human to use it becomes the progenitor vampire. Humans killed by vampires are turned into vampires, but their power gradually weakens.
Racial Talents: Level bonuses, time-based bonuses, slow energy regeneration over time.
Passive Skills: Reduced damage underwater, fast health regeneration, increased melee damage, increased defense, truce with monsters, no fall damage.

Weaknesses: Burns in sunlight without a golden helmet; takes increased damage from wooden weapons; can only eat raw meat.
Werewolf: A dark creature with immense power during the night.

Racial Talents: Restores energy by killing creatures or eating raw meat at night; very slow energy regeneration over time.
Passive Skills: Fast health regeneration at night, increased melee and ranged attack damage, reduced fall damage.
Active Skills: Summon Wolf, Charge.
Weaknesses: Loses most abilities during the day.

body:
# 🌌 SquareIO | Unlimited Open-World Skyblock

Welcome to **SquareIO**, the ultimate destination for the **Skyblock Infinite** gameplay experience! Powered natively by Modrinth's revolutionary [Skyblock Infinite Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) and built upon a heavily customized server architecture, we offer a massive, borderless multiplayer world. 

Instead of traditional, cramped islands, we embrace the endless progression and dynamic resource generation of **Skyblock Infinite**. Best of all? **100% Vanilla clients can join.** You don't need to download or install a single mod pack to experience everything our custom-tailored [Skyblock Infinite](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) world has to offer.

---

## 🚀 Unique Features

* **♾️ Open-World Skyblock Infinite (No Borders!)**
  Unlike traditional servers that lock you inside a tiny bedrock box, SquareIO opens up the world. Travel across the endless void, build massive bridges, meet your neighbors, and team up naturally in a completely seamless world driven by [Skyblock Infinite's](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) progression mechanics.

* **🏝️ 17 Unique Starter Islands**
  When you type `/island`, you aren't stuck with just one template. Choose carefully from **17 different starting layouts** to find the perfect foundation for your sky empire. *(Choose wisely: island creation is permanent!)*

* **🌾 Dedicated Resource World & Custom Nether**
  Never run out of building materials. Use `/resources` to gather blocks in a resettable resource world. Plus, we've overhauled the Nether overworld-to-Nether ratio from **8:1 to 1:1**, allowing for precise coordinate management and easier exploration.

* **🛠️ Completely Custom Server-Side Mods**
  We run a blend of highly optimized open-source performance mods alongside our own **in-house developer creations** (like *BasicsMod*, *ClaimMod*, *EcoBal*, *RankupMod*, *ShopShelves*, and *SwordSight*) to deliver a smooth, feature-rich experience without requiring client downloads.

---

## 📈 Free In-Game Rankup System (8 Tiers)

No pay-to-win mechanics here. Complete in-game tasks (breaking blocks, breeding animals, etc.) and use your hard-earned in-game currency to unlock powerful utilities across **8 distinct ranks**. 

Click below to reveal the progression tree:

<details>
<summary>🔍 Click to expand Rank Details</summary>

| Rank | Claim Blocks | Homes / Warps | Unlocked Abilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Vessel** | +250 | 2 Homes | Color codes on signs, Shift+Right Click signs |
| **Drift** | +500 | 1 Player Warp | Access to `/workbench` and `/sleep`, formatting on signs |
| **Cinder** | +500 | 3 Homes | `/feed` (1hr cooldown), `/hat`, Glow ink not consumed on signs |
| **Pillar** | +1000 | 2 Player Warps | `/enderchest`, `/heal` (2hr cooldown, restores health), Sign icons |
| **Relic** | +1500 | 4 Homes | `/heal` (90m cooldown), `/glow white`, Lead villagers, Phantoms ignore you |
| **Exalt** | +2500 | — | `/feed` (30m cooldown), `/glow light_purple`, `/heal` removes bad effects, Vexes ignore you |
| **Zenith** | +3750 | 3 Player Warps | `/heal` (60m cooldown), `/glow yellow`, 5 total homes |
| **Apeiron**| +5000 | 6 Homes | `/glow aqua`, `/heal` grants Golden Apple effects |

</details>

---

## 🗳️ Voting Rewards

Support the server by typing `/vote` and get instant progression boosts:
* **Every Vote:** $100 In-Game Balance + 100 Claim Blocks
* **Every 5th Vote:** 2x Diamonds bonus!

---

## 🛠️ Server Rules Summary (Type `/rules` In-Game)

To keep our community welcoming and lag-free, please follow these core guidelines:

1. **No Griefing or Stealing**
   * This applies to ALL builds on the server.
   * Taking items or breaking blocks from unclaimed land is strictly banned, just like claimed land.

2. **Chat Etiquette**
   * Keep chat family-friendly and appropriate for all ages.
   * Use English-only in global chat (utilize private messages for other languages).
   * Respect all players and staff members at all times.

3. **No Automation or Cheats**
   * Auto-clickers, macros, and Baritone are heavily penalized.
   * X-ray, ESP, fly, reach, and hacked clients are strictly prohibited.

4. **Performance Friendly Gameplay**
   * Massive redstone builds or mob farms **must** have a physical ON/OFF switch.
   * You must disable your farms when you log off or leave the area.
   * Zero-tick farms are completely forbidden.

5. **Allowed Client-Side Mods**
   * Technical utilities like *Litematica* (hologram display only), *MiniHUD*, and *Item Scroller* are fully permitted.
   * Standard minimaps are allowed for navigation purposes.

---

## 🎮 How to Join

1. Open Minecraft (Vanilla or Modded Fabric/Forge) and go to **Multiplayer**.
2. Click **Add Server**, paste the IP listed on this page, and hit **Done**.
3. Log in, type `/island` to pick your [Skyblock Infinite](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) starting island, or check `/help` to open the interactive **Command Gateway**!

title: Claim & Conquer
description: Paper plugin for chunk-based territories: foreign players cannot break, place, or fight inside claims. Wilderness PvP combat-tags both sides, blocking entry into your columns until timers lapse and executing tagged logouts with killer credit.
body:
TerritoryPvP is a Paper plugin for chunk-based territory control on a PvP-focused server. Players own axis-aligned rectangles of full chunk columns (16×16 × world height); overlapping claims, a spawn-shield ring around world spawn, and min/max claim sizes are enforced in config.

Claiming & progression — Starting claims can be placed automatically on first join; territory can grow or shrink via kills (killer expands, victim shrinks, configurable) and optionally via golden hoe + territory points. Claims can be persisted with Postgres/JDBC (e.g. Supabase) or kept in memory only.

World rules — Gameplay applies only to configured game worlds (or all worlds if the allowlist is empty). New players without a claim can get a random spawn inside the world border, with extra rolls to avoid unsafe columns (lava, water, hazards, waterlogged blocks).

Inside claimed chunk columns — Foreigners generally can’t break, place, or interact with blocks; PvP is cancelled if either side is standing in any claim column (wilderness-only fights). Explosions remove blocks from foreign claims unless primed TNT is attributed to that claim’s owner; fire spread and ender pearls / chorus into someone else’s column can be blocked via config.

Fairness & UX — Optional territory gear tiers cap golden apples and armor/weapon enchant levels by claim footprint size, with /claim tier and /claim chunks plus combat-cap hints on /claim info. /claim boundary shows a live outline at eye height and vertical markers on outer chunk corners.

Combat tag — After actual player-vs-player damage in game worlds (wilderness hits; cancelled safe-zone hits don’t tag), both fighters get a timer (default 45 s): they can’t enter their own claim while tagged. Optional combat logging: disconnect while tagged applies lethal damage and credits the online opponent like a normal kill for territory/points logic.

Ops — /tpvp reload reloads gameplay/config caches (not the DB pool). Admin commands handle expand/shrink, points, chunk info, teleport to a player’s claim, etc.

Overall it’s a “Claim & Conquer” style loop: fight in the open, hold ground in chunks you own, with config-driven limits so large empires and combat escapes stay manageable.

(This plugin was Produced and Developed by Cursor, Composer 2 AI)

* **Website:** [www.mnvibes.org](https://www.mnvibes.org)
* **Discord:** [dsc.gg/mnvibes](https://dsc.gg/mnvibes)
---

### 📌 Bottom line

Welcome to the MongolVibes family! We are not just another server you play for a week and forget; we are a passion project built on years of community history. We actually listen to what our players want, which is why we are currently running a Vanilla Survival experience focused on building an awesome community and a player-driven economy. You can grab your pickaxe and jump into version 1.21.x with us right now.

Surviving out there can be tough since we play on Hard Mode, meaning you can actually die from starvation and zombies will try to break down your doors. To keep everyone close enough to trade and interact, the world is contained within a 12,000 block border. When it comes to protecting your hard work, you can create a group and claim 16x16 chunks of land, and as the owner, you get to set your own rules for things like PvP and explosions. Even if you do not have a claim set up yet, you can instantly lock your chests, doors, and barrels just by putting a sign on them. Also, you do not have to yell at everyone to sleep anymore, because if just 50 percent of the players hop in bed, the night skips automatically.

Our economy is completely run by the community using our own currency, the MongolTugrug. You can earn money passively by fighting monsters, but the real wealth comes from trading on the Auction House, where your items stay up for sale even while you are offline. We also spiced up the vanilla gameplay with some really fun features. You will earn RPG-style stat boosts like extra health and strength just by doing everyday chores like farming and mining. We added instant tree chopping, proximity voice chat so you can talk to your neighbors naturally, and unique custom enchants at the enchanting table like Vein Miner and Bunny Hop. You can even show off your coolest items right in the chat or use fun commands to sit on your friend's head.

We just want a fair, fun place for everyone to hang out, so we use strict anti-cheat systems where hackers are permanently banned with zero warnings. Friendly trash talk is totally fine, but we do not tolerate hate speech, doxing, or item duping. If you love playing here, you can pick up lifetime ranks like LIGHT, HYPER, or BYPASS, which is perfect for peaceful builders since it makes you completely immune to player damage. To come hang out, Java players can connect using mnvibes.org, and Bedrock players can use the same IP with the port 19132. First-timers just need to register a password in chat to keep their accounts safe, and if you own a legit premium Minecraft account, you can enable auto-login to skip that step forever.

title: Ochaeconomy
description:
OchaEconomy is a Minecraft server where the player who earns the most wins. Trade on a live marketplace, manage your bank, invest in land, and run a company to dominate the economy.
日本語サーバーです
body:
# 🍵 OchaEconomy

> **"The one who earns is the strongest."**
> **「稼いだ者が最強。」**

---

## 🌐 English

### What is OchaEconomy?

OchaEconomy is a **fully player-driven economy server** for Minecraft Java Edition.
Forget fixed NPC shops — here, prices are set by **real supply and demand**.
Mine, farm, craft, and trade your way to the top of the leaderboard.

Every system in OchaEconomy is designed to make **your decisions matter**:
hoard resources to corner the market, found a company and hire workers,
or invest in land to earn passive income. The economy is yours to shape.

---

### 💹 Market

The heart of OchaEconomy is its **live player marketplace**.

- Prices fluctuate based on **real supply and demand** — buy low, sell high
- List any item for any price and watch the market respond
- Place **buy orders** to automatically purchase at your target price
- Check **price charts** to spot trends before your rivals do
- Market fees and cancel costs keep speculation in check

> ⚠️ The admin shop exists only as a **safety net** — prices are significantly worse than the market.
> If you want a good deal, trade with other players.

---

### 🏦 Bank

Don't let your gold sit idle.

| Feature | Details |
|---|---|
| 💰 Deposit | Earn interest on your savings |
| 💸 Withdraw | Access your funds anytime |
| 📤 Transfer | Send money to other players (3% fee) |
| 💳 Loan | Borrow up to 100,000G at 1%/day |

> ⚠️ Loans must be repaid within 30 days. Overdue loans carry penalties.

---

### 🏢 Company

Scale up your operation by founding a **company**.

- **Hire members** and assign roles (Manager / Staff)
- Accept **server contracts** and deliver goods for a bonus reward
- Upgrade your **shared vault** for team storage (up to 54 slots)
- Pay weekly salaries and distribute **dividends** to shareholders
- Earn a **commercial bonus** on market sales the more land you own

Company founding costs **50,000G** — save up before you commit.

---

### 🏠 Real Estate

Land is power.

- **Purchase chunks** across the world and claim them as your own
- Building level upgrades increase your land's value over time
- Earn a **commercial bonus** on all market transactions
- Put land up for **auction** or sell directly on the open market
- 5-day resale cooldown prevents instant flip abuse

> Maintenance fees are charged weekly. Neglect your land and lose it.

---

### 📋 Getting Started

```
/menu        — Open the main menu
/market      — Open the marketplace
/bank        — Open your bank account
/company     — Open company management
/re          — Open real estate menu
/shop        — Admin shop (emergency only)
/guide       — Receive your guidebook
```

New players receive a **1,000G starter grant** on first login.
Pick up your `/guide` book for a full walkthrough of every system.

---

### ⚖️ Economy Rules

- 🚫 No crafting exploits — all item prices are balanced against ingredients
- 🚫 No market manipulation — trade volume limits prevent pump & dump
- 🚫 No loan abuse — transfers are capped and overdue penalties apply
- ✅ All income comes from **genuine gameplay**: mining, farming, trading, contracts

---

 

## 🇯🇵 日本語

### OchaEconomyとは？

OchaEconomyは、**完全プレイヤー主導の経済システム**を持つMinecraft Java版サーバーです。
固定価格のNPCショップはありません — 価格はすべて**プレイヤーの取引**によって変動します。
採掘・農業・クラフト・取引を駆使してサーバーの頂点を目指してください。

OchaEconomyのすべてのシステムは**あなたの判断が結果を左右する**ように設計されています。
資源を独占して市場を支配するか、会社を設立して仲間と共に稼ぐか、
土地を買って不労所得を得るか — 経済はあなたの手の中にあります。

---

### 💹 マーケット

OchaEconomyの中心は**プレイヤー主導のリアルタイム市場**です。

- **需要と供給**によって価格がリアルタイムで変動 — 安く買って高く売ろう
- どんなアイテムでも自由な価格で出品できる
- **買い注文**を設定して目標価格での自動購入が可能
- **価格チャート**で相場の流れを先読みしよう
- 手数料とキャンセル料が相場操作を抑止

> ⚠️ 管理者ショップはあくまで**緊急用のセーフティネット**です。
> 市場より大幅に条件が悪いので、お得に取引したいならプレイヤー間取引を使いましょう。

---

### 🏦 銀行

稼いだお金を寝かせてはいけません。

| 機能 | 詳細 |
|---|---|
| 💰 預金 | 利息でお金を増やす |
| 💸 引き出し | いつでも所持金に戻せる |
| 📤 送金 | 他のプレイヤーへ振り込み（手数料3%） |
| 💳 ローン | 最大100,000Gを日利1%で借入 |

> ⚠️ ローンは30日以内に返済してください。延滞するとペナルティが発生します。

---

### 🏢 会社

規模を拡大するなら**会社を設立**しましょう。

- **メンバーを雇用**して役割（部長・社員）を割り当て
- **サーバー契約**を受注してアイテムを納品するとボーナス報酬
- **共有倉庫**をアップグレードしてチームで資材管理（最大54マス）
- 週給の支払いや**配当**の分配も可能
- 所有する土地が多いほど市場売上に**商業ボーナス**が加算

会社の設立費用は**50,000G**。十分な資金を貯めてから始めましょう。

---

### 🏠 不動産

土地は力なり。

- ワールドの**チャンクを購入**して自分の土地として確保
- 建物レベルをアップグレードして土地の価値を高める
- 全市場取引に**商業ボーナス**が加算される
- **オークション**や**直接売却**でいつでも手放せる
- 転売クールダウン5日で即転売を防止

> 週次維持費を払えないと土地を失います。管理を怠らないよう注意。

---

### 📋 はじめ方

```
/menu        — メインメニューを開く
/market      — マーケットを開く
/bank        — 銀行口座を開く
/company     — 会社管理を開く
/re          — 不動産メニューを開く
/shop        — 管理者ショップ（緊急用）
/guide       — ガイドブックを受け取る
```

初回ログイン時に**1,000Gのスターター資金**が付与されます。
`/guide` でガイドブックを受け取り、各システムの使い方を確認しましょう。

---

### ⚖️ 経済ルール

- 🚫 錬金術禁止 — 全アイテムの価格は素材費と整合が取れています
- 🚫 相場操作禁止 — 取引量制限によりpump & dumpを防止
- 🚫 ローン悪用禁止 — 送金上限と延滞ペナルティが適用されます
- ✅ 収入源はすべて**正規のゲームプレイ** — 採掘・農業・取引・契約納品

---

*OchaEconomy — 稼いだ者が最強。*

title: Elysia Network
description: Elysia Network ile kendini yeşil dünyaya bırak
body:
Elysia Network: Minecraft Dünyasında Yenilikçi Bir Başlangıç

Minecraft, milyonlarca oyuncunun hayal gücünü sınırlamayan bir sanal dünyaya adım attığı eşsiz bir deneyim sunar. Bu muhteşem dünya, sonsuz olasılıklarla dolu olduğu kadar, etkileyici topluluklar ve projeler için de bir zemin sağlar. Elysia Network, bu dinamik ve yaratıcı dünyada, oyunun kalbini daha da heyecanlandıran ve zenginleştiren bir deneyim sunmayı amaçlayan yenilikçi bir topluluktur.

Elysia Network, Minecraft topluluğuna katkıda bulunmak, oyunun keyfini çıkaran herkesin deneyimini geliştirmek ve oyuncuların hayal gücünü sınırlarını aşmalarını teşvik etmek amacıyla kurulmuştur. Ağ, oyunculara çeşitli oyun modlarında ve deneyimlerde kendilerini geliştirme fırsatı sunar. Bu modlar arasında hayatta kalma, yaratıcı mod, mini oyunlar ve çok daha fazlası bulunur.

Elysia Network'ün açılışında, oyuncuları heyecan verici bir maceraya davet ediyoruz. Bu ağın kapıları, Minecraft evreninde yeni ve deneyim dolu bir serüvene adım atmak isteyen herkese açıktır. Oyuncular, birlikte inşa etmek, keşfetmek ve yarışmak için bir araya gelerek, Elysia'nın eşsiz atmosferinde bir araya gelme fırsatına sahip olacaklar.

Elysia Network, Minecraft deneyimine katkıda bulunan birçok özelliği bünyesinde barındırır:

Çeşitli Oyun Modları: Elysia Network, farklı oyun modlarını bir araya getirir. Her türden oyuncunun ilgisini çeken modlar arasında hayatta kalma, yaratıcı mod, rol yapma ve mini oyunlar bulunur.

description: a server-that is anarchy, you can grief and kill players but no hacking :)
body:
XENA server is basically what happens when you take Minecraft, remove the concept of “peace,” and then quietly whisper “good luck” and leave.
It’s not a server, it’s a social experiment that forgot it was an experiment.
You spawn in thinking you’re gonna build a cute little base. Cute idea. Within like 10 minutes someone’s already:


griefing a village for fun


starting a “totally justified” war over 3 dirt blocks


or speedrunning emotional damage in chat ☠️


Drama? Oh it’s not occasional. It’s scheduled. Random argument? Congrats, that’s now a 3-day arc with alliances, betrayals, and someone quitting dramatically only to rejoin 20 minutes later like nothing happened.
Bases don’t last. They survive briefly out of respect, then get deleted by either chaos, revenge, or “I was bored bro.”
And somehow everyone still comes back like:
“this time will be chill”
No it won’t. It never is. It just cycles between peace and absolute digital disaster.
XENA isn’t Minecraft multiplayer.
It’s Minecraft: emotional damage edition.

body:
# Aeroworks SMP

## Make sure you allocate at least 6GB of RAM

[Discord Link](https://discord.gg/vNNBUVCbD3)

[Server Map](https://aero.gguppy.net/map/#world:-1530:0:653:7389:0:0:0:0:perspective)

Aeroworks is a NeoForge 1.21.1 multiplayer server for players who want to build, fly, trade, explore, and engineer large projects together.

The server is built around Create: Aeronautics, which lets players design and use airships and other moving contraptions. The main goal of Aeroworks is to give players a long term world where air travel, transport routes, towns, factories, rail systems, and shared infrastructure matter.

Players should join Aeroworks if they want a multiplayer Minecraft world that develops over time through community projects. You can build an airship, connect settlements, move goods, create factories, set up trade routes, explore improved structures, or work with other players on large engineering builds.

The server includes supporting mods such as Create: Big Cannons, Create: Propulsion, Create: Radars, CC: Sable, Vista, Mekanism, and Oritech. These add more options for automation, machinery, power, navigation, ship systems, and advanced production chains.

Exploration is expanded with Tectonic, WWOO, YUNG’s Better structures, and End Remastered. Terrain generation and many vanilla style structures are improved, while End Remastered makes reaching the End a longer server wide progression goal instead of something players rush immediately.

Aeroworks also includes multiplayer quality of life features such as claims, maps, voice chat, and social tools. These are included to make cooperation, travel, trading, and settlement building easier.

Important information before joining: Aeroworks requires the server’s NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack to connect. This is a multiplayer server experience, so gameplay may involve other players, shared infrastructure, claims, trading, towns, alliances, and community projects. Roleplay is welcome but not required.

Aeroworks is best for players who want a Create: Aeronautics server focused on airships, logistics, exploration, factories, transport networks, and a world shaped by its community.

title: ColdMC
description: ColdMC is a VANILLA server offering futuristic space exploration mixed with fantasy mmorpg vibes with magical equipment, spellbooks, and 30 new dimensions.
body:
Welcome to **ColdMC**, your ultimate Minecraft experience! Do you sometimes just wish for a world where we can go on adventurous journeys, to mystical realms unknown, discovering new creatures and plant life, riding dragons and meeting new people to help you along the way. Just to do that... be there.. make memories... that could be life changing. I would never want to leave a world like that... Hiking atop a foggy, humid mountain in the middle of no where, a dark sunset at the beach, with nobody else. An impossible to explain feeling. Words fall short, unable to capture the essence of it all. The opportunities are boundless, the horizons limitless. It’s sickening knowing that no matter how much you dream, reality will always be chains tied to your existence. Yet, a glimmer of hope now emerges. Whether you’re new to our server or a seasoned player, this wiki is your go-to resource for all the information you need to thrive in our world. Here, you’ll find everything from basic server guidelines to detailed guides on gameplay mechanics, custom features, and community events. Let’s dive in and get started! *** ## Getting Started **1. Server Address** * **IP Address:** `coldmc.com` * **Version:** We support the latest version of Minecraft, but older versions under 1.21.11 may also be compatible with minor graphical bugs. **2. Joining the Server** * Launch Minecraft and click on "Multiplayer.", click "Add Server" and enter the server details. * Connect to the server and accept our pack by clicking "Yes". You only need to download the pack once! (or again if we update the whole game) **3. Creating a character** * Once you join, you are first prompted with the profile selection GUI. This GUI displays all of the profiles that you have registered, along with some basic information about each one. The player is required to select a profile from this GUI before you can proceed to play on the server. * After chosing a profile, the corresponding data will be loaded, including health and mana, inventory, location, bed spawn point, ender-chest, quest progression, loaded ammunition... You can log out, create or delete profiles using the Adventurer's Menu. **4. Read** [New Overworld](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/overworld) **to start claiming land and using custom features!** *** ## Server Rules To ensure a fun and fair experience for everyone, please abide by the following rules: 1. **Respect All Players:** No harassment, hate speech, or bullying. 2. **No Griefing:** Do not destroy or steal others' creations. 3. **Cheating is Prohibited:** No use of hacks, mods, or exploits. 4. **Keep Chat Clean:** Avoid spamming, advertising, or using offensive language. 5. **Follow Staff Instructions:** Our staff is here to help, please respect their decisions. Breaking the rules can result in warnings, temporary bans, or permanent bans depending on the severity of the offense. Read more [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NuHrVMGeP1028pgO7QTfrpWAvO_gLbMY9JowHRAR4gY/). (or write "/rules" in game) *** ## Custom Features ColdMC isn’t your ordinary Minecraft server; we’ve implemented several custom features to enhance gameplay: * **Custom Items and Crafting Recipes:** Discover unique items and crafting recipes exclusive to ColdMC in the [Advanced Crafting Station](https://wiki.coldmc.com/items/stations/early-stations/advanced-crafting-station). * **Quests and Missions:** Take on quests to earn rewards and advance your skills. Read more at [Scenario Types](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/scenario-types). * **Economy System:** Earn in-game currency, trade with other players, and build your empire. * **Land Claiming:** Protect your builds and resources with [Towns & Land Claiming](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/overworld/mechanics/towns-and-land-claiming). * **MMORPG:** Level up skills to gain special abilities and perks. Read more at [Mastery](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/skills), [Arcanum (Lv99)](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/gaia-new-v1.100/arcanum-lv99), [Magic (Lv20)](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/magic-lv20), [Star Levels](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/star-levels). * **Mini-Games:** Enjoy a variety of mini-games for a quick break from regular gameplay, like our Custom fishing, farming and generators features. * **Spell Customization:** Customize and upgrade your spells through a skill tree system, allowing you to tailor your magic to your playstyle. * [Classes (Lv30)](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/classes-lv30) **and** [Races (Lv100)](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/races-lv100)**:** Certain spells are exclusive to specific classes and races, adding depth to your character’s abilities and strategy. * **Entities:** * [Pets](https://wiki.coldmc.com/entities/pets) Tame unique pets that offer companionship and sometimes even combat support. Each pet may come with special abilities or buffs. ("/pets") * [Mounts](https://wiki.coldmc.com/entities/mounts) Ride powerful and exotic mounts to traverse the world more quickly. Some mounts may have additional benefits, such as flight or speed boosts. ("/horses") * [Monsters](https://wiki.coldmc.com/entities/monsters) Face off against a variety of custom monsters that provide challenges and rewards. * [Bosses](https://wiki.coldmc.com/entities/bosses) Engage in epic battles with powerful bosses that require strategy and teamwork to defeat. * [World Boss](https://wiki.coldmc.com/entities/ex-bosses/world-boss) Take on world bosses—massive, server-wide events where players must band together to bring down a formidable foe. * **Ranks, Levels, Rarities, Tiers, Stacks, and Tags:** * **Ranks:** Progress through various ranks on the server to unlock new privileges, commands, and bonuses. Higher ranks may offer exclusive items or abilities. * **Levels:** Level up your character/profile and skills through EXP points gained from various professions, unlocking new abilities and boosts as you progress. * **Rarities:** Items on ColdMC have different rarity levels, from common to fabled, each with unique stats and effects. * **Tiers:** Spells are classified into tiers, with higher tiers offering better stats and more powerful bonuses. * **Stacks:** Manage your items efficiently with basis enhancements that can be worth up to of the corresponding basis * **Tags:** Special items and entities may have tags that indicate their unique properties, which can be used to display with your username in chat. * **Dimensions (Public has found 11/31 dimensions)** * **Explore the Realms:** Inspired by the legendary world tree Yggdrasil combined with Terra Infinita, ColdMC offers custom dimensions, each representing a different realm with its own unique environment, challenges, and rewards.
* [New Overworld](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/overworld) The mortal realm, similar to the Overworld in traditional Minecraft, but with enhanced features, zones like [The World Beyond](/dim/overworld/zones/the-world-beyond.md) and richer lore. The [New Overworld](/dim/overworld.md) serves as the hub where all adventures begin. * [Nether: Incendium](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/nether-incendium) The realm of fire and chaos is home to the fire beasts and a land of constant warfare. It’s the first ultimate test of strength, where players can obtain more powerful loot. * [The End](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/the-end) The realm of the dead is a gloomy dimension filled with old evolved undead creatures and ancient secrets. It’s a place of immense danger, but also even greater rewards for those who survive here. * [Mythical Lands](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/mythical-lands) The realm of the elves is a world of eternal twilight and ethereal beauty. It’s a place of powerful boosted magic, where players can find magical items and magical ores. * [The Garden](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/the-garden) A lush and verdant realm is the hidden lands of nature spirits and ancient wisdom. Here, players can harvest powerful herbs and encounter mystical creatures. * [Wastelands](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/wastelands) A dry and fiery dimension, The Wasteland is ruled by volcanic activity and molten lava. Players who brave its dangers can discover most legendary treasures and materials for infinity crafting. * [The Aether Highlands](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/the-aether-highlands) A realm of divine light is home to the angels and the seat of immense magical energy. Expect to find divine materials, world items and face celestial beings. * [Land of Quaoar](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/land-of-quaoar) A cold and mountainous land, the Land of Eternal Frost is the domain of giants. It’s a dangerous dimension filled with powerful monsters, but also rich in the most valuable resources. * [Lands of Collosi](https://wiki.coldmc.com/dim/lands-of-collosi) The underground realm of the dwarves is a labyrinth of mines and forges. Here, players can find mythical or fabled metals and craft the most powerful weapons and armor.
* **Realm-Specific Loot:** Each of the dimensions offers exclusive items, materials, and rewards that can only be found within its realm. Whether it’s divine relics in the Aether or ancient tomes in the Nether, the treasures of Yggdrasil are worth the journey. * **Unique Biomes and Challenges:** Every dimension has its own set of biomes, creatures, and environmental hazards. Prepare yourself accordingly before entering these realms, as each offers a distinct and immersive experience. * **Job Classes and Race Classes (Public has found 45/2082 classes)** * [Classes (Lv30)](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/classes-lv30) Choose from a variety of classes, each with its own strengths, weaknesses, and unique abilities. Classes may specialize in combat, magic, crafting, or support roles. * [Races (Lv100)](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/races-lv100) Select from different races, each offering distinct traits and abilities that impact your gameplay. Races may have bonuses to certain skills or access to race-specific items and spells. * [Class Skills](https://wiki.coldmc.com/systems/classes-lv30/class-skills) Each class has its own set of abilities, including passive perks and active skills, making your choice impactful on your gameplay style. * **Race-Specific Spells and Abilities:** Races may unlock specific spells or abilities that further customize your character’s capabilities. * **Guilds:** * **Form or Join a Guild:** Band together with other players to form a guild, allowing you to share resources, build together, and take on greater challenges. * **Guild Benefits:** Gain access to guild-specific perks such as shared storage, guild missions, and collective buffs. * **Guild Wars:** Participate in guild wars, where you can compete against other guilds for dominance and rewards. * **Guild Levels and Upgrades:** Level up your guild to unlock new abilities, increase member capacity, and gain more powerful buffs. *** ## Support and Help If you encounter any issues or need assistance, our staff team is here to help. You can reach out through the following channels: * **In-Game:** Use the `/menu` command to open the menu. * [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/uTsATaer3P)**:** Post in the #ticket channel for help from staff. * [**Reddit**](https://www.reddit.com/r/coldmc/)**:** Post here to get help from community members. * [**Forums**](http://forum.coldmc.com/)**:** Create a support ticket or browse through our help topics. Other socials you can reach out to: * [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/coldmcserver/)

title: Regalsmp
description: Survival Minecraft Server 1.21.11 Java and Bedrock
body:
RegalSMP ist ein klassischer, aber bewusst kompromissloser Survival-Multiplayer-Server für Spieler, die Minecraft in seiner offenen und dynamischen Form erleben wollen. Auf regalsmp.de erwartet dich eine frei zugängliche Survival-Welt, in der Entscheidungen Konsequenzen haben und jede Handlung Teil einer größeren, von der Community geschriebenen Geschichte ist.

Im Mittelpunkt steht ein offenes SMP-Konzept: Du kannst bauen, handeln, erkunden oder deinen eigenen Weg gehen ohne vorgefertigte Rollen oder Einschränkungen. Die Welt entwickelt sich durch ihre Spieler. Große Bauprojekte entstehen neben kleinen Basen, Handelsrouten bilden sich organisch, und Konflikte gehören genauso dazu wie Allianzen. Griefing und Scamming sind erlaubt, was bedeutet, dass Vertrauen, Vorsicht und Strategie eine echte Rolle spielen. Wer überleben will, muss nicht nur gut bauen, sondern auch klug handeln.

RegalSMP legt großen Wert auf Serverstabilität und Balance. Die Technik läuft zuverlässig, Performance und Spielgefühl stehen im Fokus. Das Spielerlebnis bleibt dabei möglichst nah am Vanilla-Gefühl, wird aber durch eine saubere Administration und sinnvolle Anpassungen unterstützt, damit langfristiges Spielen Spaß macht.

Die Community ist aktiv und prägt den Server entscheidend mit. Regelmäßige Events sorgen für Abwechslung und bringen Spieler zusammen ob kooperativ oder kompetitiv. Dabei greift das Team nur dort ein, wo es notwendig ist, und handelt transparent, um ein faires Umfeld zu gewährleisten, ohne die Freiheit des Spiels einzuschränken.

RegalSMP ist kein Server für kurze Runden, sondern für Spieler, die sich auf eine lebendige Welt einlassen wollen, in der alles passieren kann. Wenn du Survival mit echten Risiken, echten Spielern und echten Geschichten suchst, bist du hier genau richtig.

body:
# Realmify 🌎

Realmify is a small project that allows you to host your own SMP server for free. Everything can be controlled ingame, with user friendly GUIs to simplify management.

[![discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98df16a53357ada12b1156235d9bd3a4cd5b4c04.png)](https://discord.gg/ksMDZ8rRDk)


# Some screenshots 📸

![Servers](https://realmify.net/images/what-is-06.webp)
![Users](https://realmify.net/images/what-is-02.webp)
![Plugins](https://realmify.net/images/what-is-03.webp)

***

# FAQ 🔍
*Click a question to expand the answer.*

## Getting started

<details>
<summary>How do I create a server?</summary>


**Steps:**
1. Open your slots using the piston in your hotbar or the **Servers** item from the menu.
2. Pick a free slot (1 to 3).
3. Run through the setup: software, version, and options.
4. Wait until the server is created and shows as running.
5. When it is online, left click to join from the same menu.

</details>


---

## Installing plugins

<details>
<summary>How do I install plugins?</summary>

Open Control for your server (`/realm config <slot>`), then open **Plugins**.

**Choose one path:**
*   **Plugin templates**: Curated one-click installs.
*   **Browse Modrinth**: Search, pick a project, and install.
*   **Installed plugins**: This screen lists what is already on the server. Remove plugins here when the network allows it.

### Why can’t I find a plugin on Modrinth?

**Common reasons:**
*   Some projects are hidden by network policy.
*   Your search terms may not match how the project is named.
*   *If you still cannot find it, ask staff whether it is blocked on purpose.*
</details>

---

## Inviting players & friends

<details>
<summary>How do I let my friends join my server?</summary>
  
**Two common setups:**
*   **Whitelist**: Add their Minecraft name so only listed players can join. Useful for private servers.
*   **Slot users**: Add people as users on your slot with permissions (for example who can change settings and who can only play).

**Where to configure:**
In Control, open **User permissions** or **Whitelist**. Labels can differ per network.
</details>

---

## Server management

### What is “serverlist” vs “servers”?

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/realm servers` | Your slots: create a server, open Control, and join. |
| `/realm serverlist` | Every server you may use: servers you own, servers where you are whitelisted, and public servers where you were added as a user. |

### What is a “subuser”?

*   **Definition**: A subuser is someone who is not the server owner but was granted rights on another player’s server (for example to help manage plugins or only to join).
*   **Where it shows up**: Those servers may appear under **Subuser servers**.

</details>

title: NitroLandia
description: NitroLandia je český semi-vanilla survival server pro hráče, kteří chtějí normální Minecraft bez zbytečných omezení, pay-to-win výhod a přeplácaných pluginů.
body:
**NitroLandia** je český semi-vanilla survival server pro hráče, kteří chtějí normální Minecraft bez zbytečných omezení, pay-to-win výhod a přeplácaných pluginů.

Server běží komunitně, bez VIP systému, bez kupování předmětů a bez Residence. *Nejde* o anonymní survival s lobby, denními odměnami a hromadou příkazů. Cílem je spíš klasický Minecraft zážitek, kde se hráči znají, staví vlastní projekty, spolupracují a nemusí pořád řešit složité ochrany pozemků nebo pluginové systémy.

NitroLandia podporuje Java edici i Bedrock edici, takže se dá hrát i z mobilu přes MCPE, Windows Bedrock, konzole a další zařízení. Server používá jen odlehčené pluginy a datapacky pro základní funkčnost, bezpečnost a drobná vylepšení hry — například mapu světa, podporu Bedrock hráčů, statistiky, logování griefů nebo užitečné quality-of-life datapacky.

Přístup na server je přes registraci nebo pozvánku od hráče. Díky tomu zůstává komunita menší, přehlednější a normálnější než na veřejných survival serverech bez kontroly.

* Český Minecraft survival server
* Semi-vanilla styl hraní
* Java + Bedrock / MCPE kompatibilita
* Bez Residence a složitých ochran pozemků
* Bez VIP, mikrotransakcí a pay-to-win výhod
* Komunitní server, kde se hráči znají
* Odlehčené pluginy, žádné přeplácané systémy
* Registrace přes web nebo pozvánka od hráče

title: MajoKraft Worlds
description: CZ/SK Semi-Vanilla Survival experience
body:
## ✨ Vitaj na MajoKrafte! ⭐
Sme československý **Semi-Vanilla Minecraft server** založený v roku **2020**. 🎮

Server sme vytvorili, aby semi-vanilla survival nebol len o prežití, ale aj o dobrodružstvách plných questov, výziev a priateľských momentov. 🏹 Každý deň ťa čakajú nové príbehy a úlohy, ktoré robia hru jedinečnou.

Na MajoKrafte ✨ však zažiješ ešte viac – špeciálne kozmetiky, originálne efekty a zberateľské predmety, ktoré ti umožnia ukázať svoj štýl a odlíšiť sa od ostatných. 🌟

## ⛏️ Na čo sa u nás môžeš tešiť? 🎉
**● Nezničená Minecraft príroda** 🌲— Na našom serveri nečakaj žiadny wipe. Prírodu na MajoKrafte nebudeme resetovať ako to robí väčšina serverov.. U nás nájdeš **ťažiaci svet**, ktorý sa pravidelne resetuje a slúži na získavanie surovín aby sa zbytočne neničil klasický svet!

title: SMP-Attempt#3
description: Seasonal SMP that requires approval to join, 5 slots remaining. Attempt#{Number} is the season and saturdays the season ends with a fight. On sundays legacy attempts are played or minigames according to polls. It's encouraged to create content
body:
# **SMP-Attempt#3!**
This is a whitelisted server to join. You can apply from [our website](https://spaceboom07.wixsite.com/smp-attempt).

On the server, er we encourage content creation for server funding, but if you are uncomfortable with content making, the typical server fee is a literal dollar per week.
If you have more questions about the content-making rules, you can check out our application form on our website.

### Rules:
-    Griefing is allowed unless: The target is offline, the player is a pacifist, the grief target is a landscape that encourages peace in its borders (Not all landscapes can do this)
-    PVP without consent is allowed unless the player is a pacifist and never PVP'ed from the start of the season
-    Claiming structures like mob spawners and strongholds,s or monetizing landscapes in-game currency like diamonds or whatever the landscape owner requests (not physical money) is allowed
-    Normally, keep inventory is disabled, but the start of all seasons can have up to 3 keep inventory,y on days, but players can protest to end keep inventory too.
  
### Events:
-   On the second Saturday of the season, the season will end with a fight with all teams against each other (Any Saturday during the season disables any pacifist, landscape, or any protection), but we could extend the season if players aren't leveled up yet or if not more than 3 people are online.
  
-   On Sundays (any), the server switches to either a legacy attempt (season) war or a mini/game map like Skyblock for the day.
- On Fridays, the server is on an Up-Time event, which means any player can join the server, which will run on more CR, which means higher performance and more one-day plugins.

### ?
This server does have plugins installed with PaperMC server software for features like TPA, Voice chat (Download Simple Voice Chat from Modrinth to see VC features!), and optimization with Chunky.

### ?
If you ever have a problem with joining the server, except for a whitelist error (if you are not a player supposed to be in the whitelist), you can ask for help from spaceboom07@gmail.com or the contact information you received with your approval mail.


### Rule-breaking:

  Breaking rules splits into 2: ethical and unethical. Ethical rule-breaking involves things like griefing or killing pacifists or stealing (stuff that doesn't involve cheats or any offensive communication with voice chat or chat). Unethical rule-breaking is using hacked clients, harassing people, or taking advantage of server features like trapping with TPA

### Tips!

  For creators on the server, we recommend using Medal but even if you aren't one, using Medal allows you to catch and report rule-breaking with F8, but honestly, you can use what is best for you, for example, Nvidia Shadow Play.
  
  Almost everyone uses mods and shaders for their client or server gameplay, but we recommend using:
  
  **Optimization**
-    Sodium 
-    Entity culling
-    Lithium
-    Fast IP ping
-    More Culling
-    Bad Optimizations
-    Immediately Fast
-    Ferrite Core
 
  **Features for the server**
-      Simple Voice Chat
 
**API mods and libraries**
-      Fabric API
-      Collective
-      Cloth Config API

body:
Thematic Official - Superhero Roleplay

This is the definitive home for the Thematic mod. We offer a high-performance Fabric environment where your choice of hero or villain isn't just a skin—it is a recognized title within a living, evolving multiverse. Two iconic cities, one elite community.

The Official Character (OC) System

Stand out from the crowd. Our unique Official Character system allows dedicated players to audition for the exclusive rights to iconic heroes and villains. Once you are the Official Batman or the Official Homelander, that mantle is yours alone. Lead the server lore, dictate major story events, and become the face of justice or terror.

A Tale of Two Cities

Explore a world of geographic contrast designed specifically for superhero movement and vertical combat.

Gotham City: A massive, hand-crafted metropolitan sprawl. Rain-slicked rooftops and dark alleys provide the perfect backdrop for street-level brawlers and high-tech detectives.

Fawcett City: The heart of our community. Unlike Gotham, Fawcett is a player-built project where you and your guild can leave a permanent mark on the skyline.

Official Guilds and Factions

Do not just play alone. Form a team and rise through the ranks to become an Official Guild.

Headquarters: Secure your territory within the city limits and build your custom base of operations.

Conflict: Engage in organized guild warfare, territory disputes, and collaborative patrols across the two cities.

Legacy: Official Guilds gain recognized status in the server’s history and influence the development of player-built areas like Fawcett City.

Authentic Superhero Mechanics

Powered by the Thematic mod, we provide the full suite of hero tech without compromise.

The Suit Bench: Craft and upgrade over 200 unique suits, progressing from Tier 1 prototypes to Tier 3 powerhouses.

The Gadget Bench: Customize your utility belt with functional smoke bombs, grappling hooks, and specialized weaponry.

Archetype Mastery: Choose your path as a Brawler, Archer, or Speedster, with mechanics tailored to your specific playstyle.

Performance First

Built on Fabric 1.20.1, our infrastructure is optimized to handle high-speed flight, explosive combat, and dense urban environments without the lag associated with traditional modded servers.

title: Craftopia MC
description: Rejoignez notre survie 26.1.2 conviviale ! Profitez d'une expérience enrichie par des plugins et data packs pour sublimer le gameplay vanille. Pour préserver vos plus belles créations, nous avons séparé le monde de construction du monde de minage.
body:
# 🌍 Bienvenue sur notre serveur Minecraft ! 
oignez une aventure où la sérénité et la progression sont au cœur de l'expérience. Notre serveur est conçu pour offrir un environnement stable, accueillant et optimisé pour tous les joueurs.

## 🏗️ Un monde préservé
Nous accordons une importance capitale à l'esthétique de nos constructions. Pour éviter que le paysage ne soit défiguré par l'extraction intensive de ressources, notre serveur repose sur un système de mondes séparés :

Le Monde de Build : Un espace dédié à vos plus belles créations, protégé et pensé pour le long terme.

Le Monde de Minage : Une zone dédiée exclusivement à la récolte de ressources, où vous pouvez miner sans aucune limite pour laisser votre imagination s'exprimer librement sur le serveur principal.

## 💎 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Nous avons sélectionné une suite de plugins de pointe pour garantir une expérience fluide et sécurisée :

Sécurité et Protection : Vos constructions sont en sécurité grâce à GriefPrevention et WorldGuard, avec un historique complet des modifications grâce à CoreProtect. En cas d'imprévu, AxInventoryRestore et AxGraves protègent vos objets précieux.

Économie et Progression : Progressez à votre rythme avec le système de métiers (Jobs) et facilitez vos échanges grâce à QuickShop-Hikari.

Confort de Jeu : Profitez d'une communication immersive avec le Simple Voice Chat, voyagez facilement avec SimpleRTP et profitez d'une expérience optimisée, que vous soyez sur Java ou Bedrock (grâce à Geyser et Floodgate).

Immersion totale : Des fonctionnalités comme CustomNPCs et FancyHolograms donnent vie à notre monde, tandis que TAB et InsaneAnnouncer vous permettent de rester informé en temps réel.

Prêt à bâtir votre légende ? Connectez-vous dès maintenant et commencez votre aventure !

title: 落英乡坊
description: A vanilla Minecraft survival server (with plugins and whitelist,you can join the whitelist by joining the official qq group at 377505417 or 729416878)
body:
# The official server description
(Sorry for the machine translation)
## English
Welcome to "Falling Leaves Village" - a warm, enduring, and pure Minecraft community
Dear traveler, are you searching for a server that you can call "home"?

A pure land without disputes, without the need for internal competition, filled only with friends, architecture, and leisurely moments? "Luo Ying Xiang Fang" is precisely such a place. We uphold our initial inspiration and simplest aspiration: to build a stable, warm, and long-lasting home.

Here, we won't talk about complicated technology, but only about simple happiness.

"Luo Ying Xiang Fang" is a **survival-based plugin server**. Our core value is **the connection between people**, the joy of sharing construction, the surprise of exploring together, and the leisure of fishing in the afternoon.
- You can: Build a unique dream house in a scenic spot.
- You can: cultivate a piece of fertile land, raise a flock of cats and dogs, and live a self-sufficient rural life.
- You can: gather friends, delve deep underground to seek treasures, or venture to the End to challenge the dragons.
- You can also: do nothing but hang out, watching everyone chatting lively in the chat channel, and feeling the warmth of the community.
To ensure that the labor achievements of every member are respected, we have introduced necessary yet restrained plugins to enable you to enjoy your "retirement" peacefully:

Territory protection: Every blade of grass, every tree, every brick, and every tile in your territory are absolutely protected. You can travel with peace of mind, knowing that your home will still be there when you return.

Convenient Features: Provides thoughtful functions such as /homex:sethome to set up personal homes and /tpa to teleport to friends, making reunions simple and exploration worry-free.

Economy and Shops: Use chests to open a small shop, and freely trade with other players using the wheat you harvest and diamonds you dig up, experiencing a warm and welcoming community economy.

Pure Environment: We have strict light moderation mechanisms, aiming to create a fair and harmonious gaming environment.

---

## 中文
欢迎来到「落英乡坊」—— 一个温暖、长久、纯粹的Minecraft养老社区
亲爱的旅人，你是否在寻找一个可以称之为“家”的服务器？
一个没有纷争、无需内卷，只有朋友、建筑与悠闲时光的净土？「落英乡坊」正是这样一个地方。我们秉持着最初的感动与最朴素的愿望：打造一个稳定、温馨的长久家园。
在这里，我们不谈复杂的技术，只聊简单的快乐。
「落英乡坊」是一个**基于原版生存的插件养老服务器**。我们的核心是**人与人的连接**，是分享建造的喜悦，是结伴探索的惊喜，是午后垂钓的闲适。
- 你可以： 在风景秀丽处建造独一无二的梦想小屋。
- 你可以： 开垦一片良田，养上一群猫狗，过上自给自足的田园生活。
- 你可以： 呼朋引伴，深入地下寻宝，或前往末地挑战巨龙。
- 你也可以： 什么也不做，只是挂机，看着聊天频道里大家热闹地闲聊，感受社区的温暖。
为了确保每一位成员的劳动成果得到尊重，我们引入了必要且克制的插件，让你安心养老：

领地保护： 你的一草一木、一砖一瓦都受到绝对保护。可以放心外出旅行，归来时家园依旧。

title: Everrealm Survival
description: A no-reset survival server where player builds are meant to stay.
body:
# Everrealm Survival

![Everrealm Survival - A World With History](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cd1a68eb24d1be331b5d0e661c3409b2b3b04b3_0.webp)

**Everrealm Survival** is the international name of **无名世界**, a long-term Minecraft survival server built around one simple promise:

**No world resets. No seasonal wipes. Your builds are meant to stay.**

Everrealm is not a seasonal server, not a short-term wipe server, and not a pay-to-win progression server. It is a persistent survival world where player-made bases, roads, farms, towns, shops, and landmarks can become part of the server’s long-term history.

The original community is Chinese, but players of all languages are welcome. English is recommended for communication, and Chinese is preferred when possible. The server is currently rebuilding activity, so it is best suited for players who enjoy smaller communities, slow-paced survival, and long-term projects.

---

## Quick Info

- **Version:** 1.21.4
- **Edition:** Java Edition
- **World resets:** No
- **Seasonal wipes:** No
- **Map replacement:** No
- **Pay-to-win:** No
- **Original community:** Chinese
- **Languages:** All languages are welcome. English is recommended, and Chinese is preferred when possible.
- **Bedrock Edition:** Not confirmed yet

---

## Join

### Java Edition

```text
world-mc.cn
```

### Bedrock Edition

Bedrock support is not confirmed yet.
This page will be updated if Bedrock access becomes available.

---

## What kind of server is this?

Everrealm Survival is a relaxed, survival-focused community server.

It is best suited for players who enjoy:

* Long-term survival
* Building homes, towns, roads, farms, and landmarks
* Redstone and technical survival projects
* Player trading and community interaction
* Slow-paced progression
* Smaller communities
* A persistent world with real history

This is a place for players who want to settle down and leave something behind.

![Community Survival Night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d77d2dda6c7920e6dd55bade52ba134740ff6ad1_0.webp)

---

## What makes Everrealm different?

Many Minecraft servers are built around seasons.

You join, you build, you progress, and the world never resets.

Everrealm takes a different approach.

The world is meant to continue. Player builds are not treated as temporary content. A house, road, base, shop, or town can become part of the server’s long-term history.

**One world. Long-term survival. No wipes.**

![Players Together](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51d60b93f07603c1ae3db800ba169d64ceb41e2f_0.webp)

---

## Basic Rules

Please do not:

* Use hacked clients, x-ray, or unfair modifications
* Grief or destroy other players’ builds
* Steal from other players
* Abuse bugs, exploits, or duplication glitches
* Intentionally create lag machines
* Harass or insult other players
* Spam chat

Respect other players’ time, builds, and bases.

Because this is a no-reset world, griefing is taken seriously.

---

## Community Revival

Everrealm has been quiet for a while, but the world is still here.

We are now working on improving:

* New player guidance
* English onboarding
* Server descriptions
* Community announcements
* Build showcases
* Player history archives
* Small community events

If you like small, persistent Minecraft worlds with real history, you are welcome to join and help shape the next stage of the server.

![Server Gathering](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec86f22d951237e7a8dc25aec0e29f2a5901cfd0.jpeg)

---

## Final Note

Everrealm is not trying to be the biggest server.

It is trying to be a world that lasts.

**Not a season. Not a wipe. A world with history.**

# AbyxCraft

AbyxCraft is a custom Minecraft server project focused on polished gameplay, clean design, and long-term progression. The server is built around unique systems, premium-quality menus, consistent English messages, and a more refined player experience than a typical plugin-based setup. Instead of relying on many disconnected public plugins, AbyxCraft is designed as a connected custom project where systems work together as one complete experience.

The server includes and is being expanded with custom features such as economy systems, skills, progression mechanics, player-focused menus, order board systems, collections and journal tracking, advanced GUI design, Discord integration, and other custom gameplay features made specifically for the project. The goal is to create a server that feels modern, immersive, and well-structured while still staying fun and easy to understand for players.

AbyxCraft puts a strong focus on usability, performance, and visual quality. Menus are designed to be clean and readable, messages are kept simple and natural, and systems are made to feel connected instead of random. The project is also built with future expansion in mind, allowing new features, progression paths, AI-assisted systems, events, and other custom content to be added over time without losing consistency.

title: Ironclad: Vanilla
description: A community focused forever world SMP launched in 2018. Large community-built functioning spawn cities with no spawned in items or cheats.
body:
![Ironclad Vanilla Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1098cf4aff29232d352e8704b7043ac6cb6517d6.png)

## Joining the Ironclad Community

Ironclad Vanilla is a **whitelisted** server. To apply, join our Discord and submit an application:

**[Apply for Whitelist](https://discord.gg/ironcladnetwork)**

# Ironclad Vanilla

**A community-focused, forever-world semi-vanilla SMP. Launched October 2018. Whitelisted. Java + Bedrock crossplay.**

Ironclad Vanilla is a tight-knit SMP built around one idea: vanilla gameplay, preserved and elevated. No spawned items. No duped items. No cheating. Every resource is gathered legitimately, every build raised by hand, and every command that offers a personal benefit has an in-game cost. It is vanilla as it was meant to be played, with the quality-of-life and community features that turn a server into a home.

## Core Values

- **Legit-only gameplay.** No spawned or duped items. No cheats. Resources are gathered the hard way because that is the only way.
- **Hand-built, always.** Every structure on the server is built by a player, block by block.
- **Commands have a cost.** Convenience commands are balanced by an in-game economy so they never undercut vanilla progression.
- **A forever world.** No resets. Your builds, your legacy, your history all stay.

## A Player-Built World

Spawn is the heart of Ironclad, and it is built entirely by the community. Players construct civic infrastructure such as banks, post offices, courthouses, trading posts, and more. Around those civic buildings, players open their own shops using a diamond-based economy, creating sprawling, lived-in cities shaped by dozens of hands.

![Ember Valley](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a23e9f07ed9bf40d2a8c4f919866c39a62c6c6e_0.webp)

Not every player is a master builder, and that is part of the point. With guidance and collaboration from the community, a blend of styles and skill levels comes together into something that could only exist here. Every spawn we build looks uniquely Ironclad.

Every year or two, we relocate spawn so the current generation of players gets to shape a new city from the ground up. We are currently on our fifth spawn, **Ember Valley**, following Riverside(1st), New Haven(2nd), Birchcreek(3rd), and Hillcrest(4th).
![Spawns](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfbc877a73241fffc59edce38ac037da6bfe73ea_0.webp)

## A Living Community

![Eggman244 v Ironclad Gov Court Session](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/072b1d0a1275cfb33d4b27f373c180572cdd5bf2_0.webp)
*Scene from the Eggman244 v Ironclad Government Court Case*


Over 7+ years, more than 5,000 unique players have joined Ironclad. The group is always evolving. We think of eras in terms of generations, each one tied to the spawn that was active when they joined. Players come, players go, new players arrive, but the core sense of community never fades. Dedicated long-time members carry the culture forward, and new players shape what comes next. It's always fun when a old player will return after sometimes a years long hiatus to find all of their stuff right where they left it.

## Features of the Community

- **Social Systems.** Add friends, start group chats, and team up on friend-group or server-wide community quests, projects, and adventures!
- **Quests.** Progression goals that reward you for playing the game.
- **Tournaments.** Daily, weekly, and monthly server-wide tournaments with rewards.
- **Player and staff-hosted events.** Regular events that bring the whole server together.
- **Earnable Cash Economy.** In-game money comes from playtime, voting, quests, tournaments, and more. We offset the use of commands on the server by charging for their use. This keeps things balanced between an ease of life for players while preventing their abuse.
- **Diamond Economy.** Player managed shops are built in various spawns, using the manual diamond economy. We operate on a trust system among the community. No Shop plugins to mess with. All thieves are tracked and handled 
- **Quality-of-life fixes.** Such as improved ghast controls and other subtle refinements that enhance your without breaking vanilla balance.

## Dedicated Staff and Infrastructure

![staff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7617b717080d4ca78f8921f084923b69ff77aa9b.png)

Ironclad runs on a high-end dedicated server powered by **Folia** for top-tier performance at scale. Behind the server is a dedicated staff team with **50+ years of combined moderation experience** on Ironclad.

Check our Discord for other Minecraft servers and additional game servers offered by the Ironclad Network community.
