description: 欢迎加入“旅人之路”（Pathfinders' Survival）——一个新生的《我的世界》原版生存服务器。我们仅使用少量必要插件，保留游戏原始机制与纯粹体验，专注采集、建造与生存挑战。玩家将在随机生成的世界中，于纯净的方块环境中重拾冒险的本真乐趣。Join Pathfinders' Survival, a fresh Minecraft vanilla survival server. We use minimal plugins to preserve the game’s orig
body:
**Pathfinders' Survival** 是一个专注于提供**原版《我的世界》生存体验**的服务器，旨在通过技术优化和社区共建，打造纯净、稳定且包容的沙盒环境。服务器基于 Purpur 核心（Paper 的高性能分支），支持 Minecraft **1.21.11** 版本，并向下**兼容 1.16.5** 以上版本，覆盖超过 95% 的玩家群体。我们坚持**保留 Mojang 原版机制**，玩家可自由建造复杂红石装置、探索随机生成的地形，并专注于生存挑战，无插件干扰或规则篡改。
技术与稳定性：服务器采用 中国联通公网 线路，提供 100Mbps 上行 与 1Gbps 下行带宽，保障全球玩家低延迟连接。系统每 15 分钟自动存档，并通过阿里云 OSS 实现异地备份，防止数据丢失。安全机制包括轻量级反作弊插件（如 CoreProtect、NoCheatPlus），仅检测外挂行为，同时符合欧盟 GDPR 及中国《个人信息保护法》（PIPL）的数据隐私要求。
**社区与规则**：我们倡导**公平、包容与透明**的社区文化。禁止任何形式的骚扰、歧视或现实货币交易（RMT），所有资源交换需通过游戏内完成。玩家可通过 [QQ群](https://qm.qq.com/q/uyOK4Fmhxu)/[Discord](https://discord.gg/Tjh523wYvy)参与规则讨论，管理团队定期公开更新决策。未来计划包括扩展历史版本支持（如 1.12.2），举办红石/建筑竞赛
![This is a Minecraft screenshot showcasing a creative mode build for Labor Day. The center features a large pixel-art design with flaming wings, the words "Labor Day," and a cartoon figure wearing a yellow crown, holding a raised hammer—radiating festive energy. The environment blends diverse architectural styles: a tall purple tower resembling a portal (with a cross-like structure on top), distant biomes like the Nether (red terrain), oceans, forests, and modern skyscrapers. Foreground details include pink cherry blossom trees, a traditional Japanese torii gate, stone lanterns, pathways, and benches—evoking a vibrant festival plaza. The scene highlights creativity and celebration, reflecting the collaborative spirit of the game.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64d7aadbfde56543d303a6ce99af2896b9e11d5f.jpeg)

**Pathfinders' Survival** is a dedicated **Minecraft vanilla survival** server designed to deliver an authentic, unaltered gameplay experience while ensuring technical stability and community-driven governance. Built on the Purpur core (a high-performance fork of Paper), the server **supports Minecraft 1.21.11** and maintains backward compatibility with versions **from 1.16.5 onward**, accommodating over 95% of the player base. Our philosophy centers on preserving the **integrity of Mojang’s original mechanics**: players can freely construct complex redstone machines, explore procedurally generated biomes, and engage in survival challenges without interference from disruptive plugins or rule modifications.
To ensure seamless connectivity, the server operates on China Unicom’s public network with 100Mbps upload and 1Gbps download speeds, minimizing latency for global players. Automated backups occur every 15 minutes, and data is redundantly stored on Alibaba Cloud OSS to prevent loss. Security measures include lightweight anti-cheat plugins (e.g., CoreProtect, NoCheatPlus) that detect exploits without infringing on player privacy, aligning with GDPR and China’s Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL).
**Community guidelines emphasize fair play**, **inclusivity, and transparency**. Harassment, discrimination, and real-money trading (RMT) are strictly prohibited. Players collaborate through [Discord](https://discord.gg/Tjh523wYvy) to shape server rules, and updates are publicly documented. Future plans include expanding version support (e.g., 1.12.2) and hosting redstone/building competitions.
This project adheres strictly to legal and ethical standards: no content violates intellectual property rights, promotes harmful behavior, or breaches privacy laws. All systems prioritize player autonomy, technical excellence, and a return to Minecraft’s core essence—exploration, creation, and survival in a blocky, boundless world.

# **福渊大陆纯净生存**​

福渊大陆是以生存生电为核心玩法偏向于原版的公益(可赞助)服务器，致力于让各位玩家结交朋友、轻松游戏。

我们欢迎大多数玩家，无论您是小白还是大佬，在这里人人平等，可以尽享游戏的乐趣。但我们不欢迎熊孩子，以下行为是被禁止的。

破坏其他玩家的建筑，盗取玩家资产(建筑内容器，账号等)，影响服务器运行(卡服、多小号)，作弊(masa系生电模组除外)，聊天物品等带有脏话、政治敏感与引战一类的不良言论，宣传其他服务器，买卖外借帐号资产

title: Foacraft Campfire 营火工艺
description: A Chinese MMORPG server with a unique world setting, free gear crafting, and the freedom to forge your own weapon spirits. Explore islands across multiple dimensions and battle fierce monsters on your adventure.
body:
# 🔥 Tired of the same old survival mode?

Are you looking for a **real adventure** in a world full of **depth, progression, and challenge**?

Welcome to **Foacraft Campfire** — a **Minecraft 1.20.1 vanilla RPG server** built for true RPG players.  
Here, you can ignite your spirit of adventure and forge your own legend. ⚔️

---

## ✨ Server Features

### 🛡️ Deep RPG System
Say goodbye to simple mob grinding and basic leveling.  
Our server features a detailed stat system, including **Physical Damage, Magic Power, Critical Strike, Armor Penetration**, and more.  
You will need to build your gear and choose your skills carefully in order to defeat powerful enemies.

### 🔨 Free Forging System
Become a true forging master.  
There are no boring fixed recipes here. Instead, you can freely combine different materials to craft **one-of-a-kind weapons and equipment** with endless possibilities.

### 🗺️ Rich Exploration Content
From peaceful islands to dangerous unknown continents, a vast world is waiting for you to discover.  
Find hidden treasures, challenge powerful world bosses, and uncover stories buried in history.

### 🚀 Constant Updates
Our development team will continue to deliver **new content, new challenges, and new stories**, making sure your adventure always feels fresh and rewarding.

---

## 📖 Gameplay Overview

### 1️⃣ Choose Your Own Path
There are **no fixed classes** in the game.  
Your combat style depends on the weapon you choose — such as **longswords, staffs, greataxes**, and more.  
You can switch weapons freely and experience different playstyles whenever you want.

### 2️⃣ Explore and Gather
The world is filled with unique materials and valuable resources.  
By defeating monsters, opening chests, and exploring hidden areas, you can collect everything you need for forging.

### 3️⃣ Forge Legendary Equipment
Take the materials you gather and visit the forging masters in **Foacraft Campfire**.  
By combining materials freely, you can create powerful equipment with **randomized attributes** and **unique skills**.  
Every forging attempt is a brand-new possibility. ✨

### 4️⃣ Challenge and Grow
Join public events across the world, challenge powerful regional lords and world bosses, and team up with other players to claim rare loot and glory.  
Your journey will be filled with danger, rewards, and unforgettable battles. 🐉

---

# 🌐 INTERNATIONAL PLAYERS NOTICE

## 🚧 English localization is currently in progress
We are currently working on **internationalization and translation** for **Foacraft Campfire**.  
Some content may still be partially untranslated or under active localization.

### 📢 Join our Discord for the latest updates
If you are interested in the server, please join our Discord to learn more about:
- current translation progress
- international player support
- upcoming updates and announcements
- community details and server access

---

## 🌍 Learn More

### 💬 Discord
https://discord.com/invite/qJzJJ7ub8K

### 🌐 Website
https://www.foacraft.com/

---

## 🔥 Begin Your Adventure
If you are searching for a Minecraft server with **true RPG depth**, **freeform progression**, and a world worth exploring,  
then **Foacraft Campfire** is waiting for you.

**Light the fire. Forge your legend.** 🔥

title: DexMasters [Cobblemon]
description: NEVER-P2W Cobblemon server with various features such as type-based Origins, Stardew-inspired bundles, Legends: Arceus styled tasks, and much more!
body:
# Join us on Discord!: https://discord.gg/HcCpEPu
## What is DexMasters, and why?
We are a community-driven F2P server run by a small team that intends to shape both current content and future additions around the feedback you provide. DexMasters was created as a place to provide a casual environment that is both welcoming to everyone and not watered down with profit-centric features. We are not a corporate-tier development team, but regular joes with regular jobs just like anyone else. It's just so happens that we also run a server, too. DexMasters will **never** be run like a business. 

## Ok, but is this server actually nonP2W...?
When it comes to the "What is P2W?" debate, I do not believe there is as much ambiguity as people say there is. Either your real money can be translated to actual in-game value, or it can't. DexMasters has no room for that grey area that many might dance around in. We will only ever sell cosmetic goods or items that affect _all_ players equally in our online store. Finally, any forms of randomized content that we may implement in the future will of course never be paid and will never have essential or core content locked behind them. If you're curious, our store page is linked on the right so you can see for yourself!

![Divider](https://i.imgur.com/jR9VIAS.png)

![The top of our spawn, built into natural terrain with builds inspired by Pokémon: Mystery Dungeon.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/422e68cfd14106ccaf8063670737e97494f5c7a1_0.webp)

![Divider](https://i.imgur.com/jR9VIAS.png)
## Well, what features do you have available?
- **Become your favorite type!**
  - We have utilized the Origins mod to provide custom type-based origins. Embody your favorite type and gain various buffs, debuffs, and abilities themed around that type! Like the Dragon type? Gain permanent elytra and use Draco Meteor to shoot fireballs at will, but exhaust hunger more quickly! What about Fire type? You can shoot an arrow Flamethrower and use Burn Up to set yourself on fire to gain temporary buffs! Normal type is your effective opt-out of this feature, containing no buffs, debuffs, or abilities.
 
- **Complete multiple Stardew Valley inspired bundles!**
  - Visit Gimmighoul at /warp guild to turn in various items for rewards through a system styled like Stardew Valley bundles. We have over 20 Bundles to complete, including a difficult Final Bundle!

- **Rise through the ranks by completing research tasks!**
  - Loosely based on the research system of Legends: Arceus, there are many Research Tasks for you to complete to earn points, which are the way you rank up on DexMasters!
 
- **8 player-run gyms for you to challenge!**
  - Take on the Gym Challenge and battle our 8 Gym Leaders, whose types were voted on by our community, for glory and prizes. If you win, you can rechallenge them monthly for even more rewards!

- **Protect your land from unsavory individuals!**
  - Open Parties and Claims is a fantastic tool to protect and share your land. You can claim entire chunks straight from Xaero's Minimap(included) and also see any claim from there as well. Diverse flag control lets you tweak your protection exactly how you want it.

- **More to cook, more to eat!**
  - Expand your diet with Farmer's Delight & Add-ons. Bake a Coffee Cake, brew some tea, share a pot roast with your friends, and much more!
 
- **Extra blocks and decor!**
  - Included in this pack is the full suite of Macaw's Mods alongside Handcrafted and more to provide you with much more options for building your home and decorating your landscape!
 
- **Talk to the community in-game!**
  - We have added Simple Voice Chat to this modpack to allow to you participate in opt-in proximity voice chat on our server. This is entirely optional and is disabled by default until you press N to unmute other people. This does not unmute you, however, which is a separate keybind(M). Others will be able to see if you have this disabled to avoid confusion.
 
- **Express yourself!**
  - Using the Emotecraft mod will let you show just a bit more emotion when interacting with other players. The server provides a base list of emotes for you to use, but you are free to upload your own to your client that others will be able to see with no input on their end. 

- **Other features include, but are not limited to:**
  - Terralith Generation + many structure mods.
  - Lootr for instance-based chest looting.
  - Monthly themed and unthemed tournaments.
  - Pokemon outbreaks and themed distortions that spawn around you.
  - Earn profit through GTS, selling pokemon to the server, mining, and more.
  - Various shops and QoL services to help you on your adventure.
  - Gacha-style Legendary Summoning that costs in-game items to do.
  - Over 60 collectible prefixes that can be swapped to at any time.
  - All base/modded advancements reward money/items and are worth doing now.
  - ChestShops and PlayerWarps for even more player interaction.
  - Varying and periodic chat-based trivia questions.
  - New and modified recipes for things like elytra and master balls.
  - Custom music discs and funny goat horn(pokeflute) sounds.
  - Most MC mobs are turned off, but our in-game shop sells their drops.
  - Multiple expertly balanced custom regionals suggested by our community.


**This server and the associated modpack makes use of MegaShowdown x AllTheMons!**

![Divider](https://i.imgur.com/jR9VIAS.png)

title: FATEX
description: Bored? Like really bored? Let's fix that. Vanilla feel with extra sauce — custom classes, new bosses, unique items, new mechanics & more to discover. We've been perfecting this since 2019.
body:
![server description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63e427fe2e835f7fe570ccb0392e1793a3524755_0.webp)

# **Choose Your Class**

Every class rewrites the rules of how you fight. Open /class and pick an identity — your base stats shift, your model changes, and a unique skill set becomes yours. Trigger them with specific item combos, burn them for 30 seconds of chaos, then wait for cooldown.

The Faker vanishes in a burst of speed and leaping aggression — a predator built for ambushes. The Archer turns every arrow into a lightning rod. And those are just the ones we'll show you.

![class](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7874cf4943df8cd339a58eded3b174b317549ce4.png)

# **Gear That Rolls the Dice**
Every craft is a gamble. Stats are randomised on creation — your stone sword might come out with a savage buff, or a nasty debuff. Level up and the rolls get better. Some items auto-upgrade to the next tier and keep their unique stats — so your two-handed stone sword could become a two-handed diamond sword.

Rarer items can roll extra gem slots. Bosses drop gear you can't craft. The Ender Dragon drops the Eridium set. Wither Skeletons carry swords locked to level 40+. Never stop hunting.


![gear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64e58a190d0578ee6594ccccb3b44c48b14f3871.png)

# **Cosmo Stones — Infinity-Level Power**
These aren't upgrades. They're insurance — and they're rare. Three tiers: Impure, Clone, Real. The higher the tier, the closer to true power. Socket them. Protect your best gear. Identify the unidentifiable.

![cosmo stones](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d05986c7516f0cdaf9edff004fb1d079252d154a.png)

# **The Grind — Level Your Way**
Death doesn't delete your progress. Ever. Professions feed into your main level — two systems, one character. Mobs scale around you: Overworld enemies are ~30% weaker, Nether hits harder.
![levels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e75fc58da68959c01479a7dab5bcc787bb105f38.png)

Please consider visiting wiki: [wiki.fatex.eu](https://wiki.fatex.eu/arpg)

title: Aeternum Roleplay
description: Ein DnD like Minecraft Fantasy Rollenspiel Server - A german DnD style Minecraft fantasy role-playing server
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9a2a2d0e7276af5c8f955827f6977f585224eac.gif)

### Disclaimer:
Aeternum is a german speaking Minecraft text roleplay server. 
Target language is german.

### Empfohlenes Modpack:
[Aeternum Rolaplay Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/aeternum-roleplay)

## Ein DnD like Minecraft
## Fantasy Rollenspiel Server

Du öffnest deine Augen und findest dich in den kalten Mauern einer Zelle wieder.
Dein Schicksal scheint besiegelt – das Urteil ist gefallen.

Dir steht die härteste aller Strafen bevor,
die Verbannung auf die sogenannte “Insel der Verdammten”.
Eine Inselgruppe im endlosen Ozean, voller Geheimnisse, Mythen und Gefahren, wird nun deine neue Heimat sein.

Wirst du es schaffen, im Exil zu überleben und dich von deinen Ketten zu befreien?

## Kontinuierliche Updates:
Neuste aktuelle Update: **Jahreszeiten**

## Eine Neue Welt erwartet dich

Eine einzigartige, handgemachte 5000x5000 Welt erwartet dich, gekennzeichnet von Mythen aus alten Zivilisationen.

Entdecke neue Biome mit neuen Texturen und Monstern. Landrisse, Höhlensysteme, Wasserfälle,Waldbrände, Ruinen und viel mehr erwarten dich auf der Oberfläche.

In den Tiefen des Erdreiches lauern Gefahren mit einzigartigen Herausforderungen.

## Erforsche das Unbekannte

Lerne mehr über die Insel und ihre tiefere Bedeutung.
Erlerne neue Kampfkünste und erforsche die Arkane Kunst.

Über 150 Zauber und Künste gibt es zu entdecken und zu meistern.
Dabei sind alle diese Zauber und Kampfkünste visuell umgesetzt und haben Einfluss auf die Spielwelt.

Werde zum Meister und lehre anderen Spielern dein Wissen.

## Errichte deine Stadt

Ein komplexes selbstgemachtes Stadtsystem wartet auf dich, mit 8 Stadtstufen und insgesamt 54 Stadt-Upgrades und das ohne Anträge stellen zu müssen.
Verwalte deine Stadt frei nach eigenem Belieben, manage deine freigeschalteten Upgrades selber und steige Stufe für Stufe auf.

Hinter unseren Upgrades stecken dabei ganz neue Systeme, wie zum Beispiel das Upgrade “Schrebergarten”.
Schalte 15 weitere Pflanzen frei, die Einfluss auf das Kochen, die Medizin und das Brauen haben.

## Wachse und werde Stärker

Erstelle deinen eigenen Charakter mit einer Spezies und Attributen.
Schalte Punkte mit unseren selbstgemachten Errungenschaften frei und stärke deinen Charakter.
Unsere 10 Attribute werden dabei visuell von unseren animierten Würfeln unterstützt und beeinflussen einen Großteil deiner Reise.

## In den Tiefes des Erdreiches

Stelle dein Können auf die Probe und erkunde einen von bis zu 10 Dungeons.
Jeder dieser Dungeons besitzt ein eigenes Thema mit eigenen Mechaniken.
Finde besondere Belohnungen und erfahre mehr über das Schicksal der Insel.

Einige dieser Dungeons sind unbekannt und versteckt und können von dir entdeckt werden.

title: Planet One
description: A whitelisted modded Minecraft server with a long-term world, friendly community and laid-back feel.
body:
Planet One is a long term, whitelisted modded Minecraft SMP server, hosted in Europe. We have a tight-knit, dedicated community with players from Europe and the USA who collaborate on building and infrastructure projects (like railways!).

# 1.20.1 Build Showcase

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/bI9xwX3kSpE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# The Pack
We run the [CPWN Pack 2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cpwn-2), a custom modpack built specifically for this server. Some of the well-known mods in it are:

- Create & Create Aeronautics
- Farmer's Delight
- Alex's Caves
- Aquaculture 2
- Chipped
- Ars Nouveau

...but we have many more!

Currently we are running an End Survival event, exploring a structure-filled end on a Create Aeronautics airship. The overworld with our existing builds is closed until we successfully fight the Ender Dragon and are able to return there. Come and join the crew!


# The World
The current world has been running since **October 2024** and was originally created in 1.16.5. It was updated to 1.20.1 in late 2025 and has since been updated it to 1.21.1, with new terrain regenerated around player builds.

The goal is for this to be the **final modded world I'll ever play on** - I don't ever aim to reset this, instead updating once the majority of mods in the pack have transitioned over to a new version.

Outside of the map's original 1.16.5 spawn region - dubbed the **"Origin Isle"** - the world has been generated with Terralith &  Biomes O Plenty. Alex's Caves are spread throughout it and we have plenty of variety both above and below ground for keen explorers.

The world is on Hard Mode, so you'll need to think about how you gear up and build your base.

We have Waystones, but they can't be crafted or moved. If you want to do long distance travel, you'll need to build your own roads and railways - something many players have already done!


# The Rules
- No PVP, griefing or bullying of any kind is permitted.
- You can build anywhere, but if you're building in the Origin Isle (the original 1.16.5 chunks) please check with an admin first.
- The golden rule is to **be kind to one another.**


# Who are we looking for?
We are looking for 18+ players from anywhere in the world who are happy with a **slow pace**, focusing on their own builds or collaborating with others over the long term in a shared SMP experience. You will also need to be able to communicate in English.

We are all busy with work, kids and other responsibilities and only really get to play some evenings and weekends. It's about quality, not quantity. **If you're a no-lifer or a speedrunner, this server isn't for you.**

To be whitelisted, [please fill in the Planet One Application Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdTgesZwNmIniQeAyDg3G0KsH_IA83kphzURjqyCHyXUvvBkw/viewform?usp=publish-editor) and I'll message you on Discord or via email to chat further and bring you on board.

We would love for you to join us! Hopefully see you soon!

All the best,

Kwikxilver - Server Owner

title: ReboundBox
description: Майнкрафт BoxPvP сервер ReboundBox-  это новый PvP‑проект в формате боксов.
body:
# 🛡️ ReboundBox — Копай. Убивай. Доминируй.

Добро пожаловать на **ReboundBox** — сервер, где классический BoxPvP встречается с безумным ElytraPvP. Здесь вы решаете: медленно пробиваться к вершине через шахты или сразу ворваться в небо с зачарованиями за гранью возможного.

---

## 🎮 Как подключиться
* **IP-адрес:** `reboundbox.lol`
* **Версия:** `1.19.4` — `1.21.x`

---

## 💎 Особенности режима BoxPvP
На основном режиме вас ждет классическая механика прогрессии, доведенная до идеала:
* **Добыча и обмен:** Исследуйте шахты, копите ресурсы и обменивайте их на топовую экипировку.
* **Арены:** Сражения в замкнутом пространстве, где важен каждый клик.
* **Ивенты:** Участвуйте в регулярных событиях, чтобы получить преимущество над соперниками.

## 🚀 Режим ElytraPvP (OP Kits)
Для тех, кто ценит скорость и мощь:
* **Overpowered-зачарования:** Вещи, зачарованные «максимально» сильно. 
* **Доступные киты:** Никакого долгого фарма — бери сет и вступай в бой.
* **Воздушные сражения:** Маневрируй на элитрах и используй мощь своего снаряжения на 100%.

---

## 🛠️ Техническая информация
> [!TIP]
> Мы рекомендуем использовать версию **1.20.1** и выше для стабильной работы всех визуальных эффектов и механик.

| Параметр | Значение |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Пиратка и лицензия** | Свободный вход |
| **Режим** | BoxPvP / ElytraPvP |
| **Сложность** | Нормальная (BoxPvP) |
| **Экономика** | Сбалансированная |

---

> *   **增强体验：** 服务器已内置增强材质包（含粘液科技及原创功能材质），基岩版同步支持。

> **不一样的粘液科技空岛玩法，科技与魔法的终极碰撞！**

*   **🧰 实用功能：** 内置随身末影箱、工作台、自动整理箱子等便捷工具。

*   **💎 全物品获取：** 正在完善中！确保海岛环境也能获取原版生存的所有材料。
*   **⚙️ 特色刷石机：** 经过特殊设计，可以刷出各种海岛原本无法获取的方块。
*   **🏝️ 岛屿系统：** 默认 **512x512** 超大面积，支持创建多个岛屿（制作中）。
*   **🤖 技术向支持：** 包含随身工具及自动整理功能，适合长期生存玩家。



---

### 📂 完善的文档支持

# ⚔️ GuildWar.eu
Welcome to **GuildWar.eu**, a unique Minecraft experience that blends classic survival with deep MMO elements and tactical guild diplomacy. Dive into a world where your combat skills matter just as much as your diplomatic prowess.

## 🏔️ Explore Rungholt & The End
Venture off the beaten path and enter **Rungholt**, our custom-crafted PvE map. Battle unique creatures like Forest Wolves and Corrupted Harvest Spirits, or face epic boss encounters against **Arachna the Webweaver** and the legendary wolf **Fenris**. Forget standard PvP! We’ve introduced new weapon classes to redefine your playstyle:

title: ZeroWorlds
description: ZeroWorlds is a private vanilla Minecraft server with minimal enhancements, focused on a mature community, long-term gameplay, economy, and RP elements. 🌍⛏️
body:
ZeroWorlds is a private vanilla Minecraft server designed for players who want a calm, long-term survival experience without the chaos of typical public servers. The project focuses on preserving the original Minecraft gameplay while adding a few carefully selected features that improve convenience and depth without breaking vanilla mechanics. 

The server runs on Java Edition versions 1.20.1–1.21.x and supports both licensed and cracked clients. The project has existed since August 9, 2022, and has built a stable community over time rather than being a short-term server launch. 

A key idea behind ZeroWorlds is community and quality of players. Access to the server is private and requires an application, which helps filter out griefers and toxic players. Most players are Russian-speaking and around 15–30 years old, and they usually enjoy long projects such as building cities, farms, creating stories, and participating in role-play events. 

The server includes several features that expand the vanilla experience while keeping it balanced. For example, it has a player-driven economy with its own currency and shops, role-play systems such as governments, laws, quests, and events, and more than 1000 custom achievements. Voice communication through PlasmoVoice and player animations through EmoteCraft are also part of the gameplay, making interaction between players more lively. 

Overall, ZeroWorlds is not just a survival server but a living world with its own culture, events, and community history. Players come not only to gather resources but to build something meaningful, gain recognition in the community, and take part in a long-term shared world. 

If summarized in one idea: ZeroWorlds is vanilla Minecraft for players who treat the game as a long-term project rather than a short casual session.

description: UneasyVanilla is a semi-anarchy/survival minecraft server, started on the 10th of March 2020. Designed to give players total freedom to play Minecraft just as the developers intended.
body:
# UneasyVanilla

**UneasyVanilla** is a semi-anarchy survival Minecraft server launched on **March 10th, 2020**.  
It offers a persistent world where player actions, creations, and conflicts leave a permanent mark.

The goal is simple: **play Minecraft the way it was meant to be played** — with freedom.

---

## Server Philosophy

UneasyVanilla is **not pure anarchy**, but it’s close.  
Think of it as **controlled chaos** rather than complete lawlessness.

Players have the freedom to explore, build, form alliances, betray others, or play completely alone. The world is shaped entirely by the players who inhabit it.

You can do almost anything you want in-game as long as you follow a **small set of basic rules**.

---

## What to Expect

- **Semi-Anarchy Gameplay** – Minimal restrictions and maximum freedom  
- **Persistent World** – No map resets; history matters  
- **Pure Survival Experience** – No pay-to-win mechanics  
- **Minimal Staff Interference** – Staff only intervene to stop cheating and maintain server stability  
- **Player-Driven World** – Alliances, wars, bases, and history created by the community  
- **EU Hosted Server** – Excellent ping for European players and solid connections from North America  

---

## The Experience

UneasyVanilla is for players who enjoy **true survival Minecraft**.

This is a world where:
- Someone might be waiting behind a Nether portal
- Your base could become part of server history
- Every structure, war, and alliance is created by players

There are **no hand-holding mechanics, no artificial protection systems, and no shortcuts**.

Just Minecraft — **raw, unpredictable, and player-driven**.

---

## Join the World

If you're looking for **long-term survival, freedom, and a server where player actions truly matter**, UneasyVanilla might be the place for you.

title: Retro Dwarves vs Zombies (Retro DvZ)
description: Retro DvZ is based on the very first DvZ version from 2012 with Crafting classes, all while having new content updates on the latest versions of Minecraft!
body:
# DWARVES VERSUS ZOMBIES REIMAGINED
Retro DvZ is dedicated to recreating and building upon the experience of classic _**Dwarves versus Zombies**_ in modern Minecraft, inspired by the legendary 2012 videos by PauseUnpause and Etho (no affiliation with either). People who have played Dwarfscraft, Rawtech, or UberMC will be very familiar with this version of DvZ.

# What is our Gamemode?
Retro DvZ is an asymmetric attrition PvP, roleplay, and survival game mode.\
Dwarves must gather resources and construct a defendable keep to house their Shrine. At the end of the build phase, some dwarves are selected to become monsters. These monsters must then attack dwarves and destroy the Shrine.\
While dwarves are very powerful, they only have one life. Monsters on the other hand can respawn infinitely despite their relative weakness.\
The goal of the dwarves is to last as long as possible. The game ends when all dwarves are killed or when the Shrine is taken down by the monsters. 

# When do games happen?
This server is event-based and is not 24/7. Games are scheduled **every other Sunday at 5 PM Eastern Time (9 PM GMT if daylight savings, 10 PM GMT otherwise)**. Join the Discord to get reminders for when games happen!

# Important Links
**IP**: play.retrodvz.com\
**Discord**: https://discord.gg/YSV2z7V

- Mundo creativo: Un mundo para desarrollar y experimentar tus ideas.
- Mundo survival: Un mundo que tiene +4 años de antiguedad con varias bases y avances que dejaron anteriores jugadores.

Para mantener la calidad de la experiencia, contamos con una lista blanca. Únete a nuestro Discord para realizar tu postulación y empezar a construir con nosotros.

title: Abyssbay
description: German Minecraft CityBuild server in Pirate Style
body:
Willkommen auf Abyssbay.net, dem einzigartigen Citybuild-Minecraft-Server, auf dem sich alles um Piraten, Freiheit und unerschrockenes Entdecken dreht. Hier setzt du die Segel in eine lebendige Welt, in der jede Insel eine Geschichte erzählt und jeder Spieler die Chance hat, sein eigenes Piratenreich aufzubauen. Unsere Meere sind weit, die Stürme unberechenbar, doch mutige Abenteurer wie du finden darin genau die Herausforderungen, die wahre Seefahrer ausmachen.
Auf deiner persönlichen Insel gestaltest du Gebäude, Lager, Farmen und ganze Siedlungen, die deinem Stil entsprechen und deine wachsende Macht zeigen. Ressourcen zu sammeln ist nur der Anfang, denn wahre Piraten handeln, tauschen und verbünden sich, um noch größere Ziele zu erreichen. In unserer Community findest du Gleichgesinnte, die dir helfen, inspirieren oder mit dir gemeinsam große Projekte verwirklichen. Zusammenhalt ist hier ebenso wichtig wie Mut, denn niemand erobert die Meere allein. Tägliche Herausforderungen, spannende Quests und besondere Events sorgen für Abwechslung und bieten dir immer neue Möglichkeiten, deine Fähigkeiten zu beweisen und wertvolle Belohnungen zu erhalten.Unser Server legt besonderen Wert auf Fairness, Freundlichkeit und ein respektvolles Miteinander. Jeder Spieler, ob erfahrener Kapitän oder frisch angeheuerter Matrose, ist bei uns willkommen und kann frei entscheiden, welchen Weg er einschlagen möchte. Baue, entdecke, kämpfe, handle – du bestimmst dein eigenes Schicksal.Auf Abyssbay.net warten außerdem regelmäßig neue Inhalte, liebevoll gestaltete Bereiche und saisonale Ereignisse, die dir frische Motivation bieten. Ganz gleich, ob du bauen, handeln oder Schätze jagen möchtest, unsere Welt entwickelt sich ständig weiter und wächst mit dir. Darüber hinaus erwarten dich einzigartige Piratenränge, spannende Handelswege und besondere Belohnungen, die deinen Fortschritt fördern. Jede Entscheidung formt deine Legende und macht dein Abenteuer auf Abyssbay.net zu einem unvergleichlichen Erlebnis voller Freiheit heute.Darüber hinaus erwarten dich einzigartige Piratenränge, spannende Handelswege und besondere Belohnungen, die deinen Fortschritt fördern. Jede Entscheidung formt deine Legende und macht dein Abenteuer auf MeinCitybuild zu einem unvergleichlichen Erlebnis voller Freiheit heute

# 🌍 Simplex SMP
### The Ultimate No-Wipe Semi-Vanilla Survival Experience

**Simplex SMP is** your forever survival home—a place where you can claim your land, keep your inventory when things go wrong, and build your legacy on a map that will never reset. 

Whether you are a hardcore builder, an explorer, or just looking to chill with friends after a long day, we provide the perfect, stress-free environment for your Minecraft journey.

---

### 🛡️ OUR CORE PROMISE

> **🛑 ZERO MAP WIPES, EVER.**
>
> We believe the time and effort you put into your builds should be respected. 
> * **Permanent World:** We will never delete or reset the map. Your progress is safe forever.
> * **Stress-Free Survival:** Keep Inventory is permanently enabled.
> * **Grief Protection:** Our robust claiming system ensures nobody touches your hard work.

---

### ⚡ Server Highlights

* ♾️ **No Resets:** Build massive projects without the fear of losing them to a season wipe.
* 🎒 **Keep Inventory:** Focus on building, exploring, and having fun without the frustration of losing your gear.
* 🏰 **Secure Land Claims:** An easy-to-use golden shovel claiming system. You control who can interact with your base.
* 🚀 **Premium Performance:** Optimized for zero lag and locked high TPS, ensuring a buttery-smooth experience even with complex redstone.
* 👥 **60 Player Slots:** The perfect balance—large enough for a bustling economy and active chat, but small enough to maintain a tight-knit community.
* 🤝 **Active 24/7 Community:** Fair play, friendly players, and active moderation.

---

### 🛠️ The Semi-Vanilla Philosophy

We love the core Minecraft experience, which is why **everything at its heart is pure Vanilla**. However, we’ve carefully selected a few helpful, quality-of-life plugins to enhance the gameplay. 

You get the authentic survival feeling, but without the tedious, annoying parts. No overpowered kits, no pay-to-win mechanics—just pure, enhanced survival.

---

### 🎮 True Crossplay & Console Friendly

Simplex SMP is built from the ground up to support everyone, regardless of what device they play on. We offer seamless crossplay between **Java Edition** and **Bedrock Edition**.

**Playing on Console? No Problem!**
We know joining custom servers on Xbox, PlayStation, or Nintendo Switch can be a hassle. That's why we made it incredibly easy:
> 👤 **Simply add `SimplexSMP` as a friend!**
> Once added, the server will automatically appear in your native Friends tab. No complicated DNS tricks or external apps required. Just join and play!

---

**Adventure awaits. Claim your land and start your legacy today!**

body:
# PRR628CRAFT Network
## ℹ️ Overview
The PRR628CRAFT Network is a network of both private and public, vanilla and modded, servers owned and operated by PRR628. For the public, we offer a Minigames<sup>1</sup> server and SkyBlock<sup>2</sup> server. Some select users have access to private whitelisted servers.

The Network is family-friendly made for the most recent Minecraft versions, and supports full crossplay between Java and Bedrock.

The server here on Modrinth is setup to automatically install the [Cookies & Cream Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cookies+cream-modpack). If you do not wish to use it, simply copy paste the IP and leave the port option blank (this is because the default port is used).

Join today ! :3
## 🌐 Join Instructions
### Java
- **Address:** `team-tickets.gl.joinmc.link`

- **Port:** `25565` (default)

### Bedrock
- **Address:** `bedrock.prr628craft.net`

- **Port:** `4952`
### Bedrock **Console**:
1. Friend `PRR628CRAFT` on Xbox.
2. Navigate to Social in-game, and join the Friends world.

## 🎮 Minigames<sup>1</sup>
- ⛅ **Skyblock**<sup>2</sup>
  - The **traditional skyblock experience**, none of the nonsense! No economy or currency. Instead, you can grow your own island, visit your friends islands, or make group islands! *Not public yet.
- 🏁 **Parkour**
  - A bunch of **parkour courses**, and in the future timed trials plus competition!
- 🎈 **Party Games**
  - A bunch of **short minigames in quick succession**, win them to win points and win the overall game! *Not public yet.*
- ⚔️ **Battle Arena**
  - Your **typical PVP and kits gamemodes**. Compete in Free For All, battle in duels, with custom lobbies and *Not public yet.*
- 🎂 **CakeWars**
  - An **unofficial revival of the dead Mineplex game**. Defend your cape, capture territory, and battle others. *Not public yet.*
## ❓ FAQ
<details>
<summary>Is Bedrock Edition supported?</summary>

**Yes, Bedrock is officially fully supported thanks to [GeyserMC](https://geysermc.org/)**.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Are older versions (1.12, 1.8, etc.) supported?</summary>

**While (almost) all older versions are supported thanks to [ViaVersion](https://viaversion.com/)**, we highly recommend using the most recent Minecraft version.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Are mods needed to join?</summary>

**No, mods are not needed, Vanilla clients can join perfectly fine on our Minigames<sup>1</sup> and SkyBlock<sup>2</sup> servers**. Some private whitelisted servers on our Network may require mods. We recommend using a modpack anyway for performance enhancements and bonus features. We may be biased, but we recommend the [Cookies & Cream Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cookies+cream-modpack).

</details>

## 💻 Behind the Scenes
How is the server hosted? Well, this may not be of interest for you, but for those of you interested in server administration, this would be a good read for you! This server is a side project and beloved project of mine so I put lots of work everyday into this :)

<details>
<summary>Learn more</summary>

You can select the *Learn how servers work* section to learn generally about how Minecraft servers work (JARs, backend servers, proxies, ports, authentication, etc.) or click *See our server infrastructure* to get a full rundown of how our server works, as well as links to all the software we use.
<details>
<summary>Learn how servers work</summary>
  
## Server JARs
Server JARs are what the actually server itself runs on! These are simply JAR files that contain Minecraft. You can run the default vanilla Minecraft JAR, but that isn't recommended. Rather, you can choose either a [PaperMC](https://papermc.io/), [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/server/) or the dozen other server JARs available. Here is a more in-depth guide on server JARs:

<details>
<summary>Server JARs</summary>
  
## Overview
Server JARs fall into two main categories. Mod-based, like Fabric, Quilt, or NeoForge, or plugin-based, like Paper, Spiggot, Folia, etc.
## Plugin-based servers
Funnily enough, most plugin-based server JARs are related. Server JARs are forked off of other server JARs, creating a flowing tree of software. When a fork upstream updates, this update goes down the stream to the forks. Forks simply change code of the software upstream. This is the family tree of the most popular server JARs:
```
Bukkit
└── Spigot
    └── Paper
        ├── Folia
        ├── Purpur
        └── Pufferfish
```
These plugin-based servers are some of the most commonly used in big server networks. This is because they are highly optimized for performance and efficiency, however this is often at the cost of Vanilla parity, which we will discuss later.

Plugin-based server JARs are designed to work with plugins. These are Java classes and code that are run alongside serve JARs, interacting with the server via an API. Because of the nature of plugins, you cannot add new blocks or mobs to the game. Again, these server plugins use an API, and therefore work very differently from modded servers.
## Mod-based servers

Mod-based servers are less common, but very good, if not more powerful. They are rising in popularity, and the ONLY option if you want a *modded* server.
## Which should I choose?

This is primarily a personal choice, but here is a simple flowchart to help you decide.
```
Do you want to use mods?
├── ✅ Yes
│   └── Use a Mod-based server like Fabric or NeoForge.
└── ❌ No
    └── Are you planning on using advanced moderating and anti-cheat features?
        ├── ✅ Yes
        │   └── Use a plugin-based server, as there are more options for this in the plugin market.
        └── ❌ No
            └── Do you value Vanilla parity?
                ├── ✅ Yes
                │   └── Then use a mod-based server, and use only performance enhancing and simply QoL mods.
                └── ❌ No
                    └── Welp, if you are just going for a simple non-technical server, paper is very easy to set up.
```
</details>
</details>
<details>
  <summary>See our server infrastructure</summary>


This is a basic tree showing our server infrastructure. We will now go more in-depth. One important note is that our server is fully built from the ground up at home on our own servers. Using a public server host, it may be difficult to replicate this setup without shelling out a lot of cash.
```
Player Client (Fabric)
└── Playit.gg Tunnel (connects client to server)
    └── Velocity Proxy (proxies traffic to all servers)
        ├── Plugins
        │   ├── GeyserMC (allows Bedrock clients)
        │   │   └── GeyserExtras (extra features for Bedrock players)
        │   └── TAB (Scoreboards, bossbars, other cosmetics)
        └── Backend servers
            ├── Lobby server (Paper 1.21.11)
            ├── Minigame server (Fabric 1.21.11)
            └── Eternal Realm server (Fabric 1.21.11)
```
## Playit.gg

[Playit](https://playit.gg) is a simple system that allows you to make your server accessible to the public extremely easily. No port forwarding is needed (port forwarding is not only hard, but impossible for many if hosting at home.) Their website says it pretty well:

> Host game servers from your own computer and let friends join from anywhere. No port forwarding required. Premium just $3/month.

We use playit.gg because our ISP puts us behind a CGNAT. This basically means not only is port forwarding impossible for us, we don't even have our own IP address! It is shared with the whole region. This is unfortunately very common in residential areas. This isn't sponsored in any way just so you know, Playit.gg is just very easy for us.

## Velocity Proxy

[Velocity](https://papermc.io/software/velocity/) is a new-*ish* proxy, made by the same team who made Velocity! It essentially allows you to run multiple servers under a single IP, and allows you to send players to one or another using plugins that utilize the Velocity API! A proxy is REQUIRED if you want a big server network like ours. Other options include Waterfall and Bungeecoord, but those are partially outdated, and Velocity has just suited our server better.

Also, here is our list of Velocity plugins and why we use them. Thank us later :)

- [GeyserMC](https://geysermc.org) : This one is ESSENTIAL. We use it to allow Minecraft Bedrock players to connect to our server. It also has an extensions system, with both official and unofficial extensions you can use to enhance the Bedrock experience.
  - [ThirdPartyCosmetics](https://geysermc.org/download?project=other-projects&thirdpartycosmetics=expanded) (official) : This extension allows Bedrock players to see certain custom Java cosmetics, like custom capes and ears (think DeadMau5).
  - [GeyserExtras](https://modrinth.com/plugin/geyserextras) (unofficial) : This extension adds important features to Bedrock clients. It gives them a special menu (accessed by double-tapping the inventory button) that allows them to access their Java advancements, statistics, and other Java-exclusive menus. It also gives them a proper looking attack indicator, as well as particles such as critical-hit, sharpness, sweeping edge, etc.
- [Floodgate](https://geysermc.org/wiki/floodgate/) : This plugin, made by the same team behind GeyserMC, is important for bedrock players. It authenticates Bedrock players that do not have a Java account. It also enables many many other features. This is important as this is *most* Bedrock players anyway. **This should be installed on both the proxy and the backend, so backend plugins/mods can use the Floodgate API.**
## Backend servers
- [TAB](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tab-was-taken) : This plugin allows you to decorate your server with custom bossbars, scoreboards, tablists, nametags, and more! And you NEVER have to touch weird commands! You can install it on backend servers, but it is way simpler and unified on the proxy.
  - [TABScoreboardAPI](https://github.com/NEZNAMY/VelocityScoreboardAPI/) : If you are using it on a proxy, you need this library plugin, as it gives Velocity a scoreboard API (it does not have one by default)
- [MiniMOTD](https://modrinth.com/plugin/minimotd) : This plugin is simple. It just allows you to create a nice looking MOTD and server icon, but fancy! It also allows you to add multiple randomized versions, and more. A must-have imo.

As already stated, we run a bunch of backend servers for different reasons. Instead of highlighting the server themselves, I will highlight what mods and plugins we use!
</details>
</details>


## 📝 Notes

1. The Minigames server is in Beta and undergoing active maintenance.
2. The SkyBlock server is upcoming and not fully complete yet.
3. Many minigames are in Beta, or may not even be accessible yet.

## Notices

This page is on [MODRINTH](https://modrinth.com/server/prr628craft-network) ONLY. If you see it anywhere else, it is NOT THE REAL ONE.

Also AI has not been used to write this listing :) it was all personally written by the server admin, @PRR628. I just like using emojis, so sue me

If you wish to contact me, you can message @PRR628 on Discord, join my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/mvHwKpuMjK), or email `contact@prr628craft.net`. Have fun!

title: RealismCraft
description: A high-fidelity survival and technical experience pushing the limits of terrain generation and mechanical engineering on NeoForge 1.21.1.
body:
## Official Multiplayer Server
Don't want to face the harsh elements alone? RealismCraft features its very own official dedicated server! Jump into a persistent world where you can collaborate with other players on massive cross-continent rail networks, form alliances to survive brutal Horde Nights, and trade resources to conquer the tech tree faster. The server details are pre-loaded right into your multiplayer menu, so you can start playing with the community immediately.

## The World Scale
RealismCraft is designed to push the Minecraft engine to its absolute breaking point. Using Tectonic 3.0, we’ve completely unlocked the world’s verticality, stretching the build limits from -256 all the way up to 1024. This isn't just about taller mountains; it’s about a world that feels physically massive. You’ll explore vast, realistic continents separated by deep oceans, with terrain that transitions from sprawling flat plains to mountain ranges that take real time to summit.

## The Underground
To fill the massive vertical space beneath your feet, the underground has been completely overhauled. Using mods like Galosphere and Quark, we've ensured that your descent into the deep-earth caverns is constantly varied. You'll encounter unique crystal formations, glowing biomes, and varied stone types that make exploration all the way to -256 blocks feel rewarding rather than repetitive.

## Survival & Realism
In RealismCraft, survival is a logistical challenge. One of the biggest shifts is the removal of infinite water sources. With the Finite Water mod, you can no longer rely on a 2x2 hole in the ground for unlimited supply. Every drop matters. Between your own thirst management via Tough as Nails and the water requirements of your farms, you will quickly find that manual bucket hauling isn't enough. You’ll need to establish real infrastructure, using Create or Immersive Engineering to build long-distance pipelines and high-pressure pumps to bring water from rivers or oceans to your base.

The environment is a constant factor in your survival. Serene Seasons changes the world around you, affecting crop growth and temperature. You'll need to prepare for harsh winters and scorching summers, utilizing technical solutions to keep your environment stable. Combined with realistic liquid physics and falling trees, the world reacts to your presence in a way that demands respect.

## The Threat: Zombie Awareness
The monsters in RealismCraft are no longer predictable. With Zombie Awareness, mobs have become intelligent hunters. They can track the scent of your blood if you're injured, hear the sound of your tools hitting stone, and spot the glow of your torches in the dark. You are never truly safe in your base if you aren't careful with your noise and light. This threat peaks during Horde Nights, where massive waves of undead will test the defenses of your factory or bunker.

Technical Engineering To thrive, you’ll need to master the technical progression of Create, Immersive Engineering, and Mekanism. In a world this large, automation isn't just a hobby, it’s a necessity. Moving resources across continents requires massive rail networks, and extracting the materials needed for high-tier tech requires establishing deep-core mining rigs that can reach the bottom of the world.

# ⚙️ Hardware & Performance Guide
RealismCraft  is designed to be scalable across different systems.

High-End Systems (RTX 3080/4070+ / 50-series):
You can fully unleash the pack. Push your render distance to 24 or 32 to see the 1,000-block peaks from miles away. We recommend allocating 16GB to 32GB of RAM to handle the massive vertical chunk data.

Mid-Range Systems (RTX 2060 / 3060 tier):
The pack remains beautiful and playable! We suggest a render distance of 12 to 16. This keeps your GPU buffer clear while still allowing the scale of the Tectonic mountains to dominate the horizon. Allocate 10GB to 12GB of RAM for the best balance of stability and speed.

Essential Setup (Don't skip this!):
To prevent stuttering and memory errors, you MUST use these JVM flags in your launcher:
-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch

GPU/VRAM Note: Because chunks are over 1,200 blocks tall, your video memory is the main bottleneck. If you see "GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY" messages, simply turn your render distance down by 4-6 chunks to free up address space on your graphics card.

title: The Utopia
description: Minecraft SMP that aims to enhance the Vanilla experience through various datapacks and plugins! (formally KodiakMC)
body:
The Utopia (formally KodiakMC) is a Minecraft server founded by MrKodiak and officially released on March 15th, 2023. The server was passed down to BananaKingXO on August 28th, 2024 and officially renamed to "The Utopia" on August 31st, 2024.

![Banner of The Utopia Everlasting: Mystic Age](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afbffd77d63252ea1de7dd415393d1af64a05ead_0.webp)

The server is survival, with no mods, just plugins and datapacks to enhance the experience, giving the game new items, biomes, structures (like the Forbidden Castle), and mobs. A resource pack is required, however, but it does not require downloading from another site. It is simply a popup in game that is user friendly and will ask to download the resource pack. In short, there are changes to vanilla Minecraft, but it is nothing any player would have to download or install separately before opening the game.

The server resets every Season (about every 3-4 months), giving players the chance to start new bases and teams, and giving staff the chance to add new features to keep the game exciting and fresh. There were six seasons of KodiakMC, lasting from March 2023 to August 2024, and so far there have been five seasons (and one interlude) of The Utopia.

The server also features non interactive lore. Director **MichaelFantastic** writes an ongoing story that has to do with the backstory behind different spawn buildings and seasons in the server. The idea is that he is telling the story of things that happened in the particular universe of each spawn. The overarching storyline has been going on since season three of KodiakMC, but the most relevant parts of the story have been happening in seasons two and four of The Utopia.

Подключение к серверу максимально упрощено: для получения доступа к вайтлисту достаточно зайти в наш Telegram-чат **[@lumintomc](https://t.me/lumintomc)** и ввести команду `/привязать <ник>`. Сервер полностью поддерживает IPv6 (`v6.lumintomc.ru`), обеспечивая стабильное соединение для всех игроков.

Наша главная особенность — мощная интеграция с Telegram через собственного бота. Прямо в мессенджере доступен полноценный шоп, внутренняя экономика, система государств и даже мини-игры! Чат синхронизирован между игрой и Telegram, создавая единое информационное пространство. Мы строим дружелюбное комьюнити: читы и гриферство строго запрещены, однако система кланов и государств позволяет вести честные **PvP-войны по Ролевой Модели (РП)**. В игре вас ждут эксклюзивные механики: зелья возврата, сбалансированные достижения, кастомные крафты, невидимые рамки, приручение лис, аксессуары и возможность носить блоки на голове. Зачарования оставлены аккуратными и близкими к ванильным, а благодаря поддержке **EmoteCraft** (доступно даже на Bedrock) и голосовому чату ваше общение станет максимально выразительным.

Мы ценим мнение каждого игрока и реализуем идеи сообщества благодаря частым обновлениям. Если у вас возникли вопросы, предложения или жалобы, добро пожаловать на наш Telegram-форум **[@lumintoforum](https://t.me/lumintoforum)**, где администрация активно прислушивается к игрокам. Для тех, кто не использует Telegram, открыт наш Discord-сервер: [Присоединиться](https://discord.gg/PGdyGgapX). Присоединяйтесь к **LumintoMC**, чтобы испытать Minecraft таким, каким он должен быть — живым, справедливым и технологичным!

body:
# Whitelist

To get whitelisted, join [our Discord](https://discord.crss.cc) and send your nickname on the [`#whitelist`](https://discord.com/channels/1195393418151596032/1423076289048346644) channel.

# Information

Welcome to Clyde's Real Survival SMP, CRSS for short. The  main server was created by [Blurry](https://blurry.gay). The main server's twist is that it started on [b1.0](https://minecraft.wiki/w/b1.0) and updated all the way to [1.21.8](https://minecraft.wiki/w/1.21.8) on the start of each month, or more recently, when new versions get supported by the server-side mods we use. We have a few rules that you should follow to make the server a better place for everyone, you can find them at the rules section below.

We've been doing this for a good while, and our server has many structures and has had many players.

As of 30/12/2024, the server has reached the latest version of Minecraft, which kind of kills its twist. The server will remain open until Clash or Oracle decide to nuke it, and there is a secondary server called CRSS 3, which will run on b1.7.3 forever if you're into it.

In the past, we had a server called CRSS 2. Unfortunately, Oracle deleted the instance that ran it, so it's unfortunately shut down. CRSS 3 runs on the same instance as all of CRSSN, so that will probably never be deleted.

The main server currently has 3 main nations, ROP, TOA and CHK, each one with unique styles and terrain.

CRSS 3 has two main nations, GAF and DIK, with GAF being 'the spawn town' and DIK being a far away nation yet to be developed.

We have an [Youtube channel](https://yt.crss.cc) where we post content from our server. You can subscribe to it to stay tuned with CRSS content and new episodes of Quartz News Network.

The seed used in the main CRSS world is the same seed the first Main Menu Panorama used, and the spawn is set to the panorama coords.

The seed used in CRSS 3 is `Glacier`.

## Rules

Here are the main rules that are applicable to everything CRSS:

1. Don't be a dick.
    - Repeatedly sending some phrase or word with the intention to piss someone off is not okay at all. We want everybody's stay to be enjoyable.
    - For example, stating you're currently experiencing natural phenomena that's often taken as disrespectful towards people around you, is considered being a dick.
    - Griefing, insulting for no reason, and giving non constructive critiques will be considered as being a dick.
    - We're including things such as homophobia, transphobia, political extremism, and religious extremism as being a dick.

2. Don't hack.
    - This should go without saying, any use of a modified client with the intention of gaining an unfair advantage over other players is banned.
    - Tools such as litematica, minihud, or whatever y'all use to make farms these days are still allowed.

3. Don't import drama
    - External drama isn't welcome here. Keep that to your DMs or /tells, we don't want to turn this place into a drama museum.
    - If you're a community manager from some other community and would like to inform us of serious information about a certain user or group, DM @blryface_ and they'll help you out.

4. No explicit sexual content or topics.
    - This is not an e-dating server, even though we have marriages and such. We do not want to know about what you want to do with yourself or someone else in here, and we will take immediate action.
    - Silly jokes like 'hehe 69 lol funny number', naming a nation Directly Incredible Kilometer just so it shortens as `DIK`, and making upside down T's in game are alright. We don't care, as long as you're not gross about it.

5. **Respect everyone's privacy.**
    - I should not have to say this, but obviously don't expose private message and information about people in here.
    - No doxing, no identity exposure, no taking anyone out the closet, **__respect their privacy.__**
    - We will ban you immediately and permanently if you fail to follow this.

6. Remember to have fun!
    - owo meow mrrp :3

## Information

Here's general information for everything CRSS!

## CRSS (Main Server)

- Location
    - Europe
- IPs:
    - `play.crss.cc`
    - `play.crssi.cc`
    - `crss.cc`
    - `crssi.cc`
- Version:
    - 1.21.8
- Age
    - ~2.8 Years Old

## FAQ

- How do I start a nation?
    - Add information about it on [our GitHub](<https://github.com/crss666/crss>) and/or [our Wiki](<https://wiki.crss.cc>)! The Community Managers can help you put it up correctly. Since our wiki doesn't accept SVGs yet, you can keep the SVG versions of your flag and banner on the GitHub instead.
- Do I need to engage in the geopolitics roleplay?
    - No! You're free to do what you want. But, if you do engage in the roleplay, and only seem to say you're out to benefit yourself, people will not like you a lot... so try not doing that :p
- I need help! Something went out of control, I died somewhere that's impossible to get my items back, or another player is annoying everyone!
    - Don't hesitate to ping us. We will try to help you achieve what you need, as long as it isn't in the "give me 67 diamonds pls :3" sense.
- I want to suggest something! I want more information on X!
    - Ping @blryface_ on Discord. They'll tell you to ping *other people* if its out of their control.

# Final notes

We aim to be a friendly and nice place to stay at! Remember to have fun. If you make people not want to play, we're gonna make you be unable to play :3c /silly /srs

We're a small, long-term community server and we're totally fine with that. The world never resets, your builds stay forever, and we expand the borders when new updates drop. There's no monetization. No ranks for sale, no crates, no store. This is a passion project, self-hosted on personal hardware, so there's no monthly bill keeping us up at night. We're not trying to be the biggest server out there. We just want a solid place to build and hang out.

# What to expect:

The server is family-friendly. Kindness and patience aren't optional. We run weekly content updates and community events to keep things fresh. We have a robust rank system built around actual progression, so you always feel like you're working toward something. Every reward is earned through playtime, no purchase required. We support Java & Bedrock crossplay, custom furniture & decor, earnable flight within your claims, a player-driven economy with shopkeepers, and play-to-earn cosmetics.

# Features at a glance:

- Player-run shops, economy & auction house
- Custom mobs & pets
- Custom furniture & models
- Custom enchantments
- Skill leveling system (AuraSkills)
- Clue scrolls & daily activities
- Live dynmap

description: BBRL is a Minecraft Server centred around racing with friends on ice-boat tracks. You can race publicly against people online, race privately with friends or time-trial tracks to try get the fastest time on the server, and you can make your own track!
body:
# What is BBRL?
**BBRL** is a Minecraft Server centred around **racing with friends** on **ice-boat tracks**. You can race **publicly** against people online, race **privately** with friends or **time-trial** tracks to try get the fastest time on the server! We also have a feature where you can **create** your own **tracks or builds** using the commands starting with ```/buildworld``` _(currently in beta)_. 

# How do I race in even larger races?
**BBRL** stands for **Builders & Boaters Racing League**, as we sometimes run large ice boat races for the main ice boat racing community to race in and have fun. These races are **not** meant to be competitive, as we edit the track while races are happening to create chaos and fun!

Подай заявку — получи действительный IP! **Обязательно 18+**, читай правила [на сайте](https://lssmp.carrd.co/). Мы ищем зрелых игроков, уважающих чужой труд.

- **🛡️ Нет приватов** — полная свобода, но с **логгером блоков** (/lg i) — смотри, кто ставил/ломал блоки или лазил в сундуки!  
- **⚔️ PVP по желанию** — включи/выключи для себя (/pvp) и будь в безопасности.

- **🎨 Мелкие улучшения:** рисование картин, удобный сбор урожая, и многое другое (полный список изменений — в заявке).  
- **👑 Админы не трогают** — никаких вмешательств в игру (кроме нарушений правил).  
- **📜 LORE & события** — запланированные ивенты, следи в TG-канале!  

**Сервер для друзей** ❤️ — играй, строй, исследуй в компании единомышленников. **Никаких читов, гриферства или токсика.** Присоединяйся, если хочешь **настоящий выживач с душой**!

Pinnacle SMP is a small, history rich Minecraft community that has been around since 2012. We have primarily focused on a pure vanilla Minecraft experience with an emphasis on community.

Recently we have started being a vanilla+ server with only quality of life plugins, still focusing on the core vanilla experience.

## OUR COMMUNITY

![Season 11](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ao2BZbcL/images/2b70bbac22e5d9fba3668cfd4e9163ec36f2cd55.png)

We have a vibrant, diverse, and small community of friends who play Minecraft and talk about different things in our discord server. Unlike the "mega servers" where you are just a number, as a member of Pinnacle you become part of the community and friends with our other members.

## HOW TO JOIN

If you are 18+ and would like to join us, you can go to our website at https://www.pinnacle.org and apply to be whitelisted. There may be a short interview process through discord to make sure you are a good fit for our community and that we are a good fit for you.

## Season 12 Overview

**Season Start:** Season 12 began in April 2026, marking a world reset and a new chapter for the server. As with previous seasons, the focus is on long-term world building, player-driven projects, and organic progression.

**World Setup:** The world is currently running as a pure vanilla survival experience. A transition to Paper 26.1.2 was planned but it was voted by the community recently to wait for Paper 26.2.

**World Border:** Currently the world border is set to 4000 blocks across. This is to create a more condensed world to encourage player interaction, shared infrastructure and a more connected community layout in the early game. The world border is not permanent. A server vote may take place at a later date to determine whether it should be expanded or removed.

**Spawn Town Development:** Spawn is currently in active development as everyone begins shaping the central hub of the world. Rather than being pre-built, spawn town is community-driven, reflecting the style and creativity of active players. It is encouraged to set up your first starter home in town and even open up some shops there down the line.

title: Medievalcraft [DE]
description: Bist du bereit für eine faszinierende Welt voller Burgen und mittelalterlicher Abenteuer?
body:
Medievalcraft entführt dich in eine lebendige mittelalterliche Welt, in der nicht Titel, sondern Taten zählen. Hier gibt es keine klassischen Ritter, sondern Orden, deren Mitglieder durch Disziplin, Loyalität und Hingabe auffallen. Einem Orden beizutreten bedeutet Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Regeln zu achten und sich seinen Rang durch Einsatz und Rollenspiel zu verdienen. Ruhm wird nicht verschenkt – er wird erarbeitet.

Die Welt von Medievalcraft lebt von ihren Geschichten. Gewaltige Burgen, befestigte Städte, Klöster, Handelsposten und abgelegene Dörfer prägen das Landschaftsbild. Jeder Ort ist Teil eines größeren Gefüges aus Macht, Glauben, Handel und Politik. Spieler haben die Möglichkeit, diese Welt aktiv mitzugestalten – sei es als einfacher Bürger, Handwerker, Händler, Gelehrter oder als Mitglied eines einflussreichen Ordens.

Der Adel ist auf Medievalcraft kein leicht erreichbarer Status. Adelige Positionen entstehen nicht durch bloßes Spielen oder Anfragen, sondern durch langfristiges Engagement, Vertrauen der Spielleitung und glaubwürdiges Rollenspiel. Wer nach Macht und Einfluss strebt, muss sich diesen über Zeit, Beziehungen und kluge Entscheidungen verdienen. Intrigen, Diplomatie und Loyalität spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle.

Regelmäßige Events, Quests und serverweite Handlungsstränge sorgen dafür, dass die Welt niemals stillsteht. Entscheidungen einzelner Spieler oder Gruppen können das Schicksal ganzer Regionen beeinflussen. Handel, Wirtschaft und Bündnisse sind essenzieller Bestandteil des Serverlebens und eröffnen zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, sich einen Namen zu machen – auch ohne Schwert.

Besonders wichtig ist uns eine respektvolle und engagierte Community, die Wert auf immersives Rollenspiel legt. Neue Spieler werden unterstützt und finden schnell Anschluss, egal ob sie erste RP-Erfahrungen sammeln oder bereits erfahrene Rollenspieler sind. Kreativität, Geduld und gemeinsames Erzählen stehen im Mittelpunkt.
Medievalcraft ist kein Ort für schnelle Titel, sondern für langfristige Geschichten. Wenn du bereit bist, Teil einer glaubwürdigen mittelalterlichen Welt zu werden, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und deinen eigenen Weg zu gehen, dann bist du hier genau richtig.

Betritt die Welt von Medievalcraft auf:
server.medievalcraft.org

[ENG] Medievalcraft is a German medieval roleplay server where players shape a living world of castles, cities, trade, and intrigue. Instead of instant titles, your reputation, rank, and influence are earned through commitment, diplomacy, and immersive roleplay.

description: Towny Server With Active Moderators And Wars With A Earth Math, Historical server
body:
![GEOFRONTIER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a2ea950d55994c623af1286f5ec8d454dce5a5c.png)

*Forge your nation. Conquer the seas. Write your legacy.*

Welcome to **Geofrontier**, a cross-platform Minecraft server where **civilizations rise, wars are fought

We are currently in **Season 2**

---

![WHAT IS GEOFRONTIER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5aa162d715e30591bd4cf152aca68795aea41ec0.png)

**Geofrontier** is a **Java + Bedrock compatible geopolitical survival server** built around nations, exploration, warfare, and economy.

Players build **towns, factories, mining camps, and naval fleets**, competing for influence in a living world where **strategy, diplomacy, and combat** all matter.

Whether you want to become:

* A **powerful nation leader**
* A **creative builder mastering his craft**
* A **merchant controlling trade**
* Or a **warlord commanding armies**

There is a place for you on the frontier.

---

![CUSTOM WEAPONS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/902b81d03b36a9bf14155d9823d2b0d657faba7d.png)

Combat in Geofrontier keeps a balance of vanilla PvP and Custom Weaponry

You’ll have access to **custom weapons designed for large scale battles**, including:

* **Muskets** for ranged warfare
* **Greatswords** for powerful melee combat
* **Siege Weapons** for powerful **HUGE SCALE WARS** to break open enemy defences and leaving a opening for your soldiers to charge

Every weapon changes how players approach combat, encouraging **formations, tactics, and strategy** during battles.

---

![WEEKLY RANKINGS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c40fa99b96a28e83836b73dce754b95f6656a565.png)

Using **Towny**, players can establish and grow their own civilizations.

Your town is powered by a **Town Core Crystal**, which represents the heart of your settlement.

Each week, towns are evaluated through our **Town Rating System**, rewarding the most successful communities with **special perks and bonuses**.

Your town can grow through:

* Building & Architecture
* Economic & Population Growth
* PvP Performance

Only the strongest towns will dominate

---

![RAIDS & WARS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18196963aa294d2630f5e4e2aa1142e09d5b21a7.png)

Conflict is a core part of Geofrontier.

![RAIDS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e7a39879987b59fa4c3d81af42476ff15c7ca03.png)

Raids can happen **without admin approval or consent**.
If you’re not prepared, enemies may strike at any moment.
There must be a greater quantity of defenders than attackers.

![WARS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/040a11408edf5e5ffbaaff88f148032daf3bf019.png)

Full-scale wars require:

* **Consent from both sides**
* **An admin present to supervise**

This ensures that major wars remain **fair, organized, and epic**.

Prepare your defenses… or prepare your armies.

---

![THE SEA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f6451a4c603622e3b7e479aae822fad3988d726.png)

The seas of Geofrontier are vast — and dangerous.

Players can build and sail **custom boats and ships**, allowing you to explore distant lands and transport goods across the world.

But beware:

* The **ocean constantly pushes you away from the shore**
* **Sea monsters spawn** if you remain underwater too long
* The deeper the ocean… the more dangerous it becomes

Only the bravest sailors will master the seas.

---

![INDUSTRY](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3436258100329a6760f5df530937daddf71117e.png)

Great nations require great industry.

Players can establish:

* **Factories**

title: Bleeding Heart SMP
description: A unique hardcore server with a 30M world border, the Farlands, One Mace as well as reviving people if you build a shrine with their head!
body:
JAVA 1.21.11 | HARDCORE | The only hardcore server with a 30M world border, the Far Lands and Vanilla Redstone! No pay-to-win crap, only fun hardcore in a growing community.

Bleeding Heart SMP is a hardcore vanilla experience where every decision matters. One death can end your run unless another player recovers your head and revives you at a shrine. So far, over 1800 people joined, with over 1000 of them dying trying to reach greatness. The world is almost endless, with the Far Lands over 12 million blocks out, fully accessible for those who dare to explore.

We stay true to technical vanilla: TNT duping, gravity duping, and redstone contraptions all work as they were intended. Crystal PvP is disabled, making combat rely on timing, movement, and actual player skill.

A few things make this server uniquely chaotic (in a good way):

✔ Reachable Far Lands — not many servers let you travel this far.

✔ Buildable Orbital Strike Cannon — ever wanted to get your hands on this powerful weapon?

✔ One single mace exists in the world — whoever has it becomes a legend.

✔ Revival shrines let players bring others back… if they’re willing.

✔ Small, growing community where actions actually shape the world.

If you're looking for a world where survival, exploration, and player stories feel meaningful, this is the right place. Come write the first chapters of a server that’s still becoming itself.

body:
Hello, recruit! You've been selected to take part in the Fracture Combat Initiative - an exciting opportunity to make your mark on the universe's newest frontier.

**Endless competition. Real stakes.**

Report for duty, give everything you've got, and who knows? You might just come back a legend! The Initiative is waiting. We'll see you out there.

That's where you come in.

The Initiative runs several active disciplines. Find yours.

- **Team Deathmatch** - Two teams. One kill limit. First to hit it wins! Simple, brutal, effective.

- **Takedown** - Every death costs time. The only way to end a round is a full wipe. Be careful!

description: The Official Infuse Network Server.
body:
# 🧪 Welcome to The Infuse Network
**The Ultimate Power-Scaling Minecraft Experience.**

The Infuse Network is a multi-server destination built around our signature **Spark & Effect system**. Whether you are building the most powerful team in our SMP or preparing for training  in **Infuse Duels**.

---

### 🌐 Network Status
* **🟢 Infuse SMP:** [ONLINE] — High-stakes survival with 12 custom Sparks.
* **⚔️ Infuse Duels:** [COMING SOON] — The ultimate 1v1 arena is returning soon!

---

### 📥 Required Setup (Mod Installation)
To properly visualize custom effects and trigger your abilities, you must install **Bind Commands**. This is the only client-side requirement for the network.

1. **Download:** Get the [**Bind Commands Mod**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bindcommands).
2. **Install:** Place the `.jar` file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
3. **Connect:** Join `play.InfuseSMP.net` and follow the keybind setup below.

---

### 🎥 Official Tutorial by Sharooh
> **New to the Network? Watch the video under to learn how to master your Effects & Abilities and set up your client!**

<iframe width="560" height="115" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Dt5jfjgkDRA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; 
encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

### 🛠️ In-Game Keybind Setup
1. Press **ESC** → **Mods** → **Bind Commands** → **Configure**.
2. Add these exact strings into two slots:
    * **Left Spark:** `/infuse:infuse use_spark left`
    * **Right Spark:** `/infuse:infuse use_spark right`
3. Assign your keys (like **G** or **V**) and click **Done**.

---

### 🔥 Effects:
Discover the full potential of the Effects on The Infuse Network:

### ⚡ Available Sparks / Abilities
* **⚔️ Strength Spark:** All attacks are critical!
* **💨 Invisibility Spark:** Blinds enemies while giving your team true invisibility.
* **❤️ Heart Spark:** Gain +10.0 hearts and heal based on recent damage dealt.
* **🌩️ Thunder Spark:** Strike all nearby entities up to 3 times.
* **🏃 Speed Spark:** Dash forward dealing 2.0 hearts of damage to hit entities.
* **🛡️ Regeneration Spark:** Heals 1.0 heart every 2 seconds.
* **❄️ Frost Spark:** Inflicts Slowness II and Weakness I to all nearby entities.
* **🪶 Feather Spark:** Launch into the air with Levitation IV.
* **⛏️ Haste Spark:** Grants Haste III and Speed I.
* **🌊 Ocean Spark:** Pulls nearby entities toward you and grants Conduit Power.
* **🔥 Fire Spark:** Grants Fire Resistance and ignites nearby entities.
* **💎 Emerald Spark:** Unique utility and trading bonuses.

---

### 📖 Essential Commands
* **`/trust add <player>`** → Protect teammates from your Spark effects.
* **🧪 `/drain <left/right>`** → Store your effect in a bottle for trading.
* **📜 `/recipes`** → View all crafting requirements.

---

### 🔗 Stay Connected
* **IP:** `play.InfuseSMP.net`
* **Discord:** [Join the Network Community](https://discord.gg/MCz2faKY3B)
