title: Chunkful
description: At its core, Chunkful is a simple survival server. There are a few mechanics and features that have been added that make the server more enjoyable, which are explained below, but most of these features have already previously been implemented elsewhere.
body:
At its core, Chunkful is a simple survival server. However, there are a few mechanics and features
that have been added that make the server more enjoyable. Most of these features have already
previously been implemented on other servers. Our goal is to provide just the right balance of
convenience and challenge.
As part of its core philosophy, Chunkful is feature-complete and does not intend to add any new
features. We instead strive to build the best possible implementation of the features we already
have.

## Voting
Voting is a mechanic that allows players to show their support for Chunkful by voting for it on
various server listing websites. By voting, you can help us increase our visibility on these websites
and reach more players. As a reward, you will receive voting points. Using these points, you can
buy perks from the voting shop.

To vote, visit the [vote](/vote) page.
To see your vote point balance, use the `/votepoints` command.
To use the voting shop, use the `/voteshop` command.

## Spawn
Spawn is the protected area around the world center. The spawn area is made up
of three separate areas which offer different levels of protection.

### Spawn zone
The spawn zone is the fully protected area around the spawn point. It is the only area on the server where players
can build or fight. It also offers trade rooms that are ideal for safe trading.
At the center of the spawn zone is the spawn point where new players spawn and players without a bed respawn.

### Green zone
Below the spawn zone is the green zone. It's a flat grass area where players can fight but cannot build. It's ideal
for swordfights and other non-destructive combat.

## Combat logout prevention
To prevent players from logging out while in combat, an NPC is spawned in place of a player when they log out during
a fight. This NPC is fully synchronized with the player and can be killed to receive the player's items.
While in combat, you're unable to do a few things that could be considered unfair, such as:
- Using teleportation commands
- Entering a spawn zone more protected than the one you're currently in

## Homes
Homes allow you to set a few locations that you can teleport freely to.
By default, you can set two custom home locations. An additional home can be
purchased from the voting shop.
You can set a home at your current position by using the `/sethome` command and optionally adding a name.
If you want to teleport to your home, use the `/home` command and optionally add the home name.
After a few seconds of warmup, you will be teleported to your home location.
You can delete a home by using the `/delhome` command and optionally add the home name.

## Teleport requests
Teleport requests allow players to request to teleport to other players.
To request to teleport to another player, use the `/tpa <player name>` command.
To request another player to teleport to you, use the `/tpahere <player name>` command.
The other player will receive a message asking them to accept or deny the request.
Alternatively, they can use `/tpaccept` or `/tpdeny` to accept or deny the request.
If you want to cancel a pending teleport request, use the `/tpcancel` command.
You can block another player's teleport request's by using the `/tpblock <player name>` command.
By using the `/tpunblock <player name>` command, you can unblock them again.
If you want to disable or enable teleport requests altogether, use `/tpoff` and `/tpon` respectively.

## Random teleports
When first joining, you might want to safely teleport somewhere away from spawn.
To do this, use the `/tpr` command. This command will teleport you to a random location not too far away from spawn.
You can use the random teleport command once every twelve hours.

## Direct messaging
Players can send each other private messages using the `/whisper` command.
To reply to a private message, use the `/reply` command.

## Party chats
If you want to talk to multiple players at once, you can use party chats.
To start a party chat, use the `/party create` command.
You can now invite other players to your party by using the `/party invite <player name>` command.
You can join a party by using the `/party join <player name>` command.
To leave your party, use the `/party leave` command.
As the party owner, you can disband your party by using the `/party disband` command.
To switch to the party chat, use the `/channel partychat` command.
If you want to talk to the global chat again, run the `/channel global` command.

## Ignoring players
If a player is annoying you, you can ignore them by using the `/ignore <player name>` command.
To stop ignoring a player, use the `/unignore <player name>` command.
You can view a list of ignored players by using the `/ignorelist` command.
You won't see any messages from ignored players in the global chat.
You also cannot receive private messages from players you're ignoring.

title: MERC-Front Network
description: The official Network for the MERC-Front Modpack which is designed to add FPS-style PVP inspired by round-based shooters to Minecraft.
body:
# MERC-Front Network

The MERC-Front Network is the official server network for the MERC-Front Modpack.

MERC-Front is a community-run, third-party Minecraft server network built around [BlockFront](https://modrinth.com/mod/blockfront), featuring its own dedicated [modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/merc-front). The network focuses on FPS-style, match-based combat with class-based loadouts and objective-driven game modes. Matches take place across a wide variety of custom maps with themes ranging from historical settings (including WWII) to sci-fi and experimental environments, depending on the maps and events being hosted.

## Game Modes

The network supports multiple multiplayer game modes, including:

- Domination
- Free For All
- Team Deathmatch
- Gun Game
- Trouble Town
- Infected

Each mode offers a different gameplay experience, encouraging both tactical team play and fast-paced combat.

## Classes

Players can select from several gameplay classes, each with its own role and equipment during matches:

- Rifle
- Lt. Rifle
- Assault
- Support
- Medic
- Sniper
- Gunner
- Anti-Tank
- Commander
- **_Specialist Class coming soon!_**

These classes allow teams to coordinate strategies and create varied combat scenarios.

### Maps

Currently there are over 24 playable maps each with its own layout and theme, with more on the way.

## Current Network Setup

On our network you can currently either play the different game modes or build maps for matchmaking in creative. Though axcess to map building is limited and you have to get whitelisted (there is no whitelist for the normal matchmaking / gamemodes). We are currently actively looking for community members who are interested in helping design and build maps. (to get whitelisted for the building server you have to join our Discord)

## Events and Player Activity

The project is still growing, and the player base is currently small.

For the full gameplay experience, it is recommended to join during events, where there are more players online. For more Information about events join our Discord

title: KoyoSMP
description: Get ready to dive into the SMP world! Read up on our land claim system guide to protect your base, check out the item prices for farmers and builders, and make sure you understand the Nether rules before setting off on an adventure with your friends!
body:
## 🔰 New Player Guide

Welcome to the server! Once you've joined, please follow these steps:

### 🏠 1. Overworld (Main World)
* **Choose a Location:** Once you join the server, you need to find a place to settle down.
* **Protection:** ⚠️ **You cannot break blocks until you claim the land.**
* **Important Commands:** > `/sethome` — To save your home location.
  > `/claim` — To claim and protect your area.
  > `/claim addchunk <claim_name>` — To expand your area (you must stand near or around your existing claim).

---

### ⛏️ 2. Resource World
* **Freedom:** In this world, you can break, place, and destroy anything!
* **How to go there:** Press [ **I** ] or type `/myhomes` and click the **Compass** 🧭.
* **How to return:** Use the same command or select your saved Home point.

---

### 💡 Notes
* **Resource World:** You can use `/tpa` (teleport to a friend) and `/back` (return to your death point).
* **Overworld:** Teleporting is primarily focused through the central hub/spawn.
* **Announcement:** Opening times for other portals/dimensions will be announced later!

---

## 💰 Standard Item Prices

Announcing updated item prices to balance gameplay and the server economy, categorized as follows:

### 🪵 Woods

*Good prices (~160 per stack) to support builders.*

* **Oak, Birch, Spruce, Jungle, Dark Oak, Acacia:** 2.5 / each
* **Cherry, Mangrove, Pale Oak:** 3.0 / each
* **Bamboo:** 0.5 / each

### 💎 Minerals & Ores

* **Diamond:** 50.0 (Block: 450.0)
* **Emerald:** 15.0 (Block: 135.0)
* **Gold Ingot / Raw Gold:** 10.0 (Block: 90.0)
* **Iron Ingot / Raw Iron:** 8.0 (Block: 72.0)
* **Coal:** 4.0 (Block: 36.0)
* **Raw Copper:** 2.0
* **Quartz:** 5.0 | **Lapis:** 2.0 | **Redstone:** 1.0

### 🏗️ Building Materials

*You can sell dirt and stone for some easy cash!*

* **Sand, Glass, Stone, Cobblestone, Deepslate:** 0.5 / each
* **Clay Ball:** 1.0 | **Brick:** 2.0
* **Gravel:** 0.3 | **Dirt:** 0.2
* **Obsidian:** 10.0

### ⚔️ Dungeon Items

* **Breeze Rod:** 12.0
* **Tuff (All variants):** 0.5
* **Honey Bottle:** 2.0 | **Honeycomb:** 1.5

### 🌾 Agriculture

* **Apple / Bread:** 5.0
* **Carrot, Potato, Beetroot, Wheat, Pumpkin:** 1.5
* **Melon:** 1.8 (Slice: 0.2)
* **Sugar Cane, Sweet Berries:** 0.5
* **Glow Berries / Cocoa Beans:** 1.0 - 1.5

### 💀 Monster Drops

*Junk items can be sold to NPCs. For rare items (Netherite, Totems), we recommend selling them in the Auction House (`/ah`).*

* **Ender Pearl:** 15.0 | **Blaze Rod:** 15.0
* **Slime Ball:** 8.0 | **Gunpowder:** 3.0
* **Leather:** 4.0 | **String / Bone:** 1.0
* **Rotten Flesh:** 0.8

### 🍖 Cooked Food

* **Steak, Chicken, Mutton, Porkchop:** 6.0
* **Cod, Salmon:** 2.0
* **Tropical Fish:** 10.0 | **Pufferfish:** 5.0

---

💡 **Tips:** If you want to sell items in bulk, you can use server commands to check prices instantly! Have fun farming and building! 🛠️

---

## 🔥 Nether Rules

To maintain order, safety, and fairness, all players must strictly follow these rules:

1. Players **cannot create Claims in the Nether.**
   - If you want to build a farm or structure, **place a sign clearly stating the owner's name.**
   - If items are lost or destroyed, you can use `/co inspect` to check what happened.

2. **Do not destroy signs** or anything that indicates another player's ownership.

3. **Never destroy another player's Nether Portal.**

4. Creating a **Nether Link** must be done exclusively at **Y = 70**.
   > *This is to prevent portal overlapping and maintain order within the Nether network.*

5. Do not build farms or automated systems that cause **Lag** or use an excessive amount of entities.

6. Do not build structures that **block the main Nether pathways** or make it difficult for others to travel.

7. Do not use **TNT, Beds**, or **Respawn Anchors** to intentionally blow up or harm other players.

8. Large farms should be built **at least 200 blocks away from the Nether Hub.**

9. If you want to connect a **private portal to the Nether Hub**, please contact the staff team first.

10. Mining for **Netherite (Ancient Debris)**:
   - Allowed in areas away from the center hub, but **explosions are prohibited.**
   - Avoid using **explosives (TNT / Beds)** near the Nether Hub to prevent damage. If you must use them, do so **at least ~2000 blocks away.**

11. The staff reserves the right to **move, modify, or remove structures in the Nether** if rules are violated or if they cause harm to other players.

---

💬 **Thank you to all players for your cooperation**
in keeping the Nether an organized, safe, and friendly place for everyone! ❤️

# Nucleoid

Nucleoid is developing open-source minigames within the Fabric ecosystem on modern versions of Minecraft! This means that all of our minigames are developed by and for the community: anyone can contribute, and anyone can use or expand on what we have created!

## Play
We have a very wide range of minigames available on our server, created by our wonderful community - ranging from classics such as Bed Wars, Quakecraft, or Sky Wars - to unique minigames such as Shard Thief, Creeperfall, or our favorite - _Explosive Tater Spleef_ (need we say more?).

## Get Involved

For all kinds of coordination of development and playing together, consider joining our Discord server! Whether you have feedback on a minigame, would like to build a new map, or create a new minigame from scratch - we'd love to work with you! You might also consider checking out our [GitHub](https://github.com/NucleoidMC) and [Documentation](https://docs.nucleoid.xyz/). 

If you would like to set up your own server with our minigames, you may download compiled builds of the minigames of your choosing from the relevant GitHub repositories.

title: EarthWarSMP
description: EarthWars is a geopolitical Minecraft SMP where players create countries, claim territory, build walls, forge alliances, and wage wars — featuring custom enchantments, Capture the Flag events, duels, an economy with spawner grinding, and a full diplomacy
body:
# ⚔️ EarthWars SMP

**A geopolitical Minecraft experience where nations rise, clash, and fall.**

---

## 🌍 Build Your Nation
Create your own country, claim territory, and recruit citizens. Set up a capital, build defensive walls, and expand your borders. Every decision shapes the political landscape.

## ⚔️ War & Diplomacy
Forge alliances, grant visas, or declare war on rival nations. Wage full-scale wars to conquer territory — or stage a coup from within. Surrender costs you land, not just pride.

## 🏰 Defend What's Yours
Upgrade your walls, protect your capital, and fight off invaders. Combat logging won't save you — your loot drops and your enemies get untagged.

## 🗡️ Custom Enchantments
Over a dozen unique enchantments you won't find anywhere else:
- **Replant** — Auto-replant crops on harvest
- **Grapple** — Pull enemies toward you with crossbow bolts
- **Tracking** — Aimbot arrows onto glowing targets
- **Shadow** — Gain speed sneaking up behind players
- **Writhe** — Delayed poison damage on trident hits
- **Spite, Hype, Hollow, Stride, Kick Back** — and more

## 🏁 Events & PvP
- **Capture the Flag** — Country vs. country team battles
- **Duels** — Best-of-3 arena fights with a queue system
- **Supply Drops & Hardpoints** — Server-wide PvP events

## 💰 Economy & Progression
Grind spawners, sell loot, gamble with coinflips, and open loot boxes. Earn daily rewards, rank up, and unlock player vaults.

## 🤝 Community
Staff chat, Discord integration, an in-game tutorial, and a recruitment system to help new players find a country to call home.

---

*Create a nation. Build an army. Rewrite history.*

description: DemocracyCraft, or DC, is a City Roleplay server focused on the player's ability to create, amend, and remove the rules and laws that govern them. Our server boasts cars, helicopters, a democratically elected government, businesses, economy, and more!
body:
🏛️ Welcome to DemocracyCraft 🏢

DemocracyCraft, or DC, is a city roleplay server focused on the player's ability to create, amend, and remove the rules and laws that govern them. Our server boasts cars, helicopters, a democratically elected government, businesses, economy, among other realistic, life-like features!

# 🏛️ Democracy The server is run democratically, with players able to run for office and participate in government. Players can create and propose legislation, vote on laws, and even impeach officials who abuse their power. This unique gameplay mechanic allows players to have a real impact on the server's direction and fosters a strong sense of community. # 💵 Economy DemocracyCraft features a robust economy system, allowing players to run their own businesses and trade with each other. Whether you're a farmer selling crops, a miner selling ore, or a shop owner selling goods, there are plenty of opportunities to make a profit on the server. Take your business public on the share market and invest! Grow your corner shop into a multi-million dollar empire. You are only limited by your own undertakings! # 🏢 Cities & Towns Are you ready to discover one of the most incredible Minecraft cities ever built? Introducing the City of Reveille, featuring an impressive range of districts, from the bustling downtown area to the tranquil beaches. But this city is more than just a pretty face - it's also a fully immersive roleplaying experience, where players can explore, interact with NPCs, and experience the full range of city life. From shopping and dining to working and socialising, the City of Reveille has it all. If the city isn't for you, then move to one of our four towns, which all boast their own themes and local governments! # 🚨Crime While DemocracyCraft is a friendly and welcoming community, it also features a realistic crime system. Players can commit crimes such as theft or murder, and law enforcement can investigate and bring criminals to justice.

<summary>PurpleSMP Server Content</summary>

### **McMMO**
> An in depth skill system..
> Double XP for an hour every day at 6pm EST!
- `/swords, /mining, /mctop, /mcrank`
### **Personal Vaults**
> Everybody has access to 1 vault.. 
> Boosters get 2, Supporters get 5.
- `/pv 1, /pv 2`

> By default PvP is off for everyone..
> You can enable/disable PvP at will.
- `/pvp on, /pvp off`
### **Essentials**
> Basic command plugin.
> You get 15 homes by default, boosters get 30, supporters get 45.
- `/sethome, /home, /warp, /tpa, /craft, /back, /rules`
### **Resource Worlds**
> Adds resource worlds that reset every 3 days!
> This helps new players with resource hunting.
- `/rw`
### **Slime Chunks**
> A plugin that shows where slime chunks are.. 
> Everyone gets access to `/slime`
> Boosters get access to `/slimemap`
### **GSit**
> Lets you sit on slabs and stairs by right clicking them!
> You can also run many commands for different actions.
- `/sit, /crawl, /lay, /layback, /spin`
### **Voice Chat**
> Allows proximity chat in-game!
> You must have the mod for this to work.
- `/voicechat invite, /voicechat join, /voicechat leave`
### **Land Claims**
> Make sure to claim your land so people don't grief it!

## About Disc Realms

**Disc Realms Network** is a competitive, community-driven Minecraft server built for players who want more than just another reset cycle. We focus on long-term progression, meaningful conflict, player-driven economies, and custom systems designed from the ground up.

Whether you thrive in PvP domination or prefer building nations and shaping global politics, Disc Realms offers a world where your actions matter.

---

## Disc Realms: Anthala

![Disc Realms Anthala Banner Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac313cf4426a60598208250494f4b5a8569ffb7e_0.webp)

Pronounced `/ˈænθələ/`, **Anthala** represents our most ambitious project yet, a complete reimagining of Towny gameplay.

This isn’t a seasonal map. This isn’t a reset-based server. This is a persistent world built to evolve over time based on player lore and server driven events!

Anthala expands the traditional Towny experience with fully custom systems, player-driven lore, and a global economy that reacts to the actions of its nations.

### What Makes Anthala Different?

* **No Resets**: Your towns, nations, and history remain. This world is permanent and will only be expanded through future updates.
* **Player-Driven Lore**: The story of the server is shaped by wars, alliances, betrayals, and diplomacy happening throughout the server.
* **Global Market Economy**: Resources are finite and controlled by players. Trade routes, monopolies, and supply chains matter in the economy.
* **Warfare System**: Nation conflicts with meaningful consequences to lore.
* **Zero Pay-to-Win**: All core gameplay features are accessible without paid ranks. No unfair advantages are given on Anthala.

**Online Map:** [https://map.discrealms.net/](https://map.discrealms.net/)

<details>
<summary>Potential Discontinuation by October 2026</summary>
Note: Anthala may be discontinued in the future due to financial issues caused by bad actors who caused harm to our studio. We are deeply sorry for this. But Anthala will remain online until our dedicated machine expires.

body:
**MC Brawls** is a Minecraft minigames server with a focus on fun, fast games and a competitive edge. Jump in solo or party up!

![brawls hub](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/mImGsti0/images/be918e8ae456205e40f7e02b18d38eee1ffaba0b_350.webp)

**One Shot** is simple: you've got an Infinity Bow, a Riptide Trident, and a lobby full of players to eliminate. Grab powerups like Multishot, Wind Charges, and Invisibility. Get as many kills as you can before the clock hits zero.

![one shot](https://cdn.mcbrawls.net/img/one-shot-range-water-update.png)
![one shot 2](https://cdn.mcbrawls.net/img/stormscraper-promo.png)

**Rise** is all about avoiding the floor. Powder rains down constantly and one wrong step eliminates you.  
**Rise: Capture** takes that same chaos and adds a team objective, with players scrapping over a centre monument using Knockback Sticks.

![rise arena](https://cdn.mcbrawls.net/img/rise-stage-promo-2.png)

**Spleef and Rocket Spleef** are two similar games. Spleef is a classic - dig the floor out from under your opponents and don't fall yourself. Rocket Spleef does the same thing but hands everyone an Elytra and a Rocket Launcher, with random mutators like Meteor Strike and Blindfold shaking things up.

We also host **Dodgebolt** — two teams, one-shot arrows, last team standing.

Every game has its own **Mastery** system — play, hit objectives, and earn XP and Coins as you go.  
Climb the **leaderboards** to see how you stack up.  
Grab **Titles** to show off on your profile

**Join at `play.mcbrawls.net`**

# ZNC SMP

ZNC SMP is an evolving survival multiplayer server built around one core principle: **no pay-to-win, ever.** This server was created so my son — and players like him — can experience a fair, competitive SMP where progress is earned through gameplay, not purchases.

We are actively developing new systems and refining mechanics to create a long-term, player-driven world.

* Form alliances or build your own faction

* Strategic expansion and territorial control

### ⚔ Risk & Reward Gameplay

* PvP-enabled survival
* Earn power through grinding, smart economics, alliances — or betrayal
* No paid advantages, no purchasable power

---

## Philosophy

ZNC SMP is designed to reward:

* Strategy
* Effort
* Smart decision-making
* Social dynamics

Everything in the server can be acquired through gameplay. There are no paid ranks, no purchasable gear advantages, and no shortcuts to power.. unlessed teamed with strong progressed players.

This is a growing project. New systems, balance adjustments, and features are being added over time. Player feedback directly influences development.

If you’re looking for a fair survival experience where dominance is earned — not bought — ZNC SMP is built for you.

body:
# 🌿 Oakay Season 2 is Coming! 🌿
Mark your calendars! Season 2 officially launches on **May 2nd**. We're gearing up for a brand-new world, a totally fresh start, and new adventures for the community. Gather your friends and get ready for launch day!

![Oakay Server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5S1JEMkU/images/571a13bb4924e5b36d8c811cd9bb3fd9463cfe52.png)

Oakay is a governed, community-first **18+ Minecraft server** dedicated to long-term worldbuilding, structured progression, and player-driven governance. Designed for mature players who value collaboration over chaos, Oakay offers a refined survival experience supported by active political structures, custom technical integrations, and a deeply rooted community culture.

## 🏛️ Player-Driven Governance
At the heart of Oakay is a formal political structure that empowers the community to shape the server's future and infrastructure. 
* **Elected Officials:** Participate in structured election cycles to vote for or run as the Mayor or a Minister.
* **Active Ministries:** Dedicated leaders—including the Minister of Commerce, Minister of Recreation, and Minister of Community & Outreach—actively manage specific server districts and community initiatives. 
* **Civil Campaigns:** We enforce fair, organized campaigning rules to ensure a positive, constructive, and highly engaging election season.

## 🌍 World & Legacy
Oakay thrives on organization, intentional design, and dedicated spaces for community interaction.
* **Long-Term Worldbuilding:** We value your time and creativity. Server resets are rare, occurring only every couple of years, allowing players to build massive, sprawling foundations and leave lasting legacies.
* **Player-Driven Lore & Advancements:** Leave your mark on the server's history. We feature bespoke, custom in-game advancements inspired by our players' actual achievements, inside jokes, and major server lore events.
* **Dedicated Districts:** Explore and contribute to specialized, minister-run zones like the bustling Shopping District, the structured Gaming Disctrict, and the welcoming Community District.
* **Community Events:** The server is brought to life through major, organized gatherings and spin-off series. Past highlights include our custom Skyblock and Last Life server events, competitive Gaming District tournaments, massive Ender Dragon fight events, interactive server tours, and lively election seasons.

## ⚙️ Server Features & Integrations
We utilize optimized setups and custom tools to maintain a seamless, fair, and highly organized environment.
* **Optimized Performance:** The server runs on carefully selected performance mods to ensure a smooth, lag-free experience, even as our world grows in complexity.
* **[Interactive BlueMap](https://map.oakay.ca/#oakay_survival:0:0:0:1500:0:0:0:0:perspective):** Explore Oakay directly from your browser. Our live, high-fidelity BlueMap allows you to track builds, scout terrain, and see community progress in real-time.
* **Custom Datapacks:** Advanced background systems, including automated AFK handling and dynamic team-management integrations, keep the server running smoothly without administrative clutter.
* **Discord Integration:** Our Discord is the official hub for announcements, elections, and server lore. Membership is required to maintain whitelist status, keeping the community connected and accountable.

---

### 🤝 Join the Oakay Community
Whether you are an ambitious builder, a redstone engineer, an aspiring server politician, or simply looking for a relaxed and welcoming place to call home, there is a place for you here!

To review our community guidelines and apply for whitelist access, join [our official Discord](https://discord.oakay.ca/)!

- **Мир без заброшек:** _Система приватов устроена так, что территория освобождается автоматически, если владелец не заходил в игру более 30 дней. Карта постоянно дышит и очищается от «коробок» прошлого._
- **Максимальная лаконичность:** _В интерфейсе и сообщениях нет ничего лишнего. Команд минимум: /spawn и /home (который привязывается сам при клике на кровать)._
- **Полная свобода входа:** _Подключайся с Java или Bedrock, используй любой ник, включая русский, и связывай свои аккаунты для комфортной игры с любого устройства._
- **Порядок без банов:** _Вместо сухих блокировок используется система тюрьмы. Нарушители не просто исчезают — они несут ответственность внутри игрового процесса._
- **Душевный спавн:** _Огромная стартовая локация, построенная вручную, встречает каждого игрока и задает тон всему приключению._

Это не просто очередной сервер. Это авторское видение того, как должна выглядеть современная ваниль без лагов и визуального мусора.

**Telegram:** https://t.me/thelightmight

title: KiloCraft
description: Kilocraft is a server-modded (you can join without installing any mods) survival server.
body:
# Kilocraft – Survival, Reimagined

_Vanilla at heart. Expanded in all the right ways._

## Play Without Mods
No complicated installations! Just enter `50kilo.org` in Minecraft Java and jump straight into survival, all powered by server-side Fabric mods.

Kilocraft isn't "modded chaos". The world you enter is deeper, richer, and more alive than vanilla Minecraft.

![A city built by some members from our community](https://i.imgur.com/zpycSlx.jpeg)

## Biomes That Feel New Again
With [Traverse](https://modrinth.com/mod/traverse), the world gains immersive, lore-friendly biomes that blend naturally into vanilla terrain.

![Autumnal Woods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kXygSBVI/images/99dd0e60ba423c036128c21a27b9ee867b9cf165.png)

Paired with [Cliff under a Tree](https://modrinth.com/datapack/clifftree), terrain generation feels more organic and dramatic. Natural cliffs, overhangs, and formations that make exploration visually rewarding.

![Savanna Plateau](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/59ypHk8x/images/85dbb3571208e4822cd577bf0a8ff74f588fd67d.png)

## Nether Expansion
With [Cinderscape](https://modrinth.com/mod/cinderscapes), the Nether gains haunting volcanic biomes, glowing vegetation, eerie atmospheres, and new survival challenges that make every portal jump unpredictable.

![Luminous Grove](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/QC4wcUXZ/images/28a1a981192c60b4a2668b7fcbc330bfeb737126.png)

## The End Update Is Here
With [Enderscape](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape), the End dimension becomes a full adventure:
- Multiple new End biomes with distinct terrain
- Reworked End Cities & Strongholds
- New mobs with unique mechanics
- Powerful new materials and gear to discover
- Atmospheric sounds and sky visuals that make the End feel alien again

![Enderscape worldgeneration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/btCrWvHr/images/5fd83fb91468c27b75ffb6120240ffa0ef0652f6.png)

## The World Feels Alive
Survival feels alive thanks to expanded mob variety.

- [Friends&Foes](https://modrinth.com/mod/friends-and-foes) adds scrapped mob-vote creatures like Crabs, Iceologers, Mooblooms, and more.

![Waving Crab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/POQ2i9zu/images/e82a9ac0080130093b637ebcf6d754c684103eb0.webp)

- [Illager Expansion Recrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/illager-expansion-polymer) introduces new illager variants and raid threats that make villages and exploration more dangerous.

![Illager Fort](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zkp424MG/images/f0e7de2e9debb2c21f84be686932790f2747763f.png)


- [Tom's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-mobs) adds immersive creatures that fit seamlessly into vanilla biomes.

![Capybara near a river](https://i.imgur.com/Gmov6iT.png)

## Automation, Storage & Base Building Depth
With [PolyFactory](https://modrinth.com/mod/polyfactory), survival players can build real machinery:
- Conveyors & item transport
- Mechanical presses and grinders
- Wind-powered systems
- Functional production lines

![Example Oak Wood/Apple farm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/MikpSrAF/images/2035a4db842cf939959f53b88e787dc979c1408c.png)

[Extended Drawers](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-drawers) allows massive item storage while keeping bases clean and organized.

![Collection of drawers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AhtxbnpG/images/8e1e419c31c7ae817e5c27601b76fe47df1b1779.png)

## Survival Life, Upgraded
Kilocraft enhances everyday survival too.

### Farming & Cooking
With [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated), survival food becomes meaningful:
- New crops
- Cooking systems
- Kitchen tools
- Complex meals with real value
Farming feels like progression!

![Cooking Pots, Skillets, Stoves, Cutting Boards, Knives and so on.](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/456/881/kitchenware.png)

[Gone Fishing!](https://modrinth.com/mod/gone-fishing) adds biome-specific fish, rare loot, and rewarding fishing mechanics.

### Personalization
[Trimmable Tools](https://modrinth.com/datapack/trimmable-tool) lets players customize tools visually - style without imbalance.

[PolyDecorations](https://modrinth.com/mod/polydecorations) adds immersive decorative blocks and furniture-style elements that help bring builds to life without overpowering vanilla style.

![Workplace - Tables, Toolracks, Cut Canvas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5710VC7f/images/0745e2d3af4f5c17c2aa1c2c91ce3f00ab169665.png)

With [Blockus](https://modrinth.com/mod/blockus), builders gain dozens of new block variants, without breaking the vanilla aesthetic. More palettes. More creativity. Same survival balance.

![Almost all blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zFiY2Go0/images/de133011d225b5a6e45510a785c75fe8f8292712.png)

## Progress That Feels Earned
On Kilocraft, ranks are earned through **playtime and voting**, not paywalls.

Unlock:
- More homes & claims
- /hat, /sit, /glow, /craft, /signedit, /hug, ...
- Nickname formatting
- Player warps

Supporter ranks exist, but progression is fair and natural.

## Survival With Balance
- Grief-protected land claims
- Limited teleportation in Nether & End (to preserve difficulty)
- PvP toggle system
- VoteCrates & rewards
- Mob head drops
- Phantom toggle
- Active Discord community

The core gameplay experience is survival-based with quality-of-life enhancements. StellaRealm features an emerald-based player-driven economy where users can trade, open shops, and participate in fair market activity. The main worlds are designed to persist long-term without scheduled resets, allowing players to build permanent structures and establish lasting projects.

Additional features include per-player generated loot (including End loot such as Elytra), optional PvP with mutual consent, resettable resource worlds for material gathering, and configurable gameplay options such as phantom toggling. The server maintains a no pay-to-win model — all gameplay advantages are obtainable through in-game effort, trading, or participation.

StellaRealm is moderated to encourage respectful interaction and a community-focused environment. The goal of the project is to provide a stable, balanced, and accessible survival experience without unnecessary complexity.

body:
![JSS^2 Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02966307ad14a64918dd54628c84adca0866ad75.jpeg)

# Welcome to JSS^2!

JSS^2 is a Legacy4J/Lite Legacy based Minecraft Server, designed to give you the best legacy console edition multiplayer experience you can get! However, you can also join the server on Vanilla as well.

JSS^2 has TWO worlds for you to play on! By default, you will join into Season 2's world.

You can get to the Season 1 world in JSS^2 by running /season1 and you can go back to Season 2 by doing /season2 (A third one may come eventually)

## A brief history of JSS and JSS^2!

JSS^2's is basically a revival of the original JSS. It was comprised of three seasons.
- Season 1 lasted from May 2024 to December 2024. 
- Season 2 lasted from January 2025 to June 2025.
- Season 3 lasted from June 2025 to September 2025.

In September 2025, I took a break from the internet and also brought the server down during that time. This brings us to December 2025, when I came back and JSS^2 launched in a whitelist, invite only state. It then went public on February 18th, 2025.

title: Vanilla Squad
description: Приватный ванильный сервер Minecraft с классическим выживанием без привата, доната и лишних плагинов.
body:
VanillaSquad — это приватный сервер, который максимально приближен к атмосфере ванильного Майнкрафта. Здесь вас ждёт огромный открытый мир, приятная дружеская атмосфера и минимальное количество ограничений. На сервере используются самописные плагины и датапаки, которые не нарушают баланс и не ломают дух классического выживания. У нас нет телепортаций, привата, доната, стартовых китов и прочей «халявы». Всё это позволяет сохранить настоящую ванильность игры и подарить игрокам опыт, который сложно найти на других серверах СНГ. Выживайте, стройте, творите, общайтесь и находите новых друзей!

Здесь вам точно не будет скучно. Игроки сервера могут открывать собственные магазины с продуманной системой торговли, которая защищена от дестабилизации цен. Кроме того, на VanillaSquad регулярно проводятся различные ивенты, конкурсы и мероприятия, в которых можно как поучаствовать, так и организовать их самостоятельно. У нас существуют целые города и деревни, каждый из которых имеет собственный стиль, уклад и развлечения. Однако ничто не мешает вам построить автономный бункер в глубинах огромного мира и жить в полной независимости. Онлайн у нас стабильно высокий, поэтому даже поздней ночью вы обязательно встретите других игроков.

Особое внимание мы уделяем дополнительным мирам:

● Мир построек — для масштабных проектов, где игроки создают огромные города, крепости и памятники архитектуры.  
● Мир ферм — для технических решений и автоматизации, чтобы вы могли развивать экономику и ресурсы без перегрузки основного мира.  
● Мир артов — уникальное место для творческих игроков, где можно создавать пиксель-арты и арт-объекты.

Цель сервера заключается не в зарабатывании денег, а в постоянном развитии и улучшении проекта. Мы не стремимся превратить игру в источник прибыли, в отличие от множества других приватных серверов. Для нас главное — интерес и вовлечённость игроков. Развиваясь, проект привлекает новую аудиторию, что естественным образом обеспечивает ему устойчивость и долгосрочное существование.

Честная игра — наш приоритет. Гриферство, читы, воровство и токсичное поведение строго запрещены. За любое подобное нарушение игрок получает бан, а пострадавшие постройки восстанавливаются администрацией. На сервере также действует система, позволяющая быстро выявлять нарушителей и передавать информацию модераторам, которые максимально оперативно реагируют на жалобы. Агрессивное поведение в чате также пресекается: те, кто нарушает правила общения, надолго покидают наш проект.

Администрация VanillaSquad — это целая команда, а не один человек. Главный администратор, разработчики плагинов, технический администратор, менеджеры, бухгалтерия и модерация — каждый занимается своей сферой, обеспечивая стабильную и качественную работу проекта.

Финансовая устойчивость. Многие сервера закрываются из-за отсутствия бюджета. Мы заранее позаботились об этом, сформировав резерв, который позволяет поддерживать проект даже в случае временных убытков. Это значит, что сервер не будет закрыт внезапно. Мы работаем с 2019 года, и это является лучшей гарантией надёжности и серьёзного подхода к делу.

Наши особенности:

● уникальные самописные плагины;  
● датапаки, сохраняющие ванильную атмосферу;  
● большой функциональный сайт;  
● регулярные обновления;  
● отдельные игровые миры (построек, ферм и артов);  
● и самое ценное — наше сообщество игроков, которое по праву можно назвать золотым.

Оборудование. VanillaSquad работает на выделенном сервере, а не на дешёвом хостинге, что обеспечивает стабильность и комфортную игру. За технической стороной проекта следят опытные администраторы, которые уже много лет занимаются этой сферой. Ядро сервера всегда обновлено до актуальной версии и включает последние исправления. За производительность отвечает мощный процессор Ryzen 9 9950x, что гарантирует стабильную работу и отсутствие лагов.

Присоединение к серверу. Чтобы стать полноценным участником VanillaSquad, необходимо привязать аккаунт Discord к игровому аккаунту Minecraft. Процесс максимально прост:

1. При входе на сервер вы получите четырёхзначный код.  
2. Отправьте этот код в специальный канал Discord #⁠отправь-код-сюда.

Based on our previous server Cobblemon Explorers , We've built this server for Cobblemon 1.7 (MC version 1.21.1 Fabric) , so If you're looking for a server built around a player-driven economy, relaxing and rewarding farming, Cobblemon adventures, and a friendly, tight-knit community, all with no pay to win? ✨ Player-based Economy — Trade, buy, sell, and build your wealth your way while saving up to try to increase your claim size.

🎊  Cobblemon — Many Cobblemon Additions you know and love, and now ride your Cobblemon in style as the new method of transportation ! NO waystones in this pack to keep the world feeling big and inspire community driven projects like roads and tunnels for us to use our pokemon on ! Raids, Different sized Pokemon, Battle Tower, Safari zone, Dex rewards, All Gimmicks (mega,dynamax,tera etc) and a small region built to house a small story + more. title: Cobblemon Callisto
description: Non-Pay2Win survival server featuring all Pokémon, ultra-rare Luminous and Exalted shiny tiers, 400+ custom-textured Pokémon, permanent overworlds, Pokédex rank progression, earnable perks, weekly Legendary Raids and more!
body:
# 🌟 Welcome to Cobblemon Callisto! 🌟

Cobblemon Callisto is a relatively new Non-Pay2Win Survival server built from the ground up for a long-term, engaging, and community-focused Pokémon adventure.

The server is built to last, with no planned wipes for our main worlds and alot of planned features for the future.

## What Makes Callisto Unique?
### ✨ Custom Shiny Tiers
Inspired by PokéRogue, our server features not just standard shinies, but also ultra-rare Luminous and Exalted shinies! We have over 200 custom-textured Pokémon at launch, with the long-term goal of giving every single Pokémon its own unique shiny tier textures.

### 🌍 Choose Your World:
We offer two distinct Overworlds to build your legacy in!
Terralith: Explore breathtaking, custom biomes and landscapes.
Vanilla/Beta Hybrid: A nostalgic experience blending modern Minecraft with the feel of classic world generation.
Both worlds are permanent and filled with custom structures to discover.

### 🏆 Deep Progression Systems
Your journey is filled with goals and rewards.
Pokédex Ranks: Progress through 10 unique ranks by completing your Pokédex. Each rank-up grants you powerful perks and one-time rewards packed with valuable items.
Custom Titles: Unlock over 120 unique, tiered titles through our custom advancement system.
Levelables (Jobs): Level up professions like Mining or Pokémon Training to earn permanent, gameplay-enhancing buffs.

### 💖 A Fair & Rewarding Experience
Earn Your Power: All gameplay-altering perks (like /pc, extra homes, etc.) are unlocked by completing your Pokédex.
Support the Server: For those who wish to support our development, our store offers paid ranks that grant the perks of some Pokédex milestones as a "thank you" shortcut.
Earnable Cosmetics: You can earn a premium currency, Nova Crystals, through gameplay (events etc.). This allows you to get items from our cosmetic shop at a discount, or even completely for free, just by playing.

## Current Features

- ✅ | All Pokémon Implemented and obtainable: 99%+ are fully modeled
- ✨ | PokéRogue inspired Shiny Tiers: Luminous & Exalted with already over 200 custom textures
- 🥚 | Pokémon Breeding
- ⛓️ | Catch Combos
- 💿 | Move Tutors & TMs
- 📏 | Pokémon Size Variation:
- 🏆 | Pokédex Rank Progression
- ⛏️ | Jobs System: level up professions for permanent buffs.
- ✒️ | Over 120 Custom Prefix Titles
- 🎁 | Kits & Daily Reward Calendar
- 💰 | Player-Run Economy: Chest Shops for items & GTS for Pokémon.
- ❓ | WonderTrade
- 🎉 | Regular Events & Competitions
- 🗓️ | Weekly Shiny Days: decided by community votes!
- 🎤 | In-Game Voice Chat

- 🛡️ | Land Claiming
- 🪑 | Custom Furniture
- ⚙️ | QoL Commands like /rtp, /tpa, /home, /back, etc.
- 🌀 | Server & Player Warps

- 🪓 | Vein Miner & Tree Feller
- 🚀 | Heavily Optimized for a smooth, lag-free experience.

title: Cobblemon Eclipse
description: Cobblemon Eclipse Minecraft server. Explore. Battle. Evolve. The stars await.
body:
This modpack has Cobblemon alongside many QoL and performance mods to make your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable.
Designed to be lightweight and highly optimized, it runs comfortably even on lower-end PCs.

---

🚫 No pay-to-win. Not now, not ever.
You cannot buy stats or advantages. Every strong team on this server was earned by playing.

--- You can also join the **Cobblemon Eclipse** server directly from the start menu. Begin your adventure, catch Pokémon, battle gyms, and play together with friends online.
🌒 Server Features --- ### 🐾 Pokémon & Gameplay - Mega Evolutions (classic + ZA megas) - World Boss — up to 100 players in their own 1v1, all damage feeds one shared HP pool - CobbleSkills — 19 skills up to level 999, including Cobblemon-specific ones (shiny hunting, catching) - Alphas — large wild Pokémon fought with real Minecraft combat; legendary alphas are multi-phase boss fights - Catch Combos with bad-luck protection (longer hunts quietly improve your odds) - Area Zero — all 20 paradox Pokémon on Scarlet/Violet-matching spawn tables - Daily Dungeons - Safari Zone - Legendaries & Mythicals - Custom Fakemon - Radiant Shinies - Pokémon Breeding & Hidden Abilities - Pokédex Rewards - Research Tasks - Free Seasonal Battlepass - Events Hosted 4× Weekly - Player Gyms & NPC Gyms — 8 gyms → Elite Four → Champion, with Hard Mode - Battle Tower - Tournaments — every couple of weeks, live bracket on the wiki - Outbreaks - Build Competitions - In-Game Voice Chat (Optional) --- ### 🌍 Survival & Worlds - Weekly Resetting Resource World - Vanilla Mobs - Terralith, Nullscape Biomes - Flan Land Claiming & Base Protection - Public Homes, Towns, & Warps - Server Villager Hall --- ### 💰 Economy & Shops - Daily & Weekly Kits - Player-Driven Economy - In-Game Shops, WonderTrade, & GTS - Decorative Head Shop - Hidden Ability Shop - Shiny & Hidden Ability Crates - Earned naturally by playing — **never sold**
--- ### 🚫 Genuinely not pay-to-win and we mean it Most servers say this. Here's exactly what it means on Eclipse: - **You cannot buy Pokémon.** No store listing will ever hand you a shiny, a legendary, or a competitive team. If you want strong Pokémon, you catch and breed them like everyone else. - **Ranks come from playtime**, not your wallet. The players with the highest ranks have simply been here the longest. - **Crates are earned by playing** — through gameplay, events, and natural progression. They are not for sale, period. - **Store purchases don't give competitive edges.** Most of the store is cosmetics. The non-cosmetic options are server-wide boosts (shiny rates, breeding) that apply to every player on the server equally — not just the buyer. - **No pay-to-win has ever existed here** — this isn't a recent policy change, it's how the server has always been built. If you've been burned by p2w Cobblemon servers before, Eclipse was specifically designed as the alternative. --- ### 📖 The wiki We run a deep wiki at **[cobblemoneclipse.com](https://cobblemoneclipse.com)** — the most detailed Cobblemon Pokédex online, plus a spawn finder, damage calculator, and the live tournament bracket. Worth a look even if you don't end up playing. ### 🚀 Getting on Install this pack (one click in the Modrinth app or Prism), launch it, and pick **Cobblemon Eclipse** from the multiplayer menu. Server IP if you ever need it by hand: `play.cobblemoneclipse.com`. Discord is **[discord.gg/cobblemoneclipse](https://discord.gg/cobblemoneclipse)** if you want to ask anything before hopping on.

title: RP Register Plugin
description: An RP registration plugin for AuthMe that requires new players to create a character with a custom profession before they can move or play on the server.
body:
AuthMe ile giriş yapan yeni oyuncuları, sunucuya özel meslekler içeren bir karakter oluşturma menüsüne zorlayan bir RP kayıt eklentisidir. Oyuncular kayıt olmadan sunucuda hareket edemez.

Ana Özellikler:

Zorunlu Kayıt: Yeni oyuncular, karakterlerini (İsim, Yaş, Cinsiyet, Meslek) oluşturana kadar kilitlenir.

Dinamik Meslek Sistemi: roles.yml dosyasından 7 adede kadar tamamen özelleştirilebilir meslek ekleyin.

Oyun-içi Yönetim: Yöneticiler, /meslekduzenle komutuyla açılan menülerden meslekleri kolayca ekleyebilir, silebilir ve düzenleyebilir.

Özel/Genel Roller: Meslekleri herkesin seçebileceği (Genel) veya sadece bir yetkilinin atayabileceği (Özel) olarak ayarlayın.

Karakter Yönetimi: Oyuncular için /meslekdegistir ve /kayityenile (onaylı) komutları mevcuttur.

Özelleştirilebilir: config.yml üzerinden sunucuya özel hoş geldin başlığı gibi ayarları değiştirin.

Yönetici İçin Hızlı Başlangıç:

Meslekleri Ayarla: Sunucunuzun plugins/RPRegisterPlugin/roles.yml dosyasını açarak sunucunuza özel meslekleri oluşturun.

Oyun-içi Düzenleme: Ya da doğrudan oyuna girip /meslekduzenle komutunu kullanarak menüler aracılığıyla meslekleri yönetin.

Değişiklikleri Uygula: roles.yml dosyasında bir değişiklik yaptıysanız, sunucuyu yeniden başlatmadan /meslekyenile komutunu kullanın.

Önemli Komutlar:

/meslekduzenle - (Admin) Meslekleri oyun içinden yönetir.

/meslekata <oyuncu> <meslek_id> - (Admin) Bir oyuncuya özel bir meslek atar.

/meslekdegistir - (Oyuncu) Genel meslekler arasında geçiş yapar.

Gereksinimler: Spigot/Paper 1.21+ ve AuthMe.

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

"RP Register Plugin" is an RP registration plugin that forces new players logging in with AuthMe to create a character through a server-specific profession menu. Players cannot move on the server without registering.

Key Features:
Mandatory Registration: New players are locked until they create their character (Name, Age, Gender, Profession).

Dynamic Profession System: Add up to 7 fully customizable professions from the roles.yml file.

In-Game Management: Admins can easily add, delete, and edit professions via the /meslekduzenle command menu.

Public/Private Roles: Set professions as either selectable by anyone (Public) or assignable only by an admin (Private).

Character Management: Players can use /meslekdegistir (change profession) and /kayityenile (renew registration, admin-approved).

Customizable: Modify server-specific settings (e.g., welcome title) via config.yml.

Quick Start for Admins:
Set Up Professions: Open plugins/RPRegisterPlugin/roles.yml and create custom professions for your server.

In-Game Editing: Alternatively, use the /meslekduzenle command in-game to manage professions via menus.

Apply Changes: If you edit roles.yml, use /meslekyenile to apply changes without restarting the server.

Important Commands:
/meslekduzenle – (Admin) Manage professions in-game.

/meslekata <player> <profession_id> – (Admin) Assign a private profession to a player.

/meslekdegistir – (Player) Switch between public professions.

Requirements: Spigot/Paper 1.21+ and AuthMe.
